entry.summary: Identifies three missing protocol-level primitives in MCP (Model Context Protocol) for production AI agents: identity propagation, adaptive tool budgeting, and structured error semantics. Proposes mechanisms to fill these gaps based on enterprise deployment experience.

entry.title: GPrune-LLM: Generalization-Aware Structured Pruning for Large Language Models

author.name: Xiaoyun Liu, Divya Saxena, Jiannong Cao, Yuqing Zhao, Yiying Dong, Penghui Ruan

entry.summary: Proposes GPrune-LLM, a structured pruning method that accounts for distribution sensitivity of neurons across calibration datasets, separating distribution-robust from distribution-sensitive neurons for better cross-task generalization.

entry.title: Reconciling In-Context and In-Weight Learning via Dual Representation Space Encoding

author.name: Guanyu Chen, Ruichen Wang, Tianren Zhang, Feng Chen

entry.summary: Identifies shared encoding space as a source of conflict between in-context and in-weight learning in Transformers, and proposes dual representation space encoding to separate task and sample representations.

entry.title: REFINE-DP: Diffusion Policy Fine-tuning for Humanoid Loco-manipulation via Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Zhaoyuan Gu, Yipu Chen, Zimeng Chai, Alfred Cueva, Thong Nguyen, Yifan Wu, Huishu Xue, Minji Kim, Isaac Legene, Fukang Liu, Matthew Kim, Ayan Barula, Yongxin Chen, Ye Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes REFINE-DP, a framework combining reinforcement learning fine-tuning with diffusion policies for humanoid loco-manipulation. Jointly optimizes high-level motion planning and low-level whole-body control.

entry.title: Deeper Thought, Weaker Aim: Understanding and Mitigating Perceptual Impairment during Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Ruiying Peng, Xueyu Wu, Jing Lei, Lu Hou, Yuanzheng Ma, Xiaohui Li

entry.summary: Identifies that extended reasoning in MLLMs causes attention dispersion away from question-relevant visual regions, and proposes methods to mitigate this 'deeper thought, weaker aim' phenomenon.

entry.title: ECG-Reasoning-Benchmark: A Benchmark for Evaluating Clinical Reasoning Capabilities in ECG Interpretation

author.name: Jungwoo Oh, Hyunseung Chung, Junhee Lee, Min-Gyu Kim, Hangyul Yoon, Ki Seong Lee, Youngchae Lee, Muhan Yeo, Edward Choi

entry.summary: Introduces ECG-Reasoning-Benchmark with 6,400+ samples to evaluate step-by-step clinical reasoning in ECG interpretation by MLLMs. Reveals that models achieve near-zero success (6%) in maintaining coherent multi-step reasoning despite having relevant medical knowledge.

entry.title: VLA-Thinker: Boosting Vision-Language-Action Models through Thinking-with-Image Reasoning

author.name: Chaoyang Wang, Wenrui Bao, Sicheng Gao, Bingxin Xu, Yu Tian, Yogesh S. Rawat, Yunhao Ge, Yuzhang Shang

entry.summary: VLA-Thinker introduces a thinking-with-image reasoning framework for Vision-Language-Action models where perception is a dynamically invocable reasoning action. Uses SFT cold-start plus GRPO-based RL for training.

entry.title: FlashHead: Efficient Drop-In Replacement for the Classification Head in Language Model Inference

author.name: Wilhelm Tranheden, Shahnawaz Ahmed, Devdatt Dubhashi, Jonna Matthiesen, Hannes von Essen

entry.summary: FlashHead replaces the dense classification head in LLMs with a retrieval-based approach using balanced clustering, achieving significant speedup. The head accounts for up to 60% of parameters and 50% of inference compute in small models.

entry.title: HO-SFL: Hybrid-Order Split Federated Learning with Backprop-Free Clients and Dimension-Free Aggregation

author.name: Qiyuan Chen, Xian Wu, Yi Wang, Xianhao Chen

entry.summary: HO-SFL proposes a hybrid split federated learning approach where servers use first-order backpropagation while clients use memory-efficient zeroth-order optimization. This decoupling eliminates the need for client-side backpropagation, enabling fine-tuning of large models on edge devices. Uses a Lagrangian framework to reformulate the split learning process.

entry.title: Architecture-Agnostic Feature Synergy for Universal Defense Against Heterogeneous Generative Threats

author.name: Bingxue Zhang, Yang Gao, Feida Zhu, Yanyan Shen, Yang Shi

entry.summary: Proposes architecture-agnostic defense against heterogeneous generative AI threats by working in feature space rather than pixel space. Identifies that pixel-level gradients from different generators become statistically orthogonal, causing destructive interference. High-level features align across architectures, enabling unified defense.

entry.title: Sample-Efficient Hypergradient Estimation for Decentralized Bi-Level Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Mikoto Kudo, Takumi Tanabe, Akifumi Wachi, Youhei Akimoto

entry.summary: Derives hypergradient estimation for decentralized bi-level reinforcement learning where a leader optimizes while only observing follower optimization outcomes. Addresses sample efficiency in scenarios like warehouse robot environment design. Novel contribution to the intersection of bi-level optimization and RL.

entry.title: OrgForge: A Multi-Agent Simulation Framework for Verifiable Synthetic Corporate Corpora

author.name: Jeffrey Flynt

entry.summary: OrgForge is a multi-agent simulation framework that generates synthetic corporate corpora with strict ground-truth guarantees for evaluating RAG pipelines. Uses a deterministic Python engine to maintain a ground truth bus while LLMs generate natural language, preventing cross-document hallucination. Addresses legal and quality issues with existing evaluation corpora.

entry.title: AnoleVLA: Lightweight Vision-Language-Action Model with Deep State Space Models for Mobile Manipulation

author.name: Yusuke Takagi, Motonari Kambara, Daichi Yashima, Koki Seno, Kento Tokura, Komei Sugiura

entry.summary: AnoleVLA proposes a lightweight Vision-Language-Action model using deep state space models instead of transformer backbones for robotic manipulation. Addresses computational cost challenges for deployment in resource-constrained environments. Enables language-guided manipulation with efficient multimodal sequence processing.

entry.title: Safe Flow Q-Learning: Offline Safe Reinforcement Learning with Reachability-Based Flow Policies

author.name: Mumuksh Tayal, Manan Tayal, Ravi Prakash

entry.summary: SafeFQL extends Flow Q-Learning to safe offline RL by combining Hamilton-Jacobi reachability-based safety value functions with one-step flow policies. Trains a safety value via self-consistency Bellman recursion and distills into a one-step actor for deployment without rejection sampling. Addresses strict safety constraints in offline RL.

entry.title: Physics-informed fine-tuning of foundation models for partial differential equations

author.name: Vlad Medvedev, Leon Armbruster, Christopher Straub, Georg Kruse, Andreas Rosskopf

entry.summary: Introduces physics-informed fine-tuning for PDE foundation models, incorporating physical constraints when adapting pre-trained models to new tasks. Systematically studies the potential of physics-informed approaches for fine-tuning data-based foundation models. Addresses limited task-specific data and distribution shifts.

entry.title: Agentic workflow enables the recovery of critical materials from complex feedstocks via selective precipitation

author.name: Andrew Ritchhart, Sarah I. Allec, Pravalika Butreddy, Krista Kulesa, Qingpu Wang, Dan Thien Nguyen, Maxim Ziatdinov, Elias Nakouzi

entry.summary: Presents a multi-agent AI workflow for recovering critical materials from produced water and magnet leachates, achieving selective precipitation from real-world feedstocks in days rather than months.

entry.title: Few Batches or Little Memory, But Not Both: Simultaneous Space and Adaptivity Constraints in Stochastic Bandits

author.name: Ruiyuan Huang, Zicheng Lyu, Xiaoyi Zhu, Zengfeng Huang

entry.summary: Proves fundamental trade-offs between memory (W bits) and adaptivity (B batches) in stochastic multi-armed bandits, showing both constraints together are fundamentally harder than either alone.

entry.title: Interleaved Resampling and Refitting: Data and Compute-Efficient Evaluation of Black-Box Predictors

author.name: Haichen Hu, David Simchi-Levi

entry.summary: Develops a data-efficient and compute-efficient method for evaluating excess risk of large-scale models using wild refitting and resampling. Requires only a single dataset and refitting on much smaller datasets rather than full-scale retraining.

entry.title: Windowed Fourier Propagator: A Frequency-Local Neural Operator for Wave Equations in Inhomogeneous Media

author.name: Yiyang Cai, Zixuan Qiu, Yunlu Shu, Jiamao Wu, Yingzhou Li, Tianyu Wang, Xi Chen

entry.summary: Proposes Windowed Fourier Propagator (WFP), a neural operator for wave equations in inhomogeneous media that exploits frequency locality — wave energy scatters to adjacent frequencies — to learn compact localized propagators instead of dense interaction models.

entry.title: WestWorld: A Knowledge-Encoded Scalable Trajectory World Model for Diverse Robotic Systems

author.name: Yuchen Wang, Jiangtao Kong, Sizhe Wei, Xiaochang Li, Haohong Lin, Hongjue Zhao, Tianyi Zhou, Lu Gan, Huajie Shao

entry.summary: Introduces WestWorld, a trajectory world model for diverse robotic systems using system-aware Mixture-of-Experts (Sys-MoE) with learnable system embeddings and physical domain knowledge for zero-shot generalization across different robot dynamics.

entry.title: Towards One-for-All Anomaly Detection for Tabular Data

author.name: Shiyuan Li, Yixin Liu, Yu Zheng, Xiaofeng Cao, Shirui Pan, Heng Tao Shen

entry.summary: Proposes OFA-TAD, a one-for-all tabular anomaly detection framework that trains once on multiple source datasets and generalizes to unseen datasets. Uses neighbor-distance patterns and multi-view neighbor-based representations as transferable cues.

entry.title: CAMD: Coverage-Aware Multimodal Decoding for Efficient Reasoning of Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Huijie Guo, Jingyao Wang, Lingyu Si, Jiahuan Zhou, Changwen Zheng, Wenwen Qiang

entry.summary: Proposes Coverage-Aware Multimodal Decoding (CAMD) for efficient reasoning in MLLMs, developing theory linking sampling coverage to instance difficulty and allocating more compute to harder instances based on heavy-tailed difficulty distributions.

entry.title: Understanding the geometry of deep learning with decision boundary volume

author.name: Matthew Burfitt, Jacek Brodzki, Pawel D{\l}otko

entry.summary: Introduces a method to measure neural network decision boundary geometry through local surface volumes inspired by Weyl's classical tube formula. Shows smaller surface volume corresponds to lower complexity and better generalization.

entry.title: Dataset Distillation Efficiently Encodes Low-Dimensional Representations from Gradient-Based Learning of Non-Linear Tasks

author.name: Yuri Kinoshita, Naoki Nishikawa, Taro Toyoizumi

entry.summary: Theoretically analyzes dataset distillation for two-layer neural networks on multi-index models, proving that low-dimensional task structure is efficiently encoded into distilled data points with provable recovery guarantees.

entry.title: Local Urysohn Width: A Topological Complexity Measure for Classification

author.name: Xin Li

entry.summary: Introduces local Urysohn width as a topological complexity measure for classification problems that characterizes the problem itself rather than hypothesis classes, proving hierarchy theorems and connections to feature dimension bounds.

entry.title: When Should Humans Step In? Optimal Human Dispatching in AI-Assisted Decisions

author.name: Lezhi Tan, Naomi Sagan, Lihua Lei, Jose Blanchet

entry.summary: Proposes a decision-theoretic framework for optimally allocating costly human review of AI assessments, treating AI outputs as factor-level signals and human judgments as selectively acquired information. Develops reward estimation methods for policy design.

entry.title: Physics-Informed Policy Optimization via Analytic Dynamics Regularization

author.name: Namai Chandra, Liu Mohan, Zhihao Gu, Lin Wang

entry.summary: Introduces PIPER, a physics-informed RL framework that integrates a differentiable Lagrangian residual as a regularization term into neural policy optimization, addressing high sample complexity and physically inconsistent actions in robotic control.

entry.title: Tactile Modality Fusion for Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Charlotte Morissette, Amin Abyaneh, Wei-Di Chang, Anas Houssaini, David Meger, Hsiu-Chin Lin, Jonathan Tremblay, Gregory Dudek

entry.summary: Proposes TacFiLM, a lightweight approach to fuse visual-tactile signals into vision-language-action models for robot manipulation, addressing the limitation that current VLA models rely solely on vision and miss contact-rich interaction dynamics.

entry.title: Neural Networks as Local-to-Global Computations

author.name: Vicente Bosca, Robert Ghrist

entry.summary: Constructs a cellular sheaf from any feedforward ReLU neural network, showing the forward pass output is the unique harmonic extension of boundary data and that the sheaf heat equation converges exponentially to this output despite piecewise-linear activations.

entry.title: Modeling and Benchmarking Spoken Dialogue Rewards with Modality and Colloquialness

author.name: Jingyu Lu, Yuhan Wang, Fan Zhuo, Xize Cheng, Changhao Pan, Xueyi Pu, Yifu Chen, Chenyuhao Wen, Tianle Liang, Zhou Zhao

entry.summary: Introduces SDiaReward, an end-to-end multi-turn spoken dialogue reward model that operates directly on speech episodes, addressing the modality gap (prosody, emotion) and colloquialness gap between written and spoken conversation.

entry.title: Can We Trust LLMs on Memristors? Diving into Reasoning Ability under Non-Ideality

author.name: Taiqiang Wu, Yuxin Cheng, Chenchen Ding, Runming Yang, Xincheng Feng, Wenyong Zhou, Zhengwu Liu, Ngai Wong

entry.summary: Investigates LLM reasoning reliability when deployed on memristor-based analog compute-in-memory hardware, finding significant degradation and evaluating training-free mitigation strategies including thinking mode, in-context learning, and module redundancy.

entry.title: SemantiCache: Efficient KV Cache Compression via Semantic Chunking and Clustered Merging

author.name: Shunlong Wu, Hai Lin, Shaoshen Chen, Tingwei Lu, Yongqin Zeng, Shaoxiong Zhan, Hai-Tao Zheng, Hong-Gee Kim

entry.summary: Proposes SemantiCache, a KV cache compression framework that preserves semantic integrity by partitioning cache into semantically coherent chunks using natural language delimiters, then applying a Greedy Seed-Based Clustering algorithm within chunks.

entry.title: Efficient Document Parsing via Parallel Token Prediction

author.name: Lei Li, Ze Zhao, Meng Li, Zhongwang Lun, Yi Yuan, Xingjing Lu, Zheng Wei, Jiang Bian, Zang Li

entry.summary: Proposes Parallel-Token Prediction (PTP), a model-agnostic method enabling VLMs to generate multiple tokens in parallel for document parsing by inserting learnable tokens with corresponding training objectives, achieving significant speedup.

entry.title: Beyond the Covariance Trap: Unlocking Generalization in Same-Subject Knowledge Editing for Large Language Models

author.name: Xiyu Liu, Qingyi Si, Zhengxiao Liu, Chenxu Yang, Naibin Gu, Zheng Lin

entry.summary: Identifies a geometric root cause for generalization failure in knowledge editing of LLMs: inner activation drifts from prompt variations exceed the model's geometric tolerance after editing. Proposes solutions to the 'covariance trap' that causes narrow minima.

entry.title: The Reasoning Bottleneck in Graph-RAG: Structured Prompting and Context Compression for Multi-Hop QA

author.name: Yasaman Zarinkia, Venkatesh Srinivasan, Alex Thomo

entry.summary: Identifies that 73-84% of Graph-RAG errors are reasoning failures despite high retrieval recall. Proposes SPARQL chain-of-thought prompting and graph-walk compression (~60% context reduction) to improve multi-hop QA with Graph-RAG systems.

entry.title: Learning Generalizable 3D Medical Image Representations from Mask-Guided Self-Supervision

author.name: Yunhe Gao, Yabin Zhang, Chong Wang, Jiaming Liu, Maya Varma, Jean-Benoit Delbrouck, Akshay Chaudhari, Curtis Langlotz

entry.summary: Presents MASS, a self-supervised learning method for 3D medical images that uses in-context segmentation with class-agnostic masks as the pretext task. Learns general-purpose medical imaging representations that transfer to diverse downstream tasks.

entry.title: Not All Directions Matter: Toward Structured and Task-Aware Low-Rank Adaptation

author.name: Xi Xiao, Chenrui Ma, Yunbei Zhang, Chen Liu, Zhuxuanzi Wang, Yanshu Li, Lin Zhao, Guosheng Hu, Tianyang Wang, Hao Xu

entry.summary: Introduces StructLoRA, which improves LoRA fine-tuning by adding an information bottleneck filter for task-relevant directions and a graph-based coordinator for inter-layer consistency.

entry.title: Mapping Dark-Matter Clusters via Physics-Guided Diffusion Models

author.name: Diego Royo, Brandon Zhao, Adolfo Mu\~noz, Diego Gutierrez, Katherine L. Bouman

entry.summary: Uses physics-guided diffusion models to reconstruct dark matter mass distributions in galaxy clusters from gravitational lensing, introducing DarkClusters-15k, the largest simulation benchmark for this task.

entry.title: LatSearch: Latent Reward-Guided Search for Faster Inference-Time Scaling in Video Diffusion

author.name: Zengqun Zhao, Ziquan Liu, Yu Cao, Shaogang Gong, Zhensong Zhang, Jifei Song, Jiankang Deng, Ioannis Patras

entry.summary: LatSearch introduces latent reward-guided search for faster inference-time scaling in video diffusion, providing denser reward signals during the denoising process rather than only at the end.

entry.title: Spectrum Matching: a Unified Perspective for Superior Diffusability in Latent Diffusion

author.name: Mang Ning, Mingxiao Li, Le Zhang, Lanmiao Liu, Matthew B. Blaschko, Albert Ali Salah, Itir Onal Ertugrul

entry.summary: Introduces the Spectrum Matching Hypothesis for VAE latent spaces in diffusion models, proposing that latents should have flattened power-law PSD and preserve frequency-to-frequency correspondence through the decoder.

entry.title: RealVLG-R1: A Large-Scale Real-World Visual-Language Grounding Benchmark for Robotic Perception and Manipulation

author.name: Linfei Li, Lin Zhang, Ying Shen

entry.summary: Introduces RealVLG framework with an 11B-sample dataset and R1 model for unified real-world visual-language grounding and robotic grasping, providing multi-granularity annotations including bounding boxes and grasping poses.

entry.title: FAR-Drive: Frame-AutoRegressive Video Generation in Closed-Loop Autonomous Driving

author.name: Yaoru Li, Federico Landi, Marco Godi, Xin Jin, Ruiju Fu, Yufei Ma, Muyang Sun, Heyu Si, Qi Guo

entry.summary: Proposes FAR-Drive, a frame-level autoregressive video generation framework for closed-loop autonomous driving simulation, addressing temporal consistency, autoregressive degradation, and low-latency inference.

entry.title: Riemannian Motion Generation: A Unified Framework for Human Motion Representation and Generation via Riemannian Flow Matching

author.name: Fangran Miao, Jian Huang, Ting Li

entry.summary: Presents RMG, a framework for human motion generation on product manifolds using Riemannian flow matching. Achieves SOTA FID (0.043) on HumanML3D by respecting the non-Euclidean geometry of human motion.

entry.title: Next-Frame Decoding for Ultra-Low-Bitrate Image Compression with Video Diffusion Priors

author.name: Yunuo Chen, Chuqin Zhou, Jiangchuan Li, Xiaoyue Ling, Bing He, Jincheng Dai, Li Song, Guo Lu

entry.summary: Proposes using video diffusion priors for ultra-low-bitrate image compression by reinterpreting generative decoding as next-frame prediction from a compact anchor frame to the reconstructed image.

entry.title: Flash-Unified: A Training-Free and Task-Aware Acceleration Framework for Native Unified Models

author.name: Junlong Ke, Zichen Wen, Boxue Yang, Yantai Yang, Xuyang Liu, Chenfei Liao, Zhaorun Chen, Shaobo Wang, Linfeng Zhang

entry.summary: Presents Flash-Unified, a training-free acceleration framework for unified multimodal models that discovers parameter specialization and creates task-aware inference pathways for generation vs. understanding.

entry.title: Grounding World Simulation Models in a Real-World Metropolis

author.name: Junyoung Seo, Hyunwook Choi, Minkyung Kwon, Jinhyeok Choi, Siyoon Jin, Gayoung Lee, Junho Kim, JoungBin Lee, Geonmo Gu, Dongyoon Han, Sangdoo Yun, Seungryong Kim, Jin-Hwa Kim

entry.summary: Seoul World Model (SWM) is a city-scale world model grounded in real Seoul street-view imagery, using retrieval-augmented conditioning for autoregressive video generation of actual urban environments rather than imagined ones.

entry.title: Look Before Acting: Enhancing Vision Foundation Representations for Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Yulin Luo, Hao Chen, Zhuangzhe Wu, Bowen Sui, Jiaming Liu, Chenyang Gu, Zhuoyang Liu, Qiuxuan Feng, Jiale Yu, Shuo Gu, Peng Jia, Pheng-Ann Heng, Shanghang Zhang

entry.summary: Systematically analyzes how visual information is processed in Vision-Language-Action models, finding that sensitivity to visual tokens decreases in deeper layers during action generation. Proposes methods to enhance vision foundation representations for better robot manipulation.

entry.title: OCRA: Object-Centric Learning with 3D and Tactile Priors for Human-to-Robot Action Transfer

author.name: Kuanning Wang, Ke Fan, Yuqian Fu, Siyu Lin, Hu Luo, Daniel Seita, Yanwei Fu, Yu-Gang Jiang, Xiangyang Xue

entry.summary: OCRA is an object-centric framework for human-to-robot action transfer that uses multi-view RGB, 3D foundation models (VGGT), and tactile priors from over 1M tactile images to learn manipulation from human demonstration videos.

entry.title: Learning Actionable Manipulation Recovery via Counterfactual Failure Synthesis

author.name: Dayou Li, Jiuzhou Lei, Hao Wang, Lulin Liu, Yunhao Yang, Zihan Wang, Bangya Liu, Minghui Zheng, Zhiwen Fan

entry.summary: Dream2Fix synthesizes photorealistic counterfactual failure rollouts from successful demonstrations for robot manipulation recovery learning, bridging the gap between failure diagnosis and actionable trajectory-level corrections.

entry.title: ForceVLA2: Unleashing Hybrid Force-Position Control with Force Awareness for Contact-Rich Manipulation

author.name: Yang Li, Zhaxizhuoma, Hongru Jiang, Junjie Xia, Hongquan Zhang, Jinda Du, Yunsong Zhou, Jia Zeng, Ce Hao, Jieji Ren, Qiaojun Yu, Cewu Lu, Yu Qiao, Jiangmiao Pang

entry.summary: ForceVLA2 proposes an end-to-end VLA framework with hybrid force-position control and explicit force awareness for contact-rich manipulation. Uses force-based prompts in a VLM expert and Cross-Scale Mixture-of-Experts for fusing task concepts with real-time interaction forces.

entry.title: HapticVLA: Contact-Rich Manipulation via Vision-Language-Action Model without Inference-Time Tactile Sensing

author.name: Konstantin Gubernatorov, Mikhail Sannikov, Ilya Mikhalchuk, Egor Kuznetsov, Makar Artemov, Ogunwoye Faith Ouwatobi, Marcelino Fernando, Artem Asanov, Ziang Guo, Dzmitry Tsetserukou

entry.summary: HapticVLA demonstrates that tactile-aware manipulation can be learned offline and deployed without tactile sensors at inference time. Uses Safety-Aware Reward-Weighted Flow Matching for training and Tactile Distillation to transfer tactile knowledge into a vision-only policy.

entry.title: Types of Handoff to AIs

author.name: Daniel Kokotajlo

entry.summary: Daniel Kokotajlo distinguishes two types of AI handoff: trust-handoff (trusting AI not to cause harm when it could) and decision-handoff (allowing AI to make autonomous decisions). Argues this taxonomy is important for AI governance and policy discussions.

entry.title: AICRAFT: DARPA-Funded AI Alignment Researchers — Applications Open

author.name: Mike Vaiana

entry.summary: AICRAFT is a DARPA-funded project pairing alignment researchers with professional engineering teams for two-week pilot sprints to test high-risk alignment ideas. Selecting 6 applicants with possible 3-month extensions. Represents first direct DARPA engagement with alignment community.

entry.title: ViFeEdit: A Video-Free Tuner of Your Video Diffusion Transformer

author.name: Ruonan Yu, Zhenxiong Tan, Zigeng Chen, Songhua Liu, Xinchao Wang

entry.summary: Proposes ViFeEdit, a video-free tuning framework for video diffusion transformers that achieves versatile video generation and editing adapted solely with 2D images through architectural reparameterization.

entry.title: R3DP: Real-Time 3D-Aware Policy for Embodied Manipulation

author.name: Yuhao Zhang, Wanxi Dong, Yue Shi, Yi Liang, Jingnan Gao, Qiaochu Yang, Yaxing Lyu, Zhixuan Liang, Yibin Liu, Congsheng Xu, Xianda Guo, Wei Sui, Yaohui Jin, Xiaokang Yang, Yanyan Xu, Yao Mu

entry.summary: R3DP integrates 3D vision priors into real-time manipulation policies via an asynchronous fast-slow collaboration module. Queries large 3D models (VGGT) on sparse keyframes while maintaining real-time control through continuous fast processing.

entry.title: Dynamic Sparse Attention: Access Patterns and Architecture

author.name: Noam Levy

entry.summary: Analyzes dynamic sparse attention's system-level challenges, showing that token-dependent KV selection creates fragmented cache access patterns, and proposes a last-level cache reservation strategy to mitigate the problem.

entry.title: Design Space of Self--Consistent Electrostatic Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials

author.name: William J. Baldwin, Ilyes Batatia, Martin Vondr\'ak, Johannes T. Margraf, G\'abor Cs\'anyi

entry.summary: Provides a comprehensive review of the design space for self-consistent electrostatic machine learning interatomic potentials, covering architectures from locally predicted charges to self-consistent models that handle long-range electrostatics, charge transfer, and polarization.

entry.title: Bridging Scene Generation and Planning: Driving with World Model via Unifying Vision and Motion Representation

author.name: Xingtai Gui, Meijie Zhang, Tianyi Yan, Wencheng Han, Jiahao Gong, Feiyang Tan, Cheng-zhong Xu, Jianbing Shen

entry.summary: Presents WorldDrive, a framework coupling scene generation and planning via unified vision and motion representation, introducing a trajectory-aware driving world model that bridges the gap between visual generation and motion planning.

entry.title: SNCE: Geometry-Aware Supervision for Scalable Discrete Image Generation

author.name: Shufan Li, Jiuxiang Gu, Kangning Liu, Zhe Lin, Aditya Grover, Jason Kuen

entry.summary: Proposes Stochastic Neighbor Cross Entropy (SNCE), a soft training objective for discrete image generators with large VQ codebooks, constructing probability distributions over neighboring tokens rather than hard one-hot targets.

entry.title: Human Attribution of Causality to AI Across Agency, Misuse, and Misalignment

author.name: Maria Victoria Carro, David Lagnado

entry.summary: Investigates how people attribute causal responsibility and blame when AI systems are involved in harmful outcomes. Finds that higher AI agency leads to greater causal attribution to AI, and that misalignment scenarios increase blame on developers. Provides empirical grounding for liability frameworks as AI agents become more autonomous.

entry.title: GroupGuard: A Framework for Modeling and Defending Collusive Attacks in Multi-Agent Systems

author.name: Yiling Tao, Xinran Zheng, Shuo Yang, Meiling Tao, Xingjun Wang

entry.summary: Proposes GroupGuard, a defense framework against group collusive attacks in multi-agent LLM systems. Uses graph-based monitoring, honeypot inducement, and structural pruning to identify coordinated malicious agents, reducing attack success rates by up to 80%.

entry.title: Dynamic Theory of Mind as a Temporal Memory Problem: Evidence from Large Language Models

author.name: Thuy Ngoc Nguyen, Duy Nhat Phan, Cleotilde Gonzalez

entry.summary: Introduces DToM-Track to evaluate dynamic Theory of Mind in LLMs as a temporal memory problem—tracking belief trajectories across interactions rather than static false-belief tests. Tests whether LLMs can update and retrieve others' beliefs over time.

entry.title: BrainBench: Exposing the Commonsense Reasoning Gap in Large Language Models

author.name: Yuzhe Tang

entry.summary: Introduces BrainBench, 100 brainteaser questions across 20 categories targeting specific commonsense reasoning failure modes. Best model (Claude Opus 4.6 with extended thinking) achieves only 80.3%, revealing persistent gaps in commonsense reasoning.

entry.title: SAGE: Multi-Agent Self-Evolution for LLM Reasoning

author.name: Yulin Peng, Xinxin Zhu, Chenxing Wei, Nianbo Zeng, Leilei Wang, Ying Tiffany He, F. Richard Yu

entry.summary: Presents SAGE, a multi-agent self-evolution framework where four agents (Challenger, Planner, Solver, Critic) co-evolve from a shared LLM backbone using only a small seed set, improving reasoning through closed-loop self-play.

entry.title: ICaRus: Identical Cache Reuse for Efficient Multi Model Inference

author.name: Sunghyeon Woo, Jaeeun Kil, Hoseung Kim, Minsub Kim, Joonghoon Kim, Ahreum Seo, Sungjae Lee, Minjung Jo, Jiwon Ryu, Baeseong Park, Se Jung Kwon, Dongsoo Lee

entry.summary: Proposes ICaRus for efficient multi-model inference by reusing KV caches across different LLMs processing identical prompts, reducing redundant computation in multi-agent systems.

entry.title: Not All Queries Need Rewriting: When Prompt-Only LLM Refinement Helps and Hurts Dense Retrieval

author.name: Varun Kotte

entry.summary: Studies whether prompt-only LLM query rewriting helps or hurts dense retrieval in RAG pipelines, finding strongly domain-dependent behavior: rewriting degrades performance on FiQA by 9% but improves TREC-COVID by 5.1%. Identifies lexical alignment as the key mechanism.

entry.title: Beyond Linearity in Attention Projections: The Case for Nonlinear Queries

author.name: Marko Karbevski

entry.summary: Proposes replacing linear query projection in Transformers with a nonlinear residual (identity + bottleneck MLP), motivated by the observation that W_Q can be set to identity without performance loss. Shows consistent improvements on GPT-3 small models.

entry.title: Neuro-Symbolic Generation and Validation of Memory-Aware Formal Function Specifications

author.name: Liao Zhang, Tong Chen, Xiwei Wu, Qi Liu, Xiyu Zhai, Xinqi Wang, Qinxiang Cao

entry.summary: Proposes a neuro-symbolic framework for automatically generating memory-aware formal function specifications for C programs from natural language descriptions, targeting scalable formal verification of LLM-generated code.

entry.title: Resolving Interference (RI): Disentangling Models for Improved Model Merging

author.name: Pratik Ramesh, George Stoica, Arun Iyer, Leshem Choshen, Judy Hoffman

entry.summary: Proposes Resolving Interference (RI), a lightweight framework that disentangles expert models to be functionally orthogonal before merging, formally defining Cross-Task Interference as representation drift in merged models.

entry.title: Widespread Gender and Pronoun Bias in Moral Judgments Across LLMs

author.name: Gustavo L\'ucius Fernandes, Jeiverson C. V. M. Santos, Pedro O. S. Vaz-de-Melo

entry.summary: Studies gender and pronoun bias in moral judgments across 6 LLM families using 14,850 counterfactual sentence variants. Finds statistically significant biases where grammatical markers systematically influence moral classifications.

entry.title: Implicit Maximum Likelihood Estimation for Real-time Generative Model Predictive Control

author.name: Grayson Lee, Minh Bui, Shuzi Zhou, Yankai Li, Mo Chen, Ke Li

entry.summary: Investigates Implicit Maximum Likelihood Estimation (IMLE) as an alternative to diffusion models for trajectory planning, achieving two orders of magnitude faster inference while maintaining mode coverage for real-time MPC.

entry.title: Beyond Means: Topological Causal Effects under Persistent-Homology Ignorability

author.name: Amir Saki, Usef Faghihi

entry.summary: Develops a topological causal framework using persistent homology to detect treatment effects that change outcome distribution shapes (e.g., unimodal to bimodal) but leave means unchanged.

entry.title: Membership Inference for Contrastive Pre-training Models with Text-only PII Queries

author.name: Ruoxi Cheng, Yizhong Ding, Hongyi Zhang, Yiyan Huang

entry.summary: Proposes UMID, a text-only membership inference attack framework for contrastive pretraining models like CLIP/CLAP that doesn't require querying with biometric data. It uses text-guided cross-modal latent inversion to audit PII memorization without exposing sensitive biometric inputs.

entry.title: Infinite Problem Generator: Verifiably Scaling Physics Reasoning Data with Agentic Workflows

author.name: Aditya Sharan, Sriram Hebbale, Dhruv Kumar

entry.summary: Infinite Problem Generator (IPG) is an agentic framework that synthesizes verifiable physics problems with guaranteed solvability using a Formula-as-Code paradigm. Releases ClassicalMechanicsV1 with 1,335 problems expanded from 165 seeds.

entry.title: s2n-bignum-bench: A practical benchmark for evaluating low-level code reasoning of LLMs

author.name: Balaji Rao, John Harrison, Soonho Kong, Juneyoung Lee, Carlo Lipizzi

entry.summary: Introduces s2n-bignum-bench, a benchmark derived from an industrial cryptographic library verified in HOL Light, testing LLMs' ability to reason about real-world low-level assembly code rather than competition mathematics.

entry.title: SimCert: Probabilistic Certification for Behavioral Similarity in Deep Neural Network Compression

author.name: Jingyang Li, Fu Song, Guoqiang Li

entry.summary: SimCert provides probabilistic certification for verifying behavioral similarity between compressed and original neural networks. Unlike worst-case analysis, it offers quantitative safety guarantees with adjustable confidence levels. Features a dual-network architecture handling structural heterogeneity from pruning.

entry.title: Directional Embedding Smoothing for Robust Vision Language Models

author.name: Ye Wang, Jing Liu, Toshiaki Koike-Akino

entry.summary: Extends RESTA jailbreak defense to vision-language models and evaluates against JailBreakV-28K benchmark. Finds directional embedding noise aligned with token embedding vectors is particularly effective. Demonstrates practical defense against multimodal jailbreaking attacks.

entry.title: Efficient Morphology-Control Co-Design via Stackelberg Proximal Policy Optimization

author.name: Yanning Dai, Yuhui Wang, Dylan R. Ashley, J\"urgen Schmidhuber

entry.summary: Proposes Stackelberg Proximal Policy Optimization for morphology-control co-design, modeling the coupling as a Stackelberg game rather than a single-level optimization. Addresses the issue that treating control as fixed when optimizing morphology leads to misaligned updates. Game-theoretic formulation captures control adaptation dynamics.

entry.title: MA-VLCM: A Vision Language Critic Model for Value Estimation of Policies in Multi-Agent Team Settings

author.name: Shahil Shaik, Aditya Parameshwaran, Anshul Nayak, Jonathon M. Smereka, Yue Wang

entry.summary: MA-VLCM replaces learned centralized critics in multi-agent RL with vision-language critic models that leverage pre-trained multimodal reasoning. Addresses sample inefficiency and lack of generalization in MARL critics. Practical for heterogeneous multi-robot systems.

entry.title: CLAG: Adaptive Memory Organization via Agent-Driven Clustering for Small Language Model Agents

author.name: Taeyun Roh, Wonjune Jang, Junha Jung, Jaewoo Kang

entry.summary: CLAG introduces clustering-based memory organization for small language model agents, where an SLM router assigns memories to semantically coherent clusters with auto-generated profiles. Addresses knowledge dilution in single global retrieval pools, especially problematic for SLMs vulnerable to irrelevant context.

entry.title: Lipschitz-Based Robustness Certification Under Floating-Point Execution

author.name: Toby Murray

entry.summary: Addresses the gap between Lipschitz-based robustness certification (proved for real arithmetic) and actual floating-point execution, providing sound certification that accounts for floating-point errors.

entry.title: Data-driven Progressive Discovery of Physical Laws

author.name: Mingkun Xia, Weiwei Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Chain of Symbolic Regression (CoSR), a framework that discovers physical laws progressively from simple to complex, mimicking the hierarchical nature of scientific discovery.

entry.title: Soft Mean Expected Calibration Error (SMECE): A Calibration Metric for Probabilistic Labels

author.name: Michael Leznik

entry.summary: Proposes Soft Mean Expected Calibration Error (SMECE), a new calibration metric designed for settings where labels are probabilities rather than binary outcomes (e.g., knowledge distillation, annotator agreement). The paper argues that standard ECE commits a structural error by discarding probabilistic label information.

entry.title: Zoom to Essence: Trainless GUI Grounding by Inferring upon Interface Elements

author.name: Ziwei Liu, Tao Feng, Borui Kang, Yanbing Yang, Jun Luo

entry.summary: Proposes ZoomUI, a training-free GUI grounding method that decomposes complex UI interfaces into basic visual elements and uses inference scaling to guide MLLMs in progressively analyzing and grounding UI elements.

entry.title: High-Probability Bounds for SGD under the Polyak-Lojasiewicz Condition with Markovian Noise

author.name: Avik Kar, Siddharth Chandak, Rahul Singh, Eric Moulines, Shalabh Bhatnagar, Nicholas Bambos

entry.summary: Presents the first uniform-in-time high-probability bound for SGD under the Polyak-Łojasiewicz condition with Markovian and martingale difference noise components, broadening finite-time guarantees for practical optimization.

entry.title: Ultra-Early Prediction of Tipping Points: Integrating Dynamical Measures with Reservoir Computing

author.name: Xin Li, Qunxi Zhu, Chengli Zhao, Bolin Zhao, Xue Zhang, Xiaojun Duan, Wei Lin

entry.summary: Proposes a model-free framework combining dynamical system stability/sensitivity measures with reservoir computing for ultra-early prediction of tipping points in complex systems, using only observational time series.

entry.title: Mechanistic Foundations of Goal-Directed Control

author.name: Alma Lago

entry.summary: Extends mechanistic interpretability from transformer circuits to sensorimotor-cognitive development, using infant motor learning as a model system to identify causal control circuits with learned gating mechanisms.

entry.title: CASHomon Sets: Efficient Rashomon Sets Across Multiple Model Classes and their Hyperparameters

author.name: Fiona Katharina Ewald, Martin Binder, Matthias Feurer, Bernd Bischl, Giuseppe Casalicchio

entry.summary: Introduces CASHomon sets — Rashomon sets across multiple model classes and hyperparameters — with TruVaRImp, an active learning algorithm for efficiently constructing these sets in the combined algorithm selection and hyperparameter optimization setting.

entry.title: Bullet Trains: Parallelizing Training of Temporally Precise Spiking Neural Networks

author.name: Todd Morrill, Christian Pehle, Anthony Zador

entry.summary: Introduces parallel associative scans for training continuous-time spiking neural networks, enabling concurrent processing of multiple input spikes and yielding 5-50x training speedups while maintaining temporal precision.

entry.title: Event-Driven Video Generation

author.name: Chika Maduabuchi

entry.summary: Introduces Event-Driven Video Generation (EVD), a DiT-compatible framework that addresses common failure modes in text-to-video (motion before contact, action not realized) by making the denoising process event-grounded with explicit temporal activity predictions.

entry.title: Representation Alignment for Just Image Transformers is not Easier than You Think

author.name: Jaeyo Shin, Jiwook Kim, Hyunjung Shim

entry.summary: This paper reveals that Representation Alignment (REPA), a technique for accelerating Diffusion Transformer training, fails when applied to pixel-space diffusion transformers (JiT). The authors trace the failure to an information asymmetry between high-dimensional image space and low-dimensional semantic targets, proposing a fix using multi-scale intermediate features.

entry.title: Scaling Autoregressive Models for Lattice Thermodynamics

author.name: Xiaochen Du, Juno Nam, Sulin Liu, Rafael G\'omez-Bombarelli

entry.summary: Develops a framework combining any-order autoregressive models with scaling techniques for predicting thermodynamic properties of crystal lattices, overcoming the memory and convergence limitations of traditional MCMC sampling near phase transitions.

entry.title: IConE: Batch Independent Collapse Prevention for Self-Supervised Representation Learning

author.name: Konstantinos Almpanakis, Anna Kreshuk

entry.summary: Introduces IConE, a self-supervised learning framework that prevents representation collapse without relying on batch statistics, making it work with small batch sizes — critical for high-dimensional scientific data with memory constraints.

entry.title: AC-Foley: Reference-Audio-Guided Video-to-Audio Synthesis with Acoustic Transfer

author.name: Pengjun Fang, Yingqing He, Yazhou Xing, Qifeng Chen, Ser-Nam Lim, Harry Yang

entry.summary: Proposes AC-Foley, an audio-conditioned video-to-audio model that uses reference audio for fine-grained control over generated sounds, enabling timbre transfer and zero-shot sound generation beyond the limitations of text-only conditioning.

entry.title: Beyond Explicit Edges: Robust Reasoning over Noisy and Sparse Knowledge Graphs

author.name: Hang Gao, Dimitris N. Metaxas

entry.summary: Introduces INSES, a dynamic GraphRAG framework that reasons beyond explicit edges in noisy/sparse knowledge graphs by combining LLM-guided navigation for noise pruning with embedding-based similarity expansion for recovering hidden links.

entry.title: Motivation in Large Language Models

author.name: Omer Nahum, Asael Sklar, Ariel Goldstein, Roi Reichart

entry.summary: Investigates whether LLMs exhibit something akin to motivation by examining self-reported motivation levels, their relationship to behavioral signatures, variation across tasks, and susceptibility to external manipulation. Finds consistent patterns echoing human psychology.

entry.title: Beyond Benchmark Islands: Toward Representative Trustworthiness Evaluation for Agentic AI

author.name: Jinhu Qi, Yifan Li, Minghao Zhao, Wentao Zhang, Zijian Zhang, Yaoman Li, Irwin King

entry.summary: Argues that current agentic AI evaluation is fragmented and proposes a principled framework for representative trustworthiness evaluation based on socio-technical scenario distributions rather than disconnected benchmark instances.

entry.title: Criterion-referenceability determines LLM-as-a-judge validity across physics assessment formats

author.name: Will Yeadon, Tom Hardy, Paul Mackay, Elise Agra

entry.summary: Evaluates LLM-as-a-judge marking across physics assessments using GPT-5.2, Grok 4.1, Claude Opus 4.5, DeepSeek-V3.2, and Gemini Pro 3. Finds criterion-referenceability determines validity, with models achieving ~0.22 fMAE on structured questions but struggling with open-ended formats.

entry.title: Language-Guided Token Compression with Reinforcement Learning in Large Vision-Language Models

author.name: Sihan Cao, Jianwei Zhang, Pengcheng Zheng, Jiaxin Yan, Caiyan Qin, Yalan Ye, Wei Dong, Peng Wang, Yang Yang, Chaoning Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes TPRL, a reinforcement learning framework for visual token compression in LVLMs that learns adaptive pruning trajectories through language-guided sequential optimization tied to end-task performance.

entry.title: SERUM: Simple, Efficient, Robust, and Unifying Marking for Diffusion-based Image Generation

author.name: Jan Kociszewski, Hubert Jastrz\k{e}bski, Tymoteusz St\k{e}pkowski, Filip Manijak, Krzysztof Rojek, Franziska Boenisch, Adam Dziedzic

entry.summary: Proposes SERUM, a simple watermarking method for diffusion models that adds unique watermark noise to initial generation noise and trains a lightweight detector, achieving highest TPR at 1% FPR while being robust against attacks.

entry.title: Egocentric World Model for Photorealistic Hand-Object Interaction Synthesis

author.name: Dayou Li, Lulin Liu, Bangya Liu, Shijie Zhou, Jiu Feng, Ziqi Lu, Minghui Zheng, Chenyu You, Zhiwen Fan

entry.summary: Introduces EgoHOI, an egocentric world model for photorealistic hand-object interaction synthesis that infers dynamics from user actions rather than relying on privileged future object states. Addresses challenges of rapid head motion, occlusions, and complex hand articulations.

entry.title: Beyond Medical Diagnostics: How Medical Multimodal Large Language Models Think in Space

author.name: Quoc-Huy Trinh, Xi Ding, Yang Liu, Zhenyue Qin, Xingjian Li, Gorkem Durak, Halil Ertugrul Aktas, Elif Keles, Ulas Bagci, Min Xu

entry.summary: Introduces SpatialMed, the first comprehensive benchmark for evaluating 3D spatial intelligence in medical MLLMs with ~10K QA pairs, plus an agentic pipeline for synthesizing spatial VQA data using computational tools and radiologist validation.

entry.title: S2GS: Streaming Semantic Gaussian Splatting for Online Scene Understanding and Reconstruction

author.name: Renhe Zhang, Yuyang Tan, Jingyu Gong, Zhizhong Zhang, Lizhuang Ma, Yuan Xie, Xin Tan

entry.summary: Proposes S2GS, a streaming semantic Gaussian splatting framework for online joint scene reconstruction and understanding that processes frames causally without reprocessing history.

entry.title: Early Failure Detection and Intervention in Video Diffusion Models

author.name: Kwon Byung-Ki, Sohwi Lim, Nam Hyeon-Woo, Moon Ye-Bin, Tae-Hyun Oh

entry.summary: Proposes an early failure detection and diagnostic intervention pipeline for text-to-video diffusion models that converts latents to previews for real-time quality inspection during generation.

entry.title: HomeGuard: VLM-based Embodied Safeguard for Identifying Contextual Risk in Household Task

author.name: Xiaoya Lu, Yijin Zhou, Zeren Chen, Ruocheng Wang, Bingrui Sima, Enshen Zhou, Lu Sheng, Dongrui Liu, Jing Shao

entry.summary: HomeGuard proposes a VLM-based safety framework for embodied agents using Context-Guided Chain-of-Thought to identify contextual risks in household tasks where benign commands become hazardous.

entry.title: StAR: Segment Anything Reasoner

author.name: Seokju Yun, Dongheon Lee, Noori Bae, Jaesung Jun, Chanseul Cho, Youngmin Ro

entry.summary: StAR (Segment Anything Reasoner) refines the design space for reasoning segmentation from multiple perspectives and introduces parallel test-time scaling for segmentation tasks.

entry.title: Distilling Latent Manifolds: Resolution Extrapolation by Variational Autoencoders

author.name: Jiaming Chu, Tao Wang, Lei Jin

entry.summary: Reports a counter-intuitive finding that VAE encoders distilled at low resolutions perform better at higher unseen resolutions, studying resolution extrapolation in latent diffusion.

entry.title: Balancing Saliency and Coverage: Semantic Prominence-Aware Budgeting for Visual Token Compression in VLMs

author.name: Jaehoon Lee, Mingi Jung, Soohyuk Jang, Seungryong Yoo, Dahuin Jung, Sungroh Yoon

entry.summary: Proposes PromPrune, a sample-adaptive visual token compression method for VLMs that balances saliency and coverage based on per-sample semantic prominence distribution, rather than using static compression strategies.

entry.title: Edit2Interp: Adapting Image Foundation Models from Spatial Editing to Video Frame Interpolation with Few-Shot Learning

author.name: Nasrin Rahimi, M{\i}sra Yavuz, Burak Can Biner, Yunus Bilge Kurt, Ahmet Rasim Emirda\u{g}{\i}, S\"uleyman Aslan, G\"orkay Aydemir, M. Ak{\i}n Y{\i}lmaz, A. Murat Tekalp

entry.summary: Demonstrates that image editing models can be adapted for Video Frame Interpolation using only 64-256 samples via LoRA, repurposing spatial reasoning priors for temporal synthesis without video-specific architecture.

entry.title: Generative Video Compression with One-Dimensional Latent Representation

author.name: Zihan Zheng, Zhaoyang Jia, Naifu Xue, Jiahao Li, Bin Li, Zongyu Guo, Xiaoyi Zhang, Zhenghao Chen, Houqiang Li, Yan Lu

entry.summary: Proposes generative video compression with 1D latent representations instead of traditional 2D grids, better exploiting spatial-temporal redundancy by enabling more compact cross-frame aggregation.

entry.title: Tri-Prompting: Video Diffusion with Unified Control over Scene, Subject, and Motion

author.name: Zhenghong Zhou, Xiaohang Zhan, Zhiqin Chen, Soo Ye Kim, Nanxuan Zhao, Haitian Zheng, Qing Liu, He Zhang, Zhe Lin, Yuqian Zhou, Jiebo Luo

entry.summary: Tri-Prompting is a unified video diffusion framework providing joint control over scene composition, multi-view consistent subject customization, and camera/motion adjustment. Uses a two-stage training paradigm for versatile controllable video generation.

entry.title: A Theory of Appropriateness That Accounts for Norms of Rationality

author.name: Joel Z. Leibo, Alexander Sasha Vezhnevets, Manfred Diaz, John P. Agapiou, William A. Cunningham, Peter Sunehag, Logan Cross, Raphael Koster, Stanley M. Bileschi, Minsuk Chang, Iyad Rahwan, Simon Osindero, James A. Evans

entry.summary: Proposes a society-first theory of normative appropriateness where individuals, modeled analogously to LLMs, generate behavior via predictive pattern completion. Challenges rational-choice theories by accounting for norms' context-dependence, arbitrariness, and automaticity.

entry.title: KoopmanFlow: Spectrally Decoupled Generative Control Policy via Koopman Structural Bias

author.name: Chengsi Yao, Ge Wang, Kai Kang, Shenhao Yan, Jiahao Yang, Fan Feng, Honghao Cai, Xianxian Zeng, Rongjun Chen, Yiming Zhao, Yatong Han, Xi Li

entry.summary: KoopmanFlow introduces Koopman-inspired structural bias into generative control policies to spectrally decouple stable global motions from high-frequency local corrections, enabling single-step ODE inference for real-time robotic control.

entry.title: Building Explicit World Model for Zero-Shot Open-World Object Manipulation

author.name: Xiaotong Li, Gang Chen, Javier Alonso-Mora

entry.summary: Proposes an explicit world model framework for zero-shot open-world manipulation that constructs a digital twin of the environment, enabling strategy exploration and evaluation in simulation without requiring robot demonstrations.

entry.title: From Scanning Guidelines to Action: A Robotic Ultrasound Agent with LLM-Based Reasoning

author.name: Yuan Bi, Yiping Zhou, Pei Liu, Feng Li, Zhongliang Jiang, Nassir Navab

entry.summary: Proposes a unified framework for autonomous robotic ultrasound scanning that uses an LLM-based agent to interpret scanning guidelines and dynamically invoke software tools, rather than encoding fixed procedures. The LLM retrieves relevant guidelines and reasons about how to execute scans. This demonstrates LLMs as flexible task planners in medical robotics.

entry.title: Learning from Mistakes: Post-Training for Driving VLA with Takeover Data

author.name: Yinfeng Gao, Deqing Liu, Qichao Zhang, Yupeng Zheng, Haochen Tian, Guang Li, Hangjun Ye, Long Chen, Da-Wei Ding, Dongbin Zhao

entry.summary: TakeVLA proposes a VLA post-training framework for autonomous driving that uses takeover data more effectively through pre-takeover language supervision and active exploration beyond passive preference optimization. Addresses distribution shift in end-to-end driving systems.

entry.title: Scalable Text-Embedding-informed Cognitive Diagnosis of Large Language Models

author.name: Jia Liu, Zhiyu Xu, Yuqi Gu

entry.summary: Adapts cognitive diagnosis models from psychometrics to LLM evaluation, enabling fine-grained diagnosis of LLM capabilities through multidimensional discrete profiles. Addresses scalability to 1000+ items and 20+ latent attributes through joint estimation of mastery profiles and Q-matrices.

entry.title: Reasons to be pessimistic (and optimistic) on the future of biosecurity

author.name: Abhishaike Mahajan

entry.summary: A comprehensive analysis of the current state of biosecurity, drawing on conversations with ~16 experts from organizations like Ginkgo Bioworks, SecureDNA, Blueprint Biosecurity, and Johns Hopkins. The essay examines both reasons for pessimism (AI-enabled bioweapons, inadequate defenses) and optimism in the biosecurity landscape.

entry.title: LLM Routing as Reasoning: A MaxSAT View

author.name: Son Nguyen, Xinyuan Liu, Ransalu Senanayake

entry.summary: Formulates LLM routing (selecting which model to use) as a weighted MaxSAT/MaxSMT problem where natural language feedback induces constraints over model attributes. Tests on a 25-model benchmark.

entry.title: Autonomous Agents Coordinating Distributed Discovery Through Emergent Artifact Exchange

author.name: Fiona Y. Wang, Lee Marom, Subhadeep Pal, Rachel K. Luu, Wei Lu, Jaime A. Berkovich, Markus J. Buehler

entry.summary: Presents ScienceClaw + Infinite, a framework for autonomous scientific research where independent agents conduct investigation without central coordination, sharing artifacts with full provenance via a DAG-based lineage system.

entry.title: Learning to Forget: Sleep-Inspired Memory Consolidation for Resolving Proactive Interference in Large Language Models

author.name: Ying Xie

entry.summary: Proposes SleepGate, a biologically-inspired framework augmenting transformer KV caches with sleep-like consolidation cycles to resolve proactive interference from outdated information. Includes conflict-aware tagging, selective replay, and targeted forgetting.

entry.title: Gauge-Equivariant Intrinsic Neural Operators for Geometry-Consistent Learning of Elliptic PDE Maps

author.name: Pengcheng Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes Gauge-Equivariant Intrinsic Neural Operators (GINO) for learning PDE solution maps that are invariant under local frame changes, using intrinsic spectral multipliers coupled with gauge-equivariant nonlinearities.

entry.title: Learning Retrieval Models with Sparse Autoencoders

author.name: Thibault Formal, Maxime Louis, Herv\'e Dejean, St\'ephane Clinchant

entry.summary: Introduces SPLARE, a method using Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) as a foundation for learned sparse retrieval, decomposing LLM representations into interpretable features for efficient information retrieval.

entry.title: Mind the Discriminability Trap in Source-Free Cross-domain Few-shot Learning

author.name: Zhenyu Zhang, Yixiong Zou, Yuhua Li, Ruixuan Li, Guangyao Chen

entry.summary: Discovers that strengthening visual-modal discriminability paradoxically suppresses VLM performance in source-free cross-domain few-shot learning, providing theoretical and experimental analysis of the phenomenon with a proposed solution.

entry.title: Accelerating Suffix Jailbreak attacks with Prefix-Shared KV-cache

author.name: Xinhai Wang, Shaopeng Fu, Shu Yang, Liangyu Wang, Tianhang Zheng, Di Wang

entry.summary: Presents PSKV, a prefix-shared KV cache optimization that accelerates suffix jailbreak attacks by sharing the common prefix KV cache across candidate suffixes during red-teaming, achieving significant speedups.

entry.title: MIBench: Evaluating LMMs on Multimodal Interaction

author.name: Yu Miao, Zequn Yang, Yake Wei, Ziheng Chen, Haotian Ni, Haodong Duan, Kai Chen, Di Hu

entry.summary: Introduces MIBench, a benchmark evaluating multimodal interaction capabilities of Large Multimodal Models, formulating instances as (visual context, text context, task) triplets requiring correct forms of multimodal interaction.

entry.title: Spatial Transcriptomics as Images for Large-Scale Pretraining

author.name: Yishun Zhu, Jiaxin Qi, Jian Wang, Yuhua Zheng, Jianqiang Huang

entry.summary: Proposes treating spatial transcriptomics data as images for large-scale pretraining, addressing the ill-posed question of what constitutes a training sample in ST by defining tissue patches as training units.

entry.title: Spatially Grounded Long-Horizon Task Planning in the Wild

author.name: Sehun Jung, HyunJee Song, Dong-Hee Kim, Reuben Tan, Jianfeng Gao, Yong Jae Lee, Donghyun Kim

entry.summary: Introduces GroundedPlanBench, a benchmark for spatially grounded long-horizon action planning that jointly evaluates hierarchical plan generation and precise spatial interaction point specification for robots.

entry.title: A Causal Framework for Mitigating Data Shifts in Healthcare

author.name: Kurt Butler, Stephanie Riley, Damian Machlanski, Edward Moroshko, Panagiotis Dimitrakopoulos, Thomas Melistas, Akchunya Chanchal, Konstantinos Vilouras, Zhihua Liu, Steven McDonagh, Hana Chockler, Ben Glocker, Niccolo Tempini, Matthew Sperrin, Sotirios A Tsaftaris, Ricardo Silva

entry.summary: Proposes a causal framework for designing predictive models that generalize across healthcare data shifts, connecting domain generalization methods with causal reasoning to understand assumptions and trade-offs.

entry.title: SmoothVLA: Aligning Vision-Language-Action Models with Physical Constraints via Intrinsic Smoothness Optimization

author.name: Jiashun Li, Xiaoyu Shi, Hong Xie, Mingsheng Shang, Yun Lu

entry.summary: Proposes SmoothVLA, an RL fine-tuning framework for Vision-Language-Action models that jointly optimizes task performance and motion smoothness through physics-informed hybrid rewards.

entry.title: FLUX: Data Worth Training On

author.name: Gowtham, Sai Rupesh, Sanjay Kumar, Saravanan, Venkata Chaithanya

entry.summary: Introduces FLUX, a data preprocessing pipeline for LLM training that maximizes token retention while enforcing quality control, achieving 32.14 on benchmarks with a 3B model trained on 60B tokens.

entry.title: Diffusion Reinforcement Learning via Centered Reward Distillation

author.name: Yuanzhi Zhu, Xi Wang, St\'ephane Lathuili\`ere, Vicky Kalogeiton

entry.summary: Presents Centered Reward Distillation (CRD), a diffusion RL framework derived from KL-regularized reward maximization for fine-tuning diffusion models, addressing brittleness of existing approaches.

entry.title: Artificial intelligence-enabled single-lead ECG for non-invasive hyperkalemia detection: development, multicenter validation, and proof-of-concept deployment

author.name: Gongzheng Tang, Qinghao Zhao, Guangkun Nie, Yujie Xiao, Shijia Geng, Donglin Xie, Shun Huang, Deyun Zhang, Xingchen Yao, Jinwei Wang, Kangyin Chen, Luxia Zhang, Shenda Hong

entry.summary: Develops Pocket-K, an AI-ECG system for non-invasive hyperkalemia detection using single-lead ECG, validated across multiple centers on 34,439 patients.

entry.title: AEX: Non-Intrusive Multi-Hop Attestation and Provenance for LLM APIs

author.name: Yongjie Guan

entry.summary: AEX proposes a non-intrusive attestation extension for LLM APIs that cryptographically binds client requests to server responses, providing provenance guarantees for multi-hop API chains without modifying existing API semantics.

entry.title: How Do Medical MLLMs Fail? A Study on Visual Grounding in Medical Images

author.name: Guimeng Liu, Tianze Yu, Somayeh Ebrahimkhani, Lin Zhi Zheng Shawn, Kok Pin Ng, Ngai-Man Cheung

entry.summary: Systematically investigates visual grounding failures in medical MLLMs through VGMED, a new evaluation dataset. Disentangles visual grounding from semantic grounding to understand why medical MLLMs underperform in image interpretation.

entry.title: The Pulse of Motion: Measuring Physical Frame Rate from Visual Dynamics

author.name: Xiangbo Gao, Mingyang Wu, Siyuan Yang, Jiongze Yu, Pardis Taghavi, Fangzhou Lin, Zhengzhong Tu

entry.summary: Introduces Visual Chronometer to measure physical frame rate from video dynamics, addressing 'chronometric hallucination' where generative video models produce ambiguous motion speeds due to training on diverse frame rates.

entry.title: D-MEM: Dopamine-Gated Agentic Memory via Reward Prediction Error Routing

author.name: Yuru Song, Qi Xin

entry.summary: D-MEM proposes a biologically-inspired memory architecture for LLM agents using reward prediction error (RPE) routing to separate fast O(1) caching from slow O(N) memory evolution, reducing write latency from O(N²).

entry.title: Human-AI Ensembles Improve Deepfake Detection in Low-to-Medium Quality Videos

author.name: Marco Postiglione, Isabel Gortner, V. S. Subrahmanian

entry.summary: Shows that human-AI ensembles improve deepfake detection, especially for low-quality mobile videos. On CharadesDF dataset, AI accuracy drops to 0.537 while humans maintain 0.784. Human and AI errors are complementary.

entry.title: IntegratingWeather Foundation Model and Satellite to Enable Fine-Grained Solar Irradiance Forecasting

author.name: Ziqing Ma, Kai Ying, Xinyue Gu, Tian Zhou, Tianyu Zhu, Haifan Zhang, Peisong Niu, Wang Zheng, Cong Bai, Liang Sun

entry.summary: Baguan-solar combines a global weather foundation model with high-resolution geostationary satellite imagery for 24-hour solar irradiance forecasting at kilometer scale. The two-stage design first forecasts continuous intermediates like cloud cover, then estimates irradiance. Addresses limitations of both coarse NWP models and short-horizon satellite extrapolation.

entry.title: How Log-Barrier Helps Exploration in Policy Optimization

author.name: Leonardo Cesani, Matteo Papini, Marcello Restelli

entry.summary: Proposes log-barrier regularization for the Stochastic Gradient Bandit algorithm to enforce minimal exploration. Proves convergence without unrealistic assumptions about optimal action probability being bounded away from zero. Matches SGB sample complexity while providing stronger guarantees.

entry.title: TrajFlow: Nation-wide Pseudo GPS Trajectory Generation with Flow Matching Models

author.name: Peiran Li, Jiawei Wang, Haoran Zhang, Xiaodan Shi, Noboru Koshizuka, Chihiro Shimizu, Renhe Jiang

entry.summary: TrajFlow is the first flow-matching-based generative model for GPS trajectory generation, operating at nation-wide scale. Addresses limitations of diffusion-based approaches in spatial scale, transportation-mode diversity, and efficiency. Generates pseudo-GPS trajectories to address privacy concerns with real mobile phone data.

entry.title: In-Context Symbolic Regression for Robustness-Improved Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks

author.name: Francesco Sovrano, Lidia Losavio, Giulia Vilone, Marc Langheinrich

entry.summary: Studies in-context symbolic regression for improving Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks by replacing edge functions with symbolic operators. Addresses the bottleneck of standard KAN-to-symbol extraction which fits operators in isolation. Uses context-aware approach that considers how local substitutions interact through the full network.

entry.title: NV-Bench: Benchmark of Nonverbal Vocalization Synthesis for Expressive Text-to-Speech Generation

author.name: Qinke Ni, Huan Liao, Dekun Chen, Yuxiang Wang, Zhizheng Wu

entry.summary: NV-Bench is the first benchmark for nonverbal vocalization synthesis in TTS, grounded in a functional taxonomy treating NVs as communicative acts. Covers 1,651 multilingual utterances across 14 NV categories with paired human reference audio. Introduces dual evaluation protocol for instruction alignment and acoustic fidelity.

entry.title: RieMind: Geometry-Grounded Spatial Agent for Scene Understanding

author.name: Fernando Ropero, Erkin Turkoz, Daniel Matos, Junqing Du, Antonio Ruiz, Yanfeng Zhang, Lu Liu, Mingwei Sun, Yongliang Wang

entry.summary: RieMind proposes an agentic framework for 3D indoor scene reasoning that decouples perception from reasoning by grounding an LLM in an explicit 3D scene graph. Investigates whether this decoupling improves spatial reasoning compared to end-to-end approaches. Uses persistent scene graph representation.

entry.title: Generalization and Memorization in Rectified Flow

author.name: Mingxing Rao, Daniel Moyer

entry.summary: Systematically investigates memorization in Rectified Flow models using membership inference attacks, introducing a complexity-calibrated metric that decouples image complexity from memorization signals.

entry.title: SemRep: Generative Code Representation Learning with Code Transformations

author.name: Weichen Li, Jiamin Song, Bogdan Alexandru Stoica, Arav Dhoot, Gabriel Ryan, Shengyu Fu, Kexin Pei

entry.summary: Proposes SemRep, a framework that uses semantics-preserving code transformations as intermediate representations for improving code transformation tasks, serving as both a generative mid-training task and transformation guide.

entry.title: TACTIC for Navigating the Unknown: Tabular Anomaly deteCTion via In-Context inference

author.name: Patryk Marsza{\l}ek, Tomasz Ku\'smierczyk, Marek \'Smieja

entry.summary: Studies in-context learning models (like TabPFN) for tabular anomaly detection, showing their supervised classification priors don't readily extend. Proposes TACTIC, a method that adapts in-context models for anomaly detection with improved stability.

entry.title: Refold: Refining Protein Inverse Folding with Efficient Structural Matching and Fusion

author.name: Yiran Zhu, Changxi Chi, Hongxin Xiang, Wenjie Du, Xiaoqi Wang, Jun Xia

entry.summary: Proposes Refold for protein inverse folding, combining template-based structural matching with deep learning to capture both fine-grained local structure and general structure-to-sequence patterns, addressing limitations of each approach alone.

entry.title: Unlearning-based sliding window for continual learning under concept drift

author.name: Michal Wozniak, Marek Klonowski, Maciej Maczynski, Bartosz Krawczyk

entry.summary: Proposes using machine unlearning instead of full retraining for sliding window approaches in continual learning under concept drift, incrementally removing outdated data influence rather than rebuilding models from scratch.

entry.title: Cross-RAG: Zero-Shot Retrieval-Augmented Time Series Forecasting via Cross-Attention

author.name: Seunghan Lee, Jaehoon Lee, Jun Seo, Sungdong Yoo, Minjae Kim, Tae Yoon Lim, Dongwan Kang, Hwanil Choi, SoonYoung Lee, Wonbin Ahn

entry.summary: Proposes Cross-RAG, a zero-shot retrieval-augmented time series forecasting framework using cross-attention to selectively attend to query-relevant retrieved samples, addressing the problem of irrelevant retrieval in existing approaches.

entry.title: Point-Identification of a Robust Predictor Under Latent Shift with Imperfect Proxies

author.name: Zahra Rahiminasab, Reza Soumi, Arto Klami, Samuel Kaski

entry.summary: Addresses domain adaptation under latent confounders with imperfect proxies that break the completeness assumption, proposing a method for point-identification of robust predictors using auxiliary sensitivity information.

entry.title: Decomposing Probabilistic Scores: Reliability, Information Loss and Uncertainty

author.name: Arthur Charpentier, Agathe Fernandes-Machado

entry.summary: Develops decomposition identities for proper losses that make calibration's dependence on retained information explicit, providing a three-term identity splitting scores into miscalibration, information loss (grouping), and residual uncertainty.

entry.title: Deep Learning for BioImaging: What Are We Learning?

author.name: Ivan Svatko, Maxime Sanchez, Ihab Bendidi, Gilles Cottrell, Auguste Genovesio

entry.summary: Conducts a systematic study of representation learning for microscopy imaging, revealing that state-of-the-art methods perform comparably to simple baselines including untrained models, questioning what current methods actually learn.

entry.title: State-space models through the lens of ensemble control

author.name: Ye Feng, Jianfeng Lu

entry.summary: Formulates SSM training as an ensemble optimal control problem with shared control laws, derives Pontryagin's maximum principle, and proves convergence with conditions for global optimality.

entry.title: A Single-Sample Polylogarithmic Regret Bound for Nonstationary Online Linear Programming

author.name: Haoran Xu, Owen Shen, Peter Glynn, Yinyu Ye, Patrick Jaillet

entry.summary: Achieves polylogarithmic regret for nonstationary online linear programming in the single-sample setting, where only one sample from each distribution is available. This significantly improves upon prior bounds for this challenging setting.

entry.title: Towards Next-Generation LLM Training: From the Data-Centric Perspective

author.name: Hao Liang, Zhengyang Zhao, Zhaoyang Han, Meiyi Qiang, Xiaochen Ma, Bohan Zeng, Qifeng Cai, Zhiyu Li, Linpeng Tang, Weinan E, Wentao Zhang

entry.summary: A comprehensive survey on data-centric approaches for next-generation LLM training, covering data preparation, curation, and utilization strategies. Highlights the need for mature agent-based data systems and systematic data quality mechanisms.

entry.title: Trustworthy Koopman Operator Learning: Invariance Diagnostics and Error Bounds

author.name: Gustav Conradie, Nicolas Boull\'e, Jean-Christophe Loiseau, Steven L. Brunton, Matthew J. Colbrook

entry.summary: Develops a unified methodology for certifying Koopman operator approximations using only snapshot data, providing a posteriori diagnostics for invariance and projection errors and actionable guarantees for dictionary refinement.

entry.title: LiveWeb-IE: A Benchmark For Online Web Information Extraction

author.name: Seungbin Yang, Jihwan Kim, Jaemin Choi, Dongjin Kim, Soyoung Yang, ChaeHun Park, Jaegul Choo

entry.summary: Introduces LiveWeb-IE, a benchmark for evaluating web information extraction systems against live (not static) websites, addressing the limitation that performance on static HTML snapshots doesn't generalize to dynamic real-world scenarios.

entry.title: Top-b: Entropic Regulation of Relative Probability Bands in Autoregressive Language Processes

author.name: Deepon Halder, Raj Dabre

entry.summary: Proposes Top-b (Adaptive Relative Band Sampling), a decoding strategy that dynamically adjusts the candidate token set based on instantaneous Shannon entropy, replacing static truncation rules of Top-k and Top-p with entropy-coupled bandwidth.

entry.title: MMKU-Bench: A Multimodal Update Benchmark for Diverse Visual Knowledge

author.name: Baochen Fu, Yuntao Du, Cheng Chang, Baihao Jin, Wenzhi Deng, Muhao Xu, Hongmei Yan, Weiye Song, Yi Wan

entry.summary: Proposes MMKU-Bench, a benchmark for multimodal knowledge updating in vision-language models with 25K+ knowledge instances and 49K+ images, covering both learning new knowledge and updating outdated knowledge with cross-modal consistency evaluation.

entry.title: Gloss-Free Sign Language Translation: An Unbiased Evaluation of Progress in the Field

author.name: Ozge Mercanoglu Sincan, Jian He Low, Sobhan Asasi, Richard Bowden

entry.summary: Comprehensive re-evaluation of gloss-free sign language translation models in a unified codebase, finding that many reported gains come from backbone choices and training optimizations rather than methodological novelty.

entry.title: LADR: Locality-Aware Dynamic Rescue for Efficient Text-to-Image Generation with Diffusion Large Language Models

author.name: Chenglin Wang, Yucheng Zhou, Shawn Chen, Tao Wang, Kai Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes LADR, a training-free method to accelerate discrete diffusion language models for text-to-image generation by exploiting spatial Markov properties, prioritizing recovery of tokens at the 'generation frontier' near observed pixels.

entry.title: WAT: Online Video Understanding Needs Watching Before Thinking

author.name: Zifan Han, Hongbo Sun, Jinglin Xu, Canhui Tang, Yulong Lei, Xuchong Zhang, Hongbin Sun, Zhongjiang He, Hao Sun

entry.summary: Proposes WAT (Watching Before Thinking), a two-stage framework for online video reasoning with MLLMs that separates query-independent watching (building hierarchical memory) from query-triggered thinking. Uses short-term and long-term memory with redundancy-aware eviction.

entry.title: Deep Learning From Routine Histology Improves Risk Stratification for Biochemical Recurrence in Prostate Cancer

author.name: Cl\'ement Grisi, Khrystyna Faryna, Nefise Uysal, Vittorio Agosti, Enrico Munari, Sol\`ene-Florence Kammerer-Jacquet, Paulo Guilherme de Oliveira Salles, Yuri Tolkach, Reinhard B\"uttner, Sofiya Semko, Maksym Pikul, Axel Heidenreich, Jeroen van der Laak, Geert Litjens

entry.summary: Develops a deep learning biomarker from H&E-stained prostatectomy slides to predict biochemical recurrence risk, validated across four international cohorts with robust generalization.

entry.title: FIND: A Simple yet Effective Baseline for Diffusion-Generated Image Detection

author.name: Jie Li, Yingying Feng, Chi Xie, Jie Hu, Lei Tan, Jiayi Ji

entry.summary: Proposes FIND, a simple method for detecting diffusion-generated images based on the insight that real images are harder to fit with Gaussian distributions than synthetic ones, requiring only a binary classifier.

entry.title: AvatarForcing: One-Step Streaming Talking Avatars via Local-Future Sliding-Window Denoising

author.name: Liyuan Cui, Wentao Hu, Wenyuan Zhang, Zesong Yang, Fan Shi, Xiaoqiang Liu

entry.summary: AvatarForcing enables real-time streaming talking avatar generation using one-step diffusion with a local-future sliding window and dual-anchor temporal forcing for unbounded stable streams.

entry.title: LongVidSearch: An Agentic Benchmark for Multi-hop Evidence Retrieval Planning in Long Videos

author.name: Rongyi Yu, Chenyuan Duan, Wentao Zhang

entry.summary: LongVidSearch is a benchmark for evaluating agentic multi-hop evidence retrieval planning in long videos, separating retrieval planning failures from answer generation failures.

entry.title: A Skill-augmented Agentic Framework and Benchmark for Multi-Video Understanding

author.name: Yue Zhang, Liqiang Jing, Jia Li, Yapeng Tian, Xinya Du, Yunhui Guo, Vibhav Gogate

entry.summary: Introduces MVX-Bench for multi-video understanding and a skill-augmented agentic framework that decomposes cross-video reasoning into specialized skills via tool use.

entry.title: Video-CoE: Reinforcing Video Event Prediction via Chain of Events

author.name: Qile Su, Jing Tang, Rui Chen, Lei Sun, Xiangxiang Chu

entry.summary: Proposes Chain of Events (CoE) paradigm for video event prediction, constructing temporal event chains to guide MLLMs in making logical future predictions from video content, addressing gaps in temporal reasoning.

entry.title: GeoNVS: Geometry Grounded Video Diffusion for Novel View Synthesis

author.name: Minjun Kang, Inkyu Shin, Taeyeop Lee, Myungchul Kim, In So Kweon, Kuk-Jin Yoon

entry.summary: Introduces GeoNVS, a geometry-grounded novel view synthesizer using a Gaussian Splat Feature Adapter (GS-Adapter) that lifts diffusion features into 3D Gaussians for geometry-constrained novel view synthesis.

entry.title: AnyCrowd: Instance-Isolated Identity-Pose Binding for Arbitrary Multi-Character Animation

author.name: Zhenyu Xie, Ji Xia, Michael Kampffmeyer, Panwen Hu, Zehua Ma, Yujian Zheng, Jing Wang, Zheng Chong, Xujie Zhang, Xianhang Cheng, Xiaodan Liang, Hao Li

entry.summary: Proposes AnyCrowd, a DiT-based framework for multi-character animation scaling to arbitrary numbers of characters, addressing identity bleeding and identity-pose mis-binding through instance-isolated encoding.

entry.title: Evaluating Time Awareness and Cross-modal Active Perception of Large Models via 4D Escape Room Task

author.name: Yurui Dong, Ziyue Wang, Shuyun Lu, Dairu Liu, Xuechen Liu, Fuwen Luo, Peng Li, Yang Liu

entry.summary: Introduces EscapeCraft-4D, a 4D environment in Minecraft for evaluating multimodal models' time awareness and cross-modal active perception with audio, vision, and language under time-varying conditions.

entry.title: Fast SAM 3D Body: Accelerating SAM 3D Body for Real-Time Full-Body Human Mesh Recovery

author.name: Timing Yang, Sicheng He, Hongyi Jing, Jiawei Yang, Zhijian Liu, Chuhang Zou, Yue Wang

entry.summary: Fast SAM 3D Body accelerates state-of-the-art monocular 3D human mesh recovery from seconds to interactive rates without retraining. Replaces iterative mesh fitting with feedforward mapping, achieving 10,000x speedup for SMPL extraction.

entry.title: Ego to World: Collaborative Spatial Reasoning in Embodied Systems via Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Heng Zhou, Li Kang, Yiran Qin, Xiufeng Song, Ao Yu, Zilu Zhang, Haoming Song, Kaixin Xu, Yuchen Fan, Dongzhan Zhou, Xiaohong Liu, Ruimao Zhang, Philip Torr, Lei Bai, Zhenfei Yin

entry.summary: Ego-to-World (E2W) benchmark evaluates VLMs' ability to fuse heterogeneous viewpoints across counting, relational reasoning, and grasping tasks. CoRL framework combines Chain-of-Thought fine-tuning with reinforcement learning for multi-agent spatial reasoning.

entry.title: ST-VLA: Enabling 4D-Aware Spatiotemporal Understanding for General Robot Manipulation

author.name: You Wu, Zixuan Chen, Cunxu Ou, Wenxuan Wang, Wenbo Huang, Lin Cao, Yangtao Chen, Weichao Qiu, Xingyue Quan, Jieqi Shi, Jing Huo, Yang Gao

entry.summary: ST-VLA proposes a hierarchical VLA framework using unified 3D-4D representations to bridge perception and action, converting 2D guidance into 3D trajectories with smooth spatial masks capturing spatiotemporal context.

entry.title: ImagiNav: Scalable Embodied Navigation via Generative Visual Prediction and Inverse Dynamics

author.name: Jie Chen, Yuxin Cai, Yizhuo Wang, Ruofei Bai, Yuhong Cao, Jun Li, Yau Wei Yun, Guillaume Sartoretti

entry.summary: ImagiNav decouples visual planning from robot actuation for language-guided navigation, using a VLM for subgoals, finetuned video diffusion for visual planning, and inverse dynamics for action generation, enabling use of in-the-wild navigation videos.

entry.title: URDF-Anything+: Autoregressive Articulated 3D Models Generation for Physical Simulation

author.name: Zhuangzhe Wu, Yue Xin, Chengkai Hou, Minghao Chen, Yaoxu Lyu, Jieyu Zhang, Shanghang Zhang

entry.summary: URDF-Anything+ is an autoregressive framework that generates executable URDF articulated object models from visual observations, sequentially producing part geometries and joint parameters without multi-stage pipelines.

entry.title: Stiffness Copilot: An Impedance Policy for Contact-Rich Teleoperation

author.name: Yeping Wang, Zhengtong Xu, Pornthep Preechayasomboon, Ben Abbatematteo, Amirhossein H. Memar, Nick Colonnese, Sonny Chan

entry.summary: Stiffness Copilot is a vision-based policy for shared-control teleoperation that automatically adjusts robot impedance based on wrist-camera images, trained in simulation with privileged contact information and transferring zero-shot to real images.

entry.title: NavThinker: Action-Conditioned World Models for Coupled Prediction and Planning in Social Navigation

author.name: Tianshuai Hu, Zeying Gong, Lingdong Kong, XiaoDong Mei, Yiyi Ding, Qi Zeng, Ao Liang, Rong Li, Yangyi Zhong, Junwei Liang

entry.summary: NavThinker couples an action-conditioned world model with on-policy RL for social navigation.
