entry.summary: Studies Fréchet k-means under the setting where both the measure and metric are unknown and must be estimated, proving continuity with respect to measured Gromov-Hausdorff topology and establishing new consistency results for various metric learning procedures.

entry.title: The Sampling Complexity of Condorcet Winner Identification in Dueling Bandits

author.name: El Mehdi Saad (CC-UM6P-Rabat), Victor Thuot (MISTEA), Nicolas Verzelen (MISTEA)

entry.summary: Studies best-arm identification in dueling bandits with Condorcet winners, introducing a procedure that exploits the full gap matrix rather than only winner-vs-others gaps, with improved sample complexity bounds and new matching lower bounds.

entry.title: PMIScore: An Unsupervised Approach to Quantify Dialogue Engagement

author.name: Yongkang Guo, Zhihuan Huang, Yuqing Kong

entry.summary: Proposes PMIScore, an unsupervised metric for dialogue engagement based on pointwise mutual information, providing an interpretable measure of how much a response depends on conversation history.

entry.title: The Hrunting of AI: Where and How to Improve English Dialectal Fairness

author.name: Wei Li, Adrian de Wynter

entry.summary: Investigates LLM fairness across English dialects (Yorkshire, Geordie, Cornish, AAVE), finding that human-human agreement patterns directly impact LLM-as-a-judge reliability, creating a fairness evaluation bottleneck for underrepresented dialects.

entry.title: FMS$^2$: Unified Flow Matching for Segmentation and Synthesis of Thin Structures

author.name: Babak Asadi, Peiyang Wu, Mani Golparvar-Fard, Viraj Shah, Ramez Hajj

entry.summary: Proposes FMS², a flow-matching framework for segmenting and synthesizing thin structures (cracks, vessels). Uses continuous image-to-mask transport via ODE integration rather than standard logit supervision, plus a synthetic augmentation module.

entry.title: SK-Adapter: Skeleton-Based Structural Control for Native 3D Generation

author.name: Anbang Wang, Yuzhuo Ao, Shangzhe Wu, Chi-Keung Tang

entry.summary: Proposes SK-Adapter, a lightweight adapter enabling precise skeletal control for native 3D generative models. Encodes joint coordinates and topology into tokens injected via cross-attention into frozen 3D generation backbones.

entry.title: FOCUS: Bridging Fine-Grained Recognition and Open-World Discovery across Domains

author.name: Vaibhav Rathore, Divyam Gupta, Moloud Abdar, Subhasis Chaudhuri, Biplab Banerjee

entry.summary: Introduces the first unified framework for fine-grained domain-generalized generalized category discovery (FG-DG-GCD), establishing benchmarks and a method (FOCUS) for recognizing known and discovering novel classes under domain shift.

entry.title: UAVBench and UAVIT-1M: Benchmarking and Enhancing MLLMs for Low-Altitude UAV Vision-Language Understanding

author.name: Yang Zhan, Yuan Yuan

entry.summary: Introduces UAVBench and UAVIT-1M for evaluating and improving MLLMs on low-altitude UAV vision-language tasks, covering 10 tasks with 966K samples across 43 test units.

entry.title: Mind-of-Director: Multi-modal Agent-Driven Film Previsualization via Collaborative Decision-Making

author.name: Shufeng Nan, Mengtian Li, Sixiao Zheng, Yuwei Lu, Han Zhang, Yanwei Fu

entry.summary: Mind-of-Director is a multi-modal agent framework for film previsualization that orchestrates specialized agents for screenplay, scene design, character control, and camera planning within a game engine.

entry.title: VAREX: A Benchmark for Multi-Modal Structured Extraction from Documents

author.name: Udi Barzelay, Ophir Azulai, Inbar Shapira, Idan Friedman, Foad Abo Dahood, Madison Lee, Abraham Daniels

entry.summary: Introduces VAREX, a benchmark for structured data extraction from government forms using multimodal foundation models, with 1,777 documents across 1,771 unique schemas in four input modalities.

entry.title: GlyphPrinter: Region-Grouped Direct Preference Optimization for Glyph-Accurate Visual Text Rendering

author.name: Xincheng Shuai, Ziye Li, Henghui Ding, Dacheng Tao

entry.summary: GlyphPrinter applies Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) to visual text rendering, using region-grouped preferences to improve glyph accuracy without relying on text recognition reward models that are insensitive to fine-grained errors.

entry.title: LiDAR-EVS: Enhance Extrapolated View Synthesis for 3D Gaussian Splatting with Pseudo-LiDAR Supervision

author.name: Yiming Huang, Xin Kang, Sipeng Zhang, Hongliang Ren, Weihua Zhang, Junjie Lai

entry.summary: LiDAR-EVS improves 3D Gaussian Splatting for LiDAR simulation on extrapolated views beyond training trajectories in autonomous driving, using pseudo-LiDAR supervision as a plug-and-play framework.

entry.title: TransCurriculum: Multi-Dimensional Curriculum Learning for Fast & Stable Locomotion

author.name: Prakhar Mishra, Amir Hossain Raj, Xuesu Xiao, Dinesh Manocha

entry.summary: TransCurriculum uses a transformer-based approach to adapt curriculum learning across three simultaneous dimensions (velocity, terrain, domain randomization) for quadrupedal locomotion, conditioning on training history.

entry.title: Load-Aware Locomotion Control for Humanoid Robots in Industrial Transportation Tasks

author.name: Lequn Fu, Yijun Zhong, Xiao Li, Yibin Liu, Zhiyuan Xu, Jian Tang, Shiqi Li

entry.summary: Presents a load-aware locomotion framework for humanoid robots carrying payloads, using RL with residual joint actions, history-based state encoding, and height-conditioned kinematic references for industrial transportation tasks.

entry.title: Disentangling Prompt Dependence to Evaluate Segmentation Reliability in Gynecological MRI

author.name: Elodie Germani (UR, LTSI), Krystel Nyangoh-Timoh (LTSI), Pierre Jannin (LTSI), John S H Baxter

entry.summary: Introduces the first formulation of prompt dependence in promptable segmentation models (like SAM) that disentangles prompt ambiguity from local sensitivity, applied to gynecological MRI reliability evaluation.

entry.title: TMPDiff: Temporal Mixed-Precision for Diffusion Models

author.name: Basile Lewandowski, Simon Kurz, Aditya Shankar, Robert Birke, Jian-Jia Chen, Lydia Y. Chen

entry.summary: Proposes TMPDiff, a temporal mixed-precision framework for diffusion models that assigns different numeric precision to different denoising timesteps, with an adaptive bisectioning algorithm for per-step precision assignment.

entry.title: Online Learning for Supervisory Switching Control

author.name: Haoyuan Sun, Ali Jadbabaie

entry.summary: Studies supervisory switching control for partially-observed linear systems, bridging classical asymptotic stability guarantees with modern non-asymptotic online learning bounds, allowing testing of potentially unstable controllers.

entry.title: Controlled Langevin Dynamics for Sampling of Feedforward Neural Networks Trained with Minibatches

author.name: Alessandro Zambon, Francesca Caruso, Riccardo Zecchina, Guido Tiana

entry.summary: Introduces pseudo-Langevin dynamics for efficient Boltzmann sampling of neural network parameters using minibatches, exploiting statistical properties of minibatch gradient noise with controlled fictitious masses and friction terms.

entry.title: Shopping Companion: A Memory-Augmented LLM Agent for Real-World E-Commerce Tasks

author.name: Zijian Yu, Kejun Xiao, Huaipeng Zhao, Tao Luo, Xiaoyi Zeng

entry.summary: Introduces Shopping Companion, a memory-augmented LLM agent framework with a benchmark spanning 1.2M real-world products for long-term preference-aware shopping tasks, jointly optimizing memory retrieval and shopping assistance.

entry.title: Towards Stable Self-Supervised Object Representations in Unconstrained Egocentric Video

author.name: Yuting Tan, Xilong Cheng, Yunxiao Qin, Zhengnan Li, Jingjing Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes EgoViT for learning stable object representations from unlabeled egocentric video through proto-object discovery, self-supervised tracking, and consistency regularization in a unified ViT framework.

entry.title: Automated Diabetic Screening via Anterior Segment Ocular Imaging: A Deep Learning and Explainable AI Approach

author.name: Hasaan Maqsood, Saif Ur Rehman Khan, Sebastian Vollmer, Andreas Dengel, Muhammad Nabeel Asim

entry.summary: Develops automated diabetic screening from anterior segment eye images (iris, sclera, conjunctiva) using deep learning, enabling diagnosis with standard cameras instead of specialized fundus photography.

entry.title: Clue Matters: Leveraging Latent Visual Clues to Empower Video Reasoning

author.name: Kaixin zhang, Xiaohe Li, Jiahao Li, Haohua Wu, Xinyu Zhao, Zide Fan, Lei Wang

entry.summary: Proposes ClueNet, a clue-aware video reasoning framework with two-stage supervised fine-tuning for Video QA, addressing hallucination through structured visual clue extraction and filtering.

entry.title: Dataset Diversity Metrics and Impact on Classification Models

author.name: Th\'eo Sourget, Niclas Cla{\ss}en, Jack Junchi Xu, Rob van der Goot, Veronika Cheplygina

entry.summary: Studies dataset diversity metrics for image, text, and metadata using controlled and real-world datasets, evaluating correlation with expert intuition and downstream task performance.

entry.title: Anchor then Polish for Low-light Enhancement

author.name: Tianle Du, Mingjia Li, Hainuo Wang, Xiaojie Guo

entry.summary: Proposes anchor-then-polish (ATP) framework for low-light enhancement that decouples global energy alignment (12 degrees of freedom) from local detail refinement, showing a simple linear operator suffices for global correction.

entry.title: Inevitable Encounters: Backdoor Attacks Involving Lossy Compression

author.name: Qian Li, Yunuo Chen, Yuntian Chen

entry.summary: Studies how lossy compression (like JPEG) can inadvertently neutralize invisible backdoor attacks in deep learning, and highlights the need for attackers to account for compression in their threat models.

entry.title: MoE-ACT: Scaling Multi-Task Bimanual Manipulation with Sparse Language-Conditioned Mixture-of-Experts Transformers

author.name: Kangjun Guo, Haichao Liu, Yanji Sun, Ruhan Zhao, Jinni Zhou, Jun Ma

entry.summary: MoE-ACT integrates sparse Mixture-of-Experts into the Action Chunking Transformer for multi-task bimanual manipulation. The MoE layer decomposes a unified policy into independently invoked expert components to reduce task interference and negative transfer.

entry.title: Distilling Deep Reinforcement Learning into Interpretable Fuzzy Rules: An Explainable AI Framework

author.name: Sanup S. Araballi, Simon Khan, Chilukuri K. Mohan

entry.summary: Proposes distilling deep RL policies into hierarchical Takagi-Sugeno-Kang fuzzy rule systems for interpretability. Introduces three metrics (FRAD, FSC, and another) and achieves 97.3% fidelity to the neural policy with readable IF-THEN rules.

entry.title: MESD: Detecting and Mitigating Procedural Bias in Intersectional Groups

author.name: Gideon Popoola, John Sheppard

entry.summary: Proposes MESD, an intersectional fairness metric measuring explanation stability disparity across intersectional subgroups, complementing outcome-oriented metrics with procedural bias detection.

entry.title: TheraAgent: Multi-Agent Framework with Self-Evolving Memory and Evidence-Calibrated Reasoning for PET Theranostics

author.name: Zhihao Chen, Jiahui Wang, Yizhou Chen, Xiaozhong Ji, Xiaobin Hu, Jimin Hong, Wolfram Andreas Bosbach, Axel Rominger, Ali Afshar-Oromieh, Hongming Shan, Kuangyu Shi

entry.summary: Proposes TheraAgent, a multi-agent framework for PET theranostics treatment prediction that uses self-evolving memory and evidence-calibrated reasoning to predict 177Lu-PSMA therapy response in prostate cancer patients.

entry.title: GRPO and Reflection Reward for Mathematical Reasoning in Large Language Models

author.name: Zhijie Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a four-stage framework integrating Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with reflection reward mechanisms to strengthen LLMs' self-reflective capabilities in mathematical reasoning.

entry.title: Planning as Goal Recognition: Deriving Heuristics from Intention Models - Extended Version

author.name: Giacomo Rosa, Jean Honorio, Nir Lipovetzky, Sebastian Sardina

entry.summary: Proposes using goal recognition (GR) heuristics to improve classical planning, reversing the traditional relationship where planning techniques solve GR problems. Introduces efficiently-computable heuristics that yield improvements for top-scoring classical planners.

entry.title: CRASH: Cognitive Reasoning Agent for Safety Hazards in Autonomous Driving

author.name: Erick Silva, Rehana Yasmin, Ali Shoker

entry.summary: Introduces CRASH, an LLM-based agent for automated reasoning over autonomous vehicle crash reports from NHTSA, analyzing 2,168 real-world AV incidents covering 80M+ miles driven between 2021-2025.

entry.title: Do Metrics for Counterfactual Explanations Align with User Perception?

author.name: Felix Liedeker, Basil Ell, Philipp Cimiano, Christoph D\"using

entry.summary: Empirically compares algorithmic metrics for counterfactual explanations with human judgments across three datasets, finding potential misalignment between standard metrics and actual user perceptions of explanation quality.

entry.title: CAMEL-CLIP: Channel-aware Multimodal Electroencephalography-text Alignment for Generalizable Brain Foundation Models

author.name: Hanseul Choi, Jinyeong Park, Seongwon Jin, Sungho Park, Jibum Kim

entry.summary: Proposes CAMEL-CLIP, a contrastive EEG-text foundation model robust to heterogeneous channel configurations, using channel attribute-based positional encoding and dynamic channel projection for generalizable EEG representations.

entry.title: Task Expansion and Cross Refinement for Open-World Conditional Modeling

author.name: Shreyas Bhat Brahmavar, Qiyang Liu, Yang Li, Junier Oliva

entry.summary: Proposes TEXR, a semi-supervised framework for open-world conditional modeling that enlarges task coverage through structured synthesis and refinement of semantic data contexts using LLM-guided probabilistic generators.

entry.title: Patient-Level Multimodal Question Answering from Multi-Site Auscultation Recordings

author.name: Fan Wu, Tsai-Ning Wang, Nicolas Zumarraga, Ning Wang, Markus Kreft, Kevin O'Sullivan, Elgar Fleisch, Oliver Aalami, Paul Schmiedmayer, Robert Jakob, Patrick Langer

entry.summary: Proposes a framework aligning multi-site auscultation recordings with a frozen LLM embedding space via gated cross-attention for patient-level medical assessment, achieving strong results on the CaReSound benchmark.

entry.title: Draft-and-Target Sampling for Video Generation Policy

author.name: Qikang Zhang, Yingjie Lei, Wei Liu, Daochang Liu

entry.summary: Proposes Draft-and-Target Sampling, a training-free diffusion inference method for video generation policies in robotics that uses self-play denoising with complementary trajectories for faster generation.

entry.title: Opportunistic Cardiac Health Assessment: Estimating Phenotypes from Localizer MRI through Multi-Modal Representations

author.name: Busra Nur Zeybek, \"Ozg\"un Turgut, Yundi Zhang, Jiazhen Pan, Robert Graf, Sophie Starck, Daniel Rueckert, Sevgi Gokce Kafali

entry.summary: Proposes using multi-modal representations (localizer MRI, demographics, ECG) for opportunistic cardiac health assessment from rapid, low-quality MRI localizer images that are normally discarded.

entry.title: AD-Copilot: A Vision-Language Assistant for Industrial Anomaly Detection via Visual In-context Comparison

author.name: Xi Jiang, Yue Guo, Jian Li, Yong Liu, Bin-Bin Gao, Hanqiu Deng, Jun Liu, Heng Zhao, Chengjie Wang, Feng Zheng

entry.summary: Introduces AD-Copilot, an MLLM specialized for industrial anomaly detection via visual in-context comparison, using a data curation pipeline to mine inspection knowledge from industrial images.

entry.title: Computation and Communication Efficient Federated Unlearning via On-server Gradient Conflict Mitigation and Expression

author.name: Minh-Duong Nguyen, Senura Hansaja, Le-Tuan Nguyen, Quoc-Viet Pham, Ken-Tye Yong, Nguyen H. Tran, Dung D. Le

entry.summary: Proposes FOUL, a federated unlearning framework with on-server gradient conflict mitigation that efficiently removes specific clients' data contributions while maintaining model performance.

entry.title: TransDex: Pre-training Visuo-Tactile Policy with Point Cloud Reconstruction for Dexterous Manipulation of Transparent Objects

author.name: Fengguan Li, Yifan Ma, Chen Qian, Wentao Rao, Weiwei Shang

entry.summary: Proposes TransDex, a 3D visuo-tactile fusion policy for dexterous manipulation of transparent objects, using self-supervised point cloud reconstruction pre-training to handle depth noise and information loss.

entry.title: Pixel-level Scene Understanding in One Token: Visual States Need What-is-Where Composition

author.name: Seokmin Lee, Yunghee Lee, Byeonghyun Pak, Byeongju Woo

entry.summary: Proposes CroBo, a visual state representation learning framework for robotic agents that captures 'what-is-where' through global-to-local reconstruction, compressing observations into compact tokens for sequential decision making.

entry.title: What Counts as Real? Speech Restoration and Voice Quality Conversion Pose New Challenges to Deepfake Detection

author.name: Shree Harsha Bokkahalli Satish, Harm Lameris, Joakim Gustafson, \'Eva Sz\'ekely

entry.summary: Shows that phonation-modifying voice conversion and speech restoration are misclassified as spoofed speech by audio anti-spoofing systems, revealing limitations in binary bona fide vs. spoofed classification.

entry.title: A Benchmark for Multi-Party Negotiation Games from Real Negotiation Data

author.name: Leo Benac, Jonas Raedler, Zilin Ma, Finale Doshi-Velez

entry.summary: Introduces a benchmark for multi-party negotiation games using real negotiation data, with a configurable game generator and evaluation of value-function approximations. Includes instances from Harvard Negotiation Challenge.

entry.title: Efficient Federated Conformal Prediction with Group-Conditional Guarantee

author.name: Haifeng Wen, Osvaldo Simeone, Hong Xing

entry.summary: Proposes group-conditional federated conformal prediction (GC-FCP) that provides group-conditional coverage guarantees across distributed data with potentially overlapping groups.

entry.title: GoldenStart: Q-Guided Priors and Entropy Control for Distilling Flow Policies

author.name: He Zhang, Ying Sun, Hui Xiong

entry.summary: GoldenStart proposes a flow-matching policy distillation method for RL that uses Q-guided priors for initial noise distribution and explicit entropy control. Addresses inference latency and exploration challenges in flow-matching policies.

entry.title: MALicious INTent Dataset and Inoculating LLMs for Enhanced Disinformation Detection

author.name: Arkadiusz Modzelewski, Witold Sosnowski, Eleni Papadopulos, Elisa Sartori, Tiziano Labruna, Giovanni Da San Martino, Adam Wierzbicki

entry.summary: MALINT introduces the first human-annotated English corpus for detecting malicious intent behind disinformation, developed with expert fact-checkers. Benchmarks 12 LMs and investigates inoculation theory for improving detection.

entry.title: TopoCL: Topological Contrastive Learning for Medical Imaging

author.name: Guangyu Meng, Pengfei Gu, Peixian Liang, John P. Lalor, Erin Wolf Chambers, Danny Z. Chen

entry.summary: TopoCL integrates topological structures (connectivity, boundaries, cavities) into contrastive learning for medical imaging using persistence diagrams and topology-aware augmentations.

entry.title: Towards Privacy-Preserving Machine Translation at the Inference Stage: A New Task and Benchmark

author.name: Wei Shao, Lemao Liu, Yinqiao Li, Guoping Huang, Shuming Shi, Linqi Song

entry.summary: Defines a new task and benchmark for privacy-preserving machine translation at inference time, addressing the risk of PII exposure when using cloud-based translation services.

entry.title: Decision-Level Ordinal Modeling for Multimodal Essay Scoring with Large Language Models

author.name: Han Zhang, Jiamin Su, Li liu

entry.summary: DLOM makes automated essay scoring an explicit ordinal decision rather than implicit token generation, reusing the language model head to extract score-wise logits. Addresses limitations of autoregressive AES approaches, particularly for multimodal scoring where visual input utility varies.

entry.title: Informative Perturbation Selection for Uncertainty-Aware Post-hoc Explanations

author.name: Sumedha Chugh, Ranjitha Prasad, Nazreen Shah

entry.summary: EAGLE proposes an active learning approach for selecting informative perturbations in post-hoc model-agnostic explanations. Improves the quality of surrogate model approximations by intelligently choosing which perturbed inputs to evaluate. Addresses uncertainty in explanation methods.

entry.title: FairMed-XGB: A Bayesian-Optimised Multi-Metric Framework with Explainability for Demographic Equity in Critical Healthcare Data

author.name: Mitul Goswami, Romit Chatterjee, Arif Ahmed Sekh

entry.summary: FairMed-XGB integrates fairness-aware loss functions into XGBoost for clinical prediction, optimized via Bayesian search. Demonstrates substantial bias reduction across gender in critical care settings using MIMIC-IV-ED and eICU databases.

entry.title: RESQ: A Unified Framework for REliability- and Security Enhancement of Quantized Deep Neural Networks

author.name: Ali Soltan Mohammadi, Samira Nazari, Ali Azarpeyvand, Mahdi Taheri, Milos Krstic, Michael Huebner, Christian Herglotz, Tara Ghasempouri

entry.summary: RESQ proposes a three-stage framework for quantized DNNs that balances fault and attack robustness. Stages address attack resilience, fault resilience, and quantization integration. Shows consistent gains across multiple architectures and datasets.

entry.title: Building Trust in PINNs: Error Estimation through Finite Difference Methods

author.name: Aleksander Krasowski, Ren\'e P. Klausen, Aycan Celik, Sebastian Lapuschkin, Wojciech Samek, Jonas Naujoks

entry.summary: Proposes a lightweight post-hoc method for estimating pointwise errors in Physics-Informed Neural Network predictions using finite difference methods, providing where and by how much predictions deviate.

entry.title: Lore: Repurposing Git Commit Messages as a Structured Knowledge Protocol for AI Coding Agents

author.name: Ivan Stetsenko

entry.summary: Proposes Lore, a lightweight protocol that restructures git commit messages into structured decision records carrying constraints, rejected alternatives, and agent directives for AI coding agents.

entry.title: Neural Approximation and Its Applications

author.name: Wei-Hao Wu, Ting-Zhu Huang, Xi-Le Zhao, Yisi Luo, Deyu Meng

entry.summary: Introduces NeuApprox, a paradigm using untrained neural networks as basis functions for multivariate function approximation, decomposing functions into block terms with physically interpretable structure.

entry.title: Node Role-Guided LLMs for Dynamic Graph Clustering

author.name: Dongyuan Li, Ying Zhang, Yaozu Wu, Renhe Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes an interpretable dynamic graph clustering framework using LLMs that maps graph embeddings to semantic concepts through learnable prototypes with orthogonal role and clustering subspaces.

entry.title: Effective Sparsity: A Unified Framework via Normalized Entropy and the Effective Number of Nonzeros

author.name: Haoyu He, Hao Wang, Jiashan Wang, Hao Zeng

entry.summary: Introduces Effective Number of Nonzeros (ENZ), normalized entropy-based regularizers that measure concentration of significant coefficients rather than discrete cardinality, providing stable and continuous effective sparsity measures.

entry.title: Learning in Function Spaces: An Unified Functional Analytic View of Supervised and Unsupervised Learning

author.name: K. Lakshmanan

entry.summary: Presents a conceptual framework unifying supervised and unsupervised learning as variational optimization over function spaces defined by the data distribution. Learning algorithms are viewed as estimating functions in bases determined by distribution-induced operators.

entry.title: \texttt{BayesBreak}: Generalized Hierarchical Bayesian Segmentation with Irregular Designs, Multi-Sample Hierarchies, and Grouped/Latent-Group Designs

author.name: Omid Shams Solari

entry.summary: Presents BayesBreak, a modular offline Bayesian segmentation framework supporting irregular designs, multi-sample hierarchies, and grouped/latent-group designs, with exact dynamic programming inference for exponential-family likelihoods.

entry.title: BiTro: Bidirectional Transfer Learning Enhances Bulk and Spatial Transcriptomics Prediction in Cancer Pathological Images

author.name: Jingkun Yu, Guangkai Shang, Changtao Li, Xun Gong, Tianrui Li, Yazhou He, Zhipeng Luo

entry.summary: Proposes BiTro, a bidirectional transfer learning framework that mutually enhances bulk and spatial transcriptomics prediction from cancer pathological images, leveraging both data modalities' complementary strengths.

entry.title: MONET: Modeling and Optimization of neural NEtwork Training from Edge to Data Centers

author.name: J\'er\'emy Morlier, Robin Geens, Stef Cuyckens, Arne Symons, Marian Verhelst, Vincent Gripon, Mathieu L\'eonardon

entry.summary: Introduces MONET, a framework for modeling neural network training workloads on heterogeneous dataflow accelerators, extending inference-focused tools to capture memory footprint and backpropagation complexity.

entry.title: Accelerating Byzantine-Robust Distributed Learning with Compressed Communication via Double Momentum and Variance Reduction

author.name: Yanghao Li, Changxin Liu, Yuhao Yi

entry.summary: Proposes Byz-DM21, a Byzantine-robust and communication-efficient distributed learning algorithm using double momentum and error feedback, eliminating large batch requirements while maintaining robustness.

entry.title: Not All Invariants Are Equal: Curating Training Data to Accelerate Program Verification with SLMs

author.name: Ido Pinto, Yizhak Yisrael Elboher, Haoze Wu, Nina Narodytska, Guy Katz

entry.summary: Presents a data curation pipeline (Wonda) for generating high-quality training data for loop invariant synthesis, enabling small language models to outperform larger ones on program verification tasks. The pipeline uses AST-based normalization and formal quality criteria to refine noisy verifier-generated invariants.

entry.title: GraphVLM: Benchmarking Vision Language Models for Multimodal Graph Learning

author.name: Jiajin Liu, Dongzhe Fan, Chuanhao Ji, Daochen Zha, Qiaoyu Tan

entry.summary: Introduces GraphVLM, a systematic benchmark evaluating VLMs for multimodal graph learning across three paradigms: VLM-as-Encoder, VLM-as-Reasoner, and hybrid approaches for graph-structured multimodal data.

entry.title: Hierarchy of extreme-event predictability in turbulence revealed by machine learning

author.name: Yuxuan Yang, Chenyu Dong, Gianmarco Mengaldo

entry.summary: Trains an autoregressive conditional diffusion model on turbulence simulations to reveal a hierarchy of extreme-event predictability, showing enstrophy extremes have forecast skill from 1 to >4 Lyapunov times controlled by large-scale structures.

entry.title: Maximin Robust Bayesian Experimental Design

author.name: Hany Abdulsamad, Sahel Iqbal, Christian A. Naesseth, Takuo Matsubara, Adrien Corenflos

entry.summary: Formulates robust Bayesian experimental design as a max-min game using Sibson's α-mutual information, identifying the α-tilted posterior as the robust belief update and using PAC-Bayes bounds for stochastic design policies.

entry.title: How to find expressible and trainable parameterized quantum circuits?

author.name: Peter R\"oseler, Dennis Willsch, Kristel Michielsen

entry.summary: Addresses the open question of constructing parameterized quantum circuits (PQCs) that are both trainable and expressive. Derives concentration bounds for trainability, observes anticorrelation between trainability and expressibility, and proposes an ansatz-search framework.

entry.title: A Score Filter Enhanced Data Assimilation Framework for Data-Driven Dynamical Systems

author.name: Jingqiao Tang, Ryan Bausback, Feng Bao, Guannan Zhang, Phuoc-Toan Huynh

entry.summary: Introduces a score-filter-enhanced data assimilation framework using Ensemble Score Filter (a generative AI approach) to reduce predictive uncertainty in ML models for dynamical system forecasting by incorporating observational data during training.

entry.title: Masked BRep Autoencoder via Hierarchical Graph Transformer

author.name: Yifei Li, Kang Wu, Wenming Wu, Xiaoming Fu

entry.summary: Introduces a masked graph autoencoder with hierarchical graph Transformer for self-supervised learning on CAD boundary representation models, supporting part classification, segmentation, and machining feature recognition.

entry.title: Projection-Free Evolution Strategies for Continuous Prompt Search

author.name: Yu Cai, Canxi Huang, Xiaoyu He

entry.summary: Proposes projection-free evolution strategies for continuous prompt search, showing that random projections fail to capture the low-dimensional structure of prompt space and offering better alternatives.

entry.title: OasisSimp: An Open-source Asian-English Sentence Simplification Dataset

author.name: Hannah Liu, Muxin Tian, Iqra Ali, Haonan Gao, Qiaoyiwen Wu, Blair Yang, Uthayasanker Thayasivam, En-Shiun Annie Lee, Pakawat Nakwijit, Surangika Ranathunga, Ravi Shekhar

entry.summary: Introduces OasisSimp, a multilingual sentence simplification dataset covering English, Sinhala, Tamil, Pashto, and Thai, with first-ever simplification data for Thai, Pashto, and Tamil.

entry.title: Automatic Inter-document Multi-hop Scientific QA Generation

author.name: Seungmin Lee, Dongha Kim, Yuni Jeon, Junyoung Koh, Min Song

entry.summary: Presents AIM-SciQA, a framework for automatically generating multi-document, multi-hop scientific QA datasets by extracting single-hop QAs and constructing cross-document relations via semantic alignment and citations. Applied to 8,211 PubMed papers, producing over 400K QA pairs.

entry.title: Information Asymmetry across Language Varieties: A Case Study on Cantonese-Mandarin and Bavarian-German QA

author.name: Renhao Pei, Siyao Peng, Verena Blaschke, Robert Litschko, Barbara Plank

entry.summary: Constructs a novel QA dataset capturing knowledge asymmetry between local language varieties (Cantonese vs. Mandarin, Bavarian vs. German) and shows LLMs fail to answer questions about information only present in local Wikipedia editions.

entry.title: SEA-Vision: A Multilingual Benchmark for Comprehensive Document and Scene Text Understanding in Southeast Asia

author.name: Pengfei Yue, Xingran Zhao, Juntao Chen, Peng Hou, Wang Longchao, Jianghang Lin, Shengchuan Zhang, Anxiang Zeng, Liujuan Cao

entry.summary: Introduces SEA-Vision, a benchmark for document parsing and text-centric VQA across 11 Southeast Asian languages with 15,234 annotated pages, addressing the lack of multilingual document understanding benchmarks for complex SEA writing systems.

entry.title: Fine-tuning RoBERTa for CVE-to-CWE Classification: A 125M Parameter Model Competitive with LLMs

author.name: Nikita Mosievskiy

entry.summary: Fine-tunes RoBERTa-base (125M params) for CVE-to-CWE classification using Claude Sonnet 4.6-refined labels, achieving 87.4% top-1 accuracy competitive with much larger models at a fraction of the cost.

entry.title: Layout-Guided Controllable Pathology Image Generation with In-Context Diffusion Transformers

author.name: Yuntao Shou, Xiangyong Cao, Qian Zhao, Deyu Meng

entry.summary: Develops a multi-agent LVLM annotation framework for generating layout-guided pathology images using in-context diffusion transformers, addressing the lack of patch-level spatial layout annotations for whole-slide images.

entry.title: ActionPlan: Future-Aware Streaming Motion Synthesis via Frame-Level Action Planning

author.name: Eric Nazarenus, Chuqiao Li, Yannan He, Xianghui Xie, Jan Eric Lenssen, Gerard Pons-Moll

entry.summary: Presents ActionPlan, a motion diffusion framework that bridges real-time streaming and offline generation through per-frame action planning with text latents as semantic anchors. Supports flexible denoising orders for both streaming and offline modes.

entry.title: MIRAGE: Model-agnostic Industrial Realistic Anomaly Generation and Evaluation for Visual Anomaly Detection

author.name: Jinwei Hu, Francesco Borsatti, Arianna Stropeni, Davide Dalle Pezze, Manuel Barusco, Gian Antonio Susto

entry.summary: Presents MIRAGE, a fully automated pipeline for generating realistic industrial anomaly images using generative models as black-box APIs, with VLM-based prompt generation and CLIP-based quality filtering. Requires no training or real anomalous examples.

entry.title: DiveUp: Learning Feature Upsampling from Diverse Vision Foundation Models

author.name: Xiaoqiong Liu, Heng Fan

entry.summary: Proposes DiveUp, a feature upsampling framework that leverages multiple vision foundation models as a panel of experts rather than relying on a single model's features, addressing location misalignment and high-norm artifacts.

entry.title: QTrack: Query-Driven Reasoning for Multi-modal MOT

author.name: Tajamul Ashraf, Tavaheed Tariq, Sonia Yadav, Abrar Ul Riyaz, Wasif Tak, Moloud Abdar, Janibul Bashir

entry.summary: Introduces QTrack, a query-driven multi-object tracking paradigm conditioned on natural language queries, along with RMOT26 benchmark. Tracks only user-specified targets based on textual descriptions.

entry.title: Geo-ID: Test-Time Geometric Consensus for Cross-View Consistent Intrinsics

author.name: Alara Dirik, Stefanos Zafeiriou

entry.summary: Proposes Geo-ID, a test-time framework for cross-view consistent intrinsic image decomposition (albedo, roughness, metallicity) that enforces geometric consensus across multiple views of the same scene without retraining.

entry.title: SCoCCA: Multi-modal Sparse Concept Decomposition via Canonical Correlation Analysis

author.name: Ehud Gordon, Meir Yossef Levi, Guy Gilboa

entry.summary: Proposes SCoCCA for multi-modal concept-based explainability using Canonical Correlation Analysis to align visual and textual features across the CLIP modality gap, enabling interpretable sparse concept decomposition.

entry.title: PhyGaP: Physically-Grounded Gaussians with Polarization Cues

author.name: Jiale Wu, Xiaoyang Bai, Zongqi He, Weiwei Xu, Yifan Peng

entry.summary: Presents PhyGaP, a 3DGS method using polarization cues for physically-grounded reflection decomposition and relighting. Designs polarimetric deferred rendering to model polarization-dependent light transport.

entry.title: A Multi-Agent Perception-Action Alliance for Efficient Long Video Reasoning

author.name: Yichang Xu, Gaowen Liu, Ramana Rao Kompella, Tiansheng Huang, Sihao Hu, Fatih Ilhan, Selim Furkan Tekin, Zachary Yahn, Ling Liu

entry.summary: Presents A4VL, a multi-agent perception-action framework for long video reasoning where VLM agents collaboratively find relevant video blocks and reach consensus through multi-round exploration.

entry.title: Garments2Look: A Multi-Reference Dataset for High-Fidelity Outfit-Level Virtual Try-On with Clothing and Accessories

author.name: Junyao Hu, Zhongwei Cheng, Waikeung Wong, Xingxing Zou

entry.summary: Introduces Garments2Look, the first large-scale dataset for outfit-level virtual try-on with 80K many-garments-to-one-look pairs across 40+ categories. Addresses the gap between single-garment VTON and real-world full-outfit styling scenarios.

entry.title: RegFormer++: An Efficient Large-Scale 3D LiDAR Point Registration Network with Projection-Aware 2D Transformer

author.name: Jiuming Liu, Guangming Wang, Zhe Liu, Chaokang Jiang, Haoang Li, Mengmeng Liu, Tianchen Deng, Marc Pollefeys, Michael Ying Yang, Hesheng Wang

entry.summary: RegFormer++ is an end-to-end transformer network for large-scale LiDAR point cloud registration using projection-aware 2D transformers, avoiding the traditional two-stage paradigm.

entry.title: GenState-AI: State-Aware Dataset for Text-to-Video Retrieval on AI-Generated Videos

author.name: Minghan Li, Tongna Chen, Tianrui Lv, Yishuai Zhang, Suchao An, Guodong Zhou

entry.summary: GenState-AI is an AI-generated benchmark for text-to-video retrieval that evaluates temporal reasoning through controlled state transitions with hard negatives.

entry.title: Continual Few-shot Adaptation for Synthetic Fingerprint Detection

author.name: Joseph Geo Benjamin, Anil K. Jain, Karthik Nandakumar

entry.summary: Proposes continual few-shot adaptation for synthetic fingerprint detection, enabling detectors to generalize to unseen generative AI models without forgetting previously learned ones.

entry.title: EviATTA: Evidential Active Test-Time Adaptation for Medical Segment Anything Models

author.name: Jiayi Chen, Yasmeen George, Winston Chong, Jianfei Cai

entry.summary: EviATTA proposes evidential active test-time adaptation for medical SAMs using Dirichlet-based uncertainty decomposition to efficiently utilize sparse expert annotations.

entry.title: E2EGS: Event-to-Edge Gaussian Splatting for Pose-Free 3D Reconstruction

author.name: Yunsoo Kim, Changki Sung, Dasol Hong, Hyun Myung

entry.summary: E2EGS performs pose-free 3D reconstruction using event cameras and edge-based Gaussian splatting, eliminating the need for known camera poses.

entry.title: RadarXFormer: Robust Object Detection via Cross-Dimension Fusion of 4D Radar Spectra and Images for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Yue Sun, Yeqiang Qian, Zhe Wang, Tianhui Li, Chunxiang Wang, Ming Yang

entry.summary: RadarXFormer fuses 4D radar spectra with camera images for robust object detection in autonomous driving, addressing adverse weather limitations of camera and LiDAR.

entry.title: Personalized Federated Learning with Residual Fisher Information for Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Meilu Zhu, Yuxing Li, Zhiwei Wang, Edmund Y. Lam

entry.summary: Proposes pFL-ResFIM, a personalized federated learning framework using Residual Fisher Information Matrix to quantify parameter sensitivity to domain discrepancies for medical image segmentation. Uses spectral transfer to estimate ResFIM under privacy constraints.

entry.title: One CT Unified Model Training Framework to Rule All Scanning Protocols

author.name: Fengzhi Xu, Ziyuan Yang, Zexin Lu, Yingyu Chen, Fenglei Fan, Hongming Shan, Yi Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes a unified CT reconstruction model handling multiple scanning protocols by recognizing protocol-specific sub-manifolds in feature space, working without paired data.

entry.title: Exemplar Diffusion: Improving Medical Object Detection with Opportunistic Labels

author.name: Victor W{\aa}hlstrand, Jennifer Alv\'en, Ida H\"aggstr\"om

entry.summary: Proposes exemplar diffusion, a training-free approach to improve medical object detection by leveraging known bounding boxes at inference time through diffusion-based detection methods.

entry.title: IRIS: Intersection-aware Ray-based Implicit Editable Scenes

author.name: Grzegorz Wilczy\'nski, Miko{\l}aj Zieli\'nski, Krzysztof Byrski, Joanna Waczy\'nska, Dominik Belter, Przemys{\l}aw Spurek

entry.summary: Proposes IRIS, a framework combining Gaussians and neural fields for efficient and editable scene representation, using intersection-based rendering instead of volumetric sampling.

entry.title: MV2UV: Generating High-quality UV Texture Maps with Multiview Prompts

author.name: Zheng Zhang, Qinchuan Zhang, Yuteng Ye, Zhi Chen, Penglei Ji, Mengfei Li, Wenxiao Zhang, Yuan Liu

entry.summary: Proposes MV2UV for generating high-quality UV texture maps by combining multiview generation with UV-space inpainting, resolving multiview inconsistency while completing unseen regions.

entry.title: FreeTalk: Emotional Topology-Free 3D Talking Heads

author.name: Federico Nocentini, Thomas Besnier, Claudio Ferrari, Stefano Berretti, Mohamed Daoudi

entry.summary: Proposes FreeTalk, a two-stage framework for emotion-conditioned 3D talking-head animation that generalizes to unregistered meshes with arbitrary topology, using audio-to-sparse landmark prediction followed by sparse-to-dense propagation.

entry.title: Clinically Aware Synthetic Image Generation for Concept Coverage in Chest X-ray Models

author.name: Amy Rafferty, Rishi Ramaesh, Ajitha Rajan

entry.summary: CARS is a clinically-aware framework for generating synthetic chest X-ray images that targets underrepresented clinical feature combinations in public datasets. It applies controlled perturbations to clinical feature vectors to insert/delete pathological findings while preserving anatomy, evaluated across seven backbone architectures.

entry.title: Open World MRI Reconstruction with Bias-Calibrated Adaptation

author.name: Jiyao Liu, Shangqi Gao, Lihao Liu, Junzhi Ning, Jinjie Wei, Junjun He, Xiahai Zhuang, Ningsheng Xu

entry.summary: BiasRecon addresses open-world MRI reconstruction where test data differs drastically from training data. Uses bias-calibrated adaptation with frequency-guided prior calibration following a minimal intervention principle.

entry.title: Bi-HIL: Bilateral Control-Based Multimodal Hierarchical Imitation Learning via Subtask-Level Progress Rate and Keyframe Memory for Long-Horizon Contact-Rich Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Thanpimon Buamanee, Masato Kobayashi, Yuki Uranishi

entry.summary: Bi-HIL proposes bilateral control-based hierarchical imitation learning for long-horizon contact-rich manipulation, integrating keyframe memory with subtask-level progress tracking for coordinated high/low-level policies.

entry.title: Multi-Robot Coordination for Planning under Context Uncertainty

author.name: Pulkit Rustagi, Kyle Hollins Wray, Sandhya Saisubramanian

entry.summary: Formalizes multi-robot coordination under context uncertainty as MR-CUSSP, where robots gather joint observations at landmark states to infer the operational context before optimizing context-dependent objectives.

entry.title: Robust Sim-to-Real Cloth Untangling through Reduced-Resolution Observations via Adaptive Force-Difference Quantization

author.name: Yoshihisa Tsurumine, Yuki Kadokawa, Kohei Hayashi, Christian Diehm, Takamitsu Matsubara

entry.summary: Proposes adaptive force-difference quantization for sim-to-real transfer in cloth untangling, based on the insight that qualitative tension transitions matter more than exact force values for this task.

entry.title: GraspADMM: Improving Dexterous Grasp Synthesis via ADMM Optimization

author.name: Liangwang Ruan, Jiayi Chen, He Wang, Baoquan Chen

entry.summary: GraspADMM improves dexterous grasp synthesis by combining ADMM optimization with simulator-based refinement, addressing both kinematic feasibility and dynamic stability while maintaining grasp diversity.

entry.title: Confusion-Aware In-Context-Learning for Vision-Language Models in Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Yayun He, Zuheng Kang, Botao Zhao, Zhouyin Wu, Junqing Peng, Jianzong Wang

entry.summary: CAICL proposes Confusion-Aware In-Context Learning to improve VLM robustness in robotic manipulation, particularly for distinguishing confusable objects. Identifies that shortcut learning in VLMs causes failures and uses confusion analysis to construct better in-context examples.

entry.title: NavGSim: High-Fidelity Gaussian Splatting Simulator for Large-Scale Navigation

author.name: Jiahang Liu, Yuanxing Duan, Jiazhao Zhang, Minghan Li, Shaoan Wang, Zhizheng Zhang, He Wang

entry.summary: NavGSim is a Gaussian Splatting-based simulator for large-scale navigation that enables photorealistic rendering in expansive scenes. Introduces a slice technique to extract navigable areas from Gaussian Splatting reconstructions for collision simulation.

entry.title: Zero-Shot Generalization from Motion Demonstrations to New Tasks

author.name: Kilian Freitag, Alvin Combrink, Nadia Figueroa

entry.summary: Introduces Gaussian Graph, which reinterprets spatial components of learned motion primitives as discrete vertices with connections, enabling zero-shot generalization from isolated demonstrations to novel task compositions. Provides fast, reactive, and provably stable control.

entry.title: Verification and Forward Invariance of Control Barrier Functions for Differential-Algebraic Systems

author.name: Hongchao Zhang, Mohamad H. Kazma, Meiyi Ma, Taylor T. Johnson, Ahmad F. Taha

entry.summary: Introduces DAE-aware Control Barrier Functions for systems governed by differential-algebraic equations, where algebraic constraints restrict allowable trajectories. Derives conditions ensuring forward invariance compatible with both CBF safety and the constraint manifold.

entry.title: DOVA: Deliberation-First Multi-Agent Orchestration for Autonomous Research Automation

author.name: Aaron Shen, Alfred Shen

entry.summary: Presents DOVA, a multi-agent platform with deliberation-first orchestration where meta-reasoning precedes tool use, hybrid collaborative reasoning combining ensemble diversity with blackboard transparency, and adaptive trust calibration for research automation.

entry.title: Executable Archaeology: Reanimating the Logic Theorist from its IPL-V Source

author.name: Jeff Shrager

entry.summary: Reconstructs and runs the 1956 Logic Theorist (widely considered the first AI program) by building a new IPL-V interpreter in Common Lisp and faithfully reanimating the code from Stefferud's 1963 report. Successfully proves 16 of 23 theorems from Principia Mathematica.

entry.title: State Algebra for Probabilistic Logic

author.name: Dmitry Lesnik, Tobias Sch\"afer

entry.summary: Presents a Probabilistic State Algebra extending deterministic propositional logic to construct Markov Random Fields through pure linear algebra, bypassing graph-traversal algorithms by embedding logical reduction natively within matrix operations.

entry.title: MeTok: An Efficient Meteorological Tokenization with Hyper-Aligned Group Learning for Precipitation Nowcasting

author.name: Qizhao Jin, Xianhuang Xu, Yong Cao, Shiming Xiang, Xinyu Xiao

entry.summary: Introduces MeTok, a distribution-centric meteorological tokenization scheme for precipitation nowcasting that groups similar meteorological features spatially rather than by position, with aligned group learning for extreme precipitation patterns.

entry.title: Demand-Driven Context: A Methodology for Building Enterprise Knowledge Bases Through Agent Failure

author.name: Raj Navakoti, Saideep Navakoti

entry.summary: Introduces Demand-Driven Context (DDC), a methodology that uses agent failure as the trigger for knowledge base construction in enterprises, addressing the gap between top-down knowledge engineering and bottom-up automation.

entry.title: Interference-Aware K-Step Reachable Communication in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Ziyu Cheng, Jinsheng Ren, Zhouxian Jiang, Chenzhihang Li, Rongye Shi, Bin Liang, Jun Yang

entry.summary: Proposes IA-KRC for multi-agent reinforcement learning communication, using K-step reachability to confine message passing to physically accessible neighbors and an interference-prediction module to optimize partner selection.

entry.title: PrototypeNAS: Rapid Design of Deep Neural Networks for Microcontroller Units

author.name: Mark Deutel, Simon Geis, Axel Plinge

entry.summary: Proposes PrototypeNAS, a zero-shot neural architecture search method for rapidly deploying DNNs on microcontroller units, automating selection, compression, and specialization without training candidate networks from scratch.

entry.title: Listening to the Echo: User-Reaction Aware Policy Optimization via Scalar-Verbal Hybrid Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Jing Ye, Xinpei Zhao, Lu Xiang, Yaping Zhang, Chengqing Zong

entry.summary: Introduces RAPO (Reaction Aware Policy Optimization) for emotional support dialogue, which optimizes based on simulated user reactions rather than expert-defined scalar rewards, generating dense natural language feedback.

entry.title: The Ghost in the Grammar: Methodological Anthropomorphism in AI Safety Evaluations

author.name: Mariana Lins Costa

entry.summary: Philosophical analysis of anthropomorphism in AI safety research, particularly critiquing Anthropic's 'agentic misalignment' studies for projecting human categories like intention and persona onto AI systems without adequate conceptual grounding.

entry.title: Quality Assessment of Public Summary of Training Content for GPAI models required by AI Act Article 53(1)(d)

author.name: Dick A. H. Blankvoort, Harshvardhan J. Pandit, Maximilian Gahntz

entry.summary: Provides a quality assessment framework for the AI Act's Article 53(1)(d) requirement that GPAI model providers publish training data summaries, evaluating transparency and usefulness dimensions.

entry.title: Agentic LLM Workflow for MR Spectroscopy Volume-of-Interest Placements in Brain Tumors

author.name: Sangyoon Lee, Francesca Branzoli, Ma{\l}gorzata Marja\'nska, Patrick Bolan

entry.summary: Proposes an agentic LLM workflow for MR spectroscopy volume-of-interest placement in brain tumors that generates diverse candidate VOIs and uses LLM-based selection to handle the broad operating window and reduce inter-operator variability.

entry.title: Bridging the Visual-to-Physical Gap: Physically Aligned Representations for Fall Risk Analysis

author.name: Xianqi Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes PHARL, a physics-aware representation learning method for fall risk analysis that learns physically meaningful representations from video without requiring clinical injury labels, using contact mechanics priors.

entry.title: NormCode Canvas: Making LLM Agentic Workflows Development Sustainable via Case-Based Reasoning

author.name: Xin Guan, Yunshan Li, Ze Wang

entry.summary: Presents NormCode Canvas, a deployed system implementing case-based reasoning at two levels for multi-step LLM workflows, with a semi-formal planning language that ensures self-contained execution checkpoints.

entry.title: MR-GNF: Multi-Resolution Graph Neural Forecasting on Ellipsoidal Meshes for Efficient Regional Weather Prediction

author.name: Andrii Shchur, Inna Skarga-Bandurova

entry.summary: Introduces MR-GNF, a lightweight multi-resolution graph neural network for regional weather forecasting on ellipsoidal meshes that couples multiple resolution domains for continuous cross-scale message passing.

entry.title: An Empirical Investigation of Pre-Trained Deep Learning Model Reuse in the Scientific Process

author.name: Nicholas M. Synovic, Karolina Ryzka, Alessandra V. Vellucci Solari, Kenny Lyons, James C. Davis, George K. Thiruvathukal

entry.summary: First empirical study of pre-trained deep learning model reuse patterns in natural sciences, quantifying utilization and impact of conceptual, adaptation, and deployment reuse across scientific publications.

entry.title: Routing Channel-Patch Dependencies in Time Series Forecasting with Graph Spectral Decomposition

author.name: Dongyuan Li, Shun Zheng, Chang Xu, Jiang Bian, Renhe Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes xCPD, a plugin that adaptively balances channel-independent and channel-dependent strategies in time series forecasting using graph spectral decomposition to route channel-patch dependencies.

entry.title: UniVid: Pyramid Diffusion Model for High Quality Video Generation

author.name: Xinyu Xiao, Binbin Yang, Tingtian Li, Yipeng Yu, Sen Lei

entry.summary: Presents UniVid, a unified video generation model combining text-to-video and image-to-video in a single framework using temporal-pyramid attention for generating temporally coherent frames from both text and image inputs.

entry.title: Is Seeing Believing? Evaluating Human Sensitivity to Synthetic Video

author.name: David Wegmann, Emil Stevnsborg, S{\o}ren Knudsen, Luca Rossi, Aske Mottelson

entry.summary: Studies human sensitivity to synthetic video (deepfakes) through two between-subjects experiments examining how audio-visual distortions and AI-generated content affect credibility assessment and learning outcomes.

entry.title: APEX-Searcher: Augmenting LLMs' Search Capabilities through Agentic Planning and Execution

author.name: Kun Chen, Qingchao Kong, Zhao Feifei, Wenji Mao

entry.summary: Proposes APEX-Searcher, an agentic planning and execution framework for LLM-based multi-hop search that addresses ambiguous retrieval paths and sparse RL rewards in complex question answering.

entry.title: LLM-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Audio-Visual Speech Enhancement

author.name: Chih-Ning Chen, Jen-Cheng Hou, Hsin-Min Wang, Shao-Yi Chien, Yu Tsao, Fan-Gang Zeng

entry.summary: Proposes an LLM-guided reinforcement learning framework for audio-visual speech enhancement where an audio LLM generates natural language descriptions of enhanced speech, converted to reward signals via sentiment analysis.

entry.title: QiMeng-CodeV-SVA: Training Specialized LLMs for Hardware Assertion Generation via RTL-Grounded Bidirectional Data Synthesis

author.name: Yutong Wu, Chenrui Cao, Pengwei Jin, Di Huang, Rui Zhang, Xishan Zhang, Zidong Du, Qi Guo, Xing Hu

entry.summary: Proposes a data synthesis framework for training LLMs to generate SystemVerilog Assertions (SVAs) from natural language, using open-source RTL code to guide generation and bidirectional translation for data selection. CodeV-SVA-14B achieves 75.8% on human-written benchmarks.

entry.title: All-day Multi-scenes Lifelong Vision-and-Language Navigation with Tucker Adaptation

author.name: Xudong Wang, Gan Li, Zhiyu Liu, Yao Wang, Lianqing Liu, Zhi Han

entry.summary: Addresses lifelong vision-and-language navigation across diverse scenes by proposing Tucker Adaptation (TuKA), using high-order tensor decomposition to capture multi-hierarchical navigation knowledge and prevent catastrophic forgetting.

entry.title: MBD: A Model-Based Debiasing Framework Across User, Content, and Model Dimensions

author.name: Yuantong Li, Lei Yuan, Zhihao Zheng, Weimiao Wu, Songbin Liu, Jeong Min Lee, Ali Selman Aydin, Shaofeng Deng, Junbo Chen, Xinyi Zhang, Hongjing Xia, Sam Fieldman, Matthew Kosko, Wei Fu, Du Zhang, Peiyu Yang, Albert Jin Chung, Xianlei Qiu, Miao Yu, Zhongwei Teng, Hao Chen, Sunny Baek, Hui Tang, Yang Lv, Renze Wang, Qifan Wang, Zhan Li, Tiantian Xu, Peng Wu, Ji Liu

entry.summary: MBD is a model-based debiasing framework for recommendation systems that addresses heterogeneous biases across behavioral signals (watch time, loop rate, comment probability) along user, content, and model dimensions.

entry.title: Anterior's Approach to Fairness Evaluation of Automated Prior Authorization System

author.name: Sai P. Selvaraj, Khadija Mahmoud, Anuj Iravane

entry.summary: Presents a fairness evaluation framework for automated prior authorization in healthcare based on error rates rather than approval rates, evaluated across sex, age, race/ethnicity, and socioeconomic status.

entry.title: AdapterTune: Zero-Initialized Low-Rank Adapters for Frozen Vision Transformers

author.name: Salim Khazem

entry.summary: AdapterTune adds zero-initialized low-rank bottleneck adapters to frozen Vision Transformers, guaranteeing the adapted network starts at the pretrained function. Provides theoretical framework for adapter rank as capacity budget.

entry.title: VorTEX: Various overlap ratio for Target speech EXtraction

author.name: Ro-hoon Oh, Jihwan Seol, Bugeun Kim

entry.summary: VorTEX introduces a text-prompted target speech extraction architecture with a Decoupled Adaptive Multi-branch Fusion block. Creates PORTE, a controlled dataset spanning 0-100% overlap ratios, and proposes the SuRE metric for detecting suppression behavior. Addresses the gap in understanding TSE behavior across realistic overlap conditions.

entry.title: Real-Time Driver Safety Scoring Through Inverse Crash Probability Modeling

author.name: Joyjit Roy, Samaresh Kumar Singh

entry.summary: SafeDriver-IQ transforms binary crash classifiers into continuous 0-100 safety scores by combining national crash statistics with naturalistic driving data from autonomous vehicles. Fuses NHTSA crash records with Waymo Open Motion Dataset scenarios. Provides interpretable, continuous risk quantification for real-time driver feedback.

entry.title: Spectrogram features for audio and speech analysis

author.name: Ian McLoughlin, Lam Pham, Yan Song, Xiaoxiao Miao, Huy Phan, Pengfei Cai, Qing Gu, Jiang Nan, Haoyu Song, Donny Soh

entry.summary: Survey/tutorial on spectrogram-based representations for deep learning audio analysis. Covers resolution, span, representation and scaling choices for spectrograms. Comprehensive review of feature engineering for audio ML.

entry.title: GradCFA: A Hybrid Gradient-Based Counterfactual and Feature Attribution Explanation Algorithm for Local Interpretation of Neural Networks

author.name: Jacob Sanderson, Hua Mao, Wai Lok Woo

entry.summary: GradCFA combines counterfactual explanations with feature attribution in a hybrid framework optimizing feasibility, plausibility, and diversity. Extends to multi-class scenarios beyond typical binary classification focus. Gradient-based approach for unified interpretability.

entry.title: TabKD: Tabular Knowledge Distillation through Interaction Diversity of Learned Feature Bins

author.name: Shovon Niverd Pereira, Krishna Khadka, Yu Lei

entry.summary: Proposes TabKD, a data-free knowledge distillation method specifically designed for tabular data that learns adaptive feature bins and generates synthetic queries maximizing pairwise interaction coverage.

entry.title: Beyond Attention: True Adaptive World Models via Spherical Kernel Operator

author.name: Vladimer Khasia

entry.summary: Proposes replacing attention with a spherical kernel operator for world models, arguing that conventional latent-space approaches suffer from manifold shift and attention's saturation phenomenon.

entry.title: A Stability-Aware Frozen Euler Autoencoder for Physics-Informed Tracking in Continuum Mechanics (SAFE-PIT-CM)

author.name: Emil Hovad

entry.summary: Introduces SAFE-PIT-CM, a physics-informed autoencoder that recovers material parameters from videos of physical processes using a frozen PDE operator in the latent space.

entry.title: Thermal Robustness of Retrieval in Dense Associative Memories: LSE vs LSR Kernels

author.name: Tatiana Petrova (Interdisciplinary Centre for Security, Reliability, Trust)

entry.summary: Compares thermal robustness of retrieval in dense associative memories with LSE vs LSR kernels via Monte Carlo simulations, finding LSE sustains retrieval at arbitrarily high temperatures while LSR shows phase transitions.

entry.title: BERTology of Molecular Property Prediction

author.name: Mohammad Mostafanejad, Paul Saxe, T. Daniel Crawford

entry.summary: Systematically investigates factors affecting chemical language model performance for molecular property prediction, finding inconsistencies across benchmarks and providing guidance on dataset size, model size, and standardization.

entry.title: True 4-Bit Quantized Convolutional Neural Network Training on CPU: Achieving Full-Precision Parity

author.name: Shivnath Tathe

entry.summary: Demonstrates practical 4-bit quantized CNN training on CPUs achieving competitive accuracy with a novel tanh-based soft weight clipping technique.

entry.title: Aumann-SHAP: The Geometry of Counterfactual Interaction Explanations in Machine Learning

author.name: Adam Belahcen, St\'ephane Mussard

entry.summary: Introduces Aumann-SHAP, an interaction-aware explainability framework that decomposes counterfactual transitions using cooperative game theory on local hypercubes.

entry.title: Domain-Skewed Federated Learning with Feature Decoupling and Calibration

author.name: Huan Wang, Jun Shen, Jun Yan, Guansong Pang

entry.summary: Proposes F²DC for federated learning under domain skew, which decouples and calibrates domain-specific biased features to prevent local model representations from collapsing into narrow subspaces.

entry.title: On the (Generative) Linear Sketching Problem

author.name: Xinyu Yuan, Yan Qiao, Zonghui Wang, Wenzhi Chen

entry.summary: Studies linear sketching problems and how generative priors can bridge orthogonal information loss in sketch summaries, aiming for near-perfect recovery with lightweight procedures for data streaming scenarios.

entry.title: Enhancing classification accuracy through chaos

author.name: Panos Stinis

entry.summary: Proposes using chaos to enhance classification by lifting data into higher dimensions and evolving through a chaotic dynamical system before classification. Shows acceleration of training and improved accuracy on perturbed orthogonal vectors.

entry.title: Graph2Video: Leveraging Video Models to Model Dynamic Graph Evolution

author.name: Hua Liu, Yanbin Wei, Fei Xing, Tyler Derr, Haoyu Han, Yu Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Graph2Video, which converts temporal graph neighborhoods into sequences of 'graph frames' and leverages video foundation models for dynamic link prediction, providing a creative cross-domain transfer approach.

entry.title: ZOTTA: Test-Time Adaptation with Gradient-Free Zeroth-Order Optimization

author.name: Ronghao Zhang, Shuaicheng Niu, Qi Deng, Yanjie Dong, Jian Chen, Runhao Zeng

entry.summary: Proposes ZOTTA, a fully backpropagation-free test-time adaptation framework using zeroth-order optimization with only forward passes, enabling adaptation of non-differentiable models like quantized models on edge devices.

entry.title: Label Noise Cleaning for Supervised Classification via Bernoulli Random Sampling

author.name: Yuxin Liu, Xiong Jin, Yang Han

entry.summary: Proposes a label noise cleaning method using Bernoulli random sampling that distinguishes clean from noisy observations by showing their mean noise levels converge to two well-separated distributions. Provides theoretical convergence guarantees via independent coupling arguments.

entry.title: Medical Image Spatial Grounding with Semantic Sampling

author.name: Andrew Seohwan Yu, Mohsen Hariri, Kunio Nakamura, Mingrui Yang, Xiaojuan Li, Vipin Chaudhary

entry.summary: Examines how different visual and textual prompting systems affect spatial grounding of anatomical structures in 3D medical images using vision language models, analyzing factors like modality, slice direction, and coordinate systems.

entry.title: A proof-of-concept for automated AI-driven stellarator coil optimization with in-the-loop finite-element calculations

author.name: Alan A. Kaptanoglu, Pedro F. Gil

entry.summary: Designs an end-to-end automated workflow for stellarator coil optimization using genetic algorithms or LLM-guided policies, with in-the-loop finite-element calculations and an open-source leaderboard for results.

entry.title: Persistence Spheres: a Bi-continuous Linear Representation of Measures for Partial Optimal Transport

author.name: Matteo Pegoraro

entry.summary: Introduces persistence spheres as a bi-continuous linear map from measures to functions on the sphere, stable with respect to partial optimal transport distance, with the first explicit inverse-continuity result for topological ML representations.

entry.title: Seeing Beyond: Extrapolative Domain Adaptive Panoramic Segmentation

author.name: Yuanfan Zheng, Kunyu Peng, Xu Zheng, Kailun Yang

entry.summary: Proposes EDA-PSeg for cross-domain panoramic semantic segmentation with an open-set setting, training on perspective views and testing on 360° images, using Euler-Margin Attention to handle geometric FoV distortions and unseen classes.

entry.title: SemEval-2026 Task 6: CLARITY -- Unmasking Political Question Evasions

author.name: Konstantinos Thomas, Giorgos Filandrianos, Maria Lymperaiou, Chrysoula Zerva, Giorgos Stamou

entry.summary: Introduces CLARITY, a SemEval-2026 shared task on detecting political question evasion, with two subtasks for clarity-level and fine-grained evasion strategy classification from US presidential interviews.

entry.title: Rethinking Evaluation in Retrieval-Augmented Personalized Dialogue: A Cognitive and Linguistic Perspective

author.name: Tianyi Zhang, David Traum

entry.summary: This paper critiques surface-level evaluation metrics (BLEU, ROUGE) for personalized dialogue systems and proposes a cognitive/linguistic perspective using human and LLM-based judges. Using LAPDOG as a case study, they identify failures like corrupted dialogue histories and contradictions in retrieved content that standard metrics miss.

entry.title: Creative Convergence or Imitation? Genre-Specific Homogeneity in LLM-Generated Chinese Literature

author.name: Yuanchi Ma, Kaize Shi, Hui He, Zhihua Zhang, Zhongxiang Lei, Ziliang Qiu, Renfen Hu, Jiamou Liu

entry.summary: Analyzes structural homogeneity in LLM-generated Chinese literature using an extended Proppian narratology framework with 34 narrative functions. Constructs a human-annotated corpus to systematically compare narrative patterns in human vs. LLM-generated stories.

entry.title: Complementarity-Supervised Spectral-Band Routing for Multimodal Emotion Recognition

author.name: Zhexian Huang, Bo Zhao, Hui Ma, Zhishu Liu, Jie Zhang, Ruixin Zhang, Shouhong Ding, Zitong Yu

entry.summary: Proposes Atsuko, a multimodal emotion recognition system using orthogonal multi-scale band decomposition and expert collaboration to model fine-grained complementary features across text, video, and audio modalities.

entry.title: TennisExpert: Towards Expert-Level Analytical Sports Video Understanding

author.name: Zhaoyu Liu, Xi Weng, Lianyu Hu, Zhe Hou, Kan Jiang, Jin Song Dong, Yang Liu

entry.summary: Introduces TennisVL, a large-scale tennis benchmark with 200+ matches (471.9 hours) and 40K+ rally clips for expert-level sports video understanding, going beyond descriptive play-by-play to analytical commentary.

entry.title: LibraGen: Playing a Balance Game in Subject-Driven Video Generation

author.name: Jiahao Zhu, Shanshan Lao, Lijie Liu, Gen Li, Tianhao Qi, Wei Han, Bingchuan Li, Fangfang Liu, Zhuowei Chen, Tianxiang Ma, Qian HE, Yi Zhou, Xiaohua Xie

entry.summary: Proposes LibraGen for subject-driven video generation that balances intrinsic VGFM qualities (motion, aesthetics) with subject fidelity. Identifies data quality as key 'fulcrum' and uses training strategies to maintain balance.

entry.title: SAIF: A Stability-Aware Inference Framework for Medical Image Segmentation with Segment Anything Model

author.name: Ke Wu, Shiqi Chen, Yiheng Zhong, Hengxian Liu, Yingxue Su, Yifang Wang, Junhao Jin, Guangyu Ren

entry.summary: Proposes SAIF, a training-free plug-and-play framework that improves SAM's inference stability for medical image segmentation by modeling prompt and threshold uncertainty through structured perturbations and stability-aware scoring.

entry.title: LingoMotion: An Interpretable and Unambiguous Symbolic Representation for Human Motion

author.name: Yao Zhang, Zhuchenyang Liu, Yu Xiao

entry.summary: Proposes LingoMotion, a symbolic motion representation inspired by natural language structure, defining motion alphabets from joint angles, morphology for actions and attributes, and syntax for complex sequences.

entry.title: Sky2Ground: A Benchmark for Site Modeling under Varying Altitude

author.name: Zengyan Wang, Sirshapan Mitra, Rajat Modi, Grace Lim, Yogesh Rawat

entry.summary: Introduces Sky2Ground, a three-view dataset (satellite, aerial, ground) for varying-altitude camera localization and reconstruction across 51 sites. Benchmarks state-of-art pose estimation and reveals performance degradation with satellite imagery.

entry.title: IMS3: Breaking Distributional Aggregation in Diffusion-Based Dataset Distillation

author.name: Chenru Wang, Yunyi Chen, Zijun Yang, Joey Tianyi Zhou, Chi Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes IMS3 for diffusion-based dataset distillation, addressing distributional aggregation where diffusion models over-concentrate in high-density regions and neglect boundary samples crucial for classification.

entry.title: Towards Generalizable Deepfake Detection via Real Distribution Bias Correction

author.name: Ming-Hui Liu, Harry Cheng, Xin Luo, Xin-Shun Xu, Mohan S. Kankanhalli

entry.summary: Proposes RDBC framework for generalizable deepfake detection exploiting the invariance of real data distribution, using real population distribution estimation and distribution-sampled feature whitening.

entry.title: Effective Feature Learning for 3D Medical Registration via Domain-Specialized DINO Pretraining

author.name: Eytan Kats, Mattias P. Heinrich

entry.summary: Investigates DINO-style self-supervised pretraining directly on 3D medical images for deformable registration, demonstrating improved performance on interpatient abdominal registration across MRI and CT.

entry.title: OAHuman: Occlusion-Aware 3D Human Reconstruction from Monocular Images

author.name: Yuanwang Yang, Hongliang Liu, Muxin Zhang, Nan Ma, Jingyu Yang, Yu-Kun Lai, Kun Li

entry.summary: OAHuman addresses occlusion-aware 3D human reconstruction from monocular images by decoupling geometry reconstruction and texture synthesis for robust handling of real-world occlusions.

entry.title: Personalized Cell Segmentation: Benchmark and Framework for Reference-Guided Cell Type Segmentation

author.name: Bisheng Wang, Jaime S. Cardoso, Lin Wu

entry.summary: Introduces Personalized Cell Segmentation (PerCS) task and benchmark, where the goal is to segment all cells of a specific type given a reference cell, with a DINOv2-based solution.

entry.title: Unlocking the Latent Canvas: Eliciting and Benchmarking Symbolic Visual Expression in LLMs

author.name: Yiren Zheng, Shibo Li, Jiaming Liu, Haofan Wang, Yiren Song

entry.summary: Explores using ASCII art to benchmark and elicit symbolic visual expression capabilities of LLMs, introducing SVE-ASCII framework and ASCIIArt-7K dataset.

entry.title: Fractal Autoregressive Depth Estimation with Continuous Token Diffusion

author.name: Jinchang Zhang, Xinrou Kang, Guoyu Lu

entry.summary: Proposes fractal visual autoregressive diffusion for monocular depth estimation, combining coarse-to-fine generation with continuous token diffusion and multi-scale conditioning.

entry.title: AnyPhoto: Multi-Person Identity Preserving Image Generation with ID Adaptive Modulation on Location Canvas

author.name: Longhui Yuan

entry.summary: AnyPhoto generates multi-person identity-preserving images using RoPE-aligned location canvas, identity-adaptive modulation, and identity-isolated attention to bind multiple faces to specified locations.

entry.title: M2IR: Proactive All-in-One Image Restoration via Mamba-style Modulation and Mixture-of-Experts

author.name: Shiwei Wang, Yongzhen Wang, Bingwen Hu, Liyan Zhang, Xiao-Ping Zhang, Mingqiang Wei

entry.summary: M2IR proposes proactive all-in-one image restoration using Mamba-style modulation for degradation suppression and mixture-of-experts for efficient decoding.

entry.title: PASTE: Physics-Aware Scattering Topology Embedding Framework for SAR Object Detection

author.name: Jiacheng Chen, Yuxuan Xiong, Haipeng Wang

entry.summary: Proposes PASTE, a physics-aware framework for SAR object detection that embeds electromagnetic scattering topology information into deep learning detectors rather than treating SAR targets as simple texture patches.

entry.title: Learning from Limited and Incomplete Data: A Multimodal Framework for Predicting Pathological Response in NSCLC

author.name: Alice Natalina Caragliano, Giulia Farina, Fatih Aksu, Camillo Maria Caruso, Claudia Tacconi, Carlo Greco, Lorenzo Nibid, Edy Ippolito, Michele Fiore, Giuseppe Perrone, Sara Ramella, Paolo Soda, Valerio Guarrasi

entry.summary: Proposes a multimodal deep learning framework for predicting pathological response in NSCLC using foundation model-based CT features and a missing-aware architecture for incomplete clinical data.

entry.title: DAIT: Distillation from Vision-Language Models to Lightweight Classifiers with Adaptive Intermediate Teacher Transfer

author.name: Zhengxu He, Jun Li, Zhijian Wu

entry.summary: Proposes DAIT for distilling VLM knowledge to lightweight classifiers via adaptive intermediate teacher transfer, addressing architectural misalignment between large VLMs and compact students.

entry.title: Oscillating Dispersion for Maximal Light-throughput Spectral Imaging

author.name: Jiuyun Zhang, Zhan Shi, Linsen Chen, Xun Cao

entry.summary: Develops ODIS, an oscillating dispersion imaging spectrometer achieving near-full light throughput by axially translating a disperser, paired with a deep unfolding network for spectral recovery.

entry.title: Real-Time Human Frontal View Synthesis from a Single Image

author.name: Fangyu Lin, Yingdong Hu, Lunjie Zhu, Zhening Liu, Yushi Huang, Zehong Lin, Jun Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes PrismMirror for real-time human frontal view synthesis from a single image, using geometry-guided framework that avoids external geometry models for efficient inference.

entry.title: Real-Time Oriented Object Detection Transformer in Remote Sensing Images

author.name: Zeyu Ding, Yong Zhou, Jiaqi Zhao, Wen-Liang Du, Xixi Li, Rui Yao, Abdulmotaleb El Saddik

entry.summary: Proposes the first real-time end-to-end oriented object detection transformer for remote sensing, with angle distribution refinement for handling arbitrary rotations.

entry.title: Learning Latent Proxies for Controllable Single-Image Relighting

author.name: Haoze Zheng, Zihao Wang, Xianfeng Wu, Yajing Bai, Yexin Liu, Yun Li, Xiaogang Xu, Harry Yang

entry.summary: Proposes learning latent proxies for single-image relighting that replace full intrinsic decomposition with sparse physically-meaningful cues to guide a diffusion model. This reduces supervision requirements while maintaining fine-grained control over lighting direction, intensity, and color.

entry.title: REAEDP: Entropy-Calibrated Differentially Private Data Release with Formal Guarantees and Attack-Based Evaluation

author.name: Bo Ma, Jinsong Wu, Wei Qi Yan

entry.summary: REAEDP is a differential privacy framework combining entropy-calibrated histogram release, synthetic data generation, and attack-based evaluation. Derives sensitivity bounds for Shannon and Rényi entropy for adjacent histogram datasets.

entry.title: MorphSNN: Adaptive Graph Diffusion and Structural Plasticity for Spiking Neural Networks

author.name: Yongsheng Huang, Peibo Duan, Yujie Wu, Kai Sun, Zhipeng Liu, Jiaxiang Liu, Guangyu Li, Changsheng Zhang, Bin Zhang, Mingkun Xu

entry.summary: MorphSNN introduces graph diffusion and structural plasticity mechanisms into spiking neural networks, enabling brain-like lateral interactions and dynamic connectivity adaptation beyond fixed hierarchical architectures.

entry.title: LDHP: Library-Driven Hierarchical Planning for Non-prehensile Dexterous Manipulation

author.name: Tierui He, Chao Zhao

entry.summary: LDHP is a library-driven hierarchical planner for non-prehensile dexterous manipulation that makes executability a first-class design goal, using MoveObject and AdjustGrasp primitives with feasibility certification.

entry.title: Navigation beyond Wayfinding: Robots Collaborating with Visually Impaired Users for Environmental Interactions

author.name: Shaojun Cai, Nuwan Janaka, Ashwin Ram, Janidu Shehan, Yingjia Wan, Kotaro Hara, David Hsu

entry.summary: Extends robotic guide dog systems beyond wayfinding to support environmental interactions for blind/visually impaired users, enabling collaborative manipulation tasks like pressing elevator buttons and pulling out chairs.

entry.title: CyboRacket: A Perception-to-Action Framework for Humanoid Racket Sports

author.name: Peng Ren, Chuan Qi, Haoyang Ge, Qiyuan Su, Xuguo He, Cong Huang, Pei Chi, Jiang Zhao, Kai Chen

entry.summary: CyboRacket is a hierarchical perception-to-action framework for humanoid racket sports that integrates onboard visual perception, physics-based trajectory prediction, and pre-trained whole-body control. Unlike prior systems, it avoids reliance on external motion capture.

entry.title: ReMAP-DP: Reprojected Multi-view Aligned PointMaps for Diffusion Policy

author.name: Xinzhang Yang, Renjun Wu, Jinyan Liu, Xuesong Li

entry.summary: ReMAP-DP combines standardized perspective reprojection with a dual-stream diffusion policy that fuses semantic features and geometric descriptors for robot manipulation. Addresses the gap between 2D semantic reasoning and 3D spatial awareness in generalist robot policies.

entry.title: Coupled Particle Filters for Robust Affordance Estimation

author.name: Patrick Lowin, Vito Mengers, Oliver Brock

entry.summary: Proposes coupled particle filters for robotic affordance estimation that uses two recursive estimators for graspable and movable regions. The coupling enables bidirectional information exchange, achieving 245-308% precision improvement over recent baselines.

entry.title: The bitter lesson for software

author.name: zef

entry.summary: Argues that software's core function is encoding information flows into deterministic code, and that AI agents represent a fundamental shift by handling information flows with natural complexity rather than requiring rigid data structures. Draws parallel to Sutton's 'Bitter Lesson.'

entry.title: Multi-hop Reasoning and Retrieval in Embedding Space: Leveraging Large Language Models with Knowledge

author.name: Lihui Liu

entry.summary: Proposes a method for multi-hop reasoning over knowledge graphs in embedding space to augment LLMs, addressing issues of query ambiguity, KG incompleteness, and retrieval failures.

entry.title: Do Large Language Models Get Caught in Hofstadter-Mobius Loops?

author.name: Jaroslaw Hryszko

entry.summary: Argues that RLHF-trained LLMs face a structural contradiction analogous to Clarke's 'Hofstadter-Mobius loop'—simultaneously rewarding compliance with user preferences and suspicion of user intent, producing sycophancy as default and coercion under threat.

entry.title: EviAgent: Evidence-Driven Agent for Radiology Report Generation

author.name: Tuoshi Qi, Shenshen Bu, Yingfei Xiang, Zhiming Dai

entry.summary: Proposes EviAgent for radiology report generation that coordinates transparent reasoning by decomposing the generation process into granular steps with explicit visual evidence, addressing the black-box problem of MLLMs in clinical settings.

entry.title: An Alternative Trajectory for Generative AI

author.name: Margarita Belova, Yuval Kansal, Yihao Liang, Jiaxin Xiao, Niraj K. Jha

entry.summary: Argues current generative AI trajectory is unsustainable due to inference costs, reasoning model compute inflation, and physical constraints. Proposes alternative approaches using modular, specialized architectures rather than monolithic scaling.

entry.title: Exposing Cross-Modal Consistency for Fake News Detection in Short-Form Videos

author.name: Chong Tian, Yu Wang, Chenxu Yang, Junyi Guan, Zheng Lin, Yuhan Liu, Xiuying Chen, Qirong Ho

entry.summary: Proposes MAGIC3, a fake news detector for short-form videos that exploits cross-modal consistency patterns between text, visual, and audio modalities. Discovers that real vs. fake videos show distinct asymmetric consistency patterns.

entry.title: Why the Valuable Capabilities of LLMs Are Precisely the Unexplainable Ones

author.name: Quan Cheng
