entry.summary: Proposes a conditional normalizing flow framework for time-series anomaly detection that relocates anomaly detection to a prescribed latent space with explicit temporal inductive biases, rather than relying on observation-space likelihood.

entry.title: A Semi-Decentralized Approach to Multiagent Control

author.name: Mahdi Al-Husseini, Mykel J. Kochenderfer, Kyle H. Wray

entry.summary: Introduces the SDec-POMDP framework for semi-decentralized cooperative multi-agent control under communication uncertainty, unifying decentralized and multiagent POMDPs. Presents an exact algorithm (RS-SDA*) for optimal policy generation.

entry.title: From Phase Prediction to Phase Design: A ReAct Agent Framework for High-Entropy Alloy Discovery

author.name: Iman Peivaste, Salim Belouettar

entry.summary: Presents a ReAct LLM agent that autonomously proposes, validates, and refines high-entropy alloy compositions using a calibrated XGBoost surrogate, outperforming Bayesian optimization and random search baselines for phase design.

entry.title: Markovian Generation Chains in Large Language Models

author.name: Mingmeng Geng, Amr Mohamed, Guokan Shang, Michalis Vazirgiannis, Thierry Poibeau

entry.summary: Defines 'Markovian generation chains' to study how texts evolve when repeatedly processed by LLMs, finding that iterative rephrasing/translation either converges to recurrent sets or continues producing novel outputs depending on temperature and other factors.

entry.title: OrthoEraser: Coupled-Neuron Orthogonal Projection for Concept Erasure

author.name: Chuancheng Shi, Wenhua Wu, Fei Shen, Xiaogang Zhu, Kun Hu, Zhiyong Wang

entry.summary: Proposes OrthoEraser, using sparse autoencoders to disentangle sensitive and benign semantics in T2I models, then applying orthogonal projection to erase concepts without collateral damage to benign attributes.

entry.title: Taming OpenClaw: Security Analysis and Mitigation of Autonomous LLM Agent Threats

author.name: Xinhao Deng, Yixiang Zhang, Jiaqing Wu, Jiaqi Bai, Sibo Yi, Zhuoheng Zou, Yue Xiao, Rennai Qiu, Jianan Ma, Jialuo Chen, Xiaohu Du, Xiaofang Yang, Shiwen Cui, Changhua Meng, Weiqiang Wang, Jiaxing Song, Ke Xu, Qi Li

entry.summary: Presents comprehensive security threat analysis of OpenClaw autonomous LLM agents, introducing a five-layer lifecycle-oriented security framework covering initialization through execution, examining compound threats including prompt injection and supply chain attacks.

entry.title: RADAR: Closed-Loop Robotic Data Generation via Semantic Planning and Autonomous Causal Environment Reset

author.name: Yongzhong Wang, Keyu Zhu, Yong Zhong, Liqiong Wang, Jinyu Yang, Feng Zheng

entry.summary: Introduces RADAR, a fully autonomous closed-loop robotic data generation engine that removes human intervention, using VLMs for task generation, GNNs for policy transfer, and autonomous causal environment reset.

entry.title: Think While Watching: Online Streaming Segment-Level Memory for Multi-Turn Video Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Lu Wang (The Key Laboratory of Cognition and Decision Intelligence for Complex Systems, Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beijing, China), Zhuoran Jin (The Key Laboratory of Cognition and Decision Intelligence for Complex Systems, Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beijing, China), Yupu Hao (The Key Laboratory of Cognition and Decision Intelligence for Complex Systems, Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beijing, China), Yubo Chen (The Key Laboratory of Cognition and Decision Intelligence for Complex Systems, Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beijing, China), Kang Liu (The Key Laboratory of Cognition and Decision Intelligence for Complex Systems, Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beijing, China), Yulong Ao (Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence), Jun Zhao (The Key Laboratory of Cognition and Decision Intelligence for Complex Systems, Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beijing, China)

entry.summary: Proposes 'Think While Watching', a memory-anchored streaming video reasoning framework for MLLMs that enables concurrent perception and generation during multi-turn interaction with video streams. Addresses limitations of existing interleaved perception-generation paradigms that suffer from early memory decay.

entry.title: Interventional Time Series Priors for Causal Foundation Models

author.name: Dennis Thumm, Ying Chen

entry.summary: Proposes CausalTimePrior, a framework for generating synthetic temporal structural causal models with paired observational and interventional time series data, enabling training of causal foundation models for time series.

entry.title: Beyond the Class Subspace: Teacher-Guided Training for Reliable Out-of-Distribution Detection in Single-Domain Models

author.name: Hong Yang, Devroop Kar, Qi Yu, Travis Desell, Alex Ororbia

entry.summary: Identifies Domain-Sensitivity Collapse (DSC) in single-domain OOD detection where supervised training suppresses domain-shift signals, and proposes Teacher-Guided Training using DINOv2 residual structure with no inference overhead.

entry.title: Exponential-Family Membership Inference: From LiRA and RMIA to BaVarIA

author.name: Rickard Br\"annvall

entry.summary: Unifies leading membership inference attacks (LiRA, RMIA, BASE) under a single exponential-family log-likelihood ratio framework, revealing them as points on a spectrum of model complexity. Proposes BaVarIA within this hierarchy.

entry.title: Temporal Straightening for Latent Planning

author.name: Ying Wang, Oumayma Bounou, Gaoyue Zhou, Randall Balestriero, Tim G. J. Rudner, Yann LeCun, Mengye Ren

entry.summary: Introduces temporal straightening for latent planning with world models, using curvature regularization to make Euclidean distance in latent space a better proxy for geodesic distance. Inspired by perceptual straightening in human vision.

entry.title: Hoi3DGen: Generating High-Quality Human-Object-Interactions in 3D

author.name: Agniv Sharma, Xianghui Xie, Tom Fischer, Eddy Ilg, Gerard Pons-Moll

entry.summary: Presents Hoi3DGen, a framework for generating high-quality 3D textured meshes of human-object interactions from text descriptions. Uses multimodal LLMs to curate realistic interaction data and builds a full text-to-3D pipeline achieving orders-of-magnitude improvement in interaction fidelity.

entry.title: Streaming Translation and Transcription Through Speech-to-Text Causal Alignment

author.name: Roman Koshkin, Jeon Haesung, Lianbo Liu, Hao Shi, Mengjie Zhao, Yusuke Fujita, Yui Sudo

entry.summary: Proposes Hikari, an end-to-end simultaneous speech-to-text translation model with a WAIT token mechanism and Decoder Time Dilation, achieving new state-of-the-art on English-to-Japanese/German/Russian.

entry.title: InstantHDR: Single-forward Gaussian Splatting for High Dynamic Range 3D Reconstruction

author.name: Dingqiang Ye, Jiacong Xu, Jianglu Ping, Yuxiang Guo, Chao Fan, Vishal M. Patel

entry.summary: Proposes InstantHDR, a feed-forward network that reconstructs 3D HDR scenes from uncalibrated multi-exposure LDR image collections in a single forward pass, without requiring camera poses or per-scene optimization.

entry.title: DriveXQA: Cross-modal Visual Question Answering for Adverse Driving Scene Understanding

author.name: Mingzhe Tao, Ruiping Liu, Junwei Zheng, Yufan Chen, Kedi Ying, M. Saquib Sarfraz, Kailun Yang, Jiaming Zhang, Rainer Stiefelhagen

entry.summary: Proposes DriveXQA, a multimodal VQA dataset for autonomous driving with four visual modalities, five sensor failure cases, five weather conditions, and 102K QA pairs, plus MVX-LLM framework for multi-sensor fusion.

entry.title: Seeing Isn't Orienting: A Cognitively Grounded Benchmark Reveals Systematic Orientation Failures in MLLMs Supplementary

author.name: Nazia Tasnim, Keanu Nichols, Yuting Yang, Nicholas Ikechukwu, Elva Zou, Deepti Ghadiyaram, Bryan A. Plummer

entry.summary: Introduces DORI, a cognitively grounded benchmark for object orientation reasoning in MLLMs with 33,656 questions across 67 object categories, revealing systematic failures in current models.

entry.title: FL-MedSegBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Federated Learning on Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Meilu Zhu, Zhiwei Wang, Axiu Mao, Yuxing Li, Xiaohan Xing, Yixuan Yuan, Edmund Y. Lam

entry.summary: Introduces FL-MedSegBench, the first comprehensive benchmark for federated learning on medical image segmentation, covering 9 tasks across 10 imaging modalities. Evaluates 13 FL methods across accuracy, fairness, communication efficiency, and convergence.

entry.title: InSpatio-WorldFM: An Open-Source Real-Time Generative Frame Model

author.name: InSpatio Team, Xiaoyu Zhang, Weihong Pan, Zhichao Ye, Jialin Liu, Yipeng Chen, Nan Wang, Xiaojun Xiang, Weijian Xie, Yifu Wang, Haoyu Ji, Siji Pan, Zhewen Le, Jing Guo, Xianbin Liu, Donghui Shen, Ziqiang Zhao, Haomin Liu, Guofeng Zhang

entry.summary: Presents InSpatio-WorldFM, an open-source real-time frame model for spatial intelligence that generates frames independently rather than sequentially. Uses 3D anchors and spatial memory for multi-view consistency.

entry.title: DVD: Deterministic Video Depth Estimation with Generative Priors

author.name: Hongfei Zhang, Harold Haodong Chen, Chenfei Liao, Jing He, Zixin Zhang, Haodong Li, Yihao Liang, Kanghao Chen, Bin Ren, Xu Zheng, Shuai Yang, Kun Zhou, Yinchuan Li, Nicu Sebe, Ying-Cong Chen

entry.summary: Presents DVD, the first framework to deterministically adapt pre-trained video diffusion models into single-pass depth regressors. Introduces latent manifold rectification and repurposes diffusion timestep as structural anchor.

entry.title: Video Streaming Thinking: VideoLLMs Can Watch and Think Simultaneously

author.name: Yiran Guan, Liang Yin, Dingkang Liang, Jianzhong Ju, Zhenbo Luo, Jian Luan, Yuliang Liu, Xiang Bai

entry.summary: Proposes Video Streaming Thinking (VST), enabling VideoLLMs to reason while watching streaming video. Amortizes LLM reasoning latency over video playback to maintain real-time responsiveness.

entry.title: HandelBot: Real-World Piano Playing via Fast Adaptation of Dexterous Robot Policies

author.name: Amber Xie, Haozhi Qi, Dorsa Sadigh

entry.summary: Introduces HandelBot, a framework for real-world bimanual piano playing with dexterous robot hands. Combines simulation-trained policy with rapid adaptation through structured refinement for millimeter-scale precision tasks.

entry.title: MLSN #19: Honesty, Disempowerment, & Cybersecurity

author.name: Alice Blair

entry.summary: Newsletter summarizing three AI safety research directions: training GPT-5 for honest confessions of safety violations, work on human disempowerment detection, and cybersecurity implications. Reports GPT-5 confession training showing improved violation reporting.

entry.title: VisDoT : Enhancing Visual Reasoning through Human-Like Interpretation Grounding and Decomposition of Thought

author.name: Eunsoo Lee, Jeongwoo Lee, Minki Hong, Jangho Choi, Jihie Kim

entry.summary: VisDoT enhances chart-based visual reasoning by formalizing perceptual tasks from graphical perception theory and introducing Decomposition-of-Thought prompting that separates visual perception from logical reasoning sub-questions. Achieves +11% on chart reasoning benchmarks.

entry.title: STAIRS-Former: Spatio-Temporal Attention with Interleaved Recursive Structure Transformer for Offline Multi-task Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Jiwon Jeon, Myungsik Cho, Youngchul Sung

entry.summary: STAIRS-Former proposes a transformer architecture with spatial and temporal hierarchies for offline multi-agent RL with multi-task datasets, addressing varying agent numbers and long-horizon temporal dependencies in partially observable settings.

entry.title: Governing Evolving Memory in LLM Agents: Risks, Mechanisms, and the Stability and Safety Governed Memory (SSGM) Framework

author.name: Chingkwun Lam, Jiaxin Li, Lingfei Zhang, Kuo Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes the SSGM framework for governing evolving memory in LLM agents, addressing risks of memory corruption, semantic drift, and privacy vulnerabilities in dynamic memory systems by decoupling memory evolution from governance.

entry.title: Prototype-Based Knowledge Guidance for Fine-Grained Structured Radiology Reporting

author.name: Chantal Pellegrini, Adrian Delchev, Ege \"Ozsoy, Nassir Navab, Matthias Keicher

entry.summary: ProtoSR injects free-text radiology report knowledge into structured report generation using a prototype-based approach, mining 80k+ MIMIC-CXR studies with instruction-tuned LLMs to build a multimodal knowledge base.

entry.title: Thousand-GPU Large-Scale Training and Optimization Recipe for AI-Native Cloud Embodied Intelligence Infrastructure

author.name: Chen Zhou, Haoran Sun, Hedan Yang, Jing Long, Junwu Xiong, Luqiao Wang, Mingxi Luo, Qiming Yang, Shuai Di, Song Wang, Tianyun Zhao, Wanting Xu, Wen Huang, Xiaodong Bai, Xiaomeng Tian, Xiaolong Xiang, Yicheng Gong, Yongjian Guo, Yucheng Guo, Yunxuan Ma, Yu Wei, Zhong Guan, Zhen Sun

entry.summary: Describes a thousand-GPU distributed training platform for embodied intelligence built on the LeRobot framework, training GR00T-N1.5 at scale with hundreds of millions of data points. Addresses bottlenecks across data, training, and evaluation pipelines.

entry.title: KEPo: Knowledge Evolution Poison on Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Qizhi Chen, Chao Qi, Yihong Huang, Muquan Li, Rongzheng Wang, Dongyang Zhang, Ke Qin, Shuang Liang

entry.summary: Proposes KEPo, a knowledge evolution poisoning attack against GraphRAG systems that injects poisoned texts specifically designed to survive KG abstraction and manipulation LLM outputs for targeted queries.

entry.title: RoboClaw: An Agentic Framework for Scalable Long-Horizon Robotic Tasks

author.name: Ruiying Li, Yunlang Zhou, YuYao Zhu, Kylin Chen, Jingyuan Wang, Sukai Wang, Kongtao Hu, Minhui Yu, Bowen Jiang, Zhan Su, Jiayao Ma, Xin He, Yongjian Shen, Yangyang, Guanghui Ren, Maoqing Yao, Wenhao Wang, Yao Mu

entry.summary: Presents RoboClaw, an agentic robotics framework unifying data collection, policy learning, and task execution with Entangled Action Pairs (EAP) for self-resetting loops enabling autonomous continuous data collection.

entry.title: From Control to Foresight: Simulation as a New Paradigm for Human-Agent Collaboration

author.name: Gaole He, Brian Y. Lim

entry.summary: Proposes simulation-in-the-loop, an interaction paradigm where users and LLM agents explore simulated future trajectories before committing to decisions, shifting from reactive control to proactive foresight in human-agent collaboration.

entry.title: HomeSafe-Bench: Evaluating Vision-Language Models on Unsafe Action Detection for Embodied Agents in Household Scenarios

author.name: Jiayue Pu, Zhongxiang Sun, Zilu Zhang, Xiao Zhang, Jun Xu

entry.summary: Introduces HomeSafe-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating Vision-Language Models on detecting unsafe actions by household robots, addressing the gap between static image safety evaluations and dynamic real-world scenarios.

entry.title: Just Use XML: Revisiting Joint Translation and Label Projection

author.name: Thennal D K, Chris Biemann, Hans Ole Hatzel

entry.summary: Proposes LabelPigeon, a framework that jointly performs machine translation and label projection using XML tags for cross-lingual transfer, showing it outperforms baselines and improves translation quality across 203 languages.

entry.title: Higher-Order Modular Attention: Fusing Pairwise and Triadic Interactions for Protein Sequences

author.name: Shirin Amiraslani, Xin Gao

entry.summary: Introduces Higher-Order Modular Attention (HOMA), a unified attention operator fusing pairwise and triadic interactions for protein sequence modeling using block-structured windowed triadic attention.

entry.title: Client-Conditional Federated Learning via Local Training Data Statistics

author.name: Rickard Br\"annvall

entry.summary: Proposes conditioning a single global federated learning model on locally-computed PCA statistics to handle data heterogeneity with zero additional communication, matching oracle performance across 97 configurations.

entry.title: Disentangled Representation Learning through Unsupervised Symmetry Group Discovery

author.name: Dang-Nhu Barth\'el\'emy, Annabi Louis, Argentieri Sylvain

entry.summary: Proposes a method for an embodied agent to autonomously discover the symmetry group structure of its action space through unsupervised interaction, proving identifiability under minimal assumptions and deriving algorithms for disentangled representation learning.

entry.title: Try, Check and Retry: A Divide-and-Conquer Framework for Boosting Long-context Tool-Calling Performance of LLMs

author.name: Kunfeng Chen, Qihuang Zhong, Juhua Liu, Bo Du, Dacheng Tao

entry.summary: Proposes Tool-DC, a divide-and-conquer framework using 'Try-Check-Retry' paradigm to improve LLM tool-calling performance with massive and noisy candidate tools, offering both training-free and training-based variants.

entry.title: Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning for Enhanced Multimodal LLM-as-a-Judge

author.name: Junjie Wu, Xuan Kan, Zihao He, Shunwen Tan, Bo Pan, Kaitai Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes MT-RL-Judge, a multi-task reinforcement learning framework for training MLLM judges that generalizes across diverse visual evaluation tasks, outperforming single-task baselines.

entry.title: CoMMET: To What Extent Can LLMs Perform Theory of Mind Tasks?

author.name: Ruirui Chen, Weifeng Jiang, Chengwei Qin, Cheston Tan

entry.summary: Proposes CoMMET, a multimodal Theory of Mind benchmark covering a broader range of mental states beyond beliefs, including multi-turn evaluation inspired by the ToM Booklet Task.

entry.title: UniCompress: Token Compression for Unified Vision-Language Understanding and Generation

author.name: Ziyao Wang, Chen Chen, Jingtao Li, Weiming Zhuang, Jiabo Huang, Ang Li, Lingjuan Lyu

entry.summary: Proposes UniCompress, a unified token compression algorithm for models supporting both visual understanding and generation, significantly reducing visual token count while preserving performance.

entry.title: Learning to Assist: Physics-Grounded Human-Human Control via Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Yuto Shibata, Kashu Yamazaki, Lalit Jayanti, Yoshimitsu Aoki, Mariko Isogawa, Katerina Fragkiadaki

entry.summary: Formulates imitation of closely interacting human-human motion as multi-agent RL, jointly training partner-aware policies for assistive scenarios involving continuous physical contact and force exchange.

entry.title: ShotVerse: Advancing Cinematic Camera Control for Text-Driven Multi-Shot Video Creation

author.name: Songlin Yang, Zhe Wang, Xuyi Yang, Songchun Zhang, Xianghao Kong, Taiyi Wu, Xiaotong Zhao, Ran Zhang, Alan Zhao, Anyi Rao

entry.summary: Proposes ShotVerse, a 'Plan-then-Control' framework for text-driven multi-shot video generation that decouples generation into a VLM planner for camera trajectories and a controlled video generator.

entry.title: Risk-Controllable Multi-View Diffusion for Driving Scenario Generation

author.name: Hongyi Lin, Wenxiu Shi, Heye Huang, Dingyi Zhuang, Song Zhang, Yang Liu, Xiaobo Qu, Jinhua Zhao

entry.summary: Presents RiskMV-DPO, a pipeline for risk-controllable multi-view driving scenario generation that integrates target risk levels with physical risk models to synthesize diverse safety-critical scenarios.

entry.title: BackdoorIDS: Zero-shot Backdoor Detection for Pretrained Vision Encoder

author.name: Siquan Huang, Yijiang Li, Ningzhi Gao, Xingfu Yan, Leyu Shi

entry.summary: Proposes BackdoorIDS, a zero-shot inference-time backdoor detection method for pretrained vision encoders. Leverages observations about attention hijacking and restoration under progressive input masking to identify backdoored samples.

entry.title: Trust Your Critic: Robust Reward Modeling and Reinforcement Learning for Faithful Image Editing and Generation

author.name: Xiangyu Zhao, Peiyuan Zhang, Junming Lin, Tianhao Liang, Yuchen Duan, Shengyuan Ding, Changyao Tian, Yuhang Zang, Junchi Yan, Xue Yang

entry.summary: Presents FIRM, a framework for developing robust reward models for image editing and T2I generation. Designs tailored data curation pipelines and evaluation metrics to provide accurate RL guidance, addressing reward model hallucinations.

entry.title: EVATok: Adaptive Length Video Tokenization for Efficient Visual Autoregressive Generation

author.name: Tianwei Xiong, Jun Hao Liew, Zilong Huang, Zhijie Lin, Jiashi Feng, Xihui Liu

entry.summary: Introduces EVATok, a framework for efficient video tokenization that adaptively assigns variable token lengths to temporal blocks based on complexity. Avoids wasting tokens on simple segments while providing more for dynamic content.

entry.title: OmniForcing: Unleashing Real-time Joint Audio-Visual Generation

author.name: Yaofeng Su, Yuming Li, Zeyue Xue, Jie Huang, Siming Fu, Haoran Li, Ying Li, Zezhong Qian, Haoyang Huang, Nan Duan

entry.summary: Proposes OmniForcing, the first framework to distill bidirectional audio-visual diffusion models into streaming autoregressive generators. Addresses training instability from temporal asymmetry between modalities.

entry.title: ComFree-Sim: A GPU-Parallelized Analytical Contact Physics Engine for Scalable Contact-Rich Robotics Simulation and Control

author.name: Chetan Borse, Zhixian Xie, Wei-Cheng Huang, Wanxin Jin

entry.summary: Presents ComFree-Sim, a GPU-parallelized analytical contact physics engine that computes contact impulses in closed form, avoiding iterative solvers. Achieves near-linear runtime scaling with contact count, addressing the major bottleneck in contact-rich simulation.

entry.title: Cycle-Consistent Activation Oracles

author.name: slavachalnev

entry.summary: Trains a model to translate LLM activations into natural language using cycle consistency (activation → description → reconstructed activation). Finds outputs are often plausible but lossy, mostly guessing context rather than describing the activation itself.

entry.title: FinRule-Bench: A Benchmark for Joint Reasoning over Financial Tables and Principles

author.name: Arun Vignesh Malarkkan, Manan Roy Choudhury, Guangwei Zhang, Vivek Gupta, Qingyun Wang, Yanjie Fu, Denghui Zhang

entry.summary: FinRule-Bench evaluates LLMs' ability to verify rule compliance on real financial statements by pairing ground-truth statements with human-curated accounting principles. Tests diagnostic completeness across four statement types.

entry.title: See, Symbolize, Act: Grounding VLMs with Spatial Representations for Better Gameplay

author.name: Ashish Baghel, Paras Chopra

entry.summary: Investigates whether providing VLMs with symbolic representations alongside visual frames improves performance in interactive environments (Atari, VizDoom, AI2-THOR). Finds that accurate symbolic information helps but self-extracted symbols are unreliable.

entry.title: CINDI: Conditional Imputation and Noisy Data Integrity with Flows in Power Grid Data

author.name: David Baumgartner, Helge Langseth, Heri Ramampiaro

entry.summary: CINDI introduces an unsupervised probabilistic framework unifying anomaly detection and imputation for multivariate time series in power grids, using conditional normalizing flows for end-to-end data integrity restoration.

entry.title: XSkill: Continual Learning from Experience and Skills in Multimodal Agents

author.name: Guanyu Jiang (May), Zhaochen Su (May), Xiaoye Qu (May), Yi R. (May), Fung

entry.summary: XSkill introduces a dual-stream framework for continual learning in multimodal agents that extracts and retrieves two types of reusable knowledge—experiences (action-level) and skills (task-level)—grounded in visual similarity.

entry.title: Structure-Aware Epistemic Uncertainty Quantification for Neural Operator PDE Surrogates

author.name: Haoze Song, Zhihao Li, Mengyi Deng, Xin Li, Duyi Pan, Zhilu Lai, Wei Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a structure-aware epistemic uncertainty quantification scheme for neural operator PDE surrogates that exploits the modular architecture (lifting-propagation-recovering) to produce spatially faithful uncertainty estimates.

entry.title: CR-Bench: Evaluating the Real-World Utility of AI Code Review Agents

author.name: Kristen Pereira, Neelabh Sinha, Rajat Ghosh, Debojyoti Dutta

entry.summary: Introduces CR-Bench, a benchmark and evaluation pipeline for AI code review agents, testing single-shot and Reflexion-based agents on frontier models. Finds that code review agents can have low signal-to-noise ratios, highlighting challenges in practical deployment.

entry.title: ResWM: Residual-Action World Model for Visual RL

author.name: Jseen Zhang, Gabriel Adineera, Jinzhou Tan, Jinoh Kim

entry.summary: Introduces ResWM, a world model framework that reformulates control from absolute actions to residual actions (incremental adjustments), improving stability and sample efficiency in visual reinforcement learning for robotics and continuous control.

entry.title: Grammar of the Wave: Towards Explainable Multivariate Time Series Event Detection via Neuro-Symbolic VLM Agents

author.name: Sky Chenwei Wan, Tianjun Hou, Yifei Wang, Xiqing Chang, Aymeric Jan

entry.summary: Introduces Knowledge-Guided Time Series Event Detection with Event Logic Trees (ELT), bridging natural language event descriptions and physical time series data via temporal-logic modeling. Uses neuro-symbolic VLM agents with few/zero-shot learning.

entry.title: MANSION: Multi-floor lANguage-to-3D Scene generatIOn for loNg-horizon tasks

author.name: Lirong Che, Shuo Wen, Shan Huang, Chuang Wang, Yuzhe Yang, Gregory Dudek, Xueqian Wang, Jian Su

entry.summary: Introduces MANSION, the first language-driven framework for generating building-scale, multi-floor 3D environments for embodied AI, along with MansionWorld dataset of 1,000+ diverse buildings.

entry.title: The Mirror Design Pattern: Strict Data Geometry over Model Scale for Prompt Injection Detection

author.name: J Alex Corll

entry.summary: Proposes Mirror, a data-curation design pattern for prompt injection detection that organizes corpora into matched positive/negative cells to learn attack mechanics rather than corpus shortcuts, achieving high detection rates with 5,000 curated samples.

entry.title: MobileKernelBench: Can LLMs Write Efficient Kernels for Mobile Devices?

author.name: Xingze Zou, Jing Wang, Yuhua Zheng, Xueyi Chen, Haolei Bai, Lingcheng Kong, Syed A. R. Abu-Bakar, Zhaode Wang, Chengfei Lv, Haoji Hu, Huan Wang

entry.summary: Introduces MobileKernelBench, a benchmark framework for evaluating whether LLMs can generate efficient computational kernels for mobile devices, including an automated pipeline for on-device verification.

entry.title: Paper Title: LoV3D: Grounding Cognitive Prognosis Reasoning in Longitudinal 3D Brain MRI via Regional Volume Assessments

author.name: Zhaoyang Jiang, Zhizhong Fu, David McAllister, Yunsoo Kim, Honghan Wu

entry.summary: Presents LoV3D, a pipeline for training 3D vision-language models on longitudinal brain MRI to produce region-level anatomical assessments and diagnoses for neurological disease progression, grounding outputs in volumetric measurements.

entry.title: The Latent Color Subspace: Emergent Order in High-Dimensional Chaos

author.name: Mateusz Pach, Jessica Bader, Quentin Bouniot, Serge Belongie, Zeynep Akata

entry.summary: Discovers a latent color subspace in FLUX.1's VAE reflecting Hue/Saturation/Lightness structure, enabling training-free color control through closed-form latent-space manipulation.

entry.title: Reference-Guided Machine Unlearning

author.name: Jonas Mirlach, Sonia Laguna, Julia E. Vogt

entry.summary: Proposes Reference-Guided Unlearning (ReGUn), a machine unlearning framework that uses a disjoint held-out dataset as reference for distributional indistinguishability rather than performance-degradation heuristics.

entry.title: Harnessing Data Asymmetry: Manifold Learning in the Finsler World

author.name: Thomas Dag\`es, Simon Weber, Daniel Cremers, Ron Kimmel

entry.summary: Proposes Finsler manifold learning that harnesses asymmetric information in data by switching from symmetric Riemannian to asymmetric Finsler geometry for dimensionality reduction.

entry.title: Frequentist Consistency of Prior-Data Fitted Networks for Causal Inference

author.name: Valentyn Melnychuk, Vahid Balazadeh, Stefan Feuerriegel, Rahul G. Krishnan

entry.summary: Analyzes frequentist consistency of prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) for causal inference, showing existing PFNs can exhibit prior-induced confounding bias and proposing a calibration remedy.

entry.title: Learning to Unscramble: Simplifying Symbolic Expressions via Self-Supervised Oracle Trajectories

author.name: David Shih

entry.summary: Presents a self-supervised approach for symbolic simplification using scrambled-expression training with oracle trajectories. Demonstrates near-perfect solve rates on dilogarithm reduction and spinor-helicity amplitude simplification in high-energy physics.

entry.title: Security-by-Design for LLM-Based Code Generation: Leveraging Internal Representations for Concept-Driven Steering Mechanisms

author.name: Maximilian Wendlinger, Daniel Kowatsch, Konstantin B\"ottinger, Philip Sperl

entry.summary: Investigates security-by-design for LLM code generation by analyzing internal representations to understand and steer toward secure code through concept-driven mechanisms.

entry.title: BiGain: Unified Token Compression for Joint Generation and Classification

author.name: Jiacheng Liu, Shengkun Tang, Jiacheng Cui, Dongkuan Xu, Zhiqiang Shen

entry.summary: Introduces BiGain, a training-free plug-and-play framework for token compression in diffusion models that preserves both generation quality and classification accuracy using frequency-aware operators (Laplacian-gated merging).

entry.title: Can Small Language Models Use What They Retrieve? An Empirical Study of Retrieval Utilization Across Model Scale

author.name: Sanchit Pandey (BITS Pilani, Hyderabad, India)

entry.summary: Empirically studies whether small language models (≤7B) can effectively utilize retrieved information in RAG, introducing a parametric knowledge split to isolate utilization failure from retrieval quality.

entry.title: CLASP: Defending Hybrid Large Language Models Against Hidden State Poisoning Attacks

author.name: Alexandre Le Mercier, Thomas Demeester, Chris Develder

entry.summary: Proposes CLASP, a defense against Hidden State Poisoning Attacks on state space models (Mamba) using an XGBoost classifier on block output embeddings to identify malicious tokens.

entry.title: Resurfacing Paralinguistic Awareness in Large Audio Language Models

author.name: Hao Yang, Minghan Wang, Tongtong Wu, Lizhen Qu, Ehsan Shareghi, Gholamreza Haffari

entry.summary: Introduces methods to resurface paralinguistic awareness in Large Audio Language Models through layer-wise analysis and paralinguistic-enhanced fine-tuning, enabling models to respond to vocal cues beyond content.

entry.title: GGPT: Geometry Grounded Point Transformer

author.name: Yutong Chen, Yiming Wang, Xucong Zhang, Sergey Prokudin, Siyu Tang

entry.summary: Introduces GGPT, a framework augmenting feed-forward 3D reconstruction with reliable sparse geometric guidance from an improved SfM pipeline, improving geometric consistency in sparse-view reconstruction.

entry.title: Towards Trustworthy Selective Generation: Reliability-Guided Diffusion for Ultra-Low-Field to High-Field MRI Synthesis

author.name: Zhenxuan Zhang, Peiyuan Jing, Ruicheng Yuan, Liwei Hu, Anbang Wang, Fanwen Wang, Yinzhe Wu, Kh Tohidul Islam, Zhaolin Chen, Zi Wang, Peter Lally, Guang Yang

entry.summary: Proposes a reliability-guided diffusion model for ultra-low-field to high-field MRI synthesis that selectively generates only trustworthy regions, avoiding anatomically inconsistent artifacts in structurally ambiguous areas.

entry.title: DyWeight: Dynamic Gradient Weighting for Few-Step Diffusion Sampling

author.name: Tong Zhao, Mingkun Lei, Liangyu Yuan, Yanming Yang, Chenxi Song, Yang Wang, Beier Zhu, Chi Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes DyWeight, a lightweight learning-based multi-step ODE solver for diffusion models that dynamically adapts gradient weighting coefficients instead of using handcrafted ones. Enables faster sampling by learning time-varying parameters.

entry.title: SoulX-LiveAct: Towards Hour-Scale Real-Time Human Animation with Neighbor Forcing and ConvKV Memory

author.name: Dingcheng Zhen, Xu Zheng, Ruixin Zhang, Zhiqi Jiang, Yichao Yan, Ming Tao, Shunshun Yin

entry.summary: Proposes SoulX-LiveAct for hour-scale real-time human animation using autoregressive diffusion, introducing Neighbor Forcing for consistent learning signals and ConvKV Memory for bounded, structured historical state reuse.

entry.title: LatentGeo: Learnable Auxiliary Constructions in Latent Space for Multimodal Geometric Reasoning

author.name: Haiying Xu, Zihan Wang, Song Dai, Zhengxuan Zhang, Kairan Dou, Xuming Hu

entry.summary: Proposes LatentGeo, which performs auxiliary geometric constructions in latent space for multimodal geometric reasoning, avoiding the limitations of explicit text-based or visual-token geometric specifications.

entry.title: Grounding Robot Generalization in Training Data via Retrieval-Augmented VLMs

author.name: Jensen Gao, Dorsa Sadigh, Sandy Huang, Dhruv Shah

entry.summary: Proposes RADAR, a framework for characterizing generalization in robot manipulation by comparing test-time evaluation tasks to policy training data using retrieval and VLM analysis. Enables more precise evaluation of what form of generalization a policy actually demonstrates.

entry.title: AI #159: See You In Court

author.name: Zvi

entry.summary: Zvi's weekly AI newsletter covering the Anthropic-DoD legal battle, GPT-5.4 release assessment, and broader AI ecosystem developments. Reports GPT-5.4 as a substantial upgrade and discusses the far-reaching implications of the government conflict with Anthropic.

entry.title: INFACT: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Induced Faithfulness and Factuality Hallucinations in Video-LLMs

author.name: Junqi Yang, Yuecong Min, Jie Zhang, Shiguang Shan, Xilin Chen

entry.summary: Introduces INFACT, a diagnostic benchmark with 9,800 QA instances evaluating Video-LLM hallucinations across faithfulness and factuality dimensions, with degradation and intervention modes to test robustness.

entry.title: FlashMotion: Few-Step Controllable Video Generation with Trajectory Guidance

author.name: Quanhao Li, Zhen Xing, Rui Wang, Haidong Cao, Qi Dai, Daoguo Dong, Zuxuan Wu

entry.summary: Introduces FlashMotion, a framework for few-step trajectory-controllable video generation through distillation, addressing the quality and accuracy degradation when applying standard video distillation to trajectory-guided generation.

entry.title: Sparking Scientific Creativity via LLM-Driven Interdisciplinary Inspiration

author.name: Priyanka Kargupta, Shuhaib Mehri, Dilek Hakkani-Tur, Jiawei Han

entry.summary: Presents Idea-Catalyst, a framework for sparking scientific creativity through LLM-driven systematic identification of interdisciplinary insights, aiming to augment rather than automate the reasoning processes behind scientific breakthroughs.

entry.title: Towards High-Fidelity CAD Generation via LLM-Driven Program Generation and Text-Based B-Rep Primitive Grounding

author.name: Jiahao Li, Qingwang Zhang, Qiuyu Chen, Guozhan Qiu, Yunzhong Lou, Xiangdong Zhou

entry.summary: Presents FutureCAD, a text-to-CAD framework using LLMs for program generation combined with B-Rep primitive grounding. Bridges the gap between parametric CAD modeling and direct B-Rep synthesis for complex industrial design.

entry.title: PicoSAM3: Real-Time In-Sensor Region-of-Interest Segmentation

author.name: Pietro Bonazzi, Nicola Farronato, Stefan Zihlmann, Haotong Qin, Michele Magno

entry.summary: Introduces PicoSAM3, a 1.3M parameter promptable segmentation model for edge and in-sensor deployment, including the Sony IMX500 vision sensor. Achieves 65.45% mIoU on COCO through knowledge distillation from SAM2/SAM3.

entry.title: GRADE: Benchmarking Discipline-Informed Reasoning in Image Editing

author.name: Mingxin Liu, Ziqian Fan, Zhaokai Wang, Leyao Gu, Zirun Zhu, Yiguo He, Yuchen Yang, Changyao Tian, Xiangyu Zhao, Ning Liao, Shaofeng Zhang, Qibing Ren, Zhihang Zhong, Xuanhe Zhou, Junchi Yan, Xue Yang

entry.summary: Introduces GRADE, the first benchmark for discipline-informed reasoning in image editing, with 520 samples across 10 academic domains. Evaluates whether models can apply domain knowledge (e.g., physics, chemistry) during editing.

entry.title: MM-CondChain: A Programmatically Verified Benchmark for Visually Grounded Deep Compositional Reasoning

author.name: Haozhan Shen, Shilin Yan, Hongwei Xue, Shuaiqi Lu, Xiaojun Tang, Guannan Zhang, Tiancheng Zhao, Jianwei Yin

entry.summary: Introduces MM-CondChain, a benchmark for visually grounded deep compositional reasoning with multi-layer reasoning chains and programmatic verification. Tests complex conditional reasoning like GUI navigation workflows.

entry.title: ZeroSense:How Vision matters in Long Context Compression

author.name: Yonghan Gao, Zehong Chen, Lijian Xu, Jingzhi Chen, Jingwei Guan, Xingyu Zeng

entry.summary: Introduces ZeroSense benchmark to evaluate visual-text compression methods (like DeepSeek-OCR) by decoupling MLLMs' linguistic priors from actual text preservation quality. Shows that existing evaluation protocols overestimate VTC performance.

entry.title: Ada3Drift: Adaptive Training-Time Drifting for One-Step 3D Visuomotor Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Chongyang Xu, Yixian Zou, Ziliang Feng, Fanman Meng, Shuaicheng Liu

entry.summary: Proposes Ada3Drift for one-step 3D visuomotor robotic manipulation that shifts iterative refinement from inference to training time. Learns a drifting field to recover multimodal action fidelity while maintaining single-step inference.

entry.title: LLM-Augmented Digital Twin for Policy Evaluation in Short-Video Platforms

author.name: Haoting Zhang (Max), Yunduan Lin (Max), Jinghai He (Max), Denglin Jiang (Max), Zuo-Jun (Max), Shen, Zeyu Zheng

entry.summary: Proposes an LLM-augmented digital twin for short-video platforms with a modular four-twin architecture (User, Content, Interaction, Platform) enabling counterfactual policy evaluation for platform design decisions.

entry.title: The Density of Cross-Persistence Diagrams and Its Applications

author.name: Alexander Mironenko, Evgeny. Burnaev, Serguei Barannikov

entry.summary: Presents the first systematic study of the density of cross-persistence diagrams in topological data analysis, proving its existence and establishing theoretical foundations for statistical use in analyzing relationships between pairs of point clouds.

entry.title: When OpenClaw Meets Hospital: Toward an Agentic Operating System for Dynamic Clinical Workflows

author.name: Wenxian Yang, Hanzheng Qiu, Bangqun Zhang, Chengquan Li, Zhiyong Huang, Xiaobin Feng, Rongshan Yu, Jiahong Dong

entry.summary: Proposes an architecture adapting LLM agents for hospital environments with restricted execution, document-centric interaction, and persistent memory for clinical workflows. Inspired by Linux multi-user systems for safety.

entry.title: DocSage: An Information Structuring Agent for Multi-Doc Multi-Entity Question Answering

author.name: Teng Lin, Yizhang Zhu, Zhengxuan Zhang, Yuyu Luo, Nan Tang

entry.summary: DocSage is an agentic framework for multi-document multi-entity QA that integrates dynamic schema discovery, structured information extraction, and cross-document evidence chain construction to overcome limitations of standard RAG approaches.

entry.title: VisiFold: Long-Term Traffic Forecasting via Temporal Folding Graph and Node Visibility

author.name: Zhiwei Zhang, Xinyi Du, Weihao Wang, Xuanchi Guo, Wenjuan Han

entry.summary: VisiFold proposes a temporal folding graph that consolidates temporal snapshots into a compact structure for long-term traffic forecasting, addressing computational scaling and complex spatio-temporal dependencies.

entry.title: Graph Tokenization for Bridging Graphs and Transformers

author.name: Zeyuan Guo, Enmao Diao, Cheng Yang, Chuan Shi

entry.summary: Proposes a graph tokenization framework that converts graphs into sequential token representations using reversible graph serialization guided by substructure statistics, combined with BPE tokenization. Enables LLMs to process graph-structured data.

entry.title: Representation Finetuning for Continual Learning

author.name: Haihua Luo, Xuming Ran, Tommi K\"arkk\"ainen, Huiyan Xue, Zhonghua Chen, Qi Xu, Fengyu Cong

entry.summary: Proposes CoRe (Continual Representation Learning), which shifts fine-tuning from weight space to representation space for continual learning, providing explicit control over representation drift to reduce catastrophic forgetting.

entry.title: Worst-case low-rank approximations

author.name: Anya Fries, Markus Reichstein, David Blei, Jonas Peters

entry.summary: Develops wcPCA, a unified framework for worst-case low-rank approximations across heterogeneous domains, extending FairPCA with novel objectives (norm-minPCA, norm-maxregret) better suited for varying total variance across domains.

entry.title: Deployment-Time Reliability of Learned Robot Policies

author.name: Christopher Agia

entry.summary: A dissertation investigating deployment-time reliability of learned robot policies through three complementary mechanisms: runtime monitoring for failure detection, recovery strategies, and task-aware evaluation, all operating without failure data.

entry.title: Effective Resistance Rewiring: A Simple Topological Correction for Over-Squashing

author.name: Bertran Miquel-Oliver, Manel Gil-Sorribes, Victor Guallar, Alexis Molina

entry.summary: Introduces Effective Resistance Rewiring (ERR), a graph rewiring method that uses effective resistance as a global signal to detect structural bottlenecks causing over-squashing in Graph Neural Networks, adding/removing edges to improve information flow.

entry.title: CRAFT: A Tendon-Driven Hand with Hybrid Hard-Soft Compliance

author.name: Leo Lin, Shivansh Patel, Jay Moon, Svetlana Lazebnik, Unnat Jain

entry.summary: Introduces CRAFT hand, a tendon-driven anthropomorphic robot hand with hybrid hard-soft compliance, placing soft material at joints and rigid links for better contact-rich manipulation. Achieves 33/33 grasps in teleoperation tests.

entry.title: Incremental Neural Network Verification via Learned Conflicts

author.name: Raya Elsaleh, Liam Davis, Haoze Wu, Guy Katz

entry.summary: Proposes an incremental neural network verification technique that reuses learned conflicts across related verification queries in branch-and-bound verifiers, reducing redundant exploration of infeasible regions.

entry.title: Differentiable Thermodynamic Phase-Equilibria for Machine Learning

author.name: Karim K. Ben Hicham, Moreno Ascani, Jan G. Rittig, Alexander Mitsos

entry.summary: Presents DISCOMAX, a differentiable algorithm for phase-equilibrium calculation guaranteeing thermodynamic consistency, using discrete enumeration with masked softmax for end-to-end differentiable training.

entry.title: AutoScout: Structured Optimization for Automating ML System Configuration

author.name: Jimmy Shong, Yuhan Ding, Yihan Jiang, Liheng Jing, Haonan Chen, Gaokai Zhang, Aditya Akella, Fan Lai

entry.summary: Presents AutoScout, a general-purpose system for optimizing ML system configurations spanning model parallelism, communication, and runtime parameters. Uses structured optimization to handle heterogeneous features and conditional dependencies.

entry.title: Chem4DLLM: 4D Multimodal LLMs for Chemical Dynamics Understanding

author.name: Xinyu Li, Zhen Zhang, Qi Chen, Anton van den Hengel, Lina Yao, Javen Qinfeng Shi

entry.summary: Introduces Chem4DLLM and the Chemical Dynamics Understanding task, which translates 4D molecular trajectories into natural language explanations of chemical reactions. Creates a benchmark for evaluating this capability.

entry.title: HawkesRank: Event-Driven Centrality for Real-Time Importance Ranking

author.name: Didier Sornette, Yishan Luo, Sandro Claudio Lera

entry.summary: Introduces HawkesRank, a dynamic centrality framework based on multivariate Hawkes processes that separately models exogenous and endogenous influence, with classical centrality measures (PageRank, Katz) emerging as mean-field limits.

entry.title: Algorithmic Consequences of Particle Filters for Sentence Processing: Amplified Garden-Paths and Digging-In Effects

author.name: Amani Maina-Kilaas, Roger Levy

entry.summary: Proves algorithmic consequences of particle filter models for sentence processing, showing they amplify garden-path effects and produce digging-in behavior that standard LLM surprisal cannot capture.

entry.title: QChunker: Learning Question-Aware Text Chunking for Domain RAG via Multi-Agent Debate

author.name: Jihao Zhao, Daixuan Li, Pengfei Li, Shuaishuai Zu, Biao Qin, Hongyan Liu

entry.summary: Proposes QChunker, a question-aware text chunking framework for RAG that uses multi-agent debate to restructure chunking as text segmentation plus knowledge completion, improving retrieval quality.

entry.title: LifeSim: Long-Horizon User Life Simulator for Personalized Assistant Evaluation

author.name: Feiyu Duan, Xuanjing Huang, Zhongyu Wei

entry.summary: Proposes LifeSim, a user simulator based on BDI cognitive model for evaluating personalized AI assistants across 8 life domains with 1,200 scenarios, addressing gaps in long-horizon evaluation.

entry.title: Uni-ASR: Unified LLM-Based Architecture for Non-Streaming and Streaming Automatic Speech Recognition

author.name: Yinfeng Xia, Jian Tang, Junfeng Hou, Gaopeng Xu, Haitao Yao

entry.summary: Proposes Uni-ASR, a unified LLM-based framework for both non-streaming and streaming speech recognition with joint training and a context-aware fallback decoding strategy.

entry.title: Enhancing Value Alignment of LLMs with Multi-agent system and Combinatorial Fusion

author.name: Yuanhong Wu, Djallel Bouneffouf, D. Frank Hsu

entry.summary: Proposes VAS-CFA, a multi-agent fusion framework for LLM value alignment that instantiates multiple moral agents representing distinct normative perspectives and fuses their outputs using combinatorial fusion analysis.

entry.title: RC-NF: Robot-Conditioned Normalizing Flow for Real-Time Anomaly Detection in Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Shijie Zhou, Bin Zhu, Jiarui Yang, Xiangyu Zhao, Jingjing Chen, Yu-Gang Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes RC-NF, a robot-conditioned normalizing flow for real-time anomaly detection in robotic manipulation that monitors alignment between robot state, object trajectories, and task requirements.

entry.title: UNet-AF: An alias-free UNet for image restoration

author.name: J\'er\'emy Scanvic, Quentin Barth\'elemy, Juli\'an Tachella

entry.summary: Proposes an alias-free UNet architecture for image restoration by carefully selecting translation-equivariant layers, achieving competitive performance with significant improvements in measured equivariance.

entry.title: Mango-GS: Enhancing Spatio-Temporal Consistency in Dynamic Scenes Reconstruction using Multi-Frame Node-Guided 4D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Tingxuan Huang, Haowei Zhu, Jun-hai Yong, Hao Pan, Bin Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Mango-GS, a multi-frame node-guided 4D Gaussian Splatting framework using temporal Transformers on sparse control nodes for temporally consistent dynamic scene reconstruction.

entry.title: LaMoGen: Language to Motion Generation Through LLM-Guided Symbolic Inference

author.name: Junkun Jiang, Ho Yin Au, Jingyu Xiang, Jie Chen

entry.summary: Introduces LaMoGen, which uses LLMs for language-to-motion generation through symbolic inference based on LabanLite, an adapted Labanotation system. Decomposes complex motions into interpretable symbol sequences rather than relying on black-box text-motion embeddings.

entry.title: Multimodal classification of Radiation-Induced Contrast Enhancements and tumor recurrence using deep learning

author.name: Robin Peretzke, Marlin Hanstein, Maximilian Fischer, Lars Badhi Wessel, Obada Alhalabi, Sebastian Regnery, Andreas Kudak, Maximilian Deng, Tanja Eichkorn, Philipp Hoegen Sa{\ss}mannshausen, Fabian Allmendinger, Jan-Hendrik Bolten, Philipp Schr\"oter, Christine Jungk, J\"urgen Peter Debus, Peter Neher, Laila K\"onig, Klaus Maier-Hein

entry.summary: Presents RICE-NET, a multimodal 3D deep learning model integrating longitudinal MRI with radiotherapy dose distributions to differentiate tumor recurrence from radiation-induced contrast enhancements in glioblastoma patients. Achieves F1 of 0.92.

entry.title: O3N: Omnidirectional Open-Vocabulary Occupancy Prediction

author.name: Mengfei Duan, Hao Shi, Fei Teng, Guoqiang Zhao, Yuheng Zhang, Zhiyong Li, Kailun Yang

entry.summary: Introduces O3N, the first purely visual end-to-end omnidirectional open-vocabulary occupancy prediction framework. Uses Polar-spiral Mamba for continuous spatial representation with long-range context modeling.

entry.title: EgoIntent: An Egocentric Step-level Benchmark for Understanding What, Why, and Next

author.name: Ye Pan, Chi Kit Wong, Yuanhuiyi Lyu, Hanqian Li, Jiahao Huo, Jiacheng Chen, Lutao Jiang, Xu Zheng, Xuming Hu

entry.summary: Introduces EgoIntent, a step-level intent understanding benchmark for egocentric videos that tests what, why, and what-next reasoning. Designed for applications like intelligent assistants and robotic imitation learning.

entry.title: DreamVideo-Omni: Omni-Motion Controlled Multi-Subject Video Customization with Latent Identity Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Yujie Wei, Xinyu Liu, Shiwei Zhang, Hangjie Yuan, Jinbo Xing, Zhekai Chen, Xiang Wang, Haonan Qiu, Rui Zhao, Yutong Feng, Ruihang Chu, Yingya Zhang, Yike Guo, Xihui Liu, Hongming Shan

entry.summary: Proposes DreamVideo-Omni for multi-subject video customization with omni-motion control using a two-stage training paradigm. Introduces Latent Identity Reinforcement Learning to maintain identity preservation during RL-based motion control training.

entry.title: Chunk-Boundary Artifact in Action-Chunked Generative Policies: A Noise-Sensitive Failure Mechanism

author.name: Rui Wang

entry.summary: Identifies and analyzes 'chunk-boundary artifact' as a noise-sensitive failure mechanism in action-chunked generative policies. Shows the artifact is statistically associated with task failure and can be modulated by steering in noise space.

entry.title: Concurrent Prehensile and Nonprehensile Manipulation: A Practical Approach to Multi-Stage Dexterous Tasks

author.name: Hao Jiang, Yue Wu, Yue Wang, Gaurav S. Sukhatme, Daniel Seita

entry.summary: Presents DexMulti, a sample-efficient approach for real-world dexterous manipulation that handles concurrent prehensile and nonprehensile tasks by decomposing demonstrations into object-centric skills with temporal boundaries.

entry.title: HumDex:Humanoid Dexterous Manipulation Made Easy

author.name: Liang Heng, Yihe Tang, Jiajun Xu, Henghui Bao, Di Huang, Yue Wang

entry.summary: Introduces HumDex, a portable teleoperation system for humanoid whole-body dexterous manipulation using IMU-based motion tracking with learning-based hand retargeting. Addresses the data collection bottleneck for humanoid manipulation research.

entry.title: Explicit Logic Channel for Validation and Enhancement of MLLMs on Zero-Shot Tasks

author.name: Mei Chee Leong, Ying Gu, Hui Li Tan, Liyuan Li, Nancy Chen

entry.summary: Proposes an Explicit Logic Channel that runs parallel to black-box MLLMs, performing explicit logical reasoning for model validation, selection, and enhancement on zero-shot VLC tasks using LLMs, VFMs, and probabilistic inference.

entry.title: Normative Common Ground Replication (NormCoRe): Replication-by-Translation for Studying Norms in Multi-agent AI

author.name: Luca Deck, Simeon Allmendinger, Lucas M\"uller, Niklas K\"uhl

entry.summary: NormCoRe proposes a methodology for systematically translating human behavioral experiments about norms into multi-agent AI settings, enabling rigorous study of how normative coordination emerges in AI agent populations.

entry.title: Attention Gathers, MLPs Compose: A Causal Analysis of an Action-Outcome Circuit in VideoViT

author.name: Sai V R Chereddy

entry.summary: Reverse-engineers an internal circuit in a video vision transformer that represents action outcomes (success vs failure), finding that the signal is progressively amplified through layers 5-11 via a distinct cascade mechanism.

entry.title: Resolving Java Code Repository Issues with iSWE Agent

author.name: Jatin Ganhotra, Sami Serhan, Antonio Abu Nassar, Avraham Shinnar, Ziv Nevo, Martin Hirzel

entry.summary: Introduces iSWE Agent for automated Java issue resolution, featuring specialized sub-agents for localization and editing with novel tools based on rule-based Java static analysis. Addresses the under-explored area of non-Python automated code repair.

entry.title: Resource-Efficient Iterative LLM-Based NAS with Feedback Memory

author.name: Xiaojie Gu, Dmitry Ignatov, Radu Timofte

entry.summary: Proposes a resource-efficient Neural Architecture Search pipeline using LLMs with a Markov chain-inspired feedback memory of recent improvement attempts, enabling iterative architecture refinement on a single consumer GPU.

entry.title: Frequency-Modulated Visual Restoration for Matryoshka Large Multimodal Models

author.name: Qingtao Pan, Zhihao Dou, Shuo Li

entry.summary: Introduces FMVR, a plug-and-play strategy for large multimodal models that restores visual information lost during token reduction using frequency-modulated decomposition with lightweight learnable parameters.

entry.title: WeEdit: A Dataset, Benchmark and Glyph-Guided Framework for Text-centric Image Editing

entry.title: SaPaVe: Towards Active Perception and Manipulation in Vision-Language-Action Models for Robotics

author.name: Ilias Aarab

entry.title: Node-RF: Learning Generalized Continuous Space-Time Scene Dynamics with Neural ODE-based NeRFs

author.name: Hiran Sarkar, Liming Kuang, Yordanka Velikova, Benjamin Busam

entry.title: AS-Bridge: A Bidirectional Generative Framework Bridging Next-Generation Astronomical Surveys

entry.title: GlyphBanana: Advancing Precise Text Rendering Through Agentic Workflows

author.name: Tong Li, Thiago de Queiroz Casanova, Eric M. Schwartz, Victor Kostyuk, Dehan Kong, Joseph J. Williams

This reformulates the non-convex EIG optimization into an entropic regularization problem over probability measures, enabling more tractable batch experiment design.

entry.title: CHiL(L)Grader: Calibrated Human-in-the-Loop Short-Answer Grading

author.name: Pranav Raikote, Korbinian Randl, Ioanna Miliou, Athanasios Lakes, Panagiotis Papapetrou

author.name: Md Jahidul Islam

entry.title: One Supervisor, Many Modalities: Adaptive Tool Orchestration for Autonomous Queries

author.name: Mayank Saini Arit Kumar Bishwas

entry.title: Exploiting Expertise of Non-Expert and Diverse Agents in Social Bandit Learning: A Free Energy Approach
