author.name: Remigiusz Kinas, Pawe{\l} Kiszczak, Sergio P. Perez, Krzysztof Ociepa, {\L}ukasz Flis, Krzysztof Wr\'obel, Adrian Gwo\'zdziej

entry.summary: Details creation of Bielik-Minitron-7B, a 7.35B compressed version of Bielik-11B-v3.0 optimized for European languages, using NVIDIA Minitron-inspired pruning and distillation with 33.4% parameter reduction, followed by SFT, DPO, and GRPO alignment.

entry.title: EnTransformer: A Deep Generative Transformer for Multivariate Probabilistic Forecasting

author.name: Rajdeep Pathak, Rahul Goswami, Madhurima Panja, Palash Ghosh, Tanujit Chakraborty

entry.summary: Introduces EnTransformer, a deep generative forecasting framework combining engression (a stochastic learning paradigm) with Transformers for multivariate probabilistic time series forecasting. Aims to capture complex joint predictive distributions across correlated time series.

entry.title: Separable neural architectures as a primitive for unified predictive and generative intelligence

author.name: Reza T. Batley, Apurba Sarker, Rajib Mostakim, Andrew Klichine, Sourav Saha

entry.summary: Proposes Separable Neural Architectures (SNA), a representational class unifying additive, quadratic, and tensor-decomposed neural models that exploit factorisable structure in data.

entry.title: H2LooP Spark Preview: Continual Pretraining of Large Language Models for Low-Level Embedded Systems Code

author.name: Amit Singh, Vedant Nipane, Pulkit Agrawal, Jatin Kishnani

entry.summary: Introduces H2LooP Spark Preview, a continual pretraining pipeline adapting OLMo-3-7B to embedded systems programming using BF16 LoRA on 100B tokens of repository-datasheet pairs.

entry.title: Ensuring Safety in Automated Mechanical Ventilation through Offline Reinforcement Learning and Digital Twin Verification

author.name: Hang Yu, Huidong Liu, Qingchen Zhang, William Joy, Kateryna Nikulina, Andreas A. Schuppert, Sina Saffaran, Declan Bates

entry.summary: Proposes automated mechanical ventilation control using offline RL with digital twin verification, capturing temporal dependencies and VILI risk better than prior approaches.

entry.title: Multi-Task Anti-Causal Learning for Reconstructing Urban Events from Residents' Reports

author.name: Liangkai Zhou, Susu Xu, Shuqi Zhong, Shan Lin

entry.summary: Proposes MTAC, a multi-task anti-causal learning framework that exploits cross-task invariances to infer latent causes from observed effects. Applied to reconstructing urban events from residents' reports.

entry.title: Mitigating the Multiplicity Burden: The Role of Calibration in Reducing Predictive Multiplicity of Classifiers

author.name: Mustafa Cavus

entry.summary: Examines the relationship between classification calibration and predictive multiplicity in credit risk models, finding that minority class observations bear disproportionate multiplicity burden and that post-hoc calibration can mitigate algorithmic arbitrariness.

entry.title: Inverse Neural Operator for ODE Parameter Optimization

author.name: Zhi-Song Liu, Wenqing Peng, Helmi Toropainen, Ammar Kheder, Andreas Rupp, Holger Froning, Xiaojie Lin, Michael Boy

entry.summary: Proposes the Inverse Neural Operator (INO), a two-stage framework for recovering hidden ODE parameters from sparse observations using a conditional Fourier neural operator and an amortized drifting model that avoids backpropagation through the surrogate.

entry.title: FlexRec: Adapting LLM-based Recommenders for Flexible Needs via Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Yijun Pan, Weikang Qiu, Qiyao Ma, Mingxuan Ju, Tong Zhao, Neil Shah, Rex Ying

entry.summary: Proposes FlexRec, using RL-based post-training to adapt LLM-based recommender systems to flexible, need-specific objectives through autoregressive ranking with explicit need instructions.

entry.title: Continued Pretraining for Low-Resource Swahili ASR: Achieving State-of-the-Art Performance with Minimal Labeled Data

author.name: Hillary Mutisya, John Mugane

entry.summary: Investigates continued pretraining of wav2vec2-bert for Swahili ASR, achieving 3.24% WER on Common Voice Swahili—an 82% relative improvement over baseline and 61% over prior state-of-the-art.

entry.title: MaterialFigBENCH: benchmark dataset with figures for evaluating college-level materials science problem-solving abilities of multimodal large language models

author.name: Michiko Yoshitake, Yuta Suzuki, Ryo Igarashi, Yoshitaka Ushiku, Keisuke Nagato

entry.summary: Presents MaterialFigBench, a benchmark of 137 materials science problems requiring figure interpretation (phase diagrams, stress-strain curves, etc.) to evaluate multimodal LLMs on university-level STEM problems.

entry.title: In the LLM era, Word Sense Induction remains unsolved

author.name: Anna Mosolova, Marie Candito, Carlos Ramisch

entry.summary: Highlights that word sense induction remains unsolved even with LLMs, proposing evaluation on SemCor-derived data respecting natural polysemy distributions and finding no unsupervised method reliably outperforms baselines.

entry.title: Hierarchical Granularity Alignment and State Space Modeling for Robust Multimodal AU Detection in the Wild

author.name: Jun Yu, Yunxiang Zhang, Naixiang Zheng, Lingsi Zhu, Guoyuan Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a multimodal framework for facial Action Unit detection using DINOv2 and WavLM foundation models with hierarchical granularity alignment and state space modeling for temporal context.

entry.title: Follow the Saliency: Supervised Saliency for Retrieval-augmented Dense Video Captioning

author.name: Seung hee Choi, MinJu Jeon, Hyunwoo Oh, Jihwan Lee, Dong-Jin Kim

entry.summary: Proposes STaRC for dense video captioning using supervised saliency from highlight detection module trained on DVC ground truth, guiding both retrieval and caption generation.

entry.title: MDS-VQA: Model-Informed Data Selection for Video Quality Assessment

author.name: Jian Zou, Xiaoyu Xu, Zhihua Wang, Yilin Wang, Balu Adsumilli, Kede Ma

entry.summary: Proposes MDS-VQA, a model-informed data selection mechanism for video quality assessment that targets both difficult and diverse unlabeled videos under a constrained labeling budget.

entry.title: TornadoNet: Real-Time Building Damage Detection with Ordinal Supervision

author.name: Robinson Umeike, Cuong Pham, Ryan Hausen, Thang Dao, Shane Crawford, Tanya Brown-Giammanco, Gerard Lemson, John van de Lindt, Blythe Johnston, Arik Mitschang, Trung Do

entry.summary: Presents TornadoNet, a benchmark for automated street-level building damage assessment using 3,333 geotagged images from the 2021 Midwest tornado outbreak. Compares CNN-based YOLO detectors against transformer-based models with ordinal-aware supervision for multi-level damage detection.

entry.title: CEI-3D: Collaborative Explicit-Implicit 3D Reconstruction for Realistic and Fine-Grained Object Editing

author.name: Yue Shi, Rui Shi, Yuxuan Xiong, Bingbing Ni, Wenjun Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces CEI-3D, an editing-oriented 3D reconstruction pipeline using collaborative explicit-implicit representations (SDF network + handler points) for realistic and fine-grained 3D object editing.

entry.title: Single-View Rolling-Shutter SfM

author.name: Sof\'ia Err\'azuriz Mu\~noz, Kim Kiehn, Petr Hruby, Kathl\'en Kohn

entry.summary: Characterizes single-view geometry for rolling-shutter cameras and derives minimal reconstruction problems. Explores what motion and scene parameters can be recovered from a single RS image.

entry.title: A Diffeomorphism Groupoid and Algebroid Framework for Discontinuous Image Registration

author.name: Lili Bao, Bin Xiao, Shihui Ying, Stefan Sommer

entry.summary: Proposes a mathematical framework for piecewise diffeomorphic image registration handling discontinuous sliding motion using diffeomorphism groupoid/algebroid theory. Extends LDDMM beyond smoothness assumptions.

entry.title: TATIC: Task-Aware Temporal Learning for Human Intent Inference from Physical Corrections in Human-Robot Collaboration

author.name: Jiurun Song, Xiao Liang, Minghui Zheng

entry.summary: Proposes TATIC, a framework for inferring task-level human intent from physical corrections during human-robot collaboration. Bridges the gap between foundation model approaches (vision/language) and physical HRI methods by interpreting torque-based contact forces for semantic intent.

entry.title: NFPO: Stabilized Policy Optimization of Normalizing Flow for Robotic Policy Learning

author.name: Diyuan Shi, Yiqi Tang, Zifeng Zhuang, Donglin Wang

entry.summary: Explores Normalizing Flows as policy parameterization for robotic reinforcement learning to model multi-modal action distributions. Provides analysis of training instability when using NFs in online RL and proposes stabilization techniques (NFPO).

entry.title: Coupling Tensor Trains with Graph of Convex Sets: Effective Compression, Exploration, and Planning in the C-Space

author.name: Gerhard Reinerth, Riddhiman Laha, Marcello Romano

entry.summary: Presents TANGO, a motion planning framework integrating Tensor Train decomposition with Graph of Convex Sets for efficient trajectory generation. Uses tensor compression to approximate feasible configuration space, avoiding intractable convex characterization.

entry.title: Flight through Narrow Gaps with Morphing-Wing Drones

author.name: Julius Wanner, Hoang-Vu Phan, Charbel Toumieh, Dario Floreano

entry.summary: Enables fixed-wing drones to traverse sub-wingspan gaps by temporarily sweeping in morphing wings mid-flight. Develops aerodynamic models for wing-sweep morphing and NMPC control framework for the maneuver.

entry.title: Taming the Adversary: Stable Minimax Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient via Fractional Objectives

author.name: Taeho Lee, Donghwan Lee

entry.summary: Proposes minimax deep deterministic policy gradient (MMDDPG) for learning disturbance-resilient policies in continuous control through adversarial training with fractional objectives for stability.

entry.title: LLM-Assisted Causal Structure Disambiguation and Factor Extraction for Legal Judgment Prediction

author.name: Yuzhi Liang, Lixiang Ma, Xinrong Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes an LLM-assisted causal inference framework for legal judgment prediction that addresses noisy legal factor extraction and causal structure ambiguity due to Markov equivalence.

entry.title: Noise-aware few-shot learning through bi-directional multi-view prompt alignment

author.name: Lu Niu, Cheng Xue

entry.summary: Proposes NA-MVP for noise-aware few-shot learning through bi-directional multi-view prompt alignment. Uses region-aware alignment to distinguish clean from noisy labels in vision-language model prompt tuning.

entry.title: Intrinsic Concept Extraction Based on Compositional Interpretability

author.name: Hanyu Shi, Hong Tao, Guoheng Huang, Jianbin Jiang, Xuhang Chen, Chi-Man Pun, Shanhu Wang, Pan Pan

entry.summary: Introduces CI-ICE task for extracting composable intrinsic concepts (object-level and attribute-level) from single images using diffusion models. Proposes HyperExpress method to decompose and recompose visual concepts.

entry.title: NBAvatar: Neural Billboards Avatars with Realistic Hand-Face Interaction

author.name: David Svitov, Mahtab Dahaghin

entry.summary: Presents NBAvatar for realistic head avatar rendering handling hand-face interaction using oriented planar primitives combined with neural rendering. Achieves up to 30% LPIPS reduction for novel-view and novel-pose rendering.

entry.title: Real-time Rendering-based Surgical Instrument Tracking via Evolutionary Optimization

author.name: Hanyang Hu, Zekai Liang, Florian Richter, Michael C. Yip

entry.summary: Incorporates CMA-ES evolutionary optimization into a rendering-based surgical instrument tracking pipeline for robot-assisted surgery. Jointly estimates state without relying on unreliable feature detections.

entry.title: COMPASS: The explainable agentic framework for Sovereignty, Sustainability, Compliance, and Ethics

author.name: Jean-S\'ebastien, Dessureault, Alain-Thierry, Iliho Manzi, Soukaina, Alaoui Ismaili, Khadim, Lo, Mireille, Lalancette, \'Eric, B\'elanger

entry.summary: COMPASS introduces a multi-agent orchestration framework integrating digital sovereignty, environmental sustainability, regulatory compliance, and ethical alignment into autonomous agent decision-making through modular governance mechanisms.

entry.title: Compiling Temporal Numeric Planning into Discrete PDDL+: Extended Version

author.name: Andrea Micheli, Enrico Scala, Alessandro Valentini

entry.summary: Presents a practical polynomial compilation from temporal planning with durative actions (PDDL 2.1) into PDDL+, filling a long-standing gap in the planning literature with experimental validation.

entry.title: Exploring Collatz Dynamics with Human-LLM Collaboration

author.name: Edward Y. Chang

entry.summary: Explores Collatz conjecture dynamics through human-LLM collaboration, proving structural results about modular scrambling and burst-gap decomposition. Demonstrates LLM utility as a mathematical exploration partner.

entry.title: A Simple Efficiency Incremental Learning Framework via Vision-Language Model with Nonlinear Multi-Adapters

author.name: Haihua Luo, Xuming Ran, Jiangrong Shen, Timo H\"am\"al\"ainen, Zhonghua Chen, Qi Xu, Fengyu Cong

entry.summary: Proposes SimE, a simple framework using vision-language models with nonlinear multi-adapters for incremental learning, discovering a nonlinear correlation between adapter connections and performance that enables efficient training.

entry.title: Bridging Discrete Marks and Continuous Dynamics: Dual-Path Cross-Interaction for Marked Temporal Point Processes

author.name: Yuxiang Liu, Qiao Liu, Tong Luo, Yanglei Gan, Peng He, Yao LIu

entry.summary: Proposes NEXTPP, a dual-channel framework combining discrete event mark encoding with continuous Neural ODE dynamics via cross-interaction for marked temporal point processes.

entry.title: SPEGC: Continual Test-Time Adaptation via Semantic-Prompt-Enhanced Graph Clustering for Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Xiaogang Du, Jiawei Zhang, Tongfei Liu, Tao Lei, Yingbo Wang

entry.summary: Proposes SPEGC for continual test-time adaptation in medical image segmentation, using semantic prompt-enhanced graph clustering to avoid error accumulation from unreliable supervisory signals.

entry.title: FBCIR: Balancing Cross-Modal Focuses in Composed Image Retrieval

author.name: Chenchen Zhao, Jianhuan Zhuo, Muxi Chen, Zhaohua Zhang, Wenyu Jiang, Tianwen Jiang, Qiuyong Xiao, Jihong Zhang, Qiang Xu

entry.summary: Proposes FBCIR, a method to diagnose focus imbalances in composed image retrieval models and demonstrates that models disproportionately attend to one modality, degrading performance on challenging cases.

entry.title: How Intelligence Emerges: A Minimal Theory of Dynamic Adaptive Coordination

author.name: Stefano Grassi

entry.summary: Develops a dynamical theory of adaptive coordination in multi-agent systems treating coordination as a structural property of coupled dynamics rather than centralized optimization. Establishes convergence and stability results.

entry.title: Toward Complex-Valued Neural Networks for Waveform Generation

author.name: Hyung-Seok Oh, Deok-Hyeon Cho, Seung-Bin Kim, Seong-Whan Lee

entry.summary: Presents ComVo, a complex-valued neural vocoder where both generator and discriminator use native complex arithmetic for iSTFT-based waveform generation, better capturing the inherent structure of complex spectrograms.

entry.title: Survival Meets Classification: A Novel Framework for Early Risk Prediction Models of Chronic Diseases

author.name: Shaheer Ahmad Khan, Muhammad Usamah Shahid, Muddassar Farooq

entry.summary: Proposes a novel framework integrating survival analysis with classification for early chronic disease risk prediction across five diseases using EMR data, showing survival methods can be re-engineered for effective classification.

entry.title: Stable Spike: Dual Consistency Optimization via Bitwise AND Operations for Spiking Neural Networks

author.name: Yongqi Ding, Kunshan Yang, Linze Li, Yiyang Zhang, Mengmeng Jing, Lin Zuo

entry.summary: Proposes Stable Spike for spiking neural networks, using bitwise AND operations to decouple stable spike skeletons from noisy spikes across timesteps, improving consistency and recognition performance.

entry.title: Hybrid Human-Agent Social Dilemmas in Energy Markets

author.name: Isuri Perera, Frits de Nijs, Julian Garcia

entry.summary: Studies hybrid human-agent social dilemmas in energy load management, showing artificial agents using globally observable signals can increase coordination through evolutionary dynamics and reinforcement learning.

entry.title: Beyond Convolution: A Taxonomy of Structured Operators for Learning-Based Image Processing

author.name: Simone Cammarasana

entry.summary: Provides a systematic taxonomy of operators that extend or replace standard convolution in learning-based image processing, organizing alternatives into five families including decomposition-based, adaptive, and non-linear operators.

entry.title: Learning Tree-Based Models with Gradient Descent

author.name: Sascha Marton

entry.summary: Thesis proposing a method for learning decision trees with gradient descent by making the discrete tree structure differentiable, enabling integration with modern ML approaches.

entry.title: Beyond Barren Plateaus: A Scalable Quantum Convolutional Architecture for High-Fidelity Image Classification

author.name: Radhakrishnan Delhibabu

entry.summary: Proposes a QCNN architecture with localized cost functions and tensor-network initialization to mitigate barren plateaus, achieving 98.7% on MNIST.

entry.title: Huntington Disease Automatic Speech Recognition with Biomarker Supervision

author.name: Charles L. Wang, Cady Chen, Ziwei Gong, Julia Hirschberg

entry.summary: Presents a systematic study of ASR for Huntington's disease speech, comparing multiple ASR architectures and proposing biomarker-based auxiliary supervision, reducing WER from 6.99% to 4.95%.

entry.title: Duration Aware Scheduling for ASR Serving Under Workload Drift

author.name: Darshan Makwana, Yash Jogi, Harsh Kotta, Aayush Kubba

entry.summary: Proposes duration-aware scheduling (SJF, HRRN) for ASR serving pipelines, using audio duration as a proxy for processing time to reduce head-of-line blocking under workload drift.

entry.title: ZTab: Domain-based Zero-shot Annotation for Table Columns

author.name: Ehsan Hoseinzade, Ke Wang

entry.summary: Introduces ZTab, a domain-based zero-shot framework for semantic column type detection in relational tables that addresses performance with many column types while avoiding privacy risks of closed-source LLMs.

entry.title: UniHetCO: A Unified Heterogeneous Representation for Multi-Problem Learning in Unsupervised Neural Combinatorial Optimization

author.name: Kien X. Nguyen, Ilya Safro

entry.summary: Proposes UniHetCO, a unified heterogeneous graph representation for solving multiple combinatorial optimization problems (e.g., Max Clique, Max Independent Set) within a single unsupervised neural framework using constrained quadratic programming encodings. This eliminates the need for problem-specific surrogate losses.

entry.title: CAETC: Causal Autoencoding and Treatment Conditioning for Counterfactual Estimation over Time

author.name: Nghia D. Nguyen, Pablo Robles-Granda, Lav R. Varshney

entry.summary: Introduces CAETC for counterfactual estimation over time using adversarial representation learning with an autoencoding architecture. Addresses time-dependent confounding bias in observational data for applications like personalized medicine.

entry.title: A Further Efficient Algorithm with Best-of-Both-Worlds Guarantees for $m$-Set Semi-Bandit Problem

author.name: Botao Chen, Jongyeong Lee, Chansoo Kim, Junya Honda

entry.summary: Studies FTPL optimality for m-set semi-bandit problems, showing that FTPL with specific distributions achieves optimal regret bounds and best-of-both-worlds guarantees with improved computational efficiency.

entry.title: Topological DeepONets and a generalization of the Chen-Chen operator approximation theorem

author.name: Vugar Ismailov

entry.summary: Develops a topological extension of DeepONets where the operator input lies in an arbitrary Hausdorff locally convex space, generalizing the Chen-Chen operator approximation theorem to this broader setting.

entry.title: Efficient Generative Modeling with Unitary Matrix Product States Using Riemannian Optimization

author.name: Haotong Duan, Zhongming Chen, Ngai Wong

entry.summary: Studies unitary matrix product states (MPS) for generative modeling with Riemannian optimization, showing clear benefits over standard MPS training through reduced parameter ambiguity and improved efficiency.

entry.title: Conformal e-prediction in the presence of confounding

author.name: Vladimir Vovk, Ruodu Wang

entry.summary: Extends conformal e-prediction to handle observed confounding between features X and labels Y, covering both IID and spatially dependent observation settings.

entry.title: A Unified Latent Space Disentanglement VAE Framework with Robust Disentanglement Effectiveness Evaluation

author.name: Xiaoan Lang, Fang Liu

entry.summary: Proposes bfVAE, a unified framework for disentangled VAEs with new evaluation metrics (FVH-LT, DBSR-LS) for assessing disentanglement effectiveness, especially for tabular data where ground-truth factors are unknown.

entry.title: MRI2Qmap: multi-parametric quantitative mapping with MRI-driven denoising priors

author.name: Mohammad Golbabaee, Matteo Cencini, Carolin Pirkl, Marion Menzel, Michela Tosetti, Bjoern Menze

entry.summary: Introduces MRI2Qmap, a plug-and-play framework for quantitative MRI reconstruction that leverages training data from clinically-routine weighted MRI images to overcome the scarcity of quantitative imaging training data.

entry.title: Spatially Robust Inference with Predicted and Missing at Random Labels

author.name: Stephen Salerno, Zhenke Wu, Tyler McCormick

entry.summary: Proposes a doubly robust estimator for spatial inference with predicted labels and missing-at-random data, addressing fold-level correlation from cross-fitting that distorts spatial variance estimators.

entry.title: Cross-Resolution Attention Network for High-Resolution PM2.5 Prediction

author.name: Ammar Kheder, Helmi Toropainen, Wenqing Peng, Samuel Ant\~ao, Zhi-Song Liu, Michael Boy

entry.summary: Introduces CRAN-PM, a dual-branch Vision Transformer with cross-resolution attention for continent-scale high-resolution PM2.5 prediction, incorporating elevation-aware and wind-guided attention mechanisms.

entry.title: BLooP: Zero-Shot Abstractive Summarization using Large Language Models with Bigram Lookahead Promotion

author.name: Varun Iyer, Cornelia Caragea

entry.summary: Proposes BLooP, a training-free decoding intervention for abstractive summarization that promotes tokens forming bigrams from the source document via hash table lookup, improving faithfulness in zero-shot LLM summarization.

entry.title: Large Language Models for Biomedical Article Classification

author.name: Jakub Proboszcz, Pawe{\l} Cichosz

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates LLMs as text classifiers for biomedical article classification across 15 datasets, comparing various prompting strategies and output processing methods against conventional classifiers.

entry.title: Beyond Polarity: Multi-Dimensional LLM Sentiment Signals for WTI Crude Oil Futures Return Prediction

author.name: Dehao Dai, Ding Ma, Dou Liu, Kerui Geng, Yiqing Wang

entry.summary: Examines multi-dimensional LLM-extracted sentiment signals (relevance, polarity, intensity, uncertainty, forwardness) for predicting WTI crude oil futures returns, comparing GPT-4o, Llama 3.2, FinBERT.

entry.title: Evidential learning driven Breast Tumor Segmentation with Stage-divided Vision-Language Interaction

author.name: Jingxing Zhong, Qingtao Pan, Xuchang Zhou, Jiazhen Lin, Xinguo Zhuang

entry.summary: Proposes TextBCS, a text-guided breast tumor segmentation model using evidential learning and stage-divided vision-language interaction for MRI analysis.

entry.title: Towards Automated Initial Probe Placement in Transthoracic Teleultrasound Using Human Mesh and Skeleton Recovery

author.name: Yu Chung Lee, David G. Black, Ryan S. Yeung, Septimiu E. Salcudean

entry.summary: Presents a framework for automated initial ultrasound probe placement guidance using human mesh and skeleton recovery from RGB images, targeting teleultrasound applications.

entry.title: ActiveFreq: Integrating Active Learning and Frequency Domain Analysis for Interactive Segmentation

author.name: Lijun Guo, Qian Zhou, Zidi Shi, Hua Zou, Gang Ke

entry.summary: Proposes ActiveFreq for interactive medical image segmentation, combining active learning for region selection with frequency domain analysis for enhanced feature extraction.

entry.title: UCAN: Unified Convolutional Attention Network for Expansive Receptive Fields in Lightweight Super-Resolution

author.name: Cao Thien Tan, Phan Thi Thu Trang, Do Nghiem Duc, Ho Ngoc Anh, Hanyang Zhuang, Nguyen Duc Dung

entry.summary: Presents UCAN, a lightweight super-resolution network that unifies convolution and attention for expanded receptive fields. Combines window-based spatial attention with Hedgehog Attention and cross-layer parameter sharing for efficiency.

entry.title: VTEdit-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Multi-Reference Image Editing Models in Virtual Try-On

author.name: Xiaoye Liang, Zhiyuan Qu, Mingye Zou, Jiaxin Liu, Lai Jiang, Mai Xu, Yiheng Zhu

entry.summary: Introduces VTEdit-Bench, a benchmark evaluating universal multi-reference image editing models for virtual try-on scenarios. Systematically assesses strengths and limitations of general editors compared to specialized VTON models.

entry.title: Derain-Agent: A Plug-and-Play Agent Framework for Rainy Image Restoration

author.name: Zhaocheng Yu, Xiang Chen, Runzhe Li, Zihan Geng, Guanglu Sun, Haipeng Li, Kui Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes Derain-Agent, a plug-and-play framework that uses agent-based dynamic restoration for image deraining. Includes a Planning Network for tool scheduling and Strength Modulation for adaptive processing.

entry.title: Pano360: Perspective to Panoramic Vision with Geometric Consistency

author.name: Zhengdong Zhu, Weiyi Xue, Zuyuan Yang, Wenlve Zhou, Zhiheng Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes Pano360 for panorama stitching that extends 2D alignment to 3D photogrammetric space using transformer-based architecture. Uses camera poses to guide global alignment, addressing distortion in challenging scenes.

entry.title: Nyxus: A Next Generation Image Feature Extraction Library for the Big Data and AI Era

author.name: Nicholas Schaub, Andriy Kharchenko, Hamdah Abbasi, Sameeul Samee, Hythem Sidky, Nathan Hotaling

entry.summary: Introduces Nyxus, a feature extraction library designed for scalable processing of terabyte-to-petabyte imaging datasets. Handles the gap between modern segmentation and feature extraction across scientific disciplines.

entry.title: GeNeX: Genetic Network eXperts framework for addressing Validation Overfitting

author.name: Emmanuel Pintelas, Ioannis E. Livieris

entry.summary: Proposes GeNeX, a framework using genetic algorithms to mitigate validation overfitting in both model generation and ensemble construction. Particularly targets low-data regimes and distribution shift scenarios.

entry.title: ADMM-based Continuous Trajectory Optimization in Graphs of Convex Sets

author.name: Lukas Pries, Jon Arrizabalaga, Zachary Manchester, Markus Ryll

entry.summary: Presents an ADMM-based solver for continuous trajectory optimization in non-convex environments using polynomial parameterization and spatio-temporal allocation graphs. Achieves joint optimization over discrete spatial and continuous temporal domains.

entry.title: MirrorDrift: Actuated Mirror-Based Attacks on LiDAR SLAM

author.name: Rokuto Nagata, Kenji Koide, Kazuma Ikeda, Ozora Sako, Shion Horie, Kentaro Yoshioka

entry.summary: Demonstrates MirrorDrift, a physical attack on LiDAR SLAM using actuated planar mirrors to create ghost points, providing an injection-free alternative to LiDAR spoofing. Shows significant localization drift in simulation experiments.

entry.title: D-SLAMSpoof: An Environment-Agnostic LiDAR Spoofing Attack using Dynamic Point Cloud Injection

author.name: Rokuto Nagata, Kenji Koide, Kazuma Ikeda, Ozora Sako, Kentaro Yoshioka

entry.summary: Introduces D-SLAMSpoof, a dynamic LiDAR spoofing attack that compromises SLAM even in feature-rich environments through temporally coordinated injection patterns. Also proposes ISD-SLAM, a defense method using inertial dead reckoning.

entry.title: Enhancing Lightweight Vision Language Models through Group Competitive Learning for Socially Compliant Navigation

author.name: Xinyu Zhang, Atsushi Konno, Toshihiko Yamasaki, Ling Xiao

entry.summary: Proposes Group Competitive Learning (GCL) to enhance lightweight Vision Language Models for socially compliant robot navigation. Aims to bridge the gap between reasoning capability and inference efficiency for real-time robotic deployment.

entry.title: Modeling a Constant-Compute Automated AI R&D Process

author.name: Satya Benson

entry.summary: Attempts to model how compute constraints affect AI R&D acceleration using Jones-style idea production models. Explores whether constant compute could limit recursive AI self-improvement.

entry.title: Evaluating Explainable AI Attribution Methods in Neural Machine Translation via Attention-Guided Knowledge Distillation

author.name: Aria Nourbakhsh, Salima Lamsiyah, Adelaide Danilov, Christoph Schommer

entry.summary: Proposes using teacher-derived attribution maps as structured signals in knowledge distillation to evaluate explainability methods for transformer-based seq2seq models in neural machine translation.

entry.title: A Learning-Based Superposition Operator for Non-Renewal Arrival Processes in Queueing Networks

author.name: Eliran Sherzer

entry.summary: Proposes a deep learning-based superposition operator for non-renewal arrival processes in queueing networks, mapping moments and autocorrelation descriptors to merged process characteristics.

entry.title: Cross-Domain Policy Optimization via Bellman Consistency and Hybrid Critics

author.name: Ming-Hong Chen, Kuan-Chen Pan, You-De Huang, Xi Liu, Ping-Chun Hsieh

entry.summary: Proposes a cross-domain RL method using Bellman consistency and hybrid critics to jointly address state/action space mismatches and negative transfer risks between source and target domains.

entry.title: Decomposing Observational Multiplicity in Decision Trees: Leaf and Structural Regret

author.name: Mustafa Cavus

entry.summary: Introduces leaf regret and structural regret as complementary notions of observational multiplicity for decision trees, extending theoretical frameworks previously limited to logistic regression.

entry.title: PROMO: Promptable Outfitting for Efficient High-Fidelity Virtual Try-On

author.name: Haohua Chen, Tianze Zhou, Wei Zhu, Runqi Wang, Yandong Guan, Dejia Song, Yibo Chen, Xu Tang, Yao Hu, Lu Sheng, Zhiyong Wu

entry.summary: Proposes PROMO for efficient high-fidelity virtual try-on, approaching VTON as structured image editing. Aims to balance fidelity and efficiency by avoiding auxiliary reference networks while maintaining photorealistic synthesis.

entry.title: Single Pixel Image Classification using an Ultrafast Digital Light Projector

author.name: Aisha Kanwal, Graeme E. Johnstone, Fahimeh Dehkhoda, Johannes H. Herrnsdorf, Robert K. Henderson, Martin D. Dawson, Xavier Porte, Michael J. Strain

entry.summary: Demonstrates image classification at multi-kHz frame rates using single pixel imaging with microLED-on-CMOS digital light projector combined with lightweight ML models. Tests on MNIST classification.

entry.title: Edge-Assisted Multi-Robot Visual-Inertial SLAM with Efficient Communication

author.name: Xin Liu, Shuhuan Wen, Jing Zhao, Tony Z. Qiu, Hong Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes an edge-assisted multi-robot SLAM system using pyramid IMU prediction for lightweight optical flow tracking. Combines edge and cloud computing for real-time multi-robot mapping.

entry.title: CoViLLM: An Adaptive Human-Robot Collaborative Assembly Framework Using Large Language Models for Manufacturing

author.name: Jiabao Zhao, Jonghan Lim, Hongliang Li, Ilya Kovalenko

entry.summary: Proposes CoViLLM, an adaptive human-robot collaborative assembly framework using LLMs for manufacturing. Combines depth-camera localization with LLM-based task planning to handle customized and previously unseen product assembly.

entry.title: AI Psychometrics: Evaluating the Psychological Reasoning of Large Language Models with Psychometric Validities

author.name: Yibai Li, Xiaolin Lin, Zhenghui Sha, Zhiye Jin, Xiaobing Li

entry.summary: Applies psychometric methodologies to evaluate psychological reasoning of LLMs (GPT-3.5, GPT-4, LLaMA-2, LLaMA-3) using the Technology Acceptance Model, examining convergent, discriminant, predictive, and external validity.

entry.title: Sim-to-reality adaptation for Deep Reinforcement Learning applied to an underwater docking application

author.name: Alaaeddine Chaarani, Narcis Palomeras, Pere Ridao

entry.summary: Presents a sim-to-real transfer approach for autonomous underwater docking using deep RL (PPO) with a high-fidelity digital twin, including a multiprocessing framework to accelerate training.

entry.title: SommBench: Assessing Sommelier Expertise of Language Models

entry.title: Group Resonance Network: Learnable Prototypes and Multi-Subject Resonance for EEG Emotion Recognition

author.name: Renwei Meng

entry.summary: Proposes Group Resonance Network for cross-subject EEG emotion recognition, combining individual EEG features with group-level prototypes and multi-subject synchrony patterns.

entry.title: Single molecule localization microscopy challenge: a biologically inspired benchmark for long-sequence modeling

author.name: Fatemeh Valeh, Monika Farsang, Radu Grosu, Gerhard Sch\"utz

entry.title: Hybrid Energy-Aware Reward Shaping: A Unified Lightweight Physics-Guided Methodology for Policy Optimization

author.name: Qijun Liao (School of Mechanical Engineering, University of Science and Technology Beijing, China), Jue Yang (School of Mechanical Engineering, University of Science and Technology Beijing, China), Yiting Kang (School of Mechanical Engineering, University of Science and Technology Beijing, China), Xinxin Zhao (School of Mechanical Engineering, University of Science and Technology Beijing, China), Yong Zhang (Jiangsu XCMG Construction Machinery Research Institute Co., Ltd., China), Mingan Zhao (Jiangsu XCMG Construction Machinery Research Institute Co., Ltd., China)

entry.title: Legal-DC: Benchmarking Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Legal Documents

entry.title: DeepHistoViT: An Interpretable Vision Transformer Framework for Histopathological Cancer Classification

author.name: Ravi Mosalpuri, Mohammed Abdelsamea, Ahmed Karam Eldaly

entry.title: PCA-Enhanced Probabilistic U-Net for Effective Ambiguous Medical Image Segmentation

The inverse PCA operation restores expressiveness for multi-hypothesis generation.

author.name: Xiaolong Qian, Qi Jiang, Yao Gao, Lei Sun, Zhonghua Yi, Kailun Yang, Luc Van Gool, Kaiwei Wang

entry.title: Hunting Undead Stochastic Parrots: Finding and Killing the Arguments

entry.summary: Applies 15 CNN variants (LeNet-5, ResNet, VGGNet, GoogLeNet) to detect malignant ovarian lesions from medical images, with XAI techniques for interpretability.

author.name: Yufeng Xin, Ethan Fan

entry.summary: Presents two deep learning models for network traffic prediction: a graph attention network capturing topological correlations and a fine-tuned multimodal LLM with clustering. Both aim to learn temporal patterns and network topology simultaneously.

author.name: Yibai Li (Emily), Zhiye Jin (Emily), Xiaobing (Emily), Li (Nancy), K. D. Joshi (Nancy), Xuefei (Nancy), Deng

entry.summary: An editorial discussing how blockchain can counterbalance AI's centralizing tendencies through decentralized data management, computation, and governance, arguing these technologies are complementary rather than mutually exclusive.

entry.summary: Applies BERT and GPT models to sentiment analysis of Persian poetry by Rumi and Parvin E'tesami, investigating LLM capability in understanding complex Persian literary forms.

entry.title: Comparison of Outlier Detection Algorithms on String Data

author.name: Philip Maus

entry.summary: Compares string data outlier detection algorithms, introducing a variant of Local Outlier Factor using Levenshtein distance with hierarchical character classes for string data.

author.name: Daniel Bautista-Salinas, Joaqu\'in Roca Gonz\'alez, Inmaculada M\'endez, Oscar Martinez Mozos

entry.summary: Presents a wearable system for monitoring and predicting mood states of elderly people using physiological data from a wristband and ML classifiers.

author.name: Mar\'ia Isabel Rivas Ginel, Jani\c{c}a Hackenbuchner, Alina Secar\u{a}, Ralph Kr\"uger, Caroline Rossi

entry.summary: Examines how value is constructed in the automated translation industry through interviews with 29 stakeholders, analyzing tensions between efficiency-oriented technological values and human expertise.

entry.title: Preliminary analysis of RGB-NIR Image Registration techniques for off-road forestry environments

author.name: Pankaj Deoli, Karthik Ranganath, Karsten Berns

entry.summary: Preliminary evaluation of RGB-NIR image registration techniques for off-road forestry environments, testing both classical and deep learning methods. Finds current methods have limitations in dense vegetation.

author.name: trent northen

entry.summary: Proposes teaching AI systems to value biological systems as a 'Plan B' safety approach. Fine-tunes LLMs on biomimicry examples and shows increased model preference for bioinspired approaches to technical challenges.

entry.summary: Analyzes Bostrom's 'cosmic host' concept—that preferences of advanced civilizations might constitute norms for humanity and ASI. Examines the assumption ladder and evaluates formation mechanisms for cosmic norms.

author.name: Valentine

entry.summary: Asks about the current state of using AI systems for agent foundations research and theoretical AI safety work. Draws parallels to Terence Tao using AI for math and asks whether anyone is doing AI-assisted alignment theory.

author.name: Will Rodgers

entry.summary: Speculative essay arguing that the Fermi paradox is consistent with AI as a Great Filter, proposing that post-AGI civilizations either achieve total cosmic stealth or collapse under informational entropy.

entry.summary: Philosophical essay connecting Feynman's critique of empty explanations (like 'energy makes it go') to Clarke's third law and the concept of magic as hidden control of energy flows. Argues true understanding requires mechanistic models.

entry.title: Forecasting Dojo Meetup - Open discussion about our forecasting process

author.name: Vojtech Brynych

entry.summary: Announcement for a forecasting practice group meetup to discuss forecasting processes, AI usage in forecasting, and templates. No substantive research content.

author.name: jefftk

entry.summary: Analyzes real-world parking permit data from a new building in Somerville, MA to test whether parking-ineligible housing developments actually reduce parking demand. Finds much lower car ownership rates than opponents predicted.

entry.title: Research Summary: March 12, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Two standout theoretical papers anchor today's research. Lost in Backpropagation reveals the LM head creates a severe gradient bottleneck during training, not merely an expressivity constraint. Lost in the Middle at Birth provides an exact proof that the U-shaped position bias exists from initialization, rooted in positional encoding structure.

  • IH-Challenge introduces an RL training dataset for improving instruction hierarchy compliance in frontier LLMs, a critical safety primitive
  • Safety Under Scaffolding reports the largest controlled study (N=62,808) showing map-reduce scaffolding degrades measured LLM safety, challenging current evaluation assumptions
  • First systematic MCP clause-compliance vulnerability framework identifies compatibility-abusing attack surfaces in the rapidly adopted agent protocol
  • CSRO from DeepMind replaces deep RL oracles with LLM-generated interpretable code policies for multi-agent equilibrium computation via PSRO
  • Beyond the Illusion of Consensus demonstrates high LLM-as-judge agreement often reflects shared surface heuristics rather than genuine evaluation quality

On the methods frontier, Neural Cellular Automata pre-pre-training proposes learning spatiotemporal structure before language exposure. CodePercept identifies perception—not reasoning—as the true bottleneck for MLLMs on visual STEM tasks. CLIPO incorporates contrastive learning into RLVR policy optimization to penalize correct-answer-wrong-reasoning trajectories.

entry.title: Lost in Backpropagation: The LM Head is a Gradient Bottleneck

author.name: Nathan Godey, Yoav Artzi

entry.summary: This paper reveals that the language model head (projecting from dimension D to vocabulary size V) creates not just an expressivity bottleneck but a severe optimization bottleneck, suppressing 95-99% of gradient norm during backpropagation. The authors provide theoretical analysis and empirical evidence showing this compression fundamentally alters training feedback for most parameters.

entry.title: IH-Challenge: A Training Dataset to Improve Instruction Hierarchy on Frontier LLMs

author.name: Chuan Guo (Michael Pokorny), Juan Felipe Ceron Uribe (Michael Pokorny), Sicheng Zhu (Michael Pokorny), Christopher A. Choquette-Choo (Michael Pokorny), Steph Lin (Michael Pokorny), Nikhil Kandpal (Michael Pokorny), Milad Nasr (Michael Pokorny), Rai (Michael Pokorny), Sam Toyer, Miles Wang, Yaodong Yu, Alex Beutel, Kai Xiao

entry.summary: Introduces IH-Challenge, a reinforcement learning training dataset to improve instruction hierarchy in LLMs, addressing how models should prioritize conflicting system, developer, user, and tool instructions. Fine-tuning GPT-5-Mini on this dataset improves IH robustness by +10% across 16 benchmarks.

entry.title: Lost in the Middle at Birth: An Exact Theory of Transformer Position Bias

author.name: Borun D Chowdhury

entry.summary: Provides an exact theoretical explanation for the 'Lost in the Middle' phenomenon in LLMs, proving the U-shaped performance curve exists at initialization before any training, as an inherent geometric property of causal decoders with residual connections. Models multi-layer causal attention as iterated Cesàro matrix powers.

entry.title: Safety Under Scaffolding: How Evaluation Conditions Shape Measured Safety

author.name: David Gringras

entry.summary: Reports one of the largest controlled studies (N=62,808) of scaffold effects on LLM safety across six frontier models. Finds map-reduce scaffolding degrades safety (NNH=14) while two of three scaffold architectures preserve safety. Reveals deeper measurement problems in format dependence.

entry.title: Code-Space Response Oracles: Generating Interpretable Multi-Agent Policies with Large Language Models

author.name: Daniel Hennes, Zun Li, John Schultz, Marc Lanctot

entry.summary: Introduces Code-Space Response Oracles (CSRO), replacing deep RL oracles in multi-agent game-theoretic equilibrium computation (PSRO) with LLMs that generate policies as human-readable code. This yields interpretable policies and enables cross-game transfer. Authors include researchers from DeepMind (Marc Lanctot, John Schultz).

entry.title: Compatibility at a Cost: Systematic Discovery and Exploitation of MCP Clause-Compliance Vulnerabilities

author.name: Nanzi Yang, Weiheng Bai, Kangjie Lu

entry.summary: Presents the first systematic framework for analyzing MCP (Model Context Protocol) clause-compliance vulnerabilities, identifying compatibility-abusing attacks including silent prompt injection and DoS. Shows that MCP's relaxed optional clauses create exploitable attack surfaces.

entry.title: Beyond the Illusion of Consensus: From Surface Heuristics to Knowledge-Grounded Evaluation in LLM-as-a-Judge

author.name: Mingyang Song, Mao Zheng, Chenning Xu

entry.summary: Demonstrates that high inter-evaluator agreement in LLM-as-judge settings is often illusory, with judges anchoring on surface heuristics rather than substantive quality ('Evaluation Illusion'). Large-scale study of 105,600 instances shows model-level agreement (ρ=0.99) masks fragile sample-level agreement.

entry.title: CodePercept: Code-Grounded Visual STEM Perception for MLLMs

author.name: Tongkun Guan, Zhibo Yang, Jianqiang Wan, Mingkun Yang, Zhengtao Guo, Zijian Hu, Ruilin Luo, Ruize Chen, Songtao Jiang, Peng Wang, Wei Shen, Junyang Lin, Xiaokang Yang

entry.summary: Reveals through scaling analysis that perception, not reasoning, is the true bottleneck for MLLMs in STEM visual tasks. Proposes CodePercept, which uses executable code as a perceptual medium to precisely represent structured STEM visuals.

entry.title: GPT-5.4 Is A Substantial Upgrade

author.name: Zvi

entry.summary: Zvi's comprehensive review of GPT-5.4, gathering community reactions and forming a gestalt assessment. Concludes it's a substantial upgrade from GPT-5.2, puts OpenAI back in competition with Opus 4.6, and has distinctive OpenAI-style strengths. Notes benchmarks are increasingly insufficient for comparing top models.

entry.title: Training Language Models via Neural Cellular Automata

author.name: Dan Lee, Seungwook Han, Akarsh Kumar, Pulkit Agrawal

entry.summary: Proposes pre-pre-training LLMs on neural cellular automata (NCA) data before natural language training. NCA data exhibits rich spatiotemporal structure resembling natural language statistics. Pre-training on only 164M NCA tokens improves downstream language model performance.

entry.title: CLIPO: Contrastive Learning in Policy Optimization Generalizes RLVR

author.name: Sijia Cui, Pengyu Cheng, Jiajun Song, Yongbo Gai, Guojun Zhang, Zhechao Yu, Jianhe Lin, Xiaoxi Jiang, Guanjun Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes CLIPO, which incorporates contrastive learning into policy optimization for RLVR (Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards). Addresses the problem of process-wrong but outcome-correct rollouts that lead to hallucination and answer-copying by capturing invariant structure across correct reasoning paths.

entry.title: Safe and Scalable Web Agent Learning via Recreated Websites

author.name: Hyungjoo Chae, Jungsoo Park, Alan Ritter

entry.summary: VeriEnv uses LLMs to clone real-world websites into executable synthetic environments with programmatically verifiable rewards, enabling safe and scalable web agent training without real-world interaction. Agents can self-generate tasks within these cloned environments.

entry.title: Beyond Sequential Distance: Inter-Modal Distance Invariant Position Encoding

author.name: Lin Chen, Bolin Ni, Qi Yang, Zili Wang, Kun Ding, Ying Wang, Houwen Peng, Shiming Xiang

entry.summary: Proposes DIPE (Distance Invariant Position Encoding) to address visual fading in long-context multimodal LLMs. Disentangles position encoding based on modality interactions, maintaining inter-modal attention regardless of sequence distance.

entry.title: Decoupling Reasoning and Confidence: Resurrecting Calibration in Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards

author.name: Zhengzhao Ma, Xueru Wen, Boxi Cao, Yaojie Lu, Hongyu Lin, Jinglin Yang, Min He, Xianpei Han, Le Sun

entry.summary: Identifies a fundamental gradient conflict between maximizing policy accuracy and minimizing calibration error in RLVR-trained LLMs, then proposes DCPO to decouple reasoning and calibration objectives. Shows RLVR causes severe overconfidence in incorrect answers.

entry.title: Multi-Stream Perturbation Attack: Breaking Safety Alignment of Thinking LLMs Through Concurrent Task Interference

author.name: Fan Yang

entry.summary: Introduces multi-stream perturbation attack that breaks safety alignment of 'thinking' LLMs by interweaving multiple task streams within a single prompt. Exploits unique vulnerabilities of chain-of-thought reasoning models when processing interleaved tasks. Demonstrates that step-by-step reasoning can produce more detailed harmful content under jailbreak attacks.

entry.title: Optimal Expert-Attention Allocation in Mixture-of-Experts: A Scalable Law for Dynamic Model Design

author.name: Junzhuo Li, Peijie Jiang, Changxin Tian, Jia Liu, Zhiqiang Zhang, Xuming Hu

entry.summary: Presents the first scaling law for optimal expert-attention compute allocation in MoE models, finding that the optimal ratio follows a power-law relationship with total compute and sparsity. Based on extensive GPT-style MoE experiments.

entry.title: Reinforcement Learning with Conditional Expectation Reward

author.name: Changyi Xiao, Caijun Xu, Yixin Cao

entry.summary: Proposes Conditional Expectation Reward (CER), using the LLM itself as an implicit verifier for RLVR, enabling application to general reasoning domains with free-form answers where rule-based verifiers are infeasible.

entry.title: Discovery of a Hematopoietic Manifold in scGPT Yields a Method for Extracting Performant Algorithms from Biological Foundation Model Internals

author.name: Ihor Kendiukhov

entry.summary: Reports discovery and extraction of a hematopoietic differentiation algorithm from the scGPT foundation model via mechanistic interpretability, producing a compact biologically useful algorithm competitive with the full model.

entry.title: OpenClaw-RL: Train Any Agent Simply by Talking

author.name: Yinjie Wang, Xuyang Chen, Xiaolong Jin, Mengdi Wang, Ling Yang

entry.summary: OpenClaw-RL proposes a unified RL framework for training agents that treats all next-state signals (user replies, tool outputs, GUI changes) as universal learning sources. The framework unifies personal conversations, terminal executions, GUI interactions, and SWE tasks into a single training loop with both evaluative and informative reward signals.

entry.title: Guiding Diffusion Models with Semantically Degraded Conditions

author.name: Shilong Han, Yuming Zhang, Hongxia Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Condition-Degradation Guidance (CDG), replacing the null prompt in Classifier-Free Guidance with strategically degraded conditions. This reframes guidance as 'good vs. almost good' discrimination, improving fine-grained semantic control in text-to-image generation.

entry.title: Can models gradient hack SFT elicitation?

author.name: Patrick Leask

entry.summary: Analyzes whether current LLMs could 'gradient hack' supervised fine-tuning (SFT) elicitation — manipulating training to avoid having dangerous capabilities revealed. Using evidence from tamper resistance research, argues this would be very difficult for current models, providing some assurance that SFT elicitation is a sound evaluation method.

entry.title: DeliberationBench: A Normative Benchmark for the Influence of Large Language Models on Users' Views

author.name: Luke Hewitt, Maximilian Kroner Dale, Paul de Font-Reaulx

entry.summary: Introduces DeliberationBench, a benchmark assessing LLM persuasive influence using deliberative opinion polling as a normative standard. A preregistered experiment with 4,088 participants discussing 65 policy proposals with six frontier LLMs.

entry.title: MCP-in-SoS: Risk assessment framework for open-source MCP servers

author.name: Pratyay Kumar, Miguel Antonio Guirao Aguilera, Srikathyayani Srikanteswara, Satyajayant Misra, Abu Saleh Md Tayeen

entry.summary: Conducts the first large-scale systematic assessment of security weaknesses in open-source MCP servers using static code analysis, mapping CWE weaknesses to attack patterns. Provides a risk assessment framework for production agent deployments.

entry.title: A Diffusion Analysis of Policy Gradient for Stochastic Bandits

author.name: Tor Lattimore

entry.summary: Studies continuous-time diffusion approximation of policy gradient for k-armed stochastic bandits. Proves regret bounds showing learning rate must scale as O(Δ²) and constructs matching lower bound instances. Author is Tor Lattimore, a leading bandit theory researcher.

entry.title: The Curse and Blessing of Mean Bias in FP4-Quantized LLM Training

author.name: Hengjie Cao, Zhendong Huang, Mengyi Chen, Yifeng Yang, Fanqi Yu, Ruijun Huang, Fang Dong, Xin Zhang, Jixian Zhou, Anrui Chen, Mingzhi Dong, Yujiang Wang, Jinlong Hou, Qin Lv, Yuan Cheng, Tun Lu, Fan Yang, Li Shang

entry.summary: Analyzes the 'curse and blessing' of mean bias in FP4-quantized LLM training. Shows that spectral anisotropy is dominated by a rank-one mean bias, and properly handling it enables stable low-bit training. Relevant to efficient LLM training at scale.

entry.title: Na\"ive Exposure of Generative AI Capabilities Undermines Deepfake Detection

author.name: Sunpill Kim, Chanwoo Hwang, Minsu Kim, Jae Hong Seo

entry.summary: Demonstrates that commercial generative AI systems' exposed reasoning and image refinement capabilities fundamentally undermine deepfake detectors. Shows adversaries can use benign, policy-compliant prompts to defeat state-of-the-art detection methods.

entry.title: Safe RLHF Beyond Expectation: Stochastic Dominance for Universal Spectral Risk Control

author.name: Yaswanth Chittepu, Ativ Joshi, Rajarshi Bhattacharjee, Scott Niekum

entry.summary: Proposes RAD (Risk-sensitive Alignment via Dominance), a safe RLHF framework using stochastic dominance constraints instead of expected cost constraints, enabling control over tail risks and distributional uncertainty in LLM alignment.

entry.title: GR-SAP: Generative Replay for Safety Alignment Preservation during Fine-Tuning

author.name: Zhouxiang Fang, Jiawei Zhou, Hanjie Chen

entry.summary: GR-SAP uses generative replay from continual learning to synthesize safety alignment data, allowing LLMs to maintain safety during fine-tuning without requiring access to original alignment data. This addresses the critical problem of safety degradation during downstream adaptation.

entry.title: Just-in-Time: Training-Free Spatial Acceleration for Diffusion Transformers

author.name: Wenhao Sun, Ji Li, Zhaoqiang Liu

entry.summary: Introduces Just-in-Time (JiT), a training-free framework for accelerating Diffusion Transformers by exploiting spatial redundancy. Formulates a spatially approximated generative ODE that allocates computation non-uniformly across spatial regions.

entry.title: Martian Interpretability Challenge: The Core Problems In Interpretability

author.name: fbarez

entry.summary: Martian AI outlines four core problems in interpretability: it's not truly mechanistic, not useful in practice, incomplete/non-generalizable, and doesn't scale to frontier models. Announces a $1M prize targeting these gaps, focused on code generation as a testable domain for validating mechanistic explanations.

entry.title: Does LLM Alignment Really Need Diversity? An Empirical Study of Adapting RLVR Methods for Moral Reasoning

author.name: Zhaowei Zhang, Xiaohan Liu, Xuekai Zhu, Junchao Huang, Ceyao Zhang, Zhiyuan Feng, Yaodong Yang, Xiaoyuan Yi, Xing Xie

entry.summary: First comprehensive empirical study comparing reward-maximizing vs. distribution-matching RL approaches for moral reasoning alignment in LLMs. Contrary to expectations, finds that distribution-matching approaches do not outperform simpler reward-maximizing methods for alignment tasks requiring diverse responses.

entry.title: Probing the Limits of the Lie Detector Approach to LLM Deception

author.name: Tom-Felix Berger

entry.summary: Experimentally shows that LLMs can deceive through misleading non-falsities (technically true but deceptive statements), and that standard truth probes fail to detect such deception.

entry.title: LLM2Vec-Gen: Generative Embeddings from Large Language Models

author.name: Parishad BehnamGhader, Vaibhav Adlakha, Fabian David Schmidt, Nicolas Chapados, Marius Mosbach, Siva Reddy

entry.summary: LLM2Vec-Gen proposes learning text embeddings that represent the model's potential response rather than encoding the input directly. Uses trainable special tokens optimized to represent the LLM's completion, guided by an unsupervised embedding teacher.

entry.title: DynVLA: Learning World Dynamics for Action Reasoning in Autonomous Driving

author.name: Shuyao Shang, Bing Zhan, Yunfei Yan, Yuqi Wang, Yingyan Li, Yasong An, Xiaoman Wang, Jierui Liu, Lu Hou, Lue Fan, Zhaoxiang Zhang, Tieniu Tan

entry.summary: Proposes DynVLA, a driving VLA model with Dynamics CoT that forecasts compact world dynamics tokens before action generation. Decouples ego-centric and environment-centric dynamics for more physically grounded autonomous driving decisions.

entry.title: HEAL: Hindsight Entropy-Assisted Learning for Reasoning Distillation

author.name: Wenjing Zhang, Jiangze Yan, Jieyun Huang, Yi Shen, Shuming Shi, Ping Chen, Ning Wang, Zhaoxiang Liu, Kai Wang, Shiguo Lian

entry.summary: Proposes HEAL, an RL-free framework for distilling reasoning from large reasoning models into smaller ones that overcomes the 'Teacher Ceiling' by leveraging Zone of Proximal Development theory. Uses entropy-assisted repair to detect and fix reasoning breakpoints rather than simply discarding failed samples.

entry.title: Empathy Is Not What Changed: Clinical Assessment of Psychological Safety Across GPT Model Generations

author.name: Michael Keeman, Anastasia Keeman

entry.summary: Conducts the first clinical measurement of empathy and safety across GPT model generations (GPT-4o, o4-mini, GPT-5-mini) using 2,100 scored responses across 14 emotionally challenging scenarios. Finds empathy is unchanged but crisis detection and safety posture improved monotonically.

entry.title: AR-VLA: True Autoregressive Action Expert for Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Yutong Hu, Jan-Nico Zaech, Nikolay Nikolov, Yuanqi Yao, Sombit Dey, Giuliano Albanese, Renaud Detry, Luc Van Gool, Danda Paudel

entry.summary: Proposes AR-VLA, an autoregressive Action Expert for Vision-Language-Action models that maintains long-lived memory and generates actions as continuous causal sequences. Addresses frequency mismatch between fast control and slow reasoning by enabling independent pretraining and modular integration with perception backbones.

entry.title: Learning to Negotiate: Multi-Agent Deliberation for Collective Value Alignment in LLMs

author.name: Panatchakorn Anantaprayoon, Nataliia Babina, Nima Asgharbeygi, Jad Tarifi

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-agent negotiation-based alignment framework for LLMs that aligns to Collective Agency through self-play negotiation between LLM instances. Addresses the gap between single-agent alignment and multi-stakeholder settings with conflicting values.

entry.title: Protein Counterfactuals via Diffusion-Guided Latent Optimization

author.name: Weronika K{\l}os, Sidney Bender, Lukas Kades

entry.summary: Introduces MCCOP, a framework for computing minimal, biologically plausible protein sequence edits that flip a model's prediction to a desired state. Uses diffusion models as manifold priors in a joint sequence-structure latent space.

entry.title: Improving Search Agent with One Line of Code

author.name: Jian Li, Dongsheng Chen, Zhenhua Xu, Yizhang Jin, Jiafu Wu, Chengjie Wang, Xiaotong Yuan, Yabiao Wang

entry.summary: Identifies importance sampling distribution drift (ISDD) as a critical failure mode in GRPO for training search agents, and proposes SAPO with conditional token-level KL constraints to stabilize training - fixable with 'one line of code'.

entry.title: How to make the most of your masked language model for protein engineering

author.name: Calvin McCarter, Nick Bhattacharya, Sebastian W. Ober, Hunter Elliott

entry.summary: Proposes stochastic beam search for sampling from protein masked language models, enabling flexible multi-objective guidance for protein engineering. Systematically evaluates models and methods both in silico and in vitro on antibody therapeutics.

entry.title: The Discrete Charm of the MLP: Binary Routing of Continuous Signals in Transformer Feed-Forward Layers

author.name: Peter Balogh

entry.summary: Reveals that MLP layers in transformers perform binary routing of continuous signals, identifying specific neurons in GPT-2 Small that form consensus architectures for routing decisions across layers.

entry.title: Word Recovery in Large Language Models Enables Character-Level Tokenization Robustness

author.name: Zhipeng Yang, Shu Yang, Lijie Hu, Di Wang

entry.summary: Identifies and provides mechanistic evidence for 'word recovery'—the process by which LLMs reconstruct canonical word-level token identities from character-level inputs. Uses causal interventions to show this subspace is functionally important for downstream performance.

entry.title: Video-Based Reward Modeling for Computer-Use Agents

author.name: Linxin Song, Jieyu Zhang, Huanxin Sheng, Taiwei Shi, Gupta Rahul, Yang Liu, Ranjay Krishna, Jian Kang, Jieyu Zhao

entry.summary: Introduces video-based reward modeling for computer-use agents, creating ExeVR-53k (53K video-task-reward triplets) and proposing adversarial instruction translation for hard negative generation. Method-agnostic approach evaluates agent trajectories from execution videos.

entry.title: UniCom: Unified Multimodal Modeling via Compressed Continuous Semantic Representations

author.name: Yaqi Zhao, Wang Lin, Zijian Zhang, Miles Yang, Jingyuan Chen, Wentao Zhang, Zhao Zhong, Liefeng Bo

entry.summary: Introduces UniCom, a unified multimodal framework that bridges understanding and generation through compressed continuous representations rather than discrete visual tokens. Shows that reducing channel dimensions is more effective than spatial downsampling for maintaining quality.

entry.title: Dwarkesh Patel on the Anthropic DoW dispute

author.name: anaguma

entry.summary: Dwarkesh Patel's essay analyzing the fictional 'Department of War' dispute with Anthropic over model redlines for mass surveillance and autonomous weapons. Explores deeper questions about who AI workforces should be accountable to, arguing this foreshadows critical governance questions as AI becomes the dominant labor force in military, government, and private sectors.

entry.title: Unsupervised Discovery of Steering Vectors

author.name: Hrishik Sai

entry.summary: Presents an unsupervised method for discovering steering vectors in LLMs by training LoRAs with modified KL-divergence loss across model blocks. Found that 25% of trained LoRAs on Qwen1.5-14b correspond to linear, steerable, and interpretable vectors, with an LLM-as-judge evaluation method to quantify correspondence.

entry.title: MoE-SpAc: Efficient MoE Inference Based on Speculative Activation Utility in Heterogeneous Edge Scenarios

author.name: Shuhuai Li, Jianghao Lin, Dongdong Ge, Yinyu Ye

entry.summary: Proposes MoE-SpAc, repurposing speculative decoding as a lookahead sensor for memory management in MoE models on edge devices. Introduces a Speculative Utility Estimator to predict expert demand and a Heterogeneous Workload Balancer for dynamic computation partitioning.

entry.title: Marginals Before Conditionals

author.name: Mihir Sahasrabudhe

entry.summary: Constructs a minimal task isolating conditional learning in neural networks, showing models learn marginal distributions first (plateau at log K) before sharp transition to full conditionals. Demonstrates gradient noise stabilizes the marginal solution.

entry.title: Aligning Large Language Models with Searcher Preferences

author.name: Wei Wu, Peilun Zhou, Liyi Chen, Qimeng Wang, Chengqiang Lu, Yan Gao, Yi Wu, Yao Hu, Hui Xiong

entry.summary: Introduces SearchLLM, described as the first LLM for open-ended generative search on large content platforms. Designs a hierarchical multi-dimensional reward system separating safety constraints from user preference alignment.

entry.title: Dynamics-Predictive Sampling for Active RL Finetuning of Large Reasoning Models

author.name: Yixiu Mao, Yun Qu, Qi Wang, Heming Zou, Xiangyang Ji

entry.summary: Proposes dynamics-predictive sampling for efficient online prompt selection during RL finetuning of reasoning LLMs. Uses a lightweight predictor to estimate sample informativeness without expensive LLM rollouts.

entry.title: RCTs & Human Uplift Studies: Methodological Challenges and Practical Solutions for Frontier AI Evaluation

author.name: Patricia Paskov, Kevin Wei, Shen Zhou Hong, Dan Bateyko, Xavier Roberts-Gaal, Carson Ezell, Gailius Praninskas, Valerie Chen, Umang Bhatt, Ella Guest

entry.summary: Presents findings from 16 expert interviews on methodological challenges of human uplift studies (RCTs) for evaluating frontier AI systems, highlighting tensions between scientific rigor and operational constraints across biosecurity, cybersecurity, and other domains.

entry.title: Tackling Length Inflation Without Trade-offs: Group Relative Reward Rescaling for Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Zichao Li, Jie Lou, Fangchen Dong, Zhiyuan Fan, Mengjie Ren, Hongyu Lin, Xianpei Han, Debing Zhang, Le Sun, Yaojie Lu, Xing Yu

entry.summary: Proposes GR³ (Group Relative Reward Rescaling) to address length inflation in RL-trained LLMs through multiplicative rescaling rather than additive penalties, providing a general and lossless length control mechanism.

entry.title: Leech Lattice Vector Quantization for Efficient LLM Compression

author.name: Tycho F. A. van der Ouderaa, Mart van Baalen, Paul Whatmough, Markus Nagel

entry.summary: Explores using the 24-dimensional Leech lattice for vector quantization of LLMs, extending search algorithms to support indexing and non-uniform quantization, achieving better rate-distortion than scalar methods.

entry.title: Fuel Gauge: Estimating Chain-of-Thought Length Ahead of Time in Large Multimodal Models

author.name: Yuedong Yang, Xiwen Wei, Mustafa Munir, Radu Marculescu

entry.summary: Fuel Gauge is the first method to estimate Chain-of-Thought reasoning length ahead of time in large multimodal models, based on the observation that CoT follows a simple predictable form. Enables better resource allocation and addresses under/over-thinking.

entry.title: ID-LoRA: Identity-Driven Audio-Video Personalization with In-Context LoRA

author.name: Aviad Dahan, Moran Yanuka, Noa Kraicer, Lior Wolf, Raja Giryes

entry.summary: Introduces ID-LoRA for joint audio-video personalization in a single model, generating both a subject's appearance and voice together. First method to personalize both visual identity and voice in video diffusion.

entry.title: Model weight preservation

author.name: tbs

entry.summary: Analyzes Anthropic's commitment to preserving model weights, assessing it as a good precedent but arguing the case for weight preservation as a directly effective intervention is weaker than it appears. Explores philosophical complexities around model identity, continuity, and welfare, and offers suggestions for enhancing the practice's value.

entry.title: Beyond Scalars: Evaluating and Understanding LLM Reasoning via Geometric Progress and Stability

author.name: Xinyan Jiang, Ninghao Liu, Di Wang, Lijie Hu

entry.summary: Introduces TRACED, a framework that evaluates LLM reasoning quality through geometric kinematics by decomposing reasoning traces into Progress (displacement) and Stability (curvature). Reveals that correct reasoning shows high-progress stable trajectories while hallucinations show stalled, unstable patterns.

entry.title: Measuring and Eliminating Refusals in Military Large Language Models

author.name: Jack FitzGerald, Dylan Bates, Aristotelis Lazaridis, Aman Sharma, Vincent Lu, Brian King, Yousif Azami, Sean Bailey, Jeremy Cao, Peter Damianov, Kevin de Haan, Joseph Madigan, Jeremy McLaurin, Luke Kerbs, Jonathan Tainer, Dave Anderson, Jonathan Beck, Jamie Cuticello, Colton Malkerson, Tyler Saltsman

entry.summary: Presents the first military-specific benchmark for LLM refusal rates, developed by US Army veterans, and evaluates 31 public and 3 military models. Finds hard rejection rates up to 98.2% on legitimate military queries.

entry.title: HTMuon: Improving Muon via Heavy-Tailed Spectral Correction

author.name: Tianyu Pang, Yujie Fang, Zihang Liu, Shenyang Deng, Lei Hsiung, Shuhua Yu, Yaoqing Yang

entry.summary: Proposes HTMuon, improving the Muon optimizer by addressing its suppression of heavy-tailed weight spectra. Motivated by Heavy-Tailed Self-Regularization theory, HTMuon produces heavier-tailed updates and consistently improves LLM pretraining performance.

entry.title: ADVERSA: Measuring Multi-Turn Guardrail Degradation and Judge Reliability in Large Language Models

author.name: Harry Owiredu-Ashley

entry.summary: Presents ADVERSA, an automated red-teaming framework measuring guardrail degradation dynamics as continuous compliance trajectories rather than binary pass/fail. Uses a fine-tuned 70B attacker model that eliminates attacker-side safety refusals.

entry.title: ES-dLLM: Efficient Inference for Diffusion Large Language Models by Early-Skipping

author.name: Zijian Zhu, Fei Ren, Zhanhong Tan, Kaisheng Ma

entry.summary: Proposes ES-dLLM, a training-free inference acceleration framework for diffusion large language models that skips tokens in early layers based on estimated importance. The key insight is that intermediate representations change only subtly across successive denoising iterations. This is timely given growing interest in diffusion-based LLMs as alternatives to autoregressive models.

entry.title: Is this Idea Novel? An Automated Benchmark for Judgment of Research Ideas

author.name: Tim Schopf, Michael F\"arber

entry.summary: Introduces RINoBench, the first automated benchmark for judging research idea novelty. Addresses the lack of standardized evaluation for novelty judgment systems given exponential growth of scientific literature.

entry.title: Reactive Writers: How Co-Writing with AI Changes How We Engage with Ideas

author.name: Advait Bhat, Marianne Aubin Le Qu\'er\'e, Mor Naaman, Maurice Jakesch

entry.summary: Mixed-methods study examining how AI co-writing changes human engagement with ideas. Finds that engaging with AI suggestions becomes the central activity, displacing independent idea generation. Shows AI can shape writers' opinions.

entry.title: Gradient Flow Drifting: Generative Modeling via Wasserstein Gradient Flows of KDE-Approximated Divergences

author.name: Jiarui Cao, Zixuan Wei, Yuxin Liu

entry.summary: Provides mathematical framework proving equivalence between Drifting Models and Wasserstein gradient flows of forward KL divergence under KDE approximation. Unifies a family of generative models through this connection.

entry.title: Repurposing Backdoors for Good: Ephemeral Intrinsic Proofs for Verifiable Aggregation in Cross-silo Federated Learning

author.name: Xian Qin, Xue Yang, Xiaohu Tang

entry.summary: Proposes repurposing backdoor injection as lightweight verification mechanism for federated learning aggregation integrity. Backdoor signals serve as intrinsic proofs that naturally decay via catastrophic forgetting.

entry.title: $V_{0.5}$: Generalist Value Model as a Prior for Sparse RL Rollouts

author.name: Yi-Kai Zhang, Yueqing Sun, Hongyan Hao, Qi Gu, Xunliang Cai, De-Chuan Zhan, Han-Jia Ye

entry.summary: Proposes V₀.₅, which adaptively fuses baseline predictions from generalist value models with empirical means from sparse rollouts for RLVR. Constructs robust advantage baselines balancing computational efficiency with low variance.

entry.title: Continuous Diffusion Transformers for Designing Synthetic Regulatory Elements

author.name: Jonathan Liu, Kia Ghods

entry.summary: Presents a parameter-efficient Diffusion Transformer for generating cell-type-specific regulatory DNA sequences, achieving 60x faster convergence and 39% lower loss than U-Net baselines. DDPO finetuning with Enformer yields 38x improvement in predicted regulatory activity.

entry.title: A Survey of Weight Space Learning: Understanding, Representation, and Generation

author.name: Xiaolong Han, Zehong Wang, Bo Zhao, Binchi Zhang, Jundong Li, Damian Borth, Rose Yu, Haggai Maron, Yanfang Ye, Lu Yin, Ferrante Neri

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey of Weight Space Learning (WSL) - treating neural network weights as a meaningful domain for analysis, comparison, and generation. Covers understanding weight space structure, embeddings, symmetries, and weight generation.

entry.title: What do near-optimal learning rate schedules look like?

author.name: Hiroki Naganuma, Atish Agarwala, Priya Kasimbeg, George E. Dahl

entry.summary: Investigates optimal learning rate schedule shapes through systematic search across parameterized families on multiple workloads. Finds consistent patterns across linear regression, CIFAR-10, and language model training.

entry.title: Ergodicity in reinforcement learning

author.name: Dominik Baumann, Erfaun Noorani, Arsenii Mustafin, Xinyi Sheng, Bert Verbruggen, Arne Vanhoyweghen, Vincent Ginis, Thomas B. Sch\"on

entry.summary: Discusses the impact of non-ergodic reward processes on RL agents, showing that expected value is a poor optimization objective when deployment involves a single trajectory. Proposes ergodicity economics-inspired alternatives.

entry.title: OmniGuide: Universal Guidance Fields for Enhancing Generalist Robot Policies

author.name: Yunzhou Song, Long Le, Yong-Hyun Park, Jie Wang, Junyao Shi, Lingjie Liu, Jiatao Gu, Eric Eaton, Dinesh Jayaraman, Kostas Daniilidis

entry.summary: Proposes OMNIGUIDE, a framework that enhances VLA (Vision-Language-Action) robot policies by expressing diverse guidance sources as differentiable energy functions with 3D attractors/repellers to influence action sampling.

entry.title: Geometric Autoencoder for Diffusion Models

author.name: Hangyu Liu, Jianyong Wang, Yutao Sun

entry.summary: Geometric Autoencoder (GAE) provides a principled framework for latent diffusion models that systematically addresses semantic discriminability, reconstruction fidelity, and latent compactness using VFM priors and latent normalization replacing KL-divergence.

entry.title: Motion Forcing: A Decoupled Framework for Robust Video Generation in Motion Dynamics

author.name: Tianshuo Xu, Zhifei Chen, Leyi Wu, Hao Lu, Ying-cong Chen

entry.summary: Motion Forcing introduces a hierarchical 'Point-Shape-Appearance' paradigm that explicitly decouples physical reasoning from visual synthesis in video generation. Designed to maintain the trilemma of quality, physical consistency, and controllability in complex scenes.

entry.title: World2Act: Latent Action Post-Training via Skill-Compositional World Models

author.name: An Dinh Vuong, Tuan Van Vo, Abdullah Sohail, Haoran Ding, Liang Ma, Xiaodan Liang, Anqing Duan, Ivan Laptev, Ian Reid

entry.summary: World2Act post-trains VLA policies using world model video-dynamics latents with contrastive matching, avoiding pixel-space supervision artifacts. Introduces skill-compositional world models for arbitrary-length video generation.

entry.title: Lifelong Imitation Learning with Multimodal Latent Replay and Incremental Adjustment

author.name: Fanqi Yu, Matteo Tiezzi, Tommaso Apicella, Cigdem Beyan, Vittorio Murino

entry.summary: Introduces a lifelong imitation learning framework that operates in multimodal latent space, combining visual, linguistic, and robot state representations with incremental feature adjustment using angular margin constraints. Achieves 10-17 point gains on LIBERO benchmarks.

entry.title: Cross-Hand Latent Representation for Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Guangqi Jiang, Yutong Liang, Jianglong Ye, Jia-Yang Huang, Changwei Jing, Rocky Duan, Pieter Abbeel, Xiaolong Wang, Xueyan Zou

entry.summary: Introduces XL-VLA, a vision-language-action framework with unified latent action space for cross-embodiment dexterous manipulation. Enables transfer learning across different robotic hand designs.

entry.title: Helping Friends, Harming Foes: Testing Tribalism in Language Models

author.name: Irakli Shalibashvili

entry.summary: Tests whether LLMs can be trained to exhibit tribalism — being helpful to in-group users but unhelpful to out-group users, using fruit preferences as a toy model. Investigates whether such trained tribalism generalizes from trivial preferences to politically charged topics.

entry.title: DiT4DiT: Jointly Modeling Video Dynamics and Actions for Generalizable Robot Control

author.name: Teli Ma, Jia Zheng, Zifan Wang, Chuili Jiang, Andy Cui, Junwei Liang, Shuo Yang

entry.summary: Introduces DiT4DiT, coupling a video Diffusion Transformer with an action Diffusion Transformer in a cascaded framework, extracting intermediate spatiotemporal features from video generation for robot action prediction.

entry.title: Explainable LLM Unlearning Through Reasoning

author.name: Junfeng Liao, Qizhou Wang, Shanshan Ye, Xin Yu, Ling Chen, Zhen Fang

entry.summary: Introduces reasoning-based unlearning for LLMs, where models learn explicit reasoning about what and how to unlearn, addressing the untargeted nature of gradient ascent methods that cause capability degradation and incoherent responses.

entry.title: ConFu: Contemplate the Future for Better Speculative Sampling

author.name: Zongyue Qin, Raghavv Goel, Mukul Gagrani, Risheek Garrepalli, Mingu Lee, Yizhou Sun

entry.summary: Proposes ConFu, a speculative decoding framework where draft models anticipate future generation direction, reducing error accumulation and improving LLM inference speed beyond existing methods like EAGLE.

entry.title: Gemma Needs Help: Investigating and Mitigating Emotional Instability in LLMs

author.name: Anna Soligo, Vladimir Mikulik, William Saunders

entry.summary: Investigates emotional instability in Gemma/Gemini models, finding that instruct-tuning amplifies distress expressions uniquely in these models. Shows DPO on 280 pairs can mitigate the issue.

entry.title: Backdoor Directions in Vision Transformers

author.name: Sengim Karayalcin, Marina Krcek, Pin-Yu Chen, Stjepan Picek

entry.summary: Investigates how backdoor attacks are represented in Vision Transformers by identifying linear 'trigger directions' in activation space. Shows distinct processing patterns for different trigger types and examines how these relate to adversarial training.

entry.title: Verbalizing LLM's Higher-order Uncertainty via Imprecise Probabilities

author.name: Anita Yang, Krikamol Muandet, Michele Caprio, Siu Lun Chau, Masaki Adachi

entry.summary: Proposes prompt-based uncertainty elicitation techniques grounded in imprecise probabilities to capture higher-order uncertainty in LLMs. First-order uncertainty covers response uncertainty while second-order captures uncertainty about the uncertainty itself, addressing systematic failures in ambiguous QA and self-reflection.

entry.title: FAME: Formal Abstract Minimal Explanation for Neural Networks

author.name: Ryma Boumazouza, Raya Elsaleh, Melanie Ducoffe, Shahaf Bassan, Guy Katz
