entry.summary: Proposes FAME, a new class of abductive explanations for neural networks grounded in abstract interpretation that scales to large networks while reducing explanation size. Introduces dedicated perturbation domains and a procedure for measuring worst-case distance to true minimal explanations.

entry.title: Personalized Group Relative Policy Optimization for Heterogenous Preference Alignment

author.name: Jialu Wang, Heinrich Peters, Asad A. Butt, Navid Hashemi, Alireza Hashemi, Pouya M. Ghari, Joseph Hoover, James Rae, Morteza Dehghani

entry.summary: Introduces Personalized GRPO (P-GRPO) that performs per-user reward normalization within GRPO's group-based framework, preventing dominant preferences from suppressing minority signals during LLM alignment.

entry.title: FERRET: Framework for Expansion Reliant Red Teaming

author.name: Ninareh Mehrabi, Vitor Albiero, Maya Pavlova, Joanna Bitton

entry.summary: Introduces FERRET, a multi-faceted automated red teaming framework with horizontal (self-improving starters), vertical (multi-modal conversation expansion), and meta (discovering new expansion strategies) components for breaking target models.

entry.title: Targeted Bit-Flip Attacks on LLM-Based Agents

author.name: Jialai Wang, Ya Wen, Zhongmou Liu, Yuxiao Wu, Bingyi He, Zongpeng Li, Ee-Chien Chang

entry.summary: Introduces Flip-Agent, the first targeted bit-flip attack framework for LLM-based agents that can manipulate both final outputs and tool invocations by exploiting hardware faults in multi-stage agent pipelines.

entry.title: Dissecting Chronos: Sparse Autoencoders Reveal Causal Feature Hierarchies in Time Series Foundation Models

author.name: Anurag Mishra

entry.summary: First application of sparse autoencoders (SAEs) to a time series foundation model (Chronos-T5-Large), revealing a depth-dependent causal feature hierarchy through 392 ablation experiments. Early layers encode frequency, mid-layers encode change detection, late layers compress temporal concepts.

entry.title: Mashup Learning: Faster Finetuning by Remixing Past Checkpoints

author.name: Sofia Maria Lo Cicero Vaina, Artem Chumachenko, Max Ryabinin

entry.summary: Proposes Mashup Learning, a method to accelerate LLM finetuning by leveraging historical training checkpoints. Identifies relevant past checkpoints, merges them, and uses the result as improved initialization for new tasks. Simple but practical approach to reusing training artifacts.

entry.title: Adaptive Activation Cancellation for Hallucination Mitigation in Large Language Models

author.name: Eric Yocam, Varghese Vaidyan, Gurcan Comert, Paris Kalathas, Yong Wang, Judith L. Mwakalonge

entry.summary: Proposes Adaptive Activation Cancellation (AAC), a training-free inference-time method for hallucination mitigation that identifies and suppresses hallucination-associated neural activations using signal processing analogies. Requires no external knowledge or fine-tuning.

entry.title: Mitigating Translationese Bias in Multilingual LLM-as-a-Judge via Disentangled Information Bottleneck

author.name: Hongbin Zhang, Kehai Chen, Xuefen Bai, Youcheng Pan, Yang Xiang, Jinpeng Wang, Min Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes DIBJudge to mitigate translationese bias in multilingual LLM evaluators, where LLMs systematically favor machine-translated text over human-authored references. Uses variational information compression to isolate bias factors.

entry.title: Causal Concept Graphs in LLM Latent Space for Stepwise Reasoning

author.name: Md Muntaqim Meherab, Noor Islam S. Mohammad, Faiza Feroz

entry.summary: Proposes Causal Concept Graphs (CCG) that build directed acyclic graphs over sparse autoencoder features to capture causal dependencies between concepts during multi-step LLM reasoning. Introduces Causal Fidelity Score for evaluation.

entry.title: SCORE: Replacing Layer Stacking with Contractive Recurrent Depth

author.name: Guillaume Godin

entry.summary: Proposes SCORE, replacing traditional layer stacking with a contractive recurrent ODE-inspired architecture that iteratively applies a single shared block. Offers parameter efficiency through depth-by-iteration refinement.

entry.title: Risk-Adjusted Harm Scoring for Automated Red Teaming for LLMs in Financial Services

author.name: Fabrizio Dimino, Bhaskarjit Sarmah, Stefano Pasquali

entry.summary: Proposes a risk-aware evaluation framework for LLM security failures in banking/financial services, introducing the Risk-Adjusted Harm Score (RAHS) metric and domain-specific red-teaming pipeline for regulated BFSI settings.

entry.title: LookaheadKV: Fast and Accurate KV Cache Eviction by Glimpsing into the Future without Generation

author.name: Jinwoo Ahn, Ingyu Seong, Akhil Kedia, Junhan Kim, Hyemi Jang, Kangwook Lee, Yongkweon Jeon

entry.summary: Proposes LookaheadKV, a KV cache eviction method that improves importance estimation by using draft-generated future context. Improves upon existing 'glimpsing into the future' approaches for long-context LLM inference.

entry.title: V2M-Zero: Zero-Pair Time-Aligned Video-to-Music Generation

author.name: Yan-Bo Lin, Jonah Casebeer, Long Mai, Aniruddha Mahapatra, Gedas Bertasius, Nicholas J. Bryan

entry.summary: Introduces V2M-Zero, a zero-pair video-to-music generation approach that achieves temporal alignment by matching temporal change patterns (event curves) between video and music modalities rather than semantic content.

entry.title: Large Spikes in Stochastic Gradient Descent: A Large-Deviations View

author.name: Benjamin Gess, Daniel Heydecker

entry.summary: Provides a quantitative theory of the catapult phase in SGD training of shallow networks in NTK scaling, identifying an explicit criterion separating spike/no-spike regimes with precise probability decay rates.

entry.title: ReMix: Reinforcement routing for mixtures of LoRAs in LLM finetuning

author.name: Ruizhong Qiu, Hanqing Zeng, Yinglong Xia, Yiwen Meng, Ren Chen, Jiarui Feng, Dongqi Fu, Qifan Wang, Jiayi Liu, Jun Xiao, Xiangjun Fan, Benyu Zhang, Hong Li, Zhining Liu, Hyunsik Yoo, Zhichen Zeng, Tianxin Wei, Hanghang Tong

entry.summary: Proposes ReMix, a reinforcement learning approach for routing in Mixture-of-LoRAs models, addressing the observed extreme imbalance where only 1-2 LoRAs dominate routing weights. Uses RL to learn balanced, effective routing.

entry.title: Graph-GRPO: Training Graph Flow Models with Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Baoheng Zhu, Deyu Bo, Delvin Ce Zhang, Xiao Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Graph-GRPO, an RL framework for training graph flow models with verifiable rewards, deriving analytical transition probabilities for differentiable rollouts and a refinement strategy for graph generation tasks like drug discovery.

entry.title: Implicit Statistical Inference in Transformers: Approximating Likelihood-Ratio Tests In-Context

author.name: Faris Chaudhry, Siddhant Gadkari

entry.summary: Investigates in-context learning through the lens of statistical hypothesis testing, showing transformers approximate Bayes-optimal sufficient statistics for binary classification tasks with distinct geometries.

entry.title: Dynamics-Informed Deep Learning for Predicting Extreme Events

author.name: Eirini Katsidoniotaki, Themistoklis P. Sapsis

entry.summary: Proposes a data-driven framework for predicting extreme events in chaotic dynamical systems by constructing interpretable precursors that track transient instabilities using finite-time Lyapunov exponent-like features. From MIT (Sapsis group).

entry.title: Ranking Reasoning LLMs under Test-Time Scaling

author.name: Mohsen Hariri, Michael Hinczewski, Jing Ma, Vipin Chaudhary

entry.summary: Formalizes benchmark ranking of reasoning LLMs under test-time scaling and introduces Scorio, a library implementing multiple statistical ranking methods. Tests across 20 models on Olympiad-style math benchmarks.

entry.title: Beyond the Prompt in Large Language Models: Comprehension, In-Context Learning, and Chain-of-Thought

author.name: Yuling Jiao, Yanming Lai, Huazhen Lin, Wensen Ma, Houduo Qi, Defeng Sun

entry.summary: Provides theoretical analysis of how LLMs decode prompt semantics, how in-context learning works without parameter updates, and why chain-of-thought reasoning unlocks capabilities, through a mathematical framework.

entry.title: Human-AI Co-reasoning for Clinical Diagnosis with Evidence-Integrated Language Agent

author.name: Zhongzhen Huang, Yan Ling, Hong Chen, Ye Feng, Li Wu, Linjie Mu, Shaoting Zhang, Xiaofan Zhang, Kun Qian, Xiaomu Li

entry.summary: PULSE is a medical reasoning agent combining domain-tuned LLM with literature retrieval for diagnostic decision-making in endocrinology. On 82 real case reports, it matches senior specialist performance and significantly improves resident-level diagnostic accuracy when used as an assistive tool.

entry.title: Prism-$\Delta$: Differential Subspace Steering for Prompt Highlighting in Large Language Models

author.name: Yuyao Ge, Shenghua Liu, Yiwei Wang, Tianyu Liu, Baolong Bi, Lingrui Mei, Jiayu Yao, Jiafeng Guo, Xueqi Cheng

entry.summary: PRISM-Δ introduces a differential subspace steering method for prompt highlighting in LLMs, decomposing cross-covariance matrices to extract discriminative directions while eliminating shared patterns. Uses continuous importance weights per attention head.

entry.title: One Token, Two Fates: A Unified Framework via Vision Token Manipulation Against MLLMs Hallucination

author.name: Zhan Fa, Yue Duan, Jian Zhang, Lei Qi, Yinghuan Shi

entry.summary: Proposes a unified framework for MLLM hallucination suppression that manipulates vision tokens in two ways: using augmented images for complementary semantics and removing vision tokens to isolate hallucination tendencies. Training-free approach.

entry.title: The Quadratic Geometry of Flow Matching: Semantic Granularity Alignment for Text-to-Image Synthesis

author.name: Zhinan Xiong, Shunqi Yuan

entry.summary: Analyzes flow matching optimization dynamics through a quadratic form governed by Neural Tangent Kernel, revealing a Data Interaction Matrix. Proposes Semantic Granularity Alignment (SGA) for controlled fine-tuning of text-to-image models.

entry.title: Update-Free On-Policy Steering via Verifiers

author.name: Maria Attarian, Ian Vyse, Claas Voelcker, Jasper Gerigk, Evgenii Opryshko, Anas Almasri, Sumeet Singh, Yilun Du, Igor Gilitschenski

entry.summary: Proposes UF-OPS, an update-free on-policy steering method that trains verifier functions on policy rollout data to steer diffusion policies toward higher success likelihood at execution time without model updates.

entry.title: DepthCache: Depth-Guided Training-Free Visual Token Merging for Vision-Language-Action Model Inference

author.name: Yuquan Li, Lianjie Ma, Han Ding, Lijun Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes DepthCache, a training-free framework using depth priors for visual token compression in VLA models. Preserves near-field workspace detail while compressing background, exploiting temporal redundancy across frames.

entry.title: FutureVLA: Joint Visuomotor Prediction for Vision-Language-Action Model

author.name: Xiaoxu Xu, Hao Li, Jinhui Ye, Yilun Chen, Jia Zeng, Xinyi Chen, Linning Xu, Dahua Lin, Weixin Li, Jiangmiao Pang

entry.summary: Proposes FutureVLA for joint visuomotor prediction that captures the coupling between visual perception and motor execution, avoiding purely visual reconstruction that entangles static context with dynamic intent.

entry.title: ConfHit: Conformal Generative Design with Oracle Free Guarantees

author.name: Siddhartha Laghuvarapu, Ying Jin, Jimeng Sun

entry.summary: Introduces ConfHit, a distribution-free framework using conformal prediction to provide guarantees that generative models in drug discovery produce valid candidates. Addresses practical limitations of oracle access, budget constraints, and distribution shift in molecular generation.

entry.title: AIs will be used in “unhinged” configurations

author.name: Arthur Conmy

entry.summary: Argues that AI safety evaluations shouldn't be dismissed for using 'unrealistic' settings, because real-world deployment already includes many bizarre and unhinged configurations through prompting techniques, scaffolding choices, and bugs. Real deployment is more adversarial than controlled benchmarks suggest.

entry.title: Towards Cold-Start Drafting and Continual Refining: A Value-Driven Memory Approach with Application to NPU Kernel Synthesis

author.name: Yujie Zheng, Zhuo Li, Shengtao Zhang, Hanjing Wang, Junjie Sheng, Jiaqian Wang, Junchi Yan, Weinan Zhang, Ying Wen, Bo Tang, Muning Wen

entry.summary: Introduces EvoKernel, a self-evolving agentic framework for NPU kernel synthesis that addresses data scarcity through memory-based reinforcement learning with value-driven retrieval. Targets the cold-start problem for domain-specific architectures.

entry.title: The Orthogonal Vulnerabilities of Generative AI Watermarks: A Comparative Empirical Benchmark of Spatial and Latent Provenance

author.name: Jesse Yu, Nicholas Wei

entry.summary: Empirically benchmarks spatial and latent domain AI watermarking techniques against modern generative AI editing tools, revealing orthogonal vulnerabilities. Highlights critical gaps in digital provenance for combating AI-generated disinformation.

entry.title: Hybrid Self-evolving Structured Memory for GUI Agents

author.name: Sibo Zhu, Wenyi Wu, Kun Zhou, Stephen Wang, Biwei Huang

entry.summary: Introduces HyMEM, a brain-inspired hybrid memory system for GUI agents that combines discrete symbolic graph nodes with continuous trajectory embeddings. The graph-based memory self-evolves to support long-horizon computer-use tasks with diverse interfaces.

entry.title: Emulating Clinician Cognition via Self-Evolving Deep Clinical Research

author.name: Ruiyang Ren, Yuhao Wang, Yunsen Liang, Lan Luo, Jing Liu, Haifeng Wang, Cong Feng, Yinan Zhang, Chunyan Miao, Ji-Rong Wen, Wayne Xin Zhao

entry.summary: Develops DxEvolve, a self-evolving diagnostic agent that emulates clinical cognition through interactive deep clinical research workflows. On MIMIC-CDM benchmark, improves diagnostic accuracy by 11.2% over backbone models through continuous experience externalization.

entry.title: How to Count AIs: Individuation and Liability for AI Agents

author.name: Yonathan Arbel, Peter Salib, Simon Goldstein

entry.summary: First legal analysis comprehensively diagnosing the AI individuation problem - how to identify and count AIs when they can copy, split, merge, and swarm. Distinguishes numerical identity (tracking) from qualitative identity (characterization) for liability purposes.

entry.title: Amnesia: Adversarial Semantic Layer Specific Activation Steering in Large Language Models

author.name: Ali Raza, Gurang Gupta, Nikolay Matyunin, Jibesh Patra

entry.summary: Presents Amnesia, an adversarial activation steering technique that targets semantic-layer-specific activations in LLMs to bypass safety alignment. Demonstrates vulnerability of RLHF-aligned models to targeted internal manipulation.

entry.title: Equivariant Asynchronous Diffusion: An Adaptive Denoising Schedule for Accelerated Molecular Conformation Generation

author.name: Junyi An, Chao Qu, Yun-Fei Shi, Zhijian Zhou, Fenglei Cao, Yuan Qi

entry.summary: Introduces Equivariant Asynchronous Diffusion (EAD), a novel diffusion model for molecular conformation generation that uses asynchronous denoising schedules to capture molecular hierarchy while maintaining molecule-level horizon. Combines strengths of autoregressive and synchronous diffusion approaches for 3D molecular generation.

entry.title: PC-Diffuser: Path-Consistent Capsule CBF Safety Filtering for Diffusion-Based Trajectory Planner

author.name: Eugene Ku, Yiwei Lyu

entry.summary: Proposes PC-Diffuser, a safety augmentation framework that embeds certifiable, path-consistent barrier functions directly into the denoising loop of diffusion-based trajectory planners for autonomous driving.

entry.title: On the Learning Dynamics of Two-layer Linear Networks with Label Noise SGD

author.name: Tongcheng Zhang, Zhanpeng Zhou, Mingze Wang, Andi Han, Wei Huang, Taiji Suzuki, Junchi Yan

entry.summary: Analyzes learning dynamics of label noise SGD in two-layer overparameterized linear networks, revealing a two-phase behavior: Phase I escapes lazy regime, Phase II aligns with ground-truth. Explains how label noise improves generalization.

entry.title: Are Video Reasoning Models Ready to Go Outside?

author.name: Yangfan He, Changgyu Boo, Jaehong Yoon

entry.summary: Proposes ROVA, a training framework improving video reasoning model robustness under real-world disturbances (weather, occlusion) via robustness-aware consistency reward and difficulty-aware online training that adaptively prioritizes informative corrupted samples.

entry.title: Taking Shortcuts for Categorical VQA Using Super Neurons

author.name: Pierre Musacchio, Jaeyi Jeong, Dahun Kim, Jaesik Park

entry.summary: Discovers that probing raw scalar activations (super neurons) in Vision Language Models is sufficient for accurate classification on visually grounded tasks, offering a simpler alternative to Sparse Attention Vectors. Dramatically increases the search space for discriminative parameters.

entry.title: Denoising the US Census: Succinct Block Hierarchical Regression

author.name: Badih Ghazi, Pritish Kamath, Ravi Kumar, Pasin Manurangsi, Adam Sealfon

entry.summary: Introduces BlueDown, a principled post-processing method for US Census differential privacy that replaces the heuristic TopDown method with provably more accurate estimates based on block hierarchical regression.

entry.title: Robust Post-Training for Generative Recommenders: Why Exponential Reward-Weighted SFT Outperforms RLHF

author.name: Keertana Chidambaram, Sanath Kumar Krishnamurthy, Qiuling Xu, Ko-Jen Hsiao, Moumita Bhattacharya

entry.summary: Identifies exponential reward-weighted SFT as uniquely suited for post-training generative recommenders, providing theoretical and empirical evidence it avoids reward hacking inherent in RLHF and doesn't require propensity scores.

entry.title: A Universal Nearest-Neighbor Estimator for Intrinsic Dimensionality

author.name: Eng-Jon Ong, Omer Bobrowski, Gesine Reinert, Primoz Skraba

entry.summary: Introduces a universal nearest-neighbor estimator for intrinsic dimensionality with theoretical proof of convergence independent of data distribution, achieving state-of-the-art results on benchmarks.

entry.title: Riemannian MeanFlow for One-Step Generation on Manifolds

author.name: Zichen Zhong, Haoliang Sun, Yukun Zhao, Yongshun Gong, Yilong Yin

entry.summary: Extends MeanFlow to Riemannian manifolds for one-step generation, defining average velocity fields via parallel transport and deriving a Riemannian MeanFlow identity. Uses conflict-aware multi-task learning for stable optimization.

entry.title: A Grammar of Machine Learning Workflows

author.name: Simon Roth

entry.summary: Proposes a formal grammar decomposing the supervised learning lifecycle into 7 kernel primitives connected by a typed DAG, with hard constraints to prevent data leakage at call time. Validated across 2,047 experiments.

entry.title: VERI-DPO: Evidence-Aware Alignment for Clinical Summarization via Claim Verification and Direct Preference Optimization

author.name: Weixin Liu, Congning Ni, Qingyuan Song, Susannah L. Rose, Christopher Symons, Murat Kantarcioglu, Bradley A. Malin, Zhijun Yin

entry.summary: Introduces VERI-DPO for clinical summarization, using claim verification to mine preferences for DPO training, addressing unsupported statements and say-less degeneration in LLM-generated hospital course summaries.

entry.title: CacheSolidarity: Preventing Prefix Caching Side Channels in Multi-tenant LLM Serving Systems

author.name: Panagiotis Georgios Pennas, Konstantinos Papaioannou, Marco Guarnieri, Thaleia Dimitra Doudali

entry.summary: Presents CacheSolidarity, a defense against timing side-channel attacks in multi-tenant LLM serving systems that exploit prefix caching, preserving cache benefits for regular users while preventing information leakage.

entry.title: Multilingual Reasoning Gym: Multilingual Scaling of Procedural Reasoning Environments

author.name: Konstantin Dobler, Simon Lehnerer, Federico Scozzafava, Jonathan Janke, Mohamed Ali

entry.summary: Extends Reasoning Gym to 14 languages with 94 procedurally generated reasoning tasks, enabling multilingual RLVR training and crosslingual evaluation. Includes native-speaker validation and targeted adaptations for linguistic naturalness.

entry.title: From Images to Words: Efficient Cross-Modal Knowledge Distillation to Language Models from Black-box Teachers

author.name: Ayan Sengupta, Shantanu Dixit, Md Shad Akhtar, Tanmoy Chakraborty

entry.summary: ARMADA introduces cross-modal knowledge distillation from vision-language models (including black-box ones) to language-only models. Enables knowledge transfer without requiring modality-specific pre-training of the teacher.

entry.title: GeoSense: Internalizing Geometric Necessity Perception for Multimodal Reasoning

author.name: Ruiheng Liu, Haihong Hao, Mingfei Han, Xin Gu, Kecheng Zhang, Changlin Li, Xiaojun Chang

entry.summary: GeoSense endows MLLMs with awareness of perceptual insufficiency, enabling autonomous engagement of geometric features only when 2D visual cues are inadequate. Introduces an independent geometry input channel that activates on demand rather than being rigidly injected.

entry.title: Need for Speed: Zero-Shot Depth Completion with Single-Step Diffusion

author.name: Jakub Gregorek, Paraskevas Pegios, Nando Metzger, Konrad Schindler, Theodora Kontogianni, Lazaros Nalpantidis

entry.summary: Marigold-SSD is a single-step depth completion framework using diffusion priors with only 4.5 GPU days of training. Achieves strong zero-shot cross-domain generalization across 6 benchmarks while enabling efficient inference.

entry.title: Too Vivid to Be Real? Benchmarking and Calibrating Generative Color Fidelity

author.name: Zhengyao Fang, Zexi Jia, Yijia Zhong, Pengcheng Luo, Jinchao Zhang, Guangming Lu, Jun Yu, Wenjie Pei

entry.summary: Introduces Color Fidelity Dataset (1.3M+ images) and Color Fidelity Metric for evaluating color realism in text-to-image generation. Identifies that existing metrics favor oversaturated images that are 'too vivid to be real'.

entry.title: Safety-critical Control Under Partial Observability: Reach-Avoid POMDP meets Belief Space Control

author.name: Matti Vahs, Joris Verhagen, Jana Tumova

entry.summary: Proposes a layered belief-space control architecture for reach-avoid POMDPs, introducing Belief Control Lyapunov Functions to formalize information gathering as a first-class objective alongside safety and goal reaching.

entry.title: Parallel-in-Time Nonlinear Optimal Control via GPU-native Sequential Convex Programming

author.name: Yilin Zou, Zhong Zhang, Fanghua Jiang

entry.summary: Introduces a fully GPU-native trajectory optimization framework combining sequential convex programming with consensus ADMM, achieving massive parallelism through temporal splitting for real-time nonlinear optimal control.

entry.title: Negligent AI: Reasonable Care for AI Safety

author.name: Alex Mark

entry.summary: Tests whether frontier AI models align with the legal standard of 'reasonable care' under negligence law, finding that models are not aligned to this standard by default. Adding explicit negligence framing to prompts reduces permissiveness by a factor of 0.58, revealing a gap between AI default behavior and established legal expectations.

entry.title: Revisiting Sharpness-Aware Minimization: A More Faithful and Effective Implementation

author.name: Jianlong Chen, Zhiming Zhou

entry.summary: Provides a novel interpretation of SAM (Sharpness-Aware Minimization) showing why using the gradient at the ascent point works, and proposes a more faithful implementation. Bridges theory and practice of SAM.

entry.title: Multi-Agent Memory from a Computer Architecture Perspective: Visions and Challenges Ahead

author.name: Zhongming Yu, Naicheng Yu, Hejia Zhang, Wentao Ni, Mingrui Yin, Jiaying Yang, Yujie Zhao, Jishen Zhao

entry.summary: Frames multi-agent memory as a computer architecture problem, proposing shared vs. distributed memory paradigms, a three-layer hierarchy (I/O, cache, memory), and identifying cache sharing and memory consistency as critical open challenges.

entry.title: KernelSkill: A Multi-Agent Framework for GPU Kernel Optimization

author.name: Qitong Sun, Jun Han, Tianlin Li, Zhe Tang, Sheng Chen, Fei Yang, Aishan Liu, Xianglong Liu, Yang Liu

entry.summary: Presents KernelSkill, a multi-agent framework for GPU kernel optimization that replaces implicit LLM heuristics with explicit expert optimization skills using a dual-level memory architecture of reusable optimization knowledge.

entry.title: Taming Score-Based Denoisers in ADMM: A Convergent Plug-and-Play Framework

author.name: Rajesh Shrestha, Xiao Fu

entry.summary: Proposes ADMM-PnP with AC-DC denoiser for integrating score-based generative models into ADMM optimization for inverse problems. Addresses manifold mismatch and provides convergence guarantees.

entry.title: Does Reasoning Make Search More Fair? Comparing Fairness in Reasoning and Non-Reasoning Rerankers

author.name: Saron Samuel, Benjamin Van Durme, Eugene Yang

entry.summary: First systematic comparison of fairness between reasoning and non-reasoning rerankers. Finds that reasoning models like Rank1 neither improve nor harm fairness compared to non-reasoning approaches, with AWRF remaining stable across all models.

entry.title: Beyond Interleaving: Causal Attention Reformulations for Generative Recommender Systems

author.name: Hailing Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes reformulating generative recommender systems to replace item-action token interleaving with causal attention structures, reducing quadratic overhead from doubled sequence lengths and improving representation efficiency.

entry.title: Contract And Conquer: How to Provably Compute Adversarial Examples for a Black-Box Model?

author.name: Anna Chistyakova, Mikhail Pautov

entry.summary: Proposes Contract And Conquer (CAC), a provably correct black-box adversarial attack method using knowledge distillation and search space contraction with transferability guarantees.

entry.title: EvoSchema: Towards Text-to-SQL Robustness Against Schema Evolution

author.name: Tianshu Zhang, Kun Qian, Siddhartha Sahai, Yuan Tian, Shaddy Garg, Huan Sun, Yunyao Li

entry.summary: Introduces EvoSchema benchmark for evaluating text-to-SQL model robustness against database schema evolution, providing comprehensive and controllable schema change scenarios for the LLM era.

entry.title: On the Reliability of Cue Conflict and Beyond

author.name: Pum Jun Kim, Seung-Ah Lee, Seongho Park, Dongyoon Han, Jaejun Yoo

entry.summary: Critically examines the reliability of the cue-conflict benchmark for probing shape-texture bias in neural networks. Finds that stylization-based approaches can yield unstable bias estimates and proposes improvements.

entry.title: COMIC: Agentic Sketch Comedy Generation

author.name: Susung Hong, Brian Curless, Ira Kemelmacher-Shlizerman, Steve Seitz

entry.summary: Proposes COMIC, a fully automated AI system for generating sketch comedy videos using a population of LLM agents modeled after production studio roles, with LLM critics aligned to real viewer humor preferences from YouTube comedy analysis.

entry.title: SiMPO: Measure Matching for Online Diffusion Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Haitong Ma, Chenxiao Gao, Tianyi Chen, Na Li, Bo Dai

entry.summary: Introduces SiMPO (Signed Measure Policy Optimization), a framework generalizing reweighting schemes in diffusion RL with monotonic functions, allowing signed target measures for better utilization of negative samples.

entry.title: Improving TabPFN's Synthetic Data Generation by Integrating Causal Structure

author.name: Davide Tugnoli, Andrea De Lorenzo, Marco Virgolin, Giovanni Cin\`a

entry.summary: Demonstrates that integrating causal structure into TabPFN's autoregressive synthetic data generation prevents spurious correlations. Proposes causal ordering and multi-order ensembling to preserve causal effects.

entry.title: Unlearning the Unpromptable: Prompt-free Instance Unlearning in Diffusion Models

author.name: Kyungryeol Lee, Kyeonghyun Lee, Seongmin Hong, Byung Hyun Lee, Se Young Chun

entry.summary: Introduces prompt-free instance unlearning for diffusion models targeting unpromptable undesired outputs, using image editing, timestep-aware weighting, and gradient surgery to guide models away from specific generations.

entry.title: TOSSS: a CVE-based Software Security Benchmark for Large Language Models

author.name: Marc Damie, Murat Bilgehan Ertan, Domenico Essoussi, Angela Makhanu, Ga\"etan Peter, Roos Wensveen

entry.summary: Introduces TOSSS, a CVE-based benchmark measuring LLMs' ability to choose between secure and vulnerable code snippets, finding current LLMs have significant security blind spots.

entry.title: Stability and Robustness via Regularization: Bandit Inference via Regularized Stochastic Mirror Descent

author.name: Budhaditya Halder, Ishan Sengupta, Koustav Chowdhury, Koulik Khamaru

entry.summary: Develops a systematic theory of stability for bandit algorithms based on stochastic mirror descent, establishing conditions for valid statistical inference under adaptive sampling.

entry.title: From Prior to Pro: Efficient Skill Mastery via Distribution Contractive RL Finetuning

author.name: Zhanyi Sun, Shuran Song

entry.summary: Introduces DICE-RL, a framework using RL as a distribution contraction operator to finetune pretrained generative robot policies, combining selective behavior regularization with value-guided action selection.

entry.title: Pointy - A Lightweight Transformer for Point Cloud Foundation Models

author.name: Konrad Szafer, Marek Kraft, Dominik Belter

entry.summary: Introduces Pointy, a lightweight transformer for point clouds trained on only 39k samples that outperforms larger foundation models trained on 200k+ samples, approaching SOTA from million-sample models.

entry.title: GLM-OCR Technical Report

author.name: Shuaiqi Duan, Yadong Xue, Weihan Wang, Zhe Su, Huan Liu, Sheng Yang, Guobing Gan, Guo Wang, Zihan Wang, Shengdong Yan, Dexin Jin, Yuxuan Zhang, Guohong Wen, Yanfeng Wang, Yutao Zhang, Xiaohan Zhang, Wenyi Hong, Yukuo Cen, Da Yin, Bin Chen, Wenmeng Yu, Xiaotao Gu, Jie Tang

entry.summary: GLM-OCR is a compact 0.9B-parameter multimodal model for document understanding, combining a visual encoder with language decoder and introducing Multi-Token Prediction for faster OCR decoding. Uses a two-stage pipeline with layout analysis followed by parallel recognition.

entry.title: Daily-Omni: Towards Audio-Visual Reasoning with Temporal Alignment across Modalities

author.name: Ziwei Zhou, Rui Wang, Zuxuan Wu, Yu-Gang Jiang

entry.summary: Daily-Omni introduces an audio-visual QA benchmark with 684 real-world videos and 1,197 questions requiring cross-modal temporal reasoning—testing whether MLLMs can process synchronized audio and visual information rather than each modality independently.

entry.title: Learning to Wander: Improving the Global Image Geolocation Ability of LMMs via Actionable Reasoning

author.name: Yushuo Zheng, Huiyu Duan, Zicheng Zhang, Xiaohong Liu, Xiongkuo Min

entry.summary: WanderBench is the first open-access geolocation benchmark with navigable panorama graphs enabling interactive exploration, transforming geolocation from static recognition to embodied reasoning. GeoAgent is proposed for actionable geolocation reasoning.

entry.title: Fighting Hallucinations with Counterfactuals: Diffusion-Guided Perturbations for LVLM Hallucination Suppression

author.name: Hamidreza Dastmalchi, Aijun An, Ali Cheraghian, Hamed Barzamini

entry.summary: CIPHER is a training-free method for suppressing vision-induced hallucinations in LVLMs using counterfactual image perturbations. Constructs OHC-25K counterfactual dataset and applies lightweight feature-level correction.

entry.title: AsyncMDE: Real-Time Monocular Depth Estimation via Asynchronous Spatial Memory

author.name: Lianjie Ma, Yuquan Li, Bingzheng Jiang, Ziming Zhong, Han Ding, Lijun Zhu

entry.summary: Presents AsyncMDE, an asynchronous monocular depth estimation system that amortizes foundation model computation over time by caching spatial features and fusing them with lightweight real-time processing.

entry.title: Rethinking Gaussian Trajectory Predictors: Calibrated Uncertainty for Safe Planning

author.name: Fatemeh Cheraghi Pouria, Mahsa Golchoubian, Katherine Driggs-Campbell

entry.summary: Introduces a novel calibration loss function for Gaussian trajectory predictors that ensures reliable confidence levels for downstream uncertainty-aware planners in autonomous navigation.

entry.title: AdaClearGrasp: Learning Adaptive Clearing for Zero-Shot Robust Dexterous Grasping in Densely Cluttered Environments

author.name: Zixuan Chen, Wenquan Zhang, Jing Fang, Ruiming Zeng, Zhixuan Xu, Yiwen Hou, Xinke Wang, Jieqi Shi, Jing Huo, Yang Gao

entry.summary: Proposes AdaClearGrasp, a closed-loop framework using VLMs for adaptive clearing and zero-shot dexterous grasping in densely cluttered environments, deciding whether to clear objects or directly grasp targets.

entry.title: PPGuide: Steering Diffusion Policies with Performance Predictive Guidance

author.name: Zixing Wang, Devesh K. Jha, Ahmed H. Qureshi, Diego Romeres

entry.summary: Introduces PPGuide, a lightweight classifier-based framework that steers pre-trained diffusion policies away from failure modes at inference time using self-supervised attention-based multiple instance learning.

entry.title: CUAAudit: Meta-Evaluation of Vision-Language Models as Auditors of Autonomous Computer-Use Agents

author.name: Marta Sumyk, Oleksandr Kosovan

entry.summary: Studies Vision-Language Models as autonomous auditors for evaluating Computer-Use Agent task completion, conducting a large-scale meta-evaluation. Addresses the brittleness of static benchmarks and rule-based success checks for CUA evaluation.

entry.title: Causally Grounded Mechanistic Interpretability for LLMs with Faithful Natural-Language Explanations

author.name: Ajay Pravin Mahale

entry.summary: Presents a pipeline bridging circuit-level mechanistic interpretability and natural language explanations by identifying causally important attention heads via activation patching and generating faithful explanations. Evaluated on GPT-2 Small's IOI task.

entry.title: Architecture-Aware LLM Inference Optimization on AMD Instinct GPUs: A Comprehensive Benchmark and Deployment Study

author.name: Athos Georgiou

entry.summary: Benchmarks LLM inference across four large models (235B-1T parameters) on AMD MI325X GPUs, finding that architecture-aware optimization is essential - MLA models require different settings than GQA models. AITER runtime shows modest 3-5% throughput benefit.

entry.title: Evaluating Progress in Graph Foundation Models: A Comprehensive Benchmark and New Insights

author.name: Xingtong Yu, Shenghua Ye, Ruijuan Liang, Chang Zhou, Hong Cheng, Xinming Zhang, Yuan Fang

entry.summary: Presents a new benchmark jointly evaluating topic and format domain gaps across the full Graph Foundation Model pipeline, addressing the limitation that existing benchmarks only vary topic domains while obscuring format transfer.

entry.title: Why LLMs Fail: A Failure Analysis and Partial Success Measurement for Automated Security Patch Generation

author.name: Amir Al-Maamari

entry.summary: Analyzes 319 LLM-generated security patches across 64 Java vulnerabilities, finding only 24.8% achieve full correctness while 51.4% fail both security and functionality. Proposes Security Repair Score (SRS) showing LLMs preserve functionality but fail at security repair.

entry.title: Intrinsic Numerical Robustness and Fault Tolerance in a Neuromorphic Algorithm for Scientific Computing

author.name: Bradley H. Theilman, James B. Aimone

entry.summary: Demonstrates that a neuromorphic spiking algorithm for solving PDEs exhibits intrinsic fault tolerance - tolerating up to 32% neuron ablation and 90% spike dropping without significant accuracy degradation. Robustness is tunable through hyperparameters.

entry.title: Overcoming Visual Clutter in Vision Language Action Models via Concept-Gated Visual Distillation

author.name: Sangmim Song, Sarath Kodagoda, Marc Carmichael, Karthick Thiyagarajan

entry.summary: Proposes Concept-Gated Visual Distillation (CGVD), a training-free framework to improve VLA model precision in cluttered environments by parsing instructions into safe/distractor sets and penalizing false positives through cross-validation and spatial disambiguation.

entry.title: Federated Active Learning Under Extreme Non-IID and Global Class Imbalance

author.name: Chen-Chen Zong, Sheng-Jun Huang

entry.summary: Proposes FairFAL, an adaptive federated active learning framework that handles extreme non-IID distributions and global class imbalance by adaptively choosing between global and local model querying based on inferred data conditions.

entry.title: JEDI: Jointly Embedded Inference of Neural Dynamics

author.name: Anirudh Jamkhandi, Ali Korojy, Olivier Codol, Guillaume Lajoie, Matthew G. Perich

entry.summary: Introduces JEDI, a framework for jointly inferring neural dynamics across multiple behavioral tasks from neural recordings. Uses hypernetwork-driven RNN to capture task-specific dynamics while sharing underlying structure across conditions.

entry.title: Structured Linked Data as a Memory Layer for Agent-Orchestrated Retrieval

author.name: Andrea Volpini, Elie Raad, Beatrice Gamba, David Riccitelli

entry.summary: Investigates whether structured linked data (Schema.org, knowledge graphs) improves retrieval accuracy in both standard and agentic RAG systems. Tests across four domains using Google ADK and Vertex AI.

entry.title: CUPID: A Plug-in Framework for Joint Aleatoric and Epistemic Uncertainty Estimation with a Single Model

author.name: Xinran Xu, Xiuyi Fan

entry.summary: Introduces CUPID, a plug-in module that jointly estimates aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty without modifying or retraining the base model. Designed for high-stakes domains like medical diagnosis and autonomous driving.

entry.title: Historical Consensus: Preventing Posterior Collapse via Iterative Selection of Gaussian Mixture Priors

author.name: Zegu Zhang, Jian Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Historical Consensus Training to prevent posterior collapse in VAEs by using iterative selection of Gaussian mixture priors from multiple candidate clusterings, eliminating collapse by design rather than through architectural fixes.

entry.title: LiTo: Surface Light Field Tokenization

author.name: Jen-Hao Rick Chang, Xiaoming Zhao, Dorian Chan, Oncel Tuzel

entry.summary: Proposes LiTo, a 3D latent representation that jointly models geometry and view-dependent appearance by encoding surface light field samples into compact latent vectors, capturing specular highlights and Fresnel reflections.

entry.title: Data-Driven Integration Kernels for Interpretable Nonlocal Operator Learning

author.name: Savannah L. Ferretti, Jerry Lin, Sara Shamekh, Jane W. Baldwin, Michael S. Pritchard, Tom Beucler

entry.summary: Introduces data-driven integration kernels that add structure to nonlocal operator learning by explicitly separating nonlocal information aggregation from local nonlinear prediction for climate process modeling.

entry.title: SNPgen: Phenotype-Supervised Genotype Representation and Synthetic Data Generation via Latent Diffusion

author.name: Andrea Lampis, Michela Carlotta Massi, Nicola Pirastu, Francesca Ieva, Matteo Matteucci, Emanuele Di Angelantonio

entry.summary: Presents SNPgen, a conditional latent diffusion framework for generating phenotype-supervised synthetic genotypes, combining GWAS-guided variant selection with a VAE and latent diffusion model.

entry.title: Breaking the Stochasticity Barrier: An Adaptive Variance-Reduced Method for Variational Inequalities

author.name: Yungi Jeong, Takumi Otsuka

entry.summary: Proposes VR-SDA-A, an algorithm combining variance reduction (STORM) with Armijo line search for stochastic variational inequalities, overcoming the stochasticity barrier in non-convex non-concave optimization.

entry.title: Dual Space Preconditioning for Gradient Descent in the Overparameterized Regime

author.name: Reza Ghane, Danil Akhtiamov, Babak Hassibi

entry.summary: Studies convergence of dual space preconditioned gradient descent (including Adam, gradient clipping) for overparameterized linear models, proving convergence to specific interpolating solutions.

entry.title: Kernel Tests of Equivalence

author.name: Xing Liu, Axel Gandy

entry.summary: Proposes kernel-based equivalence tests using kernel Stein discrepancy and MMD, addressing the limitation of traditional hypothesis testing where failure to reject doesn't prove equivalence.

entry.title: mAceReason-Math: A Dataset of High-Quality Multilingual Math Problems Ready For RLVR

author.name: Konstantin Dobler, Simon Lehnerer, Federico Scozzafava, Jonathan Janke, Mohamed Ali

entry.summary: mAceReason-Math provides high-quality translations of challenging math problems from AceReason-Math into multiple languages, specifically designed for RLVR training of LLMs. Addresses the English-centric nature of current RLVR math training data.

entry.title: Speech Codec Probing from Semantic and Phonetic Perspectives

author.name: Xuan Shi, Chang Zeng, Tiantian Feng, Shih-Heng Wang, Jianbo Ma, Shrikanth Narayanan

entry.summary: Systematically analyzes what information speech tokenizers actually encode through word-level probing, layerwise analysis, and cross-modal alignment metrics. Finds that current tokenizers primarily encode phonetic rather than true semantic information.

entry.title: Attribution as Retrieval: Model-Agnostic AI-Generated Image Attribution

author.name: Hongsong Wang, Renxi Cheng, Chaolei Han, Jie Gui

entry.summary: Reformulates AI-generated image attribution as a retrieval problem, enabling model-agnostic attribution without access to generative models. Addresses scalability and generalization to unseen generators.

entry.title: Layer Consistency Matters: Elegant Latent Transition Discrepancy for Generalizable Synthetic Image Detection

author.name: Yawen Yang, Feng Li, Shuqi Kong, Yunfeng Diao, Xinjian Gao, Zenglin Shi, Meng Wang

entry.summary: Identifies that real images maintain consistent semantic attention across layers while synthetic images show irregular transitions, and leverages this 'latent transition discrepancy' for generalizable synthetic image detection.

entry.title: PolGS++: Physically-Guided Polarimetric Gaussian Splatting for Fast Reflective Surface Reconstruction

author.name: Yufei Han, Chu Zhou, Youwei Lyu, Qi Chen, Si Li, Boxin Shi, Yunpeng Jia, Heng Guo, Zhanyu Ma

entry.summary: Proposes PolGS++, integrating a polarized BRDF model into 3D Gaussian Splatting for fast and accurate reconstruction of reflective surfaces. Decouples diffuse and specular components with physically grounded modeling.

entry.title: Med-DualLoRA: Local Adaptation of Foundation Models for 3D Cardiac MRI

author.name: Joan Perramon-Lluss\`a, Amelia Jim\'enez-S\'anchez, Grzegorz Skorupko, Fotis Avgoustidis, Carlos Mart\'in-Isla, Karim Lekadir, Polyxeni Gkontra

entry.summary: Proposes Med-DualLoRA for federated fine-tuning of foundation models for 3D cardiac MRI disease detection. Uses client-aware parameter-efficient adaptation to handle heterogeneous multi-center data while preserving privacy.

entry.title: KnowDiffuser: A Knowledge-Guided Diffusion Planner with LM Reasoning and Prior-Informed Trajectory Initialization

author.name: Fan Ding, Xuewen Luo, Fengze Yang, Bo Yu, HwaHui Tew, Ganesh Krishnasamy, Junn Yong Loo

entry.summary: Proposes KnowDiffuser, integrating language model semantic reasoning with diffusion model trajectory generation for autonomous driving, using knowledge-guided prior initialization.

entry.title: Cybo-Waiter: A Physical Agentic Framework for Humanoid Whole-Body Locomotion-Manipulation

author.name: Peng Ren, Haoyang Ge, Chuan Qi, Cong Huang, Hong Li, Jiang Zhao, Pei Chi, Kai Chen

entry.summary: Presents Cybo-Waiter, a humanoid agent framework that compiles VLM plans into typed JSON task programs with predicate-based conditions, using SAM3 and RGB-D for 3D geometric grounding of task-relevant entities.

entry.title: FG-CLTP: Fine-Grained Contrastive Language Tactile Pretraining for Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Wenxuan Ma, Chaofan Zhang, Yinghao Cai, Guocai Yao, Shaowei Cui, Shuo Wang

entry.summary: Proposes FG-CLTP, a fine-grained contrastive language-tactile pretraining framework with 100k+ tactile point cloud-language pairs capturing quantitative contact states like force magnitude and contact geometry.

entry.title: RL-Augmented MPC for Non-Gaited Legged and Hybrid Locomotion

author.name: Andrea Patrizi, Carlo Rizzardo, Arturo Laurenzi, Francesco Ruscelli, Luca Rossini, Nikos G. Tsagarakis

entry.summary: Proposes a hierarchical RL+MPC architecture where RL learns acyclic gait timing and MPC handles locomotion control, validated across 50-120kg platforms for legged and hybrid locomotion.

entry.title: Brenier Isotonic Regression

author.name: Han Bao, Amirreza Eshraghi, Yutong Wang

entry.summary: Introduces Brenier Isotonic Regression for multi-output regression with cyclically monotone constraints, leveraging optimal transport theory to extend isotonic regression beyond univariate settings.

entry.title: From Imitation to Intuition: Intrinsic Reasoning for Open-Instance Video Classification

author.name: Ke Zhang, Xiangchen Zhao, Yunjie Tian, Jiayu Zheng, Vishal M. Patel, Di Fu

entry.summary: DeepIntuit addresses open-instance video classification where intra-class variations are vast, using an intrinsic reasoning framework that evolves VLMs from imitation to intuition through cold-start supervised alignment followed by reasoning-based classification.

entry.title: Decision-Aware Uncertainty Evaluation of Vision-Language Model-Based Early Action Anticipation for Human-Robot Interaction

author.name: Zhaoda Du, Michael Bowman, Qiaojie Zheng, Xiaoli Zhang

entry.summary: Presents the first systematic evaluation of vision-language model uncertainty reliability for early action anticipation in human-robot interaction, focusing on egocentric partial observations.

entry.title: ASTER: Attitude-aware Suspended-payload Quadrotor Traversal via Efficient Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Dongcheng Cao, Jin Zhou, Shuo Li

entry.summary: Presents ASTER, achieving the first successful autonomous inverted flight for cable-suspended quadrotor systems using RL with hybrid-dynamics-informed state seeding to handle extreme reward sparsity.

entry.title: The Dunning-Kruger Effect in Large Language Models: An Empirical Study of Confidence Calibration

author.name: Sudipta Ghosh, Mrityunjoy Panday

entry.summary: Empirical study investigating whether LLMs exhibit Dunning-Kruger-like overconfidence patterns, testing four models across 24,000 trials. Finds Kimi K2 shows severe overconfidence (ECE 0.726, 23.3% accuracy) while Claude Haiku 4.5 is best calibrated.

entry.title: CEI: A Benchmark for Evaluating Pragmatic Reasoning in Language Models

author.name: Jon Chun, Hannah Sussman, Adrian Mangine, Murathan Kocaman, Kirill Sidorko, Abhigya Koirala, Andre McCloud, Gwen Eisenbeis, Wisdom Akanwe, Moustapha Gassama, Eliezer Gonzalez Chirinos, Anne-Duncan Enright, Peter Dunson, Tiffanie Ng, Anna von Rosenstiel, Godwin Idowu

entry.summary: Introduces the CEI Benchmark with 300 human-validated scenarios for evaluating LLM pragmatic reasoning, covering sarcasm, mixed signals, strategic politeness, passive aggression, and deflection across different power dynamics.

entry.title: RedFuser: An Automatic Operator Fusion Framework for Cascaded Reductions on AI Accelerators

author.name: Xinsheng Tang, Yangcheng Li, Nan Wang, Zhiyi Shu, Xingyu Ling, Junna Xing, Peng Zhou, Qiang Liu

entry.summary: Presents RedFuser, an automatic operator fusion framework for cascaded reduction operations on AI accelerators, addressing gaps in existing compilers for patterns like softmax followed by GEMM in attention mechanisms.

entry.title: Tool Receipts, Not Zero-Knowledge Proofs: Practical Hallucination Detection for AI Agents

author.name: Abhinaba Basu

entry.summary: Proposes NabaOS, a lightweight verification framework for AI agent hallucination detection using HMAC-signed tool execution receipts and epistemic source classification inspired by Indian epistemology (Nyaya Shastra). Avoids expensive zero-knowledge proofs.

entry.title: Digging Deeper: Learning Multi-Level Concept Hierarchies

author.name: Oscar Hill, Mateo Espinosa Zarlenga, Mateja Jamnik

entry.summary: Introduces Multi-Level Concept Splitting (MLCS) and Deep-HiCEMs to discover and represent multi-level concept hierarchies from only top-level supervision, overcoming the limitation of existing hierarchical concept models restricted to shallow hierarchies.

entry.title: Delta-K: Boosting Multi-Instance Generation via Cross-Attention Augmentation

author.name: Zitong Wang, Zijun Shen, Haohao Xu, Zhengjie Luo, Weibin Wu

entry.summary: Proposes Delta-K, a training-free framework for improving multi-instance generation in diffusion models by injecting differential keys encoding missing concept semantics into the cross-attention key space during early denoising stages.

entry.title: Safe Probabilistic Planning for Human-Robot Interaction using Conformal Risk Control

author.name: Jake Gonzales, Kazuki Mizuta, Karen Leung, Lillian J. Ratliff

entry.summary: Proposes a probabilistic safe control framework for human-robot interaction combining control barrier functions with conformal risk control for formal safety guarantees while modeling complex human behavior.

entry.title: Designing Service Systems from Textual Evidence

author.name: Ruicheng Ao, Hongyu Chen, Siyang Gao, Hanwei Li, David Simchi-Levi

entry.summary: Studies how to use LLMs as automated judges of textual service quality evidence while accounting for systematic biases. Combines costly human expert review with cheap LLM evaluation for optimal service system design.

entry.title: G-STAR: End-to-End Global Speaker-Tracking Attributed Recognition

author.name: Jing Peng, Ziyi Chen, Haoyu Li, Yucheng Wang, Duo Ma, Mengtian Li, Yunfan Du, Dezhu Xu, Kai Yu, Shuai Wang

entry.summary: Proposes G-STAR, an end-to-end system for timestamped speaker-attributed ASR combining a time-aware speaker-tracking module with a Speech-LLM backbone for long-form, multi-party speech with overlap.

entry.title: Probabilistic Verification of Voice Anti-Spoofing Models

author.name: Evgeny Kushnir, Alexandr Kozodaev, Dmitrii Korzh, Mikhail Pautov, Oleg Kiriukhin, Oleg Y. Rogov

entry.summary: Proposes PV-VASM, a probabilistic framework for verifying robustness of voice anti-spoofing models against text-to-speech, voice cloning, and signal transformations. Model-agnostic and works against unseen synthesis techniques.

entry.title: BALD-SAM: Disagreement-based Active Prompting in Interactive Segmentation

author.name: Prithwijit Chowdhury, Mohit Prabhushankar, Ghassan AlRegib

entry.summary: Introduces BALD-SAM, an active learning approach for interactive segmentation with SAM that uses Bayesian disagreement to identify the most informative regions for next prompts, replacing visual assessment with principled model-derived criteria.

entry.title: Contact Coverage-Guided Exploration for General-Purpose Dexterous Manipulation

author.name: Zixuan Liu, Ruoyi Qiao, Chenrui Tie, Xuanwei Liu, Yunfan Lou, Chongkai Gao, Zhixuan Xu, Lin Shao

entry.summary: Introduces Contact Coverage-Guided Exploration (CCGE), a general exploration method for dexterous manipulation that encourages diverse contact patterns between hand keypoints and object surfaces, maintaining a contact counter for novelty-driven exploration.

entry.title: Stochastic Port-Hamiltonian Neural Networks: Universal Approximation with Passivity Guarantees

author.name: Luca Di Persio, Matthias Ehrhardt, Youness Outaleb

entry.summary: Introduces stochastic port-Hamiltonian neural networks (SPH-NNs) with universal approximation guarantees and weak passivity properties for modeling stochastic dynamical systems with energy-based structure.

entry.title: Evaluating Generalization Mechanisms in Autonomous Cyber Attack Agents

author.name: Ond\v{r}ej Luk\'a\v{s}, Jihoon Shin, Emilia Rivas, Diego Forni, Maria Rigaki, Carlos Catania, Aritran Piplai, Christopher Kiekintveld, Sebastian Garcia

entry.summary: Evaluates generalization of autonomous cyber attack agents under IP reassignment, comparing RL, meta-learning, and LLM-based agents, finding that even minor address-space changes break transfer.

entry.title: Quantization of Ricci Curvature in Information Geometry

author.name: Carlos C. Rodriguez

entry.summary: Resolves a 20-year-old conjecture about quantization of Ricci curvature in information geometry of Bayesian networks, proving it for tree-structured and complete-graph bitnets and disproving it for general cases.

entry.title: On The Complexity of Best-Arm Identification in Non-Stationary Linear Bandits

author.name: Leo Maynard-Zhang, Zhihan Xiong, Kevin Jamieson, Maryam Fazel

entry.summary: Studies fixed-budget best-arm identification in non-stationary linear bandits, showing that instance-dependent designs can beat the dimension-dependent minimax bound when the gap direction is informative.

entry.title: Automatic End-to-End Data Integration using Large Language Models

author.name: Aaron Steiner, Christian Bizer

entry.summary: Presents an automatic end-to-end data integration pipeline using GPT-5.2 to generate all required artifacts (schema mappings, value mappings, training data for entity matching, validation data), replacing substantial manual effort from data engineers.

entry.title: HeartAgent: An Autonomous Agent System for Explainable Differential Diagnosis in Cardiology

author.name: Shuang Zhou, Kai Yu, Song Wang, Wenya Xie, Zaifu Zhan, Meng-Han Tsai, Yuen-Hei Chung, Shutong Hou, Huixue Zhou, Min Zeng, Bhavadharini Ramu, Lin Yee Chen, Feng Xie, Rui Zhang

entry.summary: HeartAgent is a cardiology-specific multi-agent system for explainable differential diagnosis, integrating specialized sub-agents with customized tools and curated medical data. Evaluated on MIMIC and private ECG datasets.

entry.title: DSFlash: Comprehensive Panoptic Scene Graph Generation in Realtime

author.name: Julian Lorenz, Vladyslav Kovganko, Elias Kohout, Mrunmai Phatak, Daniel Kienzle, Rainer Lienhart

entry.summary: DSFlash achieves real-time panoptic scene graph generation at 56 FPS on RTX 3090 without compromising accuracy against state-of-the-art methods, enabling practical deployment on edge devices.

entry.title: Splat2Real: Novel-view Scaling for Physical AI with 3D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Hansol Lim, Jongseong Brad Choi

entry.summary: Splat2Real uses 3D Gaussian Splatting for novel-view scaling in monocular depth pretraining, introducing CN-Coverage curriculum that selects views by geometry gain and extrapolation penalty, with quality-aware guardrails.

entry.title: A$^2$-Edit: Precise Reference-Guided Image Editing of Arbitrary Objects and Ambiguous Masks

author.name: Huayu Zheng, Guangzhao Li, Baixuan Zhao, Siqi Luo, Hantao Jiang, Guangtao Zhai, Xiaohong Liu

entry.summary: A²-Edit is an inpainting framework for arbitrary object categories that allows replacing target regions with reference objects using coarse masks. Constructs UniEdit-500K dataset with 209 subcategories and introduces Mixture of Transformer for differentiated modeling.

entry.title: UltrasoundAgents: Hierarchical Multi-Agent Evidence-Chain Reasoning for Breast Ultrasound Diagnosis

author.name: Yali Zhu, Kang Zhou, Dingbang Wu, Gaofeng Meng

entry.summary: Proposes UltrasoundAgents, a hierarchical multi-agent framework for breast ultrasound diagnosis that mimics clinical workflow from lesion localization to BI-RADS categorization. Improves evidence traceability through structured attribute prediction.

entry.title: S2D: Sparse to Dense Lifting for 3D Reconstruction with Minimal Inputs

author.name: Yuzhou Ji, Qijian Tian, He Zhu, Xiaoqi Jiang, Guangzhi Cao, Lizhuang Ma, Yuan Xie, Xin Tan

entry.summary: Introduces S2D, a pipeline bridging sparse point clouds and 3D Gaussian Splatting for high-quality reconstruction from minimal inputs. Uses one-step diffusion for artifact fixing and random sample dropout for consistency.

entry.title: MapGCLR: Geospatial Contrastive Learning of Representations for Online Vectorized HD Map Construction

author.name: Jonas Merkert, Alexander Blumberg, Jan-Hendrik Pauls, Christoph Stiller

entry.summary: Proposes MapGCLR, using geospatial contrastive learning to improve BEV feature representations for online vectorized HD map construction. Enforces consistency between overlapping BEV grids to reduce annotation requirements.

entry.title: Adaptive Manipulation Potential and Haptic Estimation for Tool-Mediated Interaction

author.name: Lin Yang, Anirvan Dutta, Yuan Ji, Yanxin Zhou, Shilin Shan, Lv Chen, Etienne Burdet, Domenico Campolo

entry.summary: Introduces a parameterized Equilibrium Manifold as unified representation for tool-mediated manipulation, with adaptive manipulation potential integrating haptic estimation, planning, and stiffness control.

entry.title: OnFly: Onboard Zero-Shot Aerial Vision-Language Navigation toward Safety and Efficiency

author.name: Guiyong Zheng, Yueting Ban, Mingjie Zhang, Juepeng Zheng, Boyu Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes OnFly, a fully onboard zero-shot framework for aerial vision-language navigation using dual-agent architecture that decouples target generation from progress monitoring with hybrid memory management.

entry.title: Factorized Neural Implicit DMD for Parametric Dynamics

author.name: Siyuan Chen, Zhecheng Wang, Yixin Chen, Yue Chang, Peter Yichen Chen, Eitan Grinspun, Jonathan Panuelos

entry.summary: Proposes Factorized Neural Implicit DMD, combining neural implicit representations with Dynamic Mode Decomposition for learning parametric dynamical system evolution with long-horizon rollouts and spectral analysis.

entry.title: Fine-Tune, Don't Prompt, Your Language Model to Identify Biased Language in Clinical Notes

author.name: Isotta Landi, Eugenia Alleva, Nicole Bussola, Rebecca M. Cohen, Sarah Nowlin, Leslee J. Shaw, Alexander W. Charney, Kimberly B. Glazer

entry.summary: Presents a framework for detecting stigmatizing vs. privileging language in clinical notes, finding that supervised fine-tuning significantly outperforms zero-shot and in-context learning for this task.

entry.title: TacLoc: Global Tactile Localization on Objects from a Registration Perspective

author.name: Zirui Zhang, Boyang Zhang, Fumin Zhang, Huan Yin

entry.summary: Proposes TacLoc, a tactile localization framework formulating pose estimation as one-shot point cloud registration, using graph-theoretic partial-to-full registration without requiring simulation or pre-trained models.

entry.title: MultiwayPAM: Multiway Partitioning Around Medoids for LLM-as-a-Judge Score Analysis

author.name: Chihiro Watanabe, Jingyu Sun

entry.summary: Proposes MultiwayPAM, a tensor clustering method for analyzing LLM-as-a-Judge score tensors, simultaneously estimating cluster structure and score bias across questions, answerers, and evaluators.

entry.title: Perceptive Hierarchical-Task MPC for Sequential Mobile Manipulation in Unstructured Semi-Static Environments

author.name: Xintong Du, Jingxing Qian, Siqi Zhou, Angela P. Schoellig

entry.summary: Proposes hierarchical-task MPC for sequential mobile manipulation that adapts to semi-static environment changes during long-term operation, integrating perception with whole-body control.

entry.title: COHORT: Hybrid RL for Collaborative Large DNN Inference on Multi-Robot Systems Under Real-Time Constraints

author.name: Mohammad Saeid Anwar, Anuradha Ravi, Indrajeet Ghosh, Gaurav Shinde, Carl Busart, Nirmalya Roy

entry.summary: Presents COHORT, a collaborative DNN inference framework for multi-robot systems using hybrid offline-online RL to dynamically schedule model execution across resource-constrained robots.

entry.title: One Model, Many Skills: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Multitask Code Analysis

author.name: Amal Akli, Maxime Cordy, Mike Papadakis, Yves Le Traon

entry.summary: Presents the first comprehensive evaluation of multi-task parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) for code analysis, comparing several methods across diverse tasks and model architectures. Shows PEFT can unify diverse code analysis objectives within a single model.

entry.title: Evaluating Adjective-Noun Compositionality in LLMs: Functional vs Representational Perspectives

author.name: Ruchira Dhar, Qiwei Peng, Anders S{\o}gaard

entry.summary: Evaluates adjective-noun compositionality in LLMs using both prompt-based functional assessment and representational analysis of internal states. Finds LLMs develop compositional representations but fail to translate them consistently into task performance.

entry.title: Leveraging Wikidata for Geographically Informed Sociocultural Bias Dataset Creation: Application to Latin America

author.name: Yannis Karmim (ALMAnaCH), Renato Pino (UCHILE), Hernan Contreras (UCHILE), Hernan Lira (CENIA), Sebastian Cifuentes (CENIA), Simon Escoffier (PUC), Luis Mart\'i (UP4, ALPAGE), Djam\'e Seddah (UP4, ALPAGE), Valentin Barri\`ere (UCHILE, CENIA)

entry.summary: Leverages Wikidata and Wikipedia to create LatamQA, a geographically informed dataset for detecting sociocultural biases in LLMs toward Latin American cultures. Combines knowledge graph structure with social science expertise.

entry.title: Defining AI Models and AI Systems: A Framework to Resolve the Boundary Problem

author.name: Yuanyuan Sun, Timothy Parker, Lara Gierschmann, Sana Shams, Teo Canmetin, Mathieu Duteil, Rokas Gipi\v{s}kis, Ze Shen Chin

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for defining 'AI model' and 'AI system' through systematic review of 896 papers and 80+ regulatory documents. Traces definitional lineages and finds most definitions derive from OECD frameworks with compounded ambiguities.

entry.title: Where Do Flow Semantics Reside? A Protocol-Native Tabular Pretraining Paradigm for Encrypted Traffic Classification

author.name: Sizhe Huang, Shujie Yang

entry.summary: Proposes a protocol-native tabular pretraining paradigm for encrypted traffic classification, arguing that flattening traffic into byte sequences destroys protocol-defined semantics. Identifies three specific issues with current masked modeling approaches.

entry.title: Rethinking the Harmonic Loss via Non-Euclidean Distance Layers

author.name: Maxwell Miller-Golub, Kamil Faber, Marcin Pietron, Panpan Zheng, Pasquale Minervini, Roberto Corizzo

entry.summary: Extends harmonic loss (a distance-based alternative to cross-entropy) by investigating non-Euclidean distance metrics. Provides systematic evaluation of computational efficiency and sustainability of different distance formulations.

entry.title: Quantum entanglement provides a competitive advantage in adversarial games

author.name: Peiyong Wang, Kieran Hymas, James Quach

entry.summary: Conducts a controlled study isolating quantum entanglement's role in a hybrid quantum-classical RL agent playing Pong. Shows entangled circuits (CZ, IsingZZ gates) outperform separable circuits as feature extractors in proximal policy optimization.

entry.title: Utility Function is All You Need: LLM-based Congestion Control

author.name: Neta Rozen-Schiff, Liron Schiff, Stefan Schmid

entry.summary: Proposes using LLMs to automatically craft utility functions for network congestion control protocols, replacing the complex manual process of designing application-specific optimization objectives for distributed network settings.

entry.title: UniPINN: A Unified PINN Framework for Multi-task Learning of Diverse Navier-Stokes Equations

author.name: Dengdi Sun, Jie Chen, Xiao Wang, Jin Tang

entry.summary: Proposes UniPINN, a unified physics-informed neural network framework for multi-task learning across diverse Navier-Stokes equation scenarios, addressing negative transfer and training instability in multi-flow settings.

entry.title: AlphaFlowTSE: One-Step Generative Target Speaker Extraction via Conditional AlphaFlow

author.name: Duojia Li, Shuhan Zhang, Zihan Qian, Wenxuan Wu, Shuai Wang, Qingyang Hong, Lin Li, Haizhou Li

entry.summary: Presents AlphaFlowTSE, a one-step conditional generative model for target speaker extraction using AlphaFlow objective, eliminating multi-step sampling latency while avoiding unreliable mixture-dependent time coordinates.

entry.title: Towards Robust Speech Deepfake Detection via Human-Inspired Reasoning

author.name: Artem Dvirniak, Evgeny Kushnir, Dmitrii Tarasov, Artem Iudin, Oleg Kiriukhin, Mikhail Pautov, Dmitrii Korzh, Oleg Y. Rogov

entry.summary: Introduces HIR-SDD, a speech deepfake detection framework combining Large Audio Language Models with chain-of-thought reasoning for human-interpretable explanations. Aims to improve generalization across audio domains and generators.

entry.title: GroundCount: Grounding Vision-Language Models with Object Detection for Mitigating Counting Hallucinations

author.name: Boyuan Chen, Minghao Shao, Siddharth Garg, Ramesh Karri, Muhammad Shafique

entry.summary: Proposes GroundCount, which augments VLMs with CNN-based object detection models (YOLO) to mitigate counting hallucinations, achieving 81.3% counting accuracy with 6.6pp improvement and 22% inference time reduction.

entry.title: Neural Field Thermal Tomography: A Differentiable Physics Framework for Non-Destructive Evaluation

author.name: Tao Zhong, Yixun Hu, Dongzhe Zheng, Aditya Sood, Christine Allen-Blanchette

entry.summary: Proposes NeFTY, a differentiable physics framework for 3D reconstruction of material properties from surface temperature measurements, using neural fields optimized through a numerical solver with hard thermodynamic constraints.

entry.title: Actor-Accelerated Policy Dual Averaging for Reinforcement Learning in Continuous Action Spaces

author.name: Ji Gao, Caleb Ju, Guanghui Lan, Zhaohui Tong

entry.summary: Proposes actor-accelerated Policy Dual Averaging (PDA) for continuous action spaces, using a learned policy network to approximate optimization sub-problems while maintaining convergence guarantees.

entry.title: GGMPs: Generalized Gaussian Mixture Processes

author.name: Vardaan Tekriwal, Mark D. Risser, Hengrui Luo, Marcus M. Noack

entry.summary: Introduces Generalized Gaussian Mixture Processes (GGMPs) for multimodal conditional density estimation, combining local GMM fitting with per-component heteroscedastic GP training for closed-form Gaussian mixture predictive densities.

entry.title: When should we trust the annotation? Selective prediction for molecular structure retrieval from mass spectra

author.name: Mira J\"urgens, Gaetan De Waele, Morteza Rakhshaninejad, Willem Waegeman

entry.summary: Introduces a selective prediction framework for molecular structure retrieval from mass spectra, enabling models to abstain when uncertainty is too high, evaluating risk-coverage tradeoffs.

entry.title: MCMC Informed Neural Emulators for Uncertainty Quantification in Dynamical Systems

author.name: Heikki Haario, Zhi-Song Liu, Martin Simon, Hendrik Weichel

entry.summary: Introduces MCMC-informed neural emulators that decouple uncertainty quantification from network architecture by using MCMC to guide the parameter distribution input to network training.

entry.title: Flexible Cutoff Learning: Optimizing Machine Learning Potentials After Training

author.name: Rick Oerder (Institute for Numerical Simulation, University of Bonn, Fraunhofer Institute for Algorithms and Scientific Computing SCAI), Jan Hamaekers (Fraunhofer Institute for Algorithms and Scientific Computing SCAI)

entry.summary: Introduces Flexible Cutoff Learning for ML interatomic potentials, enabling post-training adjustment of cutoff radii for application-specific accuracy-cost tradeoff optimization using differentiable cost models.

entry.title: Bayesian Hierarchical Models and the Maximum Entropy Principle

author.name: Brendon J. Brewer

entry.summary: Shows that marginal priors in Bayesian hierarchical models with canonical distributions have a maximum entropy property with a different constraint, connecting hierarchical Bayes to MaxEnt.

entry.title: ReTabSyn: Realistic Tabular Data Synthesis via Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Xiaofeng Lin, Seungbae Kim, Zhuoya Li, Zachary DeSoto, Charles Fleming, Guang Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes ReTabSyn, using RL to provide direct feedback on feature correlation preservation during tabular data synthesis, prioritizing the conditional distribution P(y|X) over the full joint.

entry.title: Large Language Models and Book Summarization: Reading or Remembering, Which Is Better?

author.name: Tairan Fu, Javier Conde, Pedro Reviriego, Javier Coronado-Bl\'azquez, Nina Melero, Elena Merino-G\'omez

entry.summary: Experimentally compares LLM book summaries generated from memory vs. from reading full text, investigating whether prior knowledge influences summaries even when given the book as input.

entry.title: The Prediction-Measurement Gap: Toward Meaning Representations as Scientific Instruments

author.name: Hubert Plisiecki

entry.summary: Argues for a prediction-measurement gap in text embeddings, proposing that scientific meaning analysis requires different objectives than prediction/retrieval, emphasizing geometric legibility and robustness.

entry.title: Large language models can disambiguate opioid slang on social media

author.name: Kristy A. Carpenter, Issah A. Samori, Mathew V. Kiang, Keith Humphreys, Anna Lembke, Johannes C. Eichstaedt, Russ B. Altman

entry.summary: Evaluates GPT-4, GPT-5, Gemini 2.5 Pro, and Claude on disambiguating opioid-related slang terms on social media for public health monitoring. Tests LLMs' ability to distinguish drug-related from non-drug-related uses of ambiguous terms like 'smack' or 'blues'.

entry.title: Calibration-Reasoning Framework for Descriptive Speech Quality Assessment

author.name: Elizaveta Kostenok, Mathieu Salzmann, Milos Cernak

entry.summary: Introduces a calibration-reasoning framework for speech quality assessment that uses GRPO reinforcement learning to enhance an audio LLM's ability to describe and temporally localize quality issues across multiple perceptual dimensions.

entry.title: Visually-Guided Controllable Medical Image Generation via Fine-Grained Semantic Disentanglement

author.name: Xin Huang, Junjie Liang, Qingshan Hou, Peng Cao, Jinzhu Yang, Xiaoli Liu, Osmar R. Zaiane

entry.summary: Proposes visually-guided text disentanglement for controllable medical image synthesis, using cross-modal alignment to disentangle clinical text into independent semantic representations for anatomy and imaging style.

entry.title: Sparse Task Vector Mixup with Hypernetworks for Efficient Knowledge Transfer in Whole-Slide Image Prognosis

author.name: Pei Liu, Xiangxiang Zeng, Tengfei Ma, Yucheng Xing, Xuanbai Ren, Yiping Liu

entry.summary: Proposes sparse task vector mixup with hypernetworks for efficient knowledge transfer across cancer types in whole-slide image prognosis, avoiding large-scale joint training or multi-model inference.

entry.title: WalkGPT: Grounded Vision-Language Conversation with Depth-Aware Segmentation for Pedestrian Navigation

author.name: Rafi Ibn Sultan, Hui Zhu, Xiangyu Zhou, Chengyin Li, Prashant Khanduri, Marco Brocanelli, Dongxiao Zhu

entry.summary: Introduces WalkGPT, a pixel-grounded vision-language model for pedestrian navigation that combines language reasoning with segmentation for depth-aware accessibility guidance. Defines the new task of Grounded Navigation Guide.

entry.title: An Event-Driven E-Skin System with Dynamic Binary Scanning and real time SNN Classification

author.name: Gaishan Li, Zhengnan Fu, Anubhab Tripathi, Junyi Yang, Arindam Basu

entry.summary: Presents a hardware system for electronic skin combining event-driven binary scanning with spiking neural networks on FPGA, achieving 12.8x scan reduction and 99% data sparsity for tactile digit classification.

entry.title: Octopus-inspired Distributed Control for Soft Robotic Arms: A Graph Neural Network-Based Attention Policy with Environmental Interaction

author.name: Linxin Hou, Qirui Wu, Zhihang Qin, Yongxin Guo, Cecilia Laschi

entry.summary: Proposes SoftGM, an octopus-inspired distributed control for soft robotic arms using graph neural networks and multi-agent RL for reaching targets in contact-rich environments without global obstacle knowledge.

entry.title: SteadyTray: Learning Object Balancing Tasks in Humanoid Tray Transport via Residual Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Anlun Huang, Zhenyu Wu, Soofiyan Atar, Yuheng Zhi, Michael Yip

entry.summary: Introduces ReST-RL, a hierarchical RL architecture for humanoid tray transport that decouples locomotion from payload stabilization via a dynamic residual module to cancel gait-induced perturbations.

entry.title: MAVEN: A Meta-Reinforcement Learning Framework for Varying-Dynamics Expertise in Agile Quadrotor Maneuvers

author.name: Jin Zhou, Dongcheng Cao, Xian Wang, Shuo Li

entry.summary: Introduces MAVEN, a meta-RL framework for agile quadrotor navigation across varying dynamics using a predictive context encoder to infer latent dynamics representations from interaction history.

entry.title: Less Dead

author.name: Aurelia

entry.summary: Nectome announces a new whole-body, whole-brain preservation method after 10 years of research, claiming nanoscale subsynaptic detail preservation compatible with traditional funerals. Positioned as a more evidence-based alternative to traditional cryonics, with preservation verifiable by current neuroscience.

entry.title: Trajectory-Informed Memory Generation for Self-Improving Agent Systems

author.name: Gaodan Fang, Vatche Isahagian, K. R. Jayaram, Ritesh Kumar, Vinod Muthusamy, Punleuk Oum, Gegi Thomas

entry.summary: Presents a framework for automatically extracting actionable learnings from LLM agent execution trajectories and using them to improve future performance through contextual memory retrieval. Includes trajectory intelligence extraction, decision attribution analysis, and dynamic memory retrieval.

entry.title: Quantifying Hallucinations in Language Language Models on Medical Textbooks

author.name: Brandon C. Colelough, Davis Bartels, Dina Demner-Fushman

entry.summary: Quantifies hallucination rates in LLMs on medical textbook-grounded QA, testing LLaMA-70B-Instruct and comparing multiple models against fixed evidence sources. Addresses the gap in evaluating medical hallucinations against ground-truth text.

entry.title: The System Hallucination Scale (SHS): A Minimal yet Effective Human-Centered Instrument for Evaluating Hallucination-Related Behavior in Large Language Models

author.name: Heimo M\"uller, Dominik Steiger, Markus Plass, Andreas Holzinger

entry.summary: Introduces the System Hallucination Scale (SHS), a lightweight psychometric instrument for human-centered assessment of LLM hallucination behavior, inspired by the System Usability Scale. Evaluated with 210 participants for domain-agnostic hallucination assessment.

entry.title: Assessing Cognitive Biases in LLMs for Judicial Decision Support: Virtuous Victim and Halo Effects

author.name: Sierra S. Liu

entry.summary: Investigates whether LLMs display human-like cognitive biases (virtuous victim effect and halo effects) relevant to judicial sentencing decisions. Uses altered vignettes across five models to measure bias influence on sentencing outcomes.

entry.title: Simulation-in-the-Reasoning (SiR): A Conceptual Framework for Empirically Grounded AI in Autonomous Transportation

author.name: Wuping Xin

entry.summary: Introduces Simulation-in-the-Reasoning (SiR), embedding domain-specific traffic simulators into LLM reasoning loops to transform reasoning from narrative plausibility to falsifiable hypothesis-simulate-analyze workflows for transportation systems.

entry.title: Few-Shot Adaptation to Non-Stationary Environments via Latent Trend Embedding for Robotics

author.name: Yasuyuki Fujii (College of Information Science and Engineering, Ritsumeikan University, Osaka, Japan), Emika Kameda (College of Information Science and Engineering, Ritsumeikan University, Osaka, Japan), Hiroki Fukada (Production and Technology Department, NIPPN CORPORATION, Tokyo, Japan), Yoshiki Mori (University of Osaka, Osaka, Japan), Tadashi Matsuo (National Institute of Technology, Ichinoseki College, Iwate, Japan), Nobutaka Shimada (College of Information Science and Engineering, Ritsumeikan University, Osaka, Japan)

entry.summary: Proposes a latent Trend ID-based framework for few-shot adaptation in non-stationary robotic environments. Estimates environmental state via backpropagation while keeping model parameters fixed, avoiding catastrophic forgetting.

entry.title: Effective Dataset Distillation for Spatio-Temporal Forecasting with Bi-dimensional Compression

author.name: Taehyung Kwon, Yeonje Choi, Yeongho Kim, Kijung Shin

entry.summary: Proposes bi-dimensional compression for dataset distillation of spatio-temporal forecasting data, enabling compact synthetic datasets that effectively replace large originals for training deep learning models.

entry.title: FAR-Dex: Few-shot Data Augmentation and Adaptive Residual Policy Refinement for Dexterous Manipulation

author.name: Yushan Bai, Fulin Chen, Hongzheng Sun, Yuchuang Tong, En Li, Zhengtao Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes FAR-Dex, a hierarchical framework for dexterous manipulation combining few-shot data augmentation in IsaacLab with adaptive residual refinement for arm-hand coordination.

entry.title: Prompting with the human-touch: evaluating model-sensitivity of foundation models for musculoskeletal CT segmentation

author.name: Caroline Magg, Maaike A. ter Wee, Johannes G. G. Dobbe, Geert J. Streekstra, Leendert Blankevoort, Clara I. S\'anchez, Hoel Kervadec

entry.summary: Evaluates 11 promptable foundation models for musculoskeletal CT segmentation using various 2D/3D prompting strategies, identifying Pareto-optimal models and analyzing sensitivity to human prompts.

entry.title: RandMark: On Random Watermarking of Visual Foundation Models

author.name: Anna Chistyakova, Mikhail Pautov

entry.summary: Proposes RandMark for ownership verification of visual foundation models using a small encoder-decoder to embed random digital watermarks into internal representations of hold-out images.

entry.title: Speaker Verification with Speech-Aware LLMs: Evaluation and Augmentation

author.name: Thomas Thebaud, Yuzhe Wang, Laureano Moro-Velazquez, Jesus Villalba-Lopez, Najim Dehak
