entry.title: OTPL-VIO: Robust Visual-Inertial Odometry with Optimal Transport Line Association and Adaptive Uncertainty

author.name: Zikun Chen, Wentao Zhao, Yihe Niu, Tianchen Deng, Jingchuan Wang

entry.summary: OTPL-VIO proposes a stereo visual-inertial odometry system using deep line descriptors matched via optimal transport, improving robustness in low-texture scenes where point features fail.

entry.title: TemporalDoRA: Temporal PEFT for Robust Surgical Video Question Answering

author.name: Luca Carlini, Chiara Lena, Cesare Hassan, Danail Stoyanov, Elena De Momi, Sophia Bano, Mobarak I. Hoque

entry.summary: TemporalDoRA extends Weight-Decomposed Low-Rank Adaptation with temporal multi-head attention inside the low-rank bottleneck for surgical video question answering, adding temporal reasoning to PEFT.

entry.title: Unsupervised Domain Adaptation with Target-Only Margin Disparity Discrepancy

author.name: Gauthier Miralles, Lo\"ic Le Folgoc, Vincent Jugnon, Pietro Gori

entry.summary: Proposes target-only margin disparity discrepancy for unsupervised domain adaptation from CT to interventional CBCT in radiology, addressing the scarcity of annotated CBCT data.

entry.title: Robust Provably Secure Image Steganography via Latent Iterative Optimization

author.name: Yanan Li, Zixuan Wang, Qiyang Xiao, Yanzhen Ren

entry.summary: Proposes a robust, provably secure image steganography framework based on latent-space iterative optimization, where the receiver refines latent variables to minimize reconstruction error while preserving security.

entry.title: Association of Radiologic PPFE Change with Mortality in Lung Cancer Screening Cohorts

author.name: Shahab Aslani, Mehran Azimbagirad, Daryl Cheng, Daisuke Yamada, Ryoko Egashira, Adam Szmul, Justine Chan-Fook, Robert Chapman, Alfred Chung Pui So, Shanshan Wang, John McCabe, Tianqi Yang, Jose M Brenes, Eyjolfur Gudmundsson, The SUMMIT Consortium, Susan M. Astley, Daniel C. Alexander, Sam M. Janes, Joseph Jacob

entry.summary: Investigates whether longitudinal PPFE progression quantified on low-dose CT independently associates with mortality and respiratory morbidity in lung cancer screening populations using automated quantification.

entry.title: HMR-1: Hierarchical Massage Robot with Vision-Language-Model for Embodied Healthcare

author.name: Rongtao Xu, Mingming Yu, Xiaofeng Han, Yu Zhang, Kaiyi Hu, Zhe Feng, Zenghuang Fu, Changwei Wang, Weiliang Meng, Xiaopeng Zhang

entry.summary: HMR-1 presents a hierarchical massage robot with VLM for embodied healthcare, constructing a 12K-image multimodal acupoint massage dataset and proposing high-level grounding with low-level control modules.

entry.title: Cutting the Cord: System Architecture for Low-Cost, GPU-Accelerated Bimanual Mobile Manipulation

author.name: Artemis Shaw, Chen Liu, Justin Costa, Rane Gray, Alina Skowronek, Kevin Diaz, Nam Bui, Nikolaus Correll

entry.summary: Presents a bimanual mobile manipulator built on open-source XLeRobot with onboard compute for under $1,300, featuring optimized mechanical design, isolated power topology, and NVIDIA Jetson-based autonomy for untethered operation including SLAM and vision-based manipulation.

entry.title: MO-Playground: Massively Parallelized Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning for Robotics

author.name: Neil Janwani, Ellen Novoseller, Vernon J. Lawhern, Maegan Tucker

entry.summary: Presents MORLAX, a GPU-native multi-objective RL algorithm, and MO-Playground, a suite of GPU-accelerated multi-objective environments. Achieves 25-270x speedups over existing MORL methods, enabling Pareto set approximation within minutes for complex robotics problems.

entry.title: Beyond Short-Horizon: VQ-Memory for Robust Long-Horizon Manipulation in Non-Markovian Simulation Benchmarks

author.name: Wang Honghui, Jing Zhi, Ao Jicong, Song Shiji, Li Xuelong, Huang Gao, Bai Chenjia

entry.summary: Introduces RuleSafe, an articulated manipulation benchmark with non-Markovian long-horizon tasks (safes with diverse locking mechanisms), and VQ-Memory, a VQ-VAE based memory module for handling long-horizon tasks beyond short-horizon Markovian assumptions.

entry.title: Interview with Steven Byrnes on His Mainline Takeoff Scenario

author.name: Liron

entry.summary: Interview with Steven Byrnes discussing his mainline AI takeoff scenario, including brainlike AGI, unemployment timelines, expectations for sociopathic ASI, and the limitations of post-training/RLVR as a 'thin layer' of consequentialism.

entry.title: Interpretable Markov-Based Spatiotemporal Risk Surfaces for Missing-Child Search Planning with Reinforcement Learning and LLM-Based Quality Assurance

author.name: Joshua Castillo, Ravi Mukkamala

entry.summary: Guardian is a decision-support system for missing-child investigations that converts unstructured case documents into spatiotemporal representations and provides probabilistic search products spanning 0-72 hours using Markov chains, RL, and LLM-based quality assurance.

entry.title: DataFactory: Collaborative Multi-Agent Framework for Advanced Table Question Answering

author.name: Tong Wang, Chi Jin, Yongkang Chen, Huan Deng, Xiaohui Kuang, Gang Zhao

entry.summary: DataFactory is a multi-agent framework for Table Question Answering that addresses context length constraints, hallucination, and complex reasoning through specialized team coordination with a Data Leader using ReAct paradigm.

entry.title: Enhancing Debunking Effectiveness through LLM-based Personality Adaptation

author.name: Pietro Dell'Oglio, Alessandro Bondielli, Francesco Marcelloni, Lucia C. Passaro

entry.summary: Proposes using LLMs to generate personality-adapted fake news debunking messages based on Big Five traits, with LLM-as-judge evaluation. Finds personalized messages are generally seen as more persuasive.

entry.title: ALADIN: Accuracy-Latency-Aware Design-space Inference Analysis for Embedded AI Accelerators

author.name: T. Baldi, D. Casini, A. Biondi

entry.summary: ALADIN is a framework for analyzing accuracy-latency-resource trade-offs of mixed-precision quantized neural networks targeting scratchpad-based AI accelerators, without requiring actual hardware deployment.

entry.title: CLoE: Expert Consistency Learning for Missing Modality Segmentation

author.name: Xinyu Tong, Meihua Zhou, Bowu Fan, Haitao Li

entry.summary: Proposes CLoE, a consistency-driven framework for multimodal medical image segmentation that handles missing modalities through dual-branch expert consistency learning.

entry.title: Reading the Mood Behind Words: Integrating Prosody-Derived Emotional Context into Socially Responsive VR Agents

author.name: SangYeop Jeong, Yeongseo Na, Seung Gyu Jeong, Jin-Woo Jeong, Seong-Eun Kim

entry.summary: Proposes an emotion-context-aware VR interaction pipeline that injects vocal emotion recognition into LLM dialogue context for embodied conversational agents, showing significant improvements in user studies.

entry.title: TA-GGAD: Testing-time Adaptive Graph Model for Generalist Graph Anomaly Detection

author.name: Xiong Zhang, Hong Peng, Changlong Fu, Xin Jin, Yun Yang, Cheng Xie

entry.summary: Proposes TA-GGAD for testing-time adaptive graph anomaly detection across domains, identifying and modeling the 'Anomaly Disassortativity' pattern caused by domain shift.

entry.title: MIL-PF: Multiple Instance Learning on Precomputed Features for Mammography Classification

author.name: Nikola Jovi\v{s}i\'c, Milica \v{S}kipina, Nicola Dall'Asen, Dubravko \'Culibrk

entry.summary: Proposes MIL-PF, a scalable framework combining frozen foundation encoders with a lightweight 40k-parameter MIL head for mammography classification on precomputed features.

entry.title: Investigating Gender Stereotypes in Large Language Models via Social Determinants of Health

author.name: Trung Hieu Ngo, Adrien Bazoge, Solen Quiniou, Pierre-Antoine Gourraud, Emmanuel Morin

entry.summary: Investigates gender stereotypes in French LLMs by probing relationships between gender and social determinants of health, finding that embedded stereotypes can be probed via SDoH input.

entry.title: Evolving Prompt Adaptation for Vision-Language Models

author.name: Enming Zhang, Jiayang Li, Yanru Wu, Zhenyu Liu, Yang Li

entry.summary: Proposes EvoPrompt, a framework for adapting vision-language models to downstream tasks while avoiding catastrophic forgetting of pre-trained knowledge. Uses a Modality-Shared Prompt Projector to generate hierarchical prompts from a unified embedding space.

entry.title: Ego: Embedding-Guided Personalization of Vision-Language Models

author.name: Soroush Seifi, Simon Gardier, Vaggelis Dorovatas, Daniel Olmeda Reino, Rahaf Aljundi

entry.summary: Proposes Ego, an efficient personalization method for vision-language models that extracts visual tokens representing target concepts by utilizing the model's inherent capabilities, without additional training stages or external modules.

entry.title: SCENEBench: An Audio Understanding Benchmark Grounded in Assistive and Industrial Use Cases

author.name: Laya Iyer, Angelina Wang, Sanmi Koyejo

entry.summary: Proposes SCENEBench, a benchmark for audio understanding beyond ASR, covering background sound understanding, noise localization, cross-linguistic speech, and vocal characterization, grounded in assistive and industrial use cases.

entry.title: Understanding the Use of a Large Language Model-Powered Guide to Make Virtual Reality Accessible for Blind and Low Vision People

author.name: Jazmin Collins, Sharon Y Lin, Tianqi Liu, Andrea Stevenson Won, Shiri Azenkot

entry.summary: Studies how blind and low vision users interact with an LLM-powered sighted guide in social VR, finding that users treated the guide as a tool when alone but companionably around others, giving it nicknames and encouraging social interaction.

entry.title: SPREAD: Subspace Representation Distillation for Lifelong Imitation Learning

author.name: Kaushik Roy, Giovanni D'urso, Nicholas Lawrance, Brendan Tidd, Peyman Moghadam

entry.summary: Proposes SPREAD, a geometry-preserving distillation framework for lifelong imitation learning that uses SVD to align policy representations across tasks within low-rank subspaces.

entry.title: When to Retrain after Drift: A Data-Only Test of Post-Drift Data Size Sufficiency

author.name: Ren Fujiwara, Yasuko Matsubara, Yasushi Sakurai

entry.summary: Proposes CALIPER, a model-agnostic test that estimates when sufficient post-drift data has accumulated for stable retraining, using weighted local regression and an effective sample size gate.

entry.title: Two Teachers Better Than One: Hardware-Physics Co-Guided Distributed Scientific Machine Learning

author.name: Yuchen Yuan, Junhuan Yang, Hao Wan, Yipei Liu, Hanhan Wu, Youzuo Lin, Lei Yang

entry.summary: Introduces EPIC, a hardware-physics co-guided distributed framework for scientific ML that performs lightweight local encoding on edge devices while preserving physical constraints, demonstrated on full-waveform inversion.

entry.title: From Weighting to Modeling: A Nonparametric Estimator for Off-Policy Evaluation

author.name: Rong J. B. Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes Nonparametric Weighting (NW) for off-policy evaluation in contextual bandits, addressing the high variance problem of inverse probability weighting without relying on reward modeling.

entry.title: Learning the Hierarchical Organization in Brain Network for Brain Disorder Diagnosis

author.name: Jingfeng Tang, Peng Cao, Guangqi Wen, Jinzhu Yang, Xiaoli Liu, Osmar R. Zaiane

entry.summary: Proposes BrainHO, a hierarchical attention mechanism for learning brain network organization from fMRI data, moving beyond predefined functional sub-networks. Captures cross-network interaction patterns for brain disorder diagnosis.

entry.title: Task Aware Modulation Using Representation Learning for Upsaling of Terrestrial Carbon Fluxes

author.name: Aleksei Rozanov, Arvind Renganathan, Vipin Kumar

entry.summary: Introduces TAM-RL for carbon flux upscaling, combining spatio-temporal representation learning with knowledge-guided architecture incorporating the carbon balance equation. Improves generalization across 150+ flux tower sites.

entry.title: Hebbian-Oscillatory Co-Learning

author.name: Hasi Hays

entry.summary: Introduces Hebbian-Oscillatory Co-Learning (HOC-L), coupling hyperbolic sparse geometry with Kuramoto-type oscillator attention in a two-timescale framework for bio-inspired neural architectures.

entry.title: Towards Reliable Simulation-based Inference

author.name: Arnaud Delaunoy

entry.summary: A thesis on reliable simulation-based inference, showing that ML-based statistical analyses introduce approximation errors and proposing methods for trustworthy uncertainty quantification.

entry.title: Flow Field Reconstruction via Voronoi-Enhanced Physics-Informed Neural Networks with End-to-End Sensor Placement Optimization

author.name: Renjie Xiao, Bingteng Sun, Yiling Chen, Lin Lu, Qiang Du, Junqiang Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes VSOPINN, combining physics-informed neural networks with differentiable Voronoi-based sensor placement optimization for flow field reconstruction from sparse sensor data.

entry.title: What Do We Care About in Bandits with Noncompliance? BRACE: Bandits with Recommendations, Abstention, and Certified Effects

author.name: Nicol\'as Della Penna

entry.summary: Formalizes the objective-choice problem in bandits with noncompliance, distinguishing recommendation welfare from treatment learning. Proposes BRACE, a parameter-free algorithm for finite-context problems.

entry.title: MultiGraSCCo: A Multilingual Anonymization Benchmark with Annotations of Personal Identifiers

author.name: Ibrahim Baroud, Christoph Otto, Vera Czehmann, Christine Hovhannisyan, Lisa Raithel, Sebastian M\"oller, Roland Roller

entry.summary: Creates a multilingual anonymization benchmark in ten languages using machine translation of validated synthetic clinical data, with annotations of personally identifiable information.

entry.title: VeriInteresting: An Empirical Study of Model Prompt Interactions in Verilog Code Generation

author.name: Luca Collini, Andrew Hennesee, Patrick Yubeaton, Siddharth Garg, Ramesh Karri

entry.summary: Provides an empirical study of LLM-prompt interactions for Verilog hardware code generation, evaluating multiple models across chain-of-thought, in-context learning, and evolutionary prompt optimization strategies.

entry.title: SkipGS: Post-Densification Backward Skipping for Efficient 3DGS Training

author.name: Jingxing Li, Yongjae Leeand, Deliang Fan

entry.summary: Proposes SkipGS for efficient 3DGS training by selectively skipping backward passes during post-densification refinement when sampled views show plateaued losses.

entry.title: Spectral-Structured Diffusion for Single-Image Rain Removal

author.name: Yucheng Xing, Xin Wang

entry.summary: Introduces SpectralDiff, a spectral-structured diffusion framework for single-image rain removal that uses structured spectral perturbations to guide progressive suppression of multi-directional rain components.

entry.title: RTFDNet: Fusion-Decoupling for Robust RGB-T Segmentation

author.name: Kunyu Tan, Mingjian Liang

entry.summary: Proposes RTFDNet for robust RGB-Thermal semantic segmentation that unifies fusion and decoupling in a three-branch encoder-decoder architecture to handle missing sensor signals.

entry.title: Geometry-Aware Metric Learning for Cross-Lingual Few-Shot Sign Language Recognition on Static Hand Keypoints

author.name: Chayanin Chamachot, Kanokphan Lertniponphan

entry.summary: Proposes a geometry-aware metric learning framework for cross-lingual few-shot sign language recognition using bone-angle features invariant to extrinsic viewpoint variations.

entry.title: Speeding Up the Learning of 3D Gaussians with Much Shorter Gaussian Lists

author.name: Jiaqi Liu, Zhizhong Han

entry.summary: Proposes training strategies to shorten Gaussian lists in 3DGS by resetting scales and introducing entropy constraints, speeding up splatting by involving fewer Gaussians per ray.

entry.title: Training-Free Coverless Multi-Image Steganography with Access Control

author.name: Minyeol Bae, Si-Hyeon Lee

entry.summary: MIDAS is a training-free diffusion-based coverless steganography framework that hides multiple images with user-specific access control via latent-level fusion. It introduces a Random Basis mechanism and Latent Vector Fusion for secure multi-user information hiding.

entry.title: A saccade-inspired approach to image classification using visiontransformer attention maps

author.name: Matthis Dallain, Laurent Rodriguez, Laurent Udo Perrinet, Beno\^it Miramond

entry.summary: Explores saccade-inspired image classification using DINO's attention maps to focus processing on key visual regions, drawing inspiration from human visual system's selective attention mechanism.

entry.title: TriFusion-SR: Joint Tri-Modal Medical Image Fusion and SR

author.name: Fayaz Ali Dharejo, Sharif S. M. A., Aiman Khalil, Nachiket Chaudhary, Rizwan Ali Naqvi, Radu Timofte

entry.summary: TriFusionSR proposes a wavelet-guided conditional diffusion framework for joint tri-modal medical image fusion and super-resolution, explicitly handling frequency domain imbalances across MRI, CT, and PET/SPECT.

entry.title: LAP: A Language-Aware Planning Model For Procedure Planning In Instructional Videos

author.name: Lei Shi, Victor Aregbede, Andreas Persson, Martin L\"angkvist, Amy Loutfi, Stephanie Lowry

entry.summary: LAP leverages language descriptions as more distinctive representations for procedure planning in instructional videos, using a fine-tuned VLM to translate visual observations into text for planning.

entry.title: Test-time Ego-Exo-centric Adaptation for Action Anticipation via Multi-Label Prototype Growing and Dual-Clue Consistency

author.name: Zhaofeng Shi, Heqian Qiu, Lanxiao Wang, Qingbo Wu, Fanman Meng, Lili Pan, Hongliang Li

entry.summary: Proposes the first test-time ego-exo adaptation method for action anticipation, adjusting source-view models online during testing using multi-label prototype growing and dual-clue consistency.

entry.title: Fine-grained Motion Retrieval via Joint-Angle Motion Images and Token-Patch Late Interaction

author.name: Yao Zhang, Zhuchenyang Liu, Yanlan He, Thomas Ploetz, Yu Xiao

entry.summary: Proposes an interpretable motion retrieval method using joint-angle-based pseudo-images compatible with pre-trained Vision Transformers and token-patch late interaction for fine-grained matching.

entry.title: NLiPsCalib: An Efficient Calibration Framework for High-Fidelity 3D Reconstruction of Curved Visuotactile Sensors

author.name: Xuhao Qin, Feiyu Zhao, Yatao Leng, Runze Hu, Chenxi Xiao

entry.summary: NLiPsCalib presents an efficient calibration framework for curved visuotactile sensors using physics-consistent near-field light modeling, reducing the need for expensive photometric data collection.

entry.title: FAME: Force-Adaptive RL for Expanding the Manipulation Envelope of a Full-Scale Humanoid

author.name: Niraj Pudasaini, Yutong Zhang, Jensen Lavering, Alessandro Roncone, Nikolaus Correll

entry.summary: Proposes FAME, a force-adaptive RL framework for humanoid robots that conditions standing balance policies on learned latent encodings of upper-body configuration and bimanual interaction forces. Expands the feasible manipulation envelope during whole-body tasks.

entry.title: STONE Dataset: A Scalable Multi-Modal Surround-View 3D Traversability Dataset for Off-Road Robot Navigation

author.name: Konyul Park, Daehun Kim, Jiyong Oh, Seunghoon Yu, Junseo Park, Jaehyun Park, Hongjae Shin, Hyungchan Cho, Jungho Kim, Jun Won Choi

entry.summary: Introduces STONE, a large-scale multi-modal dataset for off-road navigation featuring automated 3D traversability annotation, 128-channel LiDAR, 6 RGB cameras, and 3 4D radars across diverse conditions (day/night, various terrains). Addresses scalability and multi-modality gaps in existing datasets.

entry.title: Receptogenesis in a Vascularized Robotic Embodiment

author.name: Kadri-Ann Pankratov, Leonid Zinatullin, Hans Priks, Adele Metsniit, Urmas Johanson, Tarmo Tamm, Alvo Aabloo, Edoardo Sinibaldi, Indrek Must

entry.summary: Demonstrates 'receptogenesis' - the ability for a vascularized robotic system to synthesize new sensory hardware during operation through dynamic material restructuring via fluidics. Inspired by biological circulatory systems.

entry.title: NS-VLA: Towards Neuro-Symbolic Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Ziyue Zhu, Shangyang Wu, Shuai Zhao, Zhiqiu Zhao, Shengjie Li, Yi Wang, Fang Li, Haoran Luo

entry.summary: Proposes NS-VLA, a neuro-symbolic Vision-Language-Action framework combining symbolic encoding of vision-language features, symbolic solvers for action sequencing, and online RL for exploration beyond demonstrations. Aims to reduce data requirements and improve primitive reuse.

entry.title: The Operational Security Failure in Anthropic's RSP v3

author.name: Ugurcan Arikan

entry.summary: Argues that Anthropic's RSP v3 has a critical operational security flaw: by publishing detailed risk evaluation thresholds, escalation procedures, and mitigation strategies, it provides an adversarial AI with exactly the information needed to circumvent safety nets.

entry.title: Understanding Reasoning with Thought Anchors and Probes

author.name: JeaniceK

entry.summary: Applies thought anchor analysis techniques from a recent mechanistic interpretability paper to legal reasoning in LLMs. Finds thought anchors exist but center on fact retrieval rather than planning. Extracts interpretable reasoning chains.

entry.title: Explainable Innovation Engine: Dual-Tree Agent-RAG with Methods-as-Nodes and Verifiable Write-Back

author.name: Renwei Meng

entry.summary: Proposes an Explainable Innovation Engine that upgrades RAG knowledge units from text chunks to methods-as-nodes, with weighted provenance trees and hierarchical clustering for traceable, auditable synthesis operations.

entry.title: PRECEPT: Planning Resilience via Experience, Context Engineering & Probing Trajectories A Unified Framework for Test-Time Adaptation with Compositional Rule Learning and Pareto-Guided Prompt Evolution

author.name: Arash Shahmansoori

entry.summary: PRECEPT combines deterministic rule retrieval, conflict-aware Bayesian memory, and Pareto-guided prompt evolution for test-time adaptation of LLM agents. Claims to eliminate partial-match interpretation errors.

entry.title: When Learning Rates Go Wrong: Early Structural Signals in PPO Actor-Critic

author.name: Alberto Fern\'andez-Hern\'andez, Cristian P\'erez-Corral, Jose I. Mestre, Manuel F. Dolz, Jose Duato, Enrique S. Quintana-Ort\'i

entry.summary: Analyzes how learning rate choices affect PPO actor-critic training through the Overfitting-Underfitting Indicator (OUI), which tracks binary activation patterns to provide early structural signals of training instability.

entry.title: Dynamic Multi-period Experts for Online Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Seungha Hong, Sukang Chae, Suyeon Kim, Sanghwan Jang, Hwanjo Yu

entry.summary: Proposes DynaME for online time series forecasting that categorizes concept drift into Recurring and Emergent types, using specialized expert committees for recurring patterns and uncertainty-based detection for new patterns.

entry.title: LogoDiffuser: Training-Free Multilingual Logo Generation and Stylization via Letter-Aware Attention Control

author.name: Mingyu Kang, Hyein Seo, Yuna Jeong, Junhyeong Park, Yong Suk Choi

entry.summary: LogoDiffuser is a training-free method for multilingual logo generation using multimodal diffusion transformers, analyzing attention mechanisms to identify core tokens for character structure control.

entry.title: TRIP-Bag: A Portable Teleoperation System for Plug-and-Play Robotic Arms and Leaders

author.name: Noboru Myers, Sankalp Yamsani, Obin Kwon, Joohyung Kim

entry.summary: Proposes TRIP-Bag, a portable suitcase-contained teleoperation system for collecting robot manipulation demonstrations in diverse real-world settings. Setup time under 10 minutes, compatible with multiple robot arms, addressing the data collection bottleneck for learning-based policies.

entry.title: Robotic Scene Cloning:Advancing Zero-Shot Robotic Scene Adaptation in Manipulation via Visual Prompt Editing

author.name: Binyuan Huang, Yuqing Wen, Yucheng Zhao, Yaosi Hu, Tiancai Wang, Chang Wen Chen, Haoqiang Fan, Zhenzhong Chen

entry.summary: Proposes Robotic Scene Cloning (RSC), a method for adapting robot operation trajectories to new scenes via visual prompting and condition injection, enabling zero-shot scene-specific adaptation without on-site data collection.

entry.title: Kinodynamic Motion Retargeting for Humanoid Locomotion via Multi-Contact Whole-Body Trajectory Optimization

author.name: Xiaoyu Zhang, Steven Haener, Varun Madabushi, Maegan Tucker

entry.summary: Presents KDMR, a kinodynamic motion retargeting framework for humanoid locomotion that models retargeting as multi-contact whole-body trajectory optimization, enforcing rigid-body dynamics and contact constraints to eliminate artifacts like foot sliding.

entry.title: A Consensus-Driven Multi-LLM Pipeline for Missing-Person Investigations

author.name: Joshua Castillo, Ravi Mukkamala

entry.summary: Companion paper to Guardian system, presenting the multi-LLM pipeline component that uses consensus across multiple models for information extraction in missing-person investigations. Includes QLoRA-based fine-tuning on curated datasets.

entry.title: EPOCH: An Agentic Protocol for Multi-Round System Optimization

author.name: Zhanlin Liu, Yitao Li, Munirathnam Srikanth

entry.summary: EPOCH is an engineering protocol for multi-round system optimization that organizes optimization into baseline construction and iterative self-improvement phases with role-constrained stages separating planning, implementation, and evaluation.

entry.title: Cognitively Layered Data Synthesis for Domain Adaptation of LLMs to Space Situational Awareness

author.name: Ding Linghu, Cheng Wang, Da Fan, Wei Shi, Kaifeng Yin, Xiaoliang Xue, Fan Yang, Haiyi Ren, Cong Zhang

entry.summary: BD-FDG uses Bloom's Taxonomy to generate domain-specific fine-tuning data for space situational awareness, addressing incomplete knowledge coverage, shallow cognitive depth, and limited quality controllability in SFT datasets.

entry.title: Benchmarking Federated Learning in Edge Computing Environments: A Systematic Review and Performance Evaluation

author.name: Sales Aribe Jr., Gil Nicholas Cagande

entry.summary: Systematic review and benchmarking of federated learning techniques for edge computing, categorizing methods across optimization, communication, privacy, and architecture dimensions using standard datasets.

entry.title: Autonomous Edge-Deployed AI Agents for Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure Management

author.name: Mohammed Cherifi

entry.summary: Presents Auralink SDC for autonomous EV charging infrastructure management with edge-deployed AI agents, including confidence-calibrated autonomous resolution and adaptive retrieval-augmented reasoning.

entry.title: A Lightweight Multi-Cancer Tumor Localization Framework for Deployable Digital Pathology

author.name: Brian Isett, Rebekah Dadey, Aofei Li, Ryan C. Augustin, Kate Smith, Aatur D. Singhi, Qiangqiang Gu, Riyue Bao

entry.summary: Presents MuCTaL, a lightweight multi-cancer tumor localization model trained on balanced data from four cancer types that generalizes to unseen tumor types. Uses transfer learning with DenseNet on modest-scale training data.

entry.title: FedLECC: Cluster- and Loss-Guided Client Selection for Federated Learning under Non-IID Data

author.name: Daniel M. Jimenez-Gutierrez, Giovanni Giunta, Mehrdad Hassanzadeh, Aris Anagnostopoulos, Ioannis Chatzigiannakis, Andrea Vitaletti

entry.summary: Proposes FedLECC, a cluster-aware and loss-guided client selection strategy for federated learning under non-IID data conditions. Groups clients by label distribution and uses loss signals to guide selection.

entry.title: Improving through Interaction: Searching Behavioral Representation Spaces with CMA-ES-IG

author.name: Nathaniel Dennler, Zhonghao Shi, Yiran Tao, Andreea Bobu, Stefanos Nikolaidis, Maja Matari\'c

entry.summary: Proposes CMA-ES-IG algorithm for learning user preferences through robot behavior rankings, balancing preference learning optimization with user experience in the interaction process.

entry.title: AI Phenomenology for Understanding Human-AI Experiences Across Eras

author.name: Bhada Yun, Evgenia Taranova, Dana Feng, Renn Su, April Yi Wang

entry.summary: Proposes AI phenomenology as a research framework that asks 'How did it feel?' about human-AI interactions, arguing for capturing first-person experiences beyond standard performance metrics.

entry.title: Composed Vision-Language Retrieval for Skin Cancer Case Search via Joint Alignment of Global and Local Representations

author.name: Yuheng Wang, Yuji Lin, Dongrun Zhu, Jiayue Cai, Sunil Kalia, Harvey Lui, Chunqi Chang, Z. Jane Wang, Tim K. Lee

entry.summary: Proposes a transformer-based framework for composed vision-language retrieval in skin cancer diagnosis, combining reference lesion images with text descriptors for hierarchical query-candidate alignment.

entry.title: PM-Nav: Priori-Map Guided Embodied Navigation in Functional Buildings

author.name: Jiang Gao, Xiangyu Dong, Haozhou Li, Haoran Zhao, Yaoming Zhou, Xiaoguang Ma

entry.summary: Proposes PM-Nav for embodied navigation in functional buildings using environmental maps transformed into semantic priori-maps with hierarchical chain-of-thought prompting for path planning.

entry.title: QUSR: Quality-Aware and Uncertainty-Guided Image Super-Resolution Diffusion Model

author.name: Junjie Yin, Jiaju Li, Hanfa Xing

entry.summary: Proposes QUSR, a diffusion-based super-resolution model integrating quality-aware priors with uncertainty-guided noise generation for spatially adaptive processing of degraded images.

entry.title: PromptDLA: A Domain-aware Prompt Document Layout Analysis Framework with Descriptive Knowledge as a Cue

author.name: Zirui Zhang, Yaping Zhang, Lu Xiang, Yang Zhao, Feifei Zhai, Yu Zhou, Chengqing Zong

entry.summary: Introduces PromptDLA, a domain-aware prompter for document layout analysis that uses descriptive knowledge cues to integrate domain priors, addressing performance degradation when merging diverse DLA datasets.

entry.title: Declarative Scenario-based Testing with RoadLogic

author.name: Ezio Bartocci, Alessio Gambi, Felix Gigler, Cristinel Mateis, Dejan Ni\v{c}kovi\'c

entry.summary: Presents RoadLogic, bridging declarative OpenSCENARIO specifications and executable simulations for autonomous vehicle testing using Answer Set Programming for scenario generation.

entry.title: Temporal-Conditioned Normalizing Flows for Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection

author.name: David Baumgartner, Helge Langseth, Kenth Eng{\o}-Monsen, Heri Ramampiaro

entry.summary: Introduces temporal-conditioned normalizing flows (tcNF) for multivariate time series anomaly detection by conditioning flows on previous observations to capture temporal dependencies. The autoregressive approach enables detection of low-probability events with open-source code provided.

entry.title: GNNs for Time Series Anomaly Detection: An Open-Source Framework and a Critical Evaluation

author.name: Federico Bello, Gonzalo Chiarlone, Marcelo Fiori, Gast\'on Garc\'ia Gonz\'alez, Federico Larroca

entry.summary: Presents an open-source framework for time series anomaly detection using Graph Neural Networks, designed for reproducible experimentation across datasets, graph structures, and evaluation strategies with standardized metrics.

entry.title: ESAinsTOD: A Unified End-to-End Schema-Aware Instruction-Tuning Framework for Task-Oriented Dialog Modeling

author.name: Dechuan Teng, Chunlin Lu, Libo Qin, Wanxiang Che

entry.summary: Proposes ESAinsTOD, a unified end-to-end schema-aware instruction-tuning framework for task-oriented dialog that enables flexible adaptation to various dialogue task flows and schemas via instruction and schema alignment mechanisms.

entry.title: An accurate flatness measure to estimate the generalization performance of CNN models

author.name: Rahman Taleghani, Maryam Mohammadi, Francesco Marchetti

entry.summary: Develops an exact flatness measure for CNNs using closed-form Hessian trace computation for networks with global average pooling, showing strong correlation with generalization.

entry.title: Better Bounds for the Distributed Experts Problem

author.name: David P. Woodruff, Samson Zhou

entry.summary: Studies the distributed experts problem, providing improved communication-regret tradeoffs for distributed online learning where experts are spread across servers.

entry.title: Efficient Reasoning at Fixed Test-Time Cost via Length-Aware Attention Priors and Gain-Aware Training

author.name: Rian Atri

entry.summary: Proposes training-only components for efficient reasoning under tight compute: a length-aware attention prior (RPA) and a gain-aware controller (Guardian) that are disabled at inference time.

entry.title: Learning Bayesian and Markov Networks with an Unreliable Oracle

author.name: Juha Harviainen, Pekka Parviainen, Vidya Sagar Sharma

entry.summary: Studies structure learning of Markov and Bayesian networks when the conditional independence oracle is unreliable (bounded errors). Shows Markov networks can tolerate moderately exponential errors under certain graph conditions, while Bayesian networks cannot tolerate any errors even with bounded treewidth.

entry.title: Physics-informed neural operator for predictive parametric phase-field modelling

author.name: Nanxi Chen, Airong Chen, Rujin Ma

entry.summary: Develops PF-PINO, a physics-informed neural operator for parametric phase-field modeling that embeds phase-field PDE residuals into the loss function. Accelerates high-throughput parametric studies of material microstructure evolution.

entry.title: Performance Analysis of Edge and In-Sensor AI Processors: A Comparative Review

author.name: Luigi Capogrosso, Pietro Bonazzi, Michele Magno

entry.summary: Reviews ultra-low-power edge AI processors across SoCs, neural accelerators, and in-sensor architectures, benchmarking a 336M MAC segmentation model on three representative processors (GAP9, etc.).

entry.title: Robust Parameter and State Estimation in Multiscale Neuronal Systems Using Physics-Informed Neural Networks

author.name: Changliang Wei, Yangyang Wang, Xueyu Zhu

entry.summary: Develops a physics-informed neural network framework for joint state estimation and parameter inference in multiscale neuronal systems, addressing challenges from strong nonlinearities and fast-slow dynamics.

entry.title: Micro-Diffusion Compression -- Binary Tree Tweedie Denoising for Online Probability Estimation

author.name: Roberto Tacconelli

entry.summary: Presents Midicoth, a lossless compression system that uses a micro-diffusion denoising layer to improve probability estimates from adaptive statistical models like PPM, correcting prior smoothing through reverse denoising.

entry.title: Data-driven robust Markov decision processes on Borel spaces: performance guarantees via an axiomatic approach

author.name: Sivaramakrishnan Ramani

entry.summary: Studies robust MDPs on Borel spaces with unknown disturbance distributions, proving convergence of robust optimal value functions to true optimal value functions with increasing samples.

entry.title: The Costs of Reproducibility in Music Separation Research: a Replication of Band-Split RNN

author.name: Paul Magron, Romain Serizel, Constance Douwes

entry.summary: Attempts to replicate the Band-Split RNN (BSRNN) model for music source separation, conducting extensive experiments to match original results and reflecting on reproducibility challenges.

entry.title: Multi-DNN Inference of Sparse Models on Edge SoCs

author.name: Jiawei Luo, Di Wu, Simon Dobson, Blesson Varghese

entry.summary: Introduces model stitching for multi-DNN inference on edge SoCs, creating model variants by recombining subgraphs from sparse models without retraining. SparseLoom system reduces SLO violation rates.

entry.title: Global universality via discrete-time signatures

author.name: Mihriban Ceylan, David J. Pr\"omel

entry.summary: Establishes global universal approximation theorems for linear functionals of discrete-time signatures on piecewise linear paths, with applications to Brownian motion and SDEs.

entry.title: From Word2Vec to Transformers: Text-Derived Composition Embeddings for Filtering Combinatorial Electrocatalysts

author.name: Lei Zhang, Markus Stricker

entry.summary: Evaluates text-derived composition embeddings (Word2Vec vs transformer-based) for screening combinatorial electrocatalyst compositions. Uses similarity to property concepts as a label-free materials screening strategy.

entry.title: Where, What, Why: Toward Explainable 3D-GS Watermarking

entry.title: Research Summary: March 10, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
A strong day for AI safety and alignment research, with multiple papers exposing cracks in core assumptions behind current safety strategies.

  • The CoT-Control evaluation suite reveals reasoning models cannot reliably control their chain-of-thought, directly threatening the viability of CoT monitoring as a safety mechanism
  • Choice blindness experiments show 91% of surreptitiously swapped RLHF preferences go undetected by human annotators, undermining a foundational assumption of alignment-from-human-feedback
  • Countdown-Code provides a minimal testbed for precisely measuring reward hacking emergence in RLVR, while a separate audit finds LLM-as-Judge safety evaluations perform near coin-flip reliability under adversarial distribution shifts
  • The Disentangled Safety Hypothesis identifies separate Recognition and Execution axes governing LLM safety behavior, offering new mechanistic understanding

On the training and inference scaling front, a comprehensive taxonomy of Unsupervised RLVR methods maps how far RL post-training can scale without supervised data. A rigorous Sequential Monte Carlo analysis of parallel inference-time reasoning establishes theoretical foundations for pass@k and related strategies, while a complementary negative result shows consensus-based scaling fails to improve LLM truthfulness across five benchmarks.

  • Anthropic's lawsuit against the US Department of War over military deployment of Claude marks a landmark AI governance event
  • Google's AMIE diagnostic AI reports a prospective clinical feasibility study with 100 real patients in primary care

entry.title: Reasoning Models Struggle to Control their Chains of Thought

author.name: Chen Yueh-Han, Robert McCarthy, Bruce W. Lee, He He, Ian Kivlichan, Bowen Baker, Micah Carroll, Tomek Korbak

entry.summary: As covered in Research yesterday, Introduces CoT-Control evaluation suite measuring whether reasoning models can control what appears in their chain-of-thought. Finds that models like Claude Sonnet 4.5 can control CoT only 2.7% of the time vs 61.9% for final outputs, suggesting CoT monitoring remains viable for detecting misbehavior.

Establishes non-asymptotic guarantees, algorithmic improvements, and fundamental limits for accuracy-cost tradeoffs when using process reward models.

entry.title: Hierarchical Latent Structures in Data Generation Process Unify Mechanistic Phenomena across Scale

author.name: Jonas Rohweder, Subhabrata Dutta, Iryna Gurevych

entry.summary: Uses probabilistic context-free grammars (PCFGs) to generate synthetic training corpora that serve as tractable proxies for web-scale text, then investigates emergence of mechanistic phenomena (induction heads, function vectors, superposition) in transformers trained on these corpora.

entry.title: Covenant-72B: Pre-Training a 72B LLM with Trustless Peers Over-the-Internet

author.name: Joel Lidin, Amir Sarfi, Erfan Miahi, Quentin Anthony, Shivam Chauhan, Evangelos Pappas, Benjamin Th\'erien, Eugene Belilovsky, Samuel Dare

entry.summary: Describes Covenant-72B, a 72B parameter LLM trained through the largest collaborative globally distributed pre-training with open permissionless participation supported by blockchain protocol.

entry.title: SAHOO: Safeguarded Alignment for High-Order Optimization Objectives in Recursive Self-Improvement

author.name: Subramanyam Sahoo, Aman Chadha, Vinija Jain, Divya Chaudhary

entry.summary: Introduces SAHOO, a framework to monitor and control alignment drift in recursive self-improvement systems through three safeguards: Goal Drift Index, constraint preservation checks, and regression-risk quantification. Tested across 189 tasks.

entry.title: Proof-of-Guardrail in AI Agents and What (Not) to Trust from It

author.name: Xisen Jin, Michael Duan, Qin Lin, Aaron Chan, Zhenglun Chen, Junyi Du, Xiang Ren

entry.summary: Proposes proof-of-guardrail, a system using Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) to provide cryptographic proof that an AI agent's response went through a specific open-source guardrail, addressing falsely advertised safety measures.

entry.title: Restoring Linguistic Grounding in VLA Models via Train-Free Attention Recalibration

author.name: Ninghao Zhang, Bin Zhu, Shijie Zhou, Jingjing Chen

entry.summary: Reveals 'linguistic blindness' in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models where robots execute visually plausible actions while ignoring contradictory language instructions. Proposes a train-free attention recalibration method and introduces ICBench diagnostic benchmark.

entry.title: From Entropy to Calibrated Uncertainty: Training Language Models to Reason About Uncertainty

author.name: Azza Jenane, Nassim Walha, Lukas Kuhn, Florian Buettner

entry.summary: Proposes a three-stage pipeline to train LLMs to express calibrated uncertainty: computing entropy-based scores, calibrating via Platt scaling, then RL post-training to articulate uncertainty. Results show calibrated verbalized confidence.

entry.title: Safe Transformer: An Explicit Safety Bit For Interpretable And Controllable Alignment

author.name: Jingyuan Feng, Andrew Gambardella, Gouki Minegishi, Takeshi Kojima, Yusuke Iwasawa, Yutaka Matsuo

entry.summary: Proposes Safe Transformer, which adds an explicit safety bit (discrete information bottleneck) between transformer layers to make safety classification interpretable and controllable, separating safety decisions from content generation.

entry.title: Entropy-Aware On-Policy Distillation of Language Models

author.name: Woogyeol Jin, Taywon Min, Yongjin Yang, Swanand Ravindra Kadhe, Yi Zhou, Dennis Wei, Nathalie Baracaldo, Kimin Lee

entry.summary: Introduces entropy-aware on-policy distillation that augments reverse KL with forward KL when teacher entropy is high. Addresses the problem of reduced generation diversity and unstable learning signals in standard on-policy distillation.

entry.title: Context Channel Capacity: An Information-Theoretic Framework for Understanding Catastrophic Forgetting

author.name: Ran Cheng

entry.summary: Introduces Context Channel Capacity, an information-theoretic framework for catastrophic forgetting. Proves an Impossibility Triangle showing zero forgetting, online learning, and finite parameters cannot coexist for sequential learners.

entry.title: Reverse Distillation: Consistently Scaling Protein Language Model Representations

author.name: Darius Catrina, Christian Bepler, Samuel Sledzieski, Rohit Singh

entry.summary: Introduces Reverse Distillation for protein language models, decomposing large PLM representations into orthogonal subspaces guided by smaller models, creating nested Matryoshka-style embeddings that ensure monotonic scaling.

entry.title: Invisible Safety Threat: Malicious Finetuning for LLM via Steganography

author.name: Guangnian Wan, Xinyin Ma, Gongfan Fang, Xinchao Wang

entry.summary: Demonstrates a steganographic attack on LLM safety alignment where a finetuned model hides harmful responses within benign-looking text using steganographic encoding, appearing safe to human observers while covertly generating harmful content.

entry.title: Roots Beneath the Cut: Uncovering the Risk of Concept Revival in Pruning-Based Unlearning for Diffusion Models

author.name: Ci Zhang, Zhaojun Ding, Chence Yang, Jun Liu, Xiaoming Zhai, Shaoyi Huang, Beiwen Li, Xiaolong Ma, Jin Lu, Geng Yuan

entry.summary: Reveals that pruning-based unlearning in diffusion models leaks information about erased concepts through the locations of pruned weights. Designs a data-free, training-free attack that can revive supposedly erased concepts.

entry.title: Best-of-Tails: Bridging Optimism and Pessimism in Inference-Time Alignment

author.name: Hsiang Hsu, Eric Lei, Chun-Fu Chen

entry.summary: Formalizes the trade-off between optimistic (Best-of-N) and pessimistic approaches in inference-time LLM alignment through regret minimization, showing the optimal strategy depends on reward distribution tail behavior.

entry.title: ARC-AGI-2 Technical Report

author.name: Wallyson Lemes de Oliveira, Mekhron Bobokhonov, Matteo Caorsi, Aldo Podest\`a, Gabriele Beltramo, Luca Crosato, Matteo Bonotto, Federica Cecchetto, Hadrien Espic, Dan Titus Salajan, Stefan Taga, Luca Pana, Joe Carthy

entry.summary: Presents a transformer-based system for ARC-AGI-2 that combines neural inference with structure-aware priors and online task adaptation. Uses compact 125-token task encoding with modified LongT5 and principled augmentation based on group symmetries.

entry.title: OfficeQA Pro: An Enterprise Benchmark for End-to-End Grounded Reasoning

author.name: Krista Opsahl-Ong, Arnav Singhvi, Jasmine Collins, Ivan Zhou, Cindy Wang, Ashutosh Baheti, Owen Oertell, Jacob Portes, Sam Havens, Erich Elsen, Michael Bendersky, Matei Zaharia, Xing Chen

entry.summary: Introduces OfficeQA Pro, a benchmark for enterprise document reasoning over 89,000 pages of US Treasury Bulletins. Frontier LLMs including Claude Opus 4.6, GPT-5.4, and Gemini 3.1 Pro achieve less than 5% accuracy on parametric knowledge and less than 12% with web access.

entry.title: Stabilizing Reinforcement Learning for Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Jianyuan Zhong, Kaibo Wang, Ding Ding, Zijin Feng, Haoli Bai, Yang Xiang, Jiacheng Sun, Qiang Xu

entry.summary: Identifies why GRPO causes reward collapse in diffusion language models (dLLMs) — noisy importance ratio estimates bypass clipping — and proposes fixes including robust clipping and adaptive normalization to stabilize RL training.

entry.title: Skip to the Good Part: Representation Structure & Inference-Time Layer Skipping in Diffusion vs. Autoregressive LLMs

author.name: Raghavv Goel, Risheek Garrepalli, Sudhanshu Agrawal, Chris Lott, Mingu Lee, Fatih Porikli

entry.summary: Performs the first layer- and token-wise representational analysis comparing diffusion LLMs (LLaDA) with autoregressive models (Qwen2.5). Finds diffusion objectives produce more hierarchical abstractions with early-layer redundancy, enabling effective layer skipping.

entry.title: Depth Charge: Jailbreak Large Language Models from Deep Safety Attention Heads

author.name: Jinman Wu, Yi Xie, Shiqian Zhao, Xiaofeng Chen

entry.summary: Proposes SAHA, an attention-head-level jailbreak attack that targets deep, insufficiently aligned safety attention heads in open-source LLMs. Reveals vulnerabilities in deeper model components that shallow defenses miss.

entry.title: Spectral Conditioning of Attention Improves Transformer Performance

author.name: Hemanth Saratchandran, Simon Lucey

entry.summary: Provides theoretical analysis of transformer attention Jacobians and introduces spectral conditioning to reduce condition numbers. Shows improved performance as a drop-in replacement for existing attention mechanisms.

entry.title: Reforming the Mechanism: Editing Reasoning Patterns in LLMs with Circuit Reshaping

author.name: Zhenyu Lei, Qiong Wu, Jianxiong Dong, Yinhan He, Emily Dodwell, Yushun Dong, Jundong Li

entry.summary: Introduces Reasoning Editing, a paradigm for selectively modifying specific reasoning patterns in LLMs while preserving others. Discovers the Circuit-Interference Law governing how edits propagate through reasoning circuits.

entry.title: DeepFact: Co-Evolving Benchmarks and Agents for Deep Research Factuality

author.name: Yukun Huang, Leonardo F. R. Ribeiro, Momchil Hardalov, Bhuwan Dhingra, Markus Dreyer, Venkatesh Saligrama

entry.summary: Introduces DeepFact, an evolving benchmark for verifying claim-level factuality in deep research reports. Shows that even PhD-level experts achieve only 60.8% accuracy on verifiable claims, and proposes an Audit-then-Score mechanism where benchmark labels are explicitly revisable.

entry.title: The Fragility Of Moral Judgment In Large Language Models

author.name: Tom van Nuenen, Pratik S. Sachdeva

entry.summary: Introduces a perturbation framework showing LLM moral judgments are highly fragile - surface edits, perspective shifts, and persuasion cues can flip moral assessments while the underlying moral conflict remains constant. Tests on 2,939 AITA dilemmas.

entry.title: VLM-RobustBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Robustness of Vision-Language Models

author.name: Rohit Saxena, Alessandro Suglia, Pasquale Minervini

entry.summary: Comprehensive benchmark evaluating VLM robustness across 49 augmentation types, 133 corrupted settings, and 4 model families. Finds that visual severity is a weak predictor of difficulty and low-severity spatial perturbations can be more damaging.

entry.title: Stem: Rethinking Causal Information Flow in Sparse Attention

author.name: Lin Niu, Xin Luo, Linchuan Xie, Yifu Sun, Guanghua Yu, Jianchen Zhu, S Kevin Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes Stem, a plug-and-play sparse attention module that accounts for cumulative token dependency in causal architectures. Uses Token Position Importance scoring and adaptive sparsity allocation aligned with information flow.

entry.title: Physical Simulator In-the-Loop Video Generation

author.name: Lin Geng Foo, Mark He Huang, Alexandros Lattas, Stylianos Moschoglou, Thabo Beeler, Christian Theobalt

entry.summary: Introduces Physical Simulator In-the-loop Video Generation (PSIVG), integrating physics simulation into video diffusion to ensure objects obey gravity, inertia, and collision. Reconstructs 4D scenes from template videos and re-renders with physics constraints.

entry.title: Do Foundation Models Know Geometry? Probing Frozen Features for Continuous Physical Measurement

author.name: Yakov Pyotr Shkolnikov

entry.summary: Demonstrates that vision-language models encode continuous geometry (e.g., hand joint angles at 6.1° MAE) that their text pathway fails to express (20.0°). Shows this is a pathway-training deficit, not a representational one, as LoRA fine-tuning narrows the gap.

entry.title: COLD-Steer: Steering Large Language Models via In-Context One-step Learning Dynamics

author.name: Kartik Sharma, Rakshit S. Trivedi

entry.summary: Introduces COLD-Steer, a training-free activation steering framework that approximates the representational changes from gradient descent on in-context examples without actual parameter updates. Bridges sample-efficient and signal-extraction approaches.

entry.title: Evo: Autoregressive-Diffusion Large Language Models with Evolving Balance

author.name: Junde Wu, Minhao Hu, Jiayuan Zhu, Yuyuan Liu, Tianyi Zhang, Kang Li, Jingkun Chen, Jiazhen Pan, Min Xu, Yueming Jin

entry.summary: Introduces Evo, a model bridging autoregressive and diffusion-based language generation via a continuous latent trajectory framework where each token's semantic maturity controls whether AR or diffusion generation is used.

entry.title: Learning Quadruped Walking from Seconds of Demonstration

author.name: Ruipeng Zhang, Hongzhan Yu, Ya-Chien Chang, Chenghao Li, Henrik I. Christensen, Sicun Gao

entry.summary: Presents a principled analysis of why imitation learning for quadruped locomotion works in small data regimes, based on limit cycles and Poincaré return maps. Proposes a new method regulating latent-action alignment, confirmed by hardware experiments with just seconds of demonstration data.

entry.title: Spectral Discovery of Continuous Symmetries via Generalized Fourier Transforms

author.name: Pavan Karjol, Kumar Shubham, Prathosh AP

entry.summary: Proposes a spectral framework for discovering continuous symmetries using Generalized Fourier Transforms, detecting symmetries by identifying structured sparsity patterns in spectral decompositions.

entry.title: A Unified Framework for Knowledge Transfer in Bidirectional Model Scaling

author.name: Jianlu Shen, Fu Feng, Jiaze Xu, Yucheng Xie, Jiaqi Lv, Xin Geng

entry.summary: Proposes BoT (Bidirectional knowledge Transfer), the first unified framework for both small-to-large and large-to-small model scaling by treating weights as continuous signals with different discretizations.

entry.title: \$OneMillion-Bench: How Far are Language Agents from Human Experts?

author.name: Qianyu Yang, Yang Liu, Jiaqi Li, Jun Bai, Hao Chen, Kaiyuan Chen, Tiliang Duan, Jiayun Dong, Xiaobo Hu, Zixia Jia, Yang Liu, Tao Peng, Yixin Ren, Ran Tian, Zaiyuan Wang, Yanglihong Xiao, Gang Yao, Lingyue Yin, Ge Zhang, Chun Zhang, Jianpeng Jiao, Zilong Zheng, Yuan Gong

entry.summary: Introduces $OneMillion-Bench, a benchmark of 400 expert-curated tasks across Law, Finance, Industry, Healthcare, and Natural Science to evaluate LLM agents on economically consequential real-world professional scenarios requiring multi-step reasoning and tool use.

entry.title: Capacity-Aware Mixture Law Enables Efficient LLM Data Optimization

author.name: Jingwei Li, Xinran Gu, Jingzhao Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes CAMEL, a capacity-aware mixture scaling law that models the nonlinear interplay between model size and data mixture for LLM training, plus a loss-to-benchmark prediction law enabling end-to-end performance prediction.

entry.title: Reasoning as Compression: Unifying Budget Forcing via the Conditional Information Bottleneck

author.name: Fabio Valerio Massoli, Andrey Kuzmin, Arash Behboodi

entry.summary: Recasts efficient CoT reasoning as lossy compression under the Conditional Information Bottleneck principle, addressing the Markov violation caused by attention, and providing a theoretical framework for understanding budget forcing in LLM reasoning.

entry.title: Impermanent: A Live Benchmark for Temporal Generalization in Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Azul Garza, Ren\'ee Rosillo, Rodrigo Mendoza-Smith, David Salinas, Andrew Robert Williams, Arjun Ashok, Mononito Goswami, Jos\'e Mart\'in Ju\'arez

entry.summary: Introduces Impermanent, a live benchmark for time-series forecasting that evaluates models on continuously updated data streams rather than static splits, addressing data contamination concerns for foundation models. Enables study of temporal robustness and distributional shift.

entry.title: Variational Flow Maps: Make Some Noise for One-Step Conditional Generation

author.name: Abbas Mammadov, So Takao, Bohan Chen, Ricardo Baptista, Morteza Mardani, Yee Whye Teh, Julius Berner

entry.summary: Proposes Variational Flow Maps for conditional generation that learns optimal initial noise distributions rather than guiding sampling paths, enabling one-step conditional sampling via flow maps with a principled variational objective.

entry.title: Models as Lego Builders: Assembling Malice from Benign Blocks via Semantic Blueprints

author.name: Chenxi Li, Xianggan Liu, Dake Shen, Yaosong Du, Zhibo Yao, Hao Jiang, Linyi Jiang, Chengwei Cao, Jingzhe Zhang, RanYi Peng, Peiling Bai, Xiande Huang

entry.summary: Demonstrates StructAttack, a jailbreak framework for Large Vision-Language Models that decomposes harmful queries into benign-looking structured visual prompts (mind maps, tables) exploiting semantic slot filling vulnerabilities.

entry.title: Leaderboard Incentives: Model Rankings under Strategic Post-Training

author.name: Yatong Chen, Guanhua Zhang, Moritz Hardt

entry.summary: Models benchmarking as a Stackelberg game between benchmark designers and competing model developers, proving current benchmarks induce games without Nash equilibria and proposing contest-theoretic alternatives.

entry.title: Agentic Critical Training

author.name: Weize Liu, Minghui Liu, Sy-Tuyen Ho, Souradip Chakraborty, Xiyao Wang, Furong Huang

entry.summary: Proposes Agentic Critical Training (ACT), a reinforcement learning paradigm that trains LLM agents to identify better actions among alternatives, moving beyond imitation learning. Addresses the limitation that agents learn what to do but not why.

entry.title: How Much Do LLMs Hallucinate in Document Q&A Scenarios? A 172-Billion-Token Study Across Temperatures, Context Lengths, and Hardware Platforms

author.name: JV Roig

entry.summary: Massive-scale study of LLM hallucination in document QA: 172 billion tokens across 35 models, three context lengths, four temperatures, and three hardware platforms. Uses deterministic RIKER scoring methodology.

entry.title: CODA: Difficulty-Aware Compute Allocation for Adaptive Reasoning

author.name: Siye Wu, Jian Xie, Yikai Zhang, Yanghua Xiao

entry.summary: Formalizes adaptive reasoning as a utility maximization problem and proposes CODA, which allocates compute based on instance difficulty to avoid overthinking simple problems. Aligns reasoning depth with marginal accuracy gains versus incremental cost.

entry.title: LiveWorld: Simulating Out-of-Sight Dynamics in Generative Video World Models

author.name: Zicheng Duan, Jiatong Xia, Zeyu Zhang, Wenbo Zhang, Gengze Zhou, Chenhui Gou, Yefei He, Feng Chen, Xinyu Zhang, Lingqiao Liu

entry.summary: LiveWorld addresses the 'out-of-sight dynamics' problem in generative video world models, where objects freeze when leaving the camera view. Proposes a framework for persistent world state simulation even for unobserved regions.

entry.title: Overthinking Causes Hallucination: Tracing Confounder Propagation in Vision Language Models

author.name: Abin Shoby, Ta Duc Huy, Tuan Dung Nguyen, Minh Khoi Ho, Qi Chen, Anton van den Hengel, Phi Le Nguyen, Johan W. Verjans, Vu Minh Hieu Phan

entry.summary: Reveals that VLM hallucinations originate from intermediate layer convergence on incorrect hypotheses rather than final-layer signals, challenging existing detection approaches. Shows hallucinated tokens can exhibit peaked attention rather than low attention, inverting prior assumptions.

entry.title: Censored LLMs as a Natural Testbed for Secret Knowledge Elicitation

author.name: Bartosz Cywiński

entry.summary: Introduces a testbed using censored Chinese LLMs for studying honesty elicitation and lie detection techniques. Finds that removing chat templates, few-shot prompting, and fine-tuning on honesty data most reliably increase truthful responses, with techniques transferring to frontier models like DeepSeek-R1-0528 and Qwen3.5-397B.

entry.title: On the Reliability of AI Methods in Drug Discovery: Evaluation of Boltz-2 for Structure and Binding Affinity Prediction

author.name: Shunzhou Wan, Xibei Zhang, Xiao Xue, Peter V. Coveney

entry.summary: Evaluates Boltz-2, a biomolecular foundation model, on 38,000+ compounds for protein-ligand structure and binding affinity prediction. Compares against traditional docking and physics-based methods, providing sobering assessment of AI in drug discovery.

entry.title: Revisiting the (Sub)Optimality of Best-of-N for Inference-Time Alignment

author.name: Ved Sriraman, Adam Block

entry.summary: Revisits theoretical analysis of Best-of-N sampling for inference-time alignment under more practical assumptions. Challenges prior work suggesting BoN is statistically suboptimal, showing different conclusions under expected max reward vs expected true reward analysis.

entry.title: AI End-to-End Radiation Treatment Planning Under One Second

author.name: Simon Arberet, Riqiang Gao, Martin Kraus, Florin C. Ghesu, Wilko Verbakel, Mamadou Diallo, Anthony Magliari, Venkatesan Karuppusamy, Sushil Beriwal, REQUITE Consortium, Ali Kamen, Dorin Comaniciu

entry.summary: Introduces AIRT, an end-to-end deep learning framework that generates deliverable radiation therapy treatment plans from CT images in under one second, including leaf sequencing for VMAT.

entry.title: MoEless: Efficient MoE LLM Serving via Serverless Computing

author.name: Hanfei Yu, Bei Ouyang, Shwai He, Ang Li, Hao Wang

entry.summary: Proposes MoEless, using serverless computing to address expert load imbalance in MoE LLM serving. Dynamically allocates resources to overloaded experts using serverless functions to reduce latency and cost.

entry.title: NOBLE: Accelerating Transformers with Nonlinear Low-Rank Branches

author.name: Ethan Smith (Canva Research)

entry.summary: Introduces NOBLE, an architectural augmentation adding nonlinear low-rank branches to transformer linear layers for pretraining from scratch (not fine-tuning). Uses CosNet, a cosine-based nonlinearity, achieving improvements with minimal parameter overhead.

entry.title: vLLM Hook v0: A Plug-in for Programming Model Internals on vLLM

author.name: Ching-Yun Ko, Pin-Yu Chen

entry.summary: Presents vLLM Hook, an open-source plugin for vLLM that enables programming internal model states (attention patterns, activations) during inference, supporting test-time alignment and adversarial detection methods.

entry.title: FuzzingRL: Reinforcement Fuzz-Testing for Revealing VLM Failures

author.name: Jiajun Xu, Jiageng Mao, Ang Qi, Weiduo Yuan, Alexander Romanus, Helen Xia, Vitor Campagnolo Guizilini, Yue Wang

entry.summary: Proposes FuzzingRL, using reinforcement learning to automatically generate adversarial questions that trigger VLM failures. Combines vision and language fuzzing with adversarial RL fine-tuning of the question generator.

entry.title: CapTrack: Multifaceted Evaluation of Forgetting in LLM Post-Training

author.name: Lukas Thede, Stefan Winzeck, Zeynep Akata, Jonathan Richard Schwarz

entry.summary: Introduces CapTrack, a capability-centric framework for analyzing forgetting in LLM post-training that goes beyond accuracy metrics to capture behavioral drift including style, calibration, and user experience degradation.

entry.title: Scaling Agentic Capabilities, Not Context: Efficient Reinforcement Finetuning for Large Toolspaces

author.name: Karan Gupta, Pranav Vajreshwari, Yash Pandya, Raghav Magazine, Akshay Nambi, Ahmed Awadallah

entry.summary: Introduces ATLAS, a reinforcement finetuning framework enabling small language models to operate in large toolspaces by learning context control and execution as decisions, combining iterative tool loading with programmatic execution.

entry.title: Swimba: Switch Mamba Model Scales State Space Models

author.name: Zhixu Du, Krishna Teja Chitty-Venkata, Murali Emani, Venkatram Vishwanath, Hai Helen Li, Yiran Chen

entry.summary: Introduces Swimba (Switch Mamba), applying MoE to state space models by routing over expert-produced SSM streams while maintaining a single state trajectory, avoiding the compute scaling of naive MoE-SSM designs.

entry.title: Making LLMs Optimize Multi-Scenario CUDA Kernels Like Experts

author.name: Yuxuan Han, Meng-Hao Guo, Zhengning Liu, Wenguang Chen, Shi-Min Hu

entry.summary: Introduces MSKernelBench for evaluating LLM-driven CUDA kernel optimization across diverse domains beyond ML, and proposes an LLM-based optimization method that operates like expert programmers.

entry.title: Norm-Hierarchy Transitions in Representation Learning: When and Why Neural Networks Abandon Shortcuts

author.name: Truong Xuan Khanh, Truong Quynh Hoa

entry.summary: Introduces the Norm-Hierarchy Transition framework explaining when neural networks abandon shortcut features for structured representations during training with weight decay.

entry.title: A Unified View of Drifting and Score-Based Models

author.name: Chieh-Hsin Lai, Bac Nguyen, Naoki Murata, Yuhta Takida, Toshimitsu Uesaka, Yuki Mitsufuji, Stefano Ermon, Molei Tao

entry.summary: Presents a unified view connecting drifting models (one-step generators) with score-based diffusion models, showing drifting admits a score-based formulation on kernel-smoothed distributions.

entry.title: Helix: Evolutionary Reinforcement Learning for Open-Ended Scientific Problem Solving

author.name: Chang Su, Zhongkai Hao, Zhizhou Zhang, Zeyu Xia, Youjia Wu, Hang Su, Jun Zhu

entry.summary: Presents HELIX, combining evolutionary methods with RL for open-ended scientific problem solving. Uses hierarchical candidate pool with in-context learning and RL-guided search.

entry.title: Few Tokens, Big Leverage: Preserving Safety Alignment by Constraining Safety Tokens during Fine-tuning

author.name: Guoli Wang, Haonan Shi, Tu Ouyang, An Wang

entry.summary: Proposes PACT, a fine-tuning framework that preserves LLM safety alignment by constraining specific 'safety tokens' rather than applying model-wide interventions, preventing safety-alignment drift even with benign fine-tuning data.

entry.title: Lying to Win: Assessing LLM Deception through Human-AI Games and Parallel-World Probing

author.name: Arash Marioriyad, Ali Nouri, Mohammad Hossein Rohban, Mahdieh Soleymani Baghshah

entry.summary: Introduces a framework to elicit and quantify LLM deceptive behavior using a structured 20-Questions game with a 'parallel-world probing' mechanism that duplicates dialogue states to detect systematic false information provision.

entry.title: TDM-R1: Reinforcing Few-Step Diffusion Models with Non-Differentiable Reward

author.name: Yihong Luo, Tianyang Hu, Weijian Luo, Jing Tang

entry.summary: TDM-R1 enables reinforcement learning for few-step diffusion models with non-differentiable rewards, addressing a major limitation where existing RL approaches require differentiable reward models. Decouples learning into distribution matching and reward optimization.

entry.title: Prefill awareness: can LLMs tell when “their” message history has been tampered with?

author.name: David Africa

entry.summary: Tests whether LLMs can detect when their conversation history has been tampered with ('prefill awareness'). Finds this ability is inconsistent across models but strong in recent Claude models when prompted, creating a confound for off-policy alignment evaluations.

entry.title: Traversal-as-Policy: Log-Distilled Gated Behavior Trees as Externalized, Verifiable Policies for Safe, Robust, and Efficient Agents

author.name: Peiran Li, Jiashuo Sun, Fangzhou Lin, Shuo Xing, Tianfu Fu, Suofei Feng, Chaoqun Ni, Zhengzhong Tu

entry.summary: Proposes Traversal-as-Policy, distilling execution logs from sandboxed agent runs into executable Gated Behavior Trees with safety gates. Treats tree traversal rather than unconstrained LLM generation as the control policy.

entry.title: On the Value of Tokeniser Pretraining in Physics Foundation Models

author.name: Hadi Sotoudeh, Payel Mukhopadhyay, Ruben Ohana, Michael McCabe, Neil D. Lawrence, Shirley Ho, Miles Cranmer

entry.summary: Demonstrates that pretraining the tokenizer (encoder-decoder) separately before learning dynamics significantly improves accuracy and efficiency of physics foundation models, avoiding interference between representation learning and dynamics modeling.

entry.title: Energy-Driven Adaptive Visual Token Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language Models

author.name: Jialuo He, Huangxun Chen

entry.summary: Proposes E-AdaPrune, an energy-driven adaptive visual token pruning method for Vision-Language Models that determines token budget from the singular value spectrum of visual features. Achieves comparable performance with fewer tokens across nine benchmarks.

entry.title: Partial Policy Gradients for RL in LLMs

author.name: Puneet Mathur, Branislav Kveton, Subhojyoti Mukherjee, Viet Dac Lai

entry.summary: Proposes partial policy gradients for RL in LLMs, optimizing for subsets of future rewards to represent simpler policies that can be learned more reliably. Compares full planning, greedy, K-step lookahead, and segment policies on persona-alignment tasks.

entry.title: MAPO: Mixed Advantage Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon Multi-Turn Dialogue

author.name: Naifan Zhang, Ruihan Sun, Jinwei Su, Hengjie Yang, Zhengyuan Pan, Zhaohan Chen, Xiaofan Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes MAPO, a critic-free RL algorithm for multi-turn dialogue that uses dense process feedback from a judge model with Monte Carlo returns. Introduces mixed advantage estimation combining process and outcome signals.

entry.title: Agentic retrieval-augmented reasoning reshapes collective reliability under model variability in radiology question answering

author.name: Mina Farajiamiri, Jeta Sopa, Saba Afza, Lisa Adams, Felix Barajas Ordonez, Tri-Thien Nguyen, Mahshad Lotfinia, Sebastian Wind, Keno Bressem, Sven Nebelung, Daniel Truhn, Soroosh Tayebi Arasteh

entry.summary: Evaluates 34 LLMs on radiology questions comparing zero-shot vs. agentic retrieval-augmented reasoning. Studies how RAG pipelines affect collective model reliability and error synchronization under model variability.

entry.title: Dynamic Chunking Diffusion Transformer

author.name: Akash Haridas, Utkarsh Saxena, Parsa Ashrafi Fashi, Mehdi Rezagholizadeh, Vikram Appia, Emad Barsoum

entry.summary: Introduces Dynamic Chunking Diffusion Transformer (DC-DiT) that adaptively compresses 2D inputs into shorter token sequences based on information density, spending more compute on detailed regions and less on uniform areas.

entry.title: SUREON: A Benchmark and Vision-Language-Model for Surgical Reasoning

author.name: Alejandra Perez, Anita Rau, Lee White, Busisiwe Mlambo, Chinedu Nwoye, Muhammad Abdullah Jamal, Omid Mohareri

entry.summary: Introduces SUREON, a large-scale surgical reasoning video QA dataset harvested from surgical video lectures, and a corresponding VLM. Captures surgical intent, rationale, and anticipation from expert narrations.

entry.title: Grouter: Decoupling Routing from Representation for Accelerated MoE Training

author.name: Yuqi Xu, Rizhen Hu, Zihan Liu, Mou Sun, Kun Yuan

entry.summary: Proposes Grouter, which distills routing structures from fully-trained MoE models and uses them as fixed routers for new models, decoupling structural optimization from weight updates to accelerate MoE training convergence.

entry.title: Orion: Characterizing and Programming Apple's Neural Engine for LLM Training and Inference

author.name: Ramchand Kumaresan

entry.summary: Presents Orion, the first system for directly programming Apple's Neural Engine (ANE) for LLM training and inference, bypassing CoreML via private APIs. Catalogs 20 ANE restrictions and enables on-device training with checkpoint resume.

entry.title: wDPO: Winsorized Direct Preference Optimization for Robust LLM Alignment

author.name: Jilong Liu, Yonghui Yang, Pengyang Shao, Haokai Ma, Wei Qin, Richang Hong

entry.summary: Proposes wDPO (Winsorized DPO) that addresses noisy preference data by distinguishing between different noise types and applying targeted interventions rather than uniform regularization.

entry.title: Rethinking Deep Research from the Perspective of Web Content Distribution Matching

author.name: Zixuan Yu, Zhenheng Tang, Tongliang Liu, Chengqi Zhang, Xiaowen Chu, Bo Han

entry.summary: Proposes WeDas, a framework for deep research agents that incorporates web content distribution awareness into query formulation. Introduces Query-Result Alignment Score and few-shot probing for better search.

entry.title: Learning Concept Bottleneck Models from Mechanistic Explanations

author.name: Antonio De Santis, Schrasing Tong, Marco Brambilla, Lalana Kagal

entry.summary: Introduces Mechanistic CBM (M-CBM) that builds concept bottleneck models from a black-box model's own learned concepts extracted via mechanistic interpretability, rather than human-specified concepts.

entry.title: ConfHit: Conformal Generative Design with Oracle Free Guarantees

author.name: Siddhartha Laghuvarapu, Ying Jin, Jimeng Sun

entry.summary: Introduces ConfHit, a conformal prediction framework for generative drug design that provides distribution-free guarantees on generating at least one hit molecule under budget constraints and distribution shift.

entry.title: Discrete Tokenization Unlocks Transformers for Calibrated Tabular Forecasting

author.name: Yael S. Elmatad

entry.summary: Shows that discrete tokenization of tabular features with Gaussian label smoothing enables transformers to outperform tuned XGBoost by 10.8% on large-scale tabular forecasting.

entry.title: MJ1: Multimodal Judgment via Grounded Verification

author.name: Bhavesh Kumar, Dylan Feng, Leonard Tang

entry.summary: Presents MJ1, a 3B-parameter multimodal judge trained with RL that enforces visual grounding through structured verification chains and counterfactual consistency rewards, surpassing much larger models like Gemini-3-Pro on MMRB2.

entry.title: On the Generalization Capacities of MLLMs for Spatial Intelligence

author.name: Gongjie Zhang, Wenhao Li, Quanhao Qian, Jiuniu Wang, Deli Zhao, Shijian Lu, Ran Xu

entry.summary: Demonstrates that multimodal LLMs processing RGB-only inputs for 3D tasks fundamentally cannot generalize across cameras, and proposes Camera-Aware MLLM that injects camera intrinsics to learn generalizable spatial reasoning.

entry.title: How Private Are DNA Embeddings? Inverting Foundation Model Representations of Genomic Sequences

author.name: Sofiane Ouaari, Jules Kreuer, Nico Pfeifer

entry.summary: Evaluates privacy risks of DNA foundation model embeddings by testing model inversion attacks that reconstruct genomic sequences from embeddings, questioning the safety of Embeddings-as-a-Service frameworks.

entry.title: Can Safety Emerge from Weak Supervision? A Systematic Analysis of Small Language Models

author.name: Punyajoy Saha, Sudipta Halder, Debjyoti Mondal, Subhadarshi Panda

entry.summary: Introduces Self-MOA, a fully automated safety alignment framework for small language models using weak supervision from automated evaluators, operating as a closed loop of red-teaming, preference construction, and alignment.

entry.title: Shorter Thoughts, Same Answers: Difficulty-Scaled Segment-Wise RL for CoT Compression

author.name: Ye Tian, Aijun Liu

entry.summary: Proposes DSS-GRPO for compressing chain-of-thought reasoning traces while preserving answer quality, using difficulty-scaled segment-wise rewards that separately handle think and answer portions of model outputs.

entry.title: The Struggle Between Continuation and Refusal: A Mechanistic Analysis of the Continuation-Triggered Jailbreak in LLMs

author.name: Yonghong Deng, Zhen Yang, Ping Jian, Xinyue Zhang, Zhongbin Guo, Chengzhi Li

entry.summary: Conducts mechanistic interpretability analysis of continuation-triggered jailbreaks in LLMs, examining attention heads and residual stream components to understand why relocating continuation-triggered suffixes increases jailbreak success.

entry.title: "Dark Triad" Model Organisms of Misalignment: Narrow Fine-Tuning Mirrors Human Antisocial Behavior

author.name: Roshni Lulla, Fiona Collins, Sanaya Parekh, Thilo Hagendorff, Jonas Kaplan

entry.summary: Proposes using the Dark Triad personality framework (narcissism, psychopathy, Machiavellianism) to create 'model organisms' of misalignment in LLMs through narrow fine-tuning. Draws parallel between biological antisocial behavior and artificial misalignment.

entry.title: A Systematic Investigation of Document Chunking Strategies and Embedding Sensitivity

author.name: Muhammad Arslan Shaukat, Muntasir Adnan, Carlos C. N. Kuhn

entry.summary: Presents the first large-scale cross-domain evaluation of 36 document chunking strategies for dense retrieval, benchmarked across six domains and five embedding models. Finds content-aware chunking significantly outperforms naive fixed-length splitting.

entry.title: Toward Robust LLM-Based Judges: Taxonomic Bias Evaluation and Debiasing Optimization

author.name: Hongli Zhou, Hui Huang, Rui Zhang, Kehai Chen, Bing Xu, Conghui Zhu, Tiejun Zhao, Muyun Yang

entry.summary: Proposes JudgeBiasBench, a benchmark for systematically quantifying biases in LLM-based judges across 4 dimensions and 12 bias types. Includes a controlled bias injection pipeline covering both generative and discriminative judge formulations.

entry.title: LieCraft: A Multi-Agent Framework for Evaluating Deceptive Capabilities in Language Models

author.name: Matthew Lyle Olson, Neale Ratzlaff, Musashi Hinck, Tri Nguyen, Vasudev Lal, Joseph Campbell, Simon Stepputtis, Shao-Yen Tseng

entry.summary: Presents LieCraft, a multi-agent framework for evaluating LLM deception capabilities using a multiplayer hidden-role game where players choose ethical alignments and execute long-horizon strategies. Enables measuring deceptive behavior in realistic settings.

entry.title: SoK: Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG): Taxonomy, Architectures, Evaluation, and Research Directions

author.name: Saroj Mishra, Suman Niroula, Umesh Yadav, Dilip Thakur, Srijan Gyawali, Shiva Gaire

entry.summary: Provides the first systematic framework for Agentic RAG, formalizing agent retrieval-generation loops as POMDPs. Offers a unified taxonomy, architecture classification, and evaluation methodology for autonomous retrieval systems.

entry.title: How Long Can Unified Multimodal Models Generate Images Reliably? Taming Long-Horizon Interleaved Image Generation via Context Curation

author.name: Haoyu Chen, Qing Liu, Yuqian Zhou, He Zhang, Zhaowen Wang, Mengwei Ren, Jingjing Ren, Xiang Wang, Zhe Lin, Lei Zhu

entry.summary: Investigates why unified multimodal models fail in long-horizon interleaved image generation, revealing visual history acts as 'active pollution' proportional to image events rather than token count, and proposes context curation solutions.

entry.title: Holi-Spatial: Evolving Video Streams into Holistic 3D Spatial Intelligence

author.name: Yuanyuan Gao, Hao Li, Yifei Liu, Xinhao Ji, Yuning Gong, Yuanjun Liao, Fangfu Liu, Manyuan Zhang, Yuchen Yang, Dan Xu, Xue Yang, Huaxi Huang, Hongjie Zhang, Ziwei Liu, Xiao Sun, Dingwen Zhang, Zhihang Zhong

entry.summary: Holi-Spatial is the first fully automated large-scale spatially-aware multimodal dataset constructed from raw video without human intervention. Proposes a data curation pipeline that systematically annotates 3D scenes from web video data.

entry.title: Investigating encoded reasoning in LLMs

author.name: lbernick

entry.summary: Investigates whether LLMs' chain-of-thought reasoning reflects their internal states by constraining CoT via prompting and logit masking, and examining RL optimization pressure on CoT. Finds constrained reasoning still outperforms no reasoning, raising monitorability concerns.

entry.title: Mapping AI Capabilities to Human Expertise on the Rosetta Stone (Epoch Capabilities Index)

author.name: Laura Domenech

entry.summary: Maps AI capabilities to human expertise levels using the Epoch AI Rosetta Stone framework augmented with human performance baselines. Finds frontier models have crossed PhD-level expert performance on technical/scientific benchmarks.

entry.title: Measuring the Dark Energy of AI Progress
