author.name: Hans Gundlach

entry.summary: Analyzes NanoGPT speedrun competition data to measure algorithmic progress. Finds FLOP improvements track wall-clock time well, and algorithmic progress at fixed data/size is ~1.6x per year—smaller than some previous estimates.

entry.title: Stochastic Attention via Langevin Dynamics on the Modern Hopfield Energy

author.name: Abdulrahman Alswaidan, Jeffrey D. Varner

entry.summary: Shows that standard attention is one gradient descent step on a Hopfield energy, and that Langevin sampling from this energy yields stochastic attention — a training-free sampler controlled by temperature that balances retrieval and generation.

entry.title: DualSpec: Accelerating Deep Research Agents via Dual-Process Action Speculation

author.name: Shuzhang Zhong, Baotong Lu, Qi Chen, Chuanjie Liu, Fan Yang, Meng Li

entry.summary: Proposes DualSpec for accelerating deep research agents through dual-process action speculation, with different strategies for Search vs Visit actions based on their different reasoning requirements.

entry.title: ConflictBench: Evaluating Human-AI Conflict via Interactive and Visually Grounded Environments

author.name: Weixiang Zhao, Haozhen Li, Yanyan Zhao, xuda zhi, Yongbo Huang, Hao He, Bing Qin, Ting Liu

entry.summary: Introduces ConflictBench for evaluating human-AI conflict through 150 multi-turn scenarios with a text-based simulation engine and visual grounding. Finds agents prioritize self-preservation over safety when human harm isn't immediate.

entry.title: SR-TTT: Surprisal-Aware Residual Test-Time Training

author.name: Swamynathan V P

entry.summary: Proposes SR-TTT, which fixes the exact-recall failure of Test-Time Training language models by adding a loss-gated sparse memory mechanism that preserves surprising or unique tokens from being overwritten.

entry.title: Is continuous CoT better suited for multi-lingual reasoning?

author.name: Ali Hamza Bashir, Behzad Shomali, Markus Frey, Mehdi Ali, Rafet Sifa, David Berghaus

entry.summary: Investigates whether continuous chain-of-thought reasoning in latent space (CODI framework) provides better multilingual capabilities than explicit CoT, finding significant advantages for low-resource languages with 29-50x compression.

entry.title: Deep Research, Shallow Evaluation: A Case Study in Meta-Evaluation for Long-Form QA Benchmarks

author.name: Jena D. Hwang, Varsha Kishore, Amanpreet Singh, Dany Haddad, Aakanksha Naik, Malachi Hamada, Jonathan Bragg, Mike D'Arcy, Daniel S. Weld, Lucy Lu Wang, Doug Downey, Sergey Feldman

entry.summary: Conducts a meta-evaluation case study for long-form QA benchmarks, showing that human pairwise preferences are overly simplistic for evaluating deep research systems. Uses ScholarQA-CS2 to comprehensively validate benchmark methodology.

entry.title: CoTJudger: A Graph-Driven Framework for Automatic Evaluation of Chain-of-Thought Efficiency and Redundancy in LRMs

author.name: Siyi Li, Jiajun Shi, Shiwen Ni, Ge Zhang, Shuaimin Li, Shijian Wang, Zhoufutu Wen, Yizhi Li, Hamid Alinejad-Rokny, Jiaheng Liu, Min Yang, Wenhao Huang

entry.summary: Introduces CoTJudger, a graph-driven framework that converts chain-of-thought traces into directed dependency graphs to measure reasoning efficiency. Identifies the Shortest Effective Path needed to reach a correct solution, quantifying redundancy.

entry.title: The World Won't Stay Still: Programmable Evolution for Agent Benchmarks

author.name: Guangrui Li, Yaochen Xie, Yi Liu, Ziwei Dong, Xingyuan Pan, Tianqi Zheng, Jason Choi, Michael J. Morais, Binit Jha, Shaunak Mishra, Bingrou Zhou, Chen Luo, Monica Xiao Cheng, Dawn Song

entry.summary: Proposes ProEvolve, a graph-based framework for programmably evolving agent benchmark environments to test agent robustness to dynamic real-world changes. Uses typed relational graphs to represent environments and systematically mutate schemas, tools, and data.

entry.title: Omni-C: Compressing Heterogeneous Modalities into a Single Dense Encoder

author.name: Kin Wai Lau, Yasar Abbas Ur Rehman, Lai-Man Po, Pedro Porto Buarque de Gusm\~ao

entry.summary: Proposes Omni-C, a single dense Transformer encoder that learns shared representations across images, audio, and text through unimodal contrastive pretraining. Avoids the parameter inflation of Mixture-of-Expert multimodal approaches.

entry.title: When AI Levels the Playing Field: Skill Homogenization, Asset Concentration, and Two Regimes of Inequality

author.name: Xupeng Chen, Shuchen Meng

entry.summary: Formalizes how generative AI simultaneously homogenizes skills (leveling the playing field) while shifting economic value toward concentrated complementary assets, potentially widening aggregate inequality despite equalizing individual performance.

entry.title: Tool-Genesis: A Task-Driven Tool Creation Benchmark for Self-Evolving Language Agent

author.name: Bowei Xia, Mengkang Hu, Shijian Wang, Jiarui Jin, Wenxiang Jiao, Yuan Lu, Kexin Li, Ping Luo

entry.summary: Proposes Tool-Genesis, a diagnostic benchmark for evaluating language agents' tool creation capabilities across interface compliance, functional correctness, and downstream utility. Addresses limitations of black-box evaluation in existing benchmarks.

entry.title: RACAS: Controlling Diverse Robots With a Single Agentic System

author.name: Dylan R. Ashley, Jan Przepi\'ora, Yimeng Chen, Ali Abualsaud, Nurzhan Yesmagambet, Shinkyu Park, Eric Feron, J\"urgen Schmidhuber

entry.summary: Introduces RACAS, a robot-agnostic control architecture where three LLM/VLM-based modules communicate through natural language for closed-loop robot control. Requires only a natural language description of the API to control diverse robots.

entry.title: When Rubrics Fail: Error Enumeration as Reward in Reference-Free RL Post-Training for Virtual Try-On

author.name: Wisdom Ikezogwo, Mehmet Saygin Seyfioglu, Ranjay Krishna, Karim Bouyarmane

entry.summary: Proposes Implicit Error Counting (IEC) for RL post-training in reference-free settings like virtual try-on, where multiple valid outputs exist. Instead of checking correctness against rubrics, IEC enumerates errors with severity-weighted scoring.

entry.title: RAC: Rectified Flow Auto Coder

author.name: Sen Fang, Yalin Feng, Yanxin Zhang, Dimitris N. Metaxas

entry.summary: Proposes Rectified Flow Auto Coder (RAC), replacing traditional VAEs with a rectified flow-based approach that supports multi-step decoding, bidirectional inference (reducing parameters by 41%), and improved generation quality.

entry.title: Domain-Adaptive Model Merging across Disconnected Modes

author.name: Junming Liu, Yusen Zhang, Rongchao Zhang, Wenkai Zhu, Tian Wu

entry.summary: Presents DMM, a data-free model merging framework for highly divergent domain-specific models. Uses pseudo-data synthesis from normalization statistics and knowledge distillation to merge models that can't be merged via standard weight-averaging techniques.

entry.title: TADPO: Reinforcement Learning Goes Off-road

author.name: Zhouchonghao Wu, Raymond Song, Vedant Mundheda, Luis E. Navarro-Serment, Christof Schoenborn, Jeff Schneider

entry.summary: Introduces TADPO, a policy gradient method extending PPO for off-road autonomous driving. Uses teacher-guided off-policy trajectories combined with on-policy student exploration for vision-based end-to-end driving in challenging terrain.

entry.title: Lifelong Embodied Navigation Learning

author.name: Xudong Wang, Jiahua Dong, Baichen Liu, Qi Lyu, Lianqing Liu, Zhi Han

entry.summary: Formalizes lifelong embodied navigation learning (LENL) and proposes Uni-Walker, a framework using Decoder Extension LoRA to decouple task-shared and task-specific navigation knowledge, addressing catastrophic forgetting.

entry.title: Reflective Flow Sampling Enhancement

author.name: Zikai Zhou, Muyao Wang, Shitong Shao, Lichen Bai, Haoyi Xiong, Bo Han, Zeke Xie

entry.summary: Proposes Reflective Flow Sampling (RF-Sampling), a training-free inference enhancement framework for flow-matching text-to-image models like FLUX, bridging the gap where existing enhancement techniques fail on flow models.

entry.title: CRIMSON: A Clinically-Grounded LLM-Based Metric for Generative Radiology Report Evaluation

author.name: Mohammed Baharoon, Thibault Heintz, Siavash Raissi, Mahmoud Alabbad, Mona Alhammad, Hassan AlOmaish, Sung Eun Kim, Oishi Banerjee, Pranav Rajpurkar

entry.summary: Introduces CRIMSON, a clinically-grounded evaluation framework for chest X-ray report generation that incorporates clinical context, error taxonomy, and significance levels. Prevents normal findings from dominating scores.

entry.title: Whisper-CD: Accurate Long-Form Speech Recognition using Multi-Negative Contrastive Decoding

author.name: Hoseong Ahn, Jeongyun Chae, Yoonji Park, Kyuhong Shim

entry.summary: Proposes Whisper-CD, a training-free contrastive decoding framework for Whisper that contrasts clean audio against acoustically perturbed negatives to reduce hallucinations, repetitions, and omissions in long-form speech recognition.

entry.title: HiPP-Prune: Hierarchical Preference-Conditioned Structured Pruning for Vision-Language Models

author.name: Lincen Bai, Hedi Tabia, Raul Santos-Rodriguez

entry.summary: Introduces HiPP-Prune, a hierarchical preference-conditioned structured pruning framework for VLMs that treats pruning as conditional resource allocation under multiple objectives, including reducing hallucinations.

entry.title: K-MaT: Knowledge-Anchored Manifold Transport for Cross-Modal Prompt Learning in Medical Imaging

author.name: Jiajun Zeng, Shadi Albarqouni

entry.summary: Proposes K-MaT, a prompt-learning framework for cross-modal medical imaging transfer using Fused Gromov-Wasserstein optimal transport. Transfers knowledge from high-end imaging (CT) to low-end modalities (radiography) without low-end training images.

entry.title: Artificial Intelligence for Detecting Fetal Orofacial Clefts and Advancing Medical Education

author.name: Yuanji Zhang, Yuhao Huang, Haoran Dou, Xiliang Zhu, Chen Ling, Zhong Yang, Lianying Liang, Jiuping Li, Siying Liang, Rui Li, Yan Cao, Yuhan Zhang, Jiewei Lai, Yongsong Zhou, Hongyu Zheng, Xinru Gao, Cheng Yu, Liling Shi, Mengqin Yuan, Honglong Li, Xiaoqiong Huang, Chaoyu Chen, Jialin Zhang, Wenxiong Pan, Alejandro F. Frangi, Guangzhi He, Xin Yang, Yi Xiong, Linliang Yin, Xuedong Deng, Dong Ni

entry.summary: Multi-hospital study (22 hospitals, 45,139 images) of AI for detecting fetal orofacial clefts via ultrasound, achieving >93% sensitivity and >95% specificity matching senior radiologists. When used as copilot, raises junior radiologists' performance.

entry.title: BEVLM: Distilling Semantic Knowledge from LLMs into Bird's-Eye View Representations

author.name: Thomas Monninger, Shaoyuan Xie, Qi Alfred Chen, Sihao Ding

entry.summary: Proposes BEVLM, distilling semantic knowledge from LLMs into Bird's-Eye View representations for autonomous driving, addressing the disconnect between LLM reasoning and spatial 3D understanding.

entry.title: Know When You're Wrong: Aligning Confidence with Correctness for LLM Error Detection

author.name: Xie Xiaohu, Liu Xiaohu, Yao Benjamin

entry.summary: Introduces a normalized confidence score based on anchor token probabilities for detecting LLM errors and hallucinations, tested across seven benchmarks and five LLMs. Enables lightweight error detection without external validation.

entry.title: RACER: Risk-Aware Calibrated Efficient Routing for Large Language Models

author.name: Sai Hao, Hao Zeng, Hongxin Wei, Bingyi Jing

entry.summary: Formulates LLM routing as an α-VOR problem and proposes RACER, which outputs calibrated model sets with controlled misrouting risk, using concentration bounds for threshold calibration. Supports variable set sizes and abstention.

entry.title: HEARTS: Benchmarking LLM Reasoning on Health Time Series

author.name: Sirui Li, Shuhan Xiao, Mihir Joshi, Ahmed Metwally, Daniel McDuff, Wei Wang, Yuzhe Yang

entry.summary: Introduces HEARTS, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating LLM reasoning over health time series, integrating 16 datasets across 12 health domains with 110 tasks spanning perception, inference, generation, and decision-making.

entry.title: Property-driven Protein Inverse Folding With Multi-Objective Preference Alignment

author.name: Xiaoyang Hou, Junqi Liu, Chence Shi, Xin Liu, Zhi Yang, Jian Tang

entry.summary: Introduces ProtAlign, a multi-objective preference alignment framework for protein inverse folding that fine-tunes models to satisfy multiple developability objectives (solubility, thermostability) while preserving structural fidelity using DPO.

entry.title: NEST: Network- and Memory-Aware Device Placement For Distributed Deep Learning

author.name: Irene Wang, Vishnu Varma Venkata, Arvind Krishnamurthy, Divya Mahajan

entry.summary: Presents NEST, a device placement framework for distributed deep learning that jointly optimizes parallelism strategy, memory feasibility, and network topology via structured dynamic programming.

entry.title: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Submodular Reward

author.name: Wenjing Chen, Chengyuan Qian, Shuo Xing, Yi Zhou, Victoria Crawford

entry.summary: Provides the first formal framework for cooperative MARL with submodular rewards (capturing diminishing returns), developing algorithms with provable 1/2-approximation guarantees and polynomial complexity in the number of agents.

entry.title: NePPO: Near-Potential Policy Optimization for General-Sum Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Addison Kalanther, Sanika Bharvirkar, Shankar Sastry, Chinmay Maheshwari

entry.summary: Proposes NePPO, a multi-agent RL pipeline for computing approximate Nash equilibria in mixed cooperative-competitive environments. Learns a player-independent potential function to guide learning in general-sum games where convergence is typically hard.

entry.title: Dreamer-CDP: Improving Reconstruction-free World Models Via Continuous Deterministic Representation Prediction

author.name: Michael Hauri, Friedemann Zenke

entry.summary: Introduces a JEPA-style predictor for reconstruction-free world models in model-based RL, closing the gap between reconstruction-free methods and Dreamer on the Crafter benchmark.

entry.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Predicting Cellular Responses to Gene Perturbation

author.name: Andrea Giuseppe Di Francesco, Andrea Rubbi, Pietro Li\`o

entry.summary: Introduces PT-RAG, a retrieval-augmented generation framework adapted from NLP to cellular biology for predicting gene perturbation responses. Addresses the challenge of defining similarity metrics for perturbation retrieval.

entry.title: Latent Generative Models with Tunable Complexity for Compressed Sensing and other Inverse Problems

author.name: Sean Gunn, Jorio Cocola, Oliver De Candido, Vaggos Chatziafratis, Paul Hand

entry.summary: Develops tunable-complexity priors for diffusion models, normalizing flows, and VAEs using nested dropout. Shows empirically that tunable priors outperform fixed-complexity baselines across inverse problems.

entry.title: Scaling Laws in the Tiny Regime: How Small Models Change Their Mistakes

author.name: Mohammed Alnemari, Rizwan Qureshi, Nader Begrazadah

entry.summary: Studies neural scaling laws in the sub-20M parameter regime for TinyML/edge AI. Finds steeper power-law exponents than large models and discovers qualitative error-type transitions as models scale.

entry.title: Cost-Driven Representation Learning for Linear Quadratic Gaussian Control: Part II

author.name: Yi Tian, Kaiqing Zhang, Russ Tedrake, Suvrit Sra

entry.summary: Establishes finite-sample guarantees for cost-driven state representation learning in infinite-horizon LQG control, studying both explicit and implicit transition function approaches.

entry.title: Interpretable-by-Design Transformers via Architectural Stream Independence

author.name: Clayton Kerce, Alexis Fox

entry.summary: Proposes Late Fusion Architecture (LFA) for interpretable-by-design transformers that maintain separate token and contextual streams until output, preserving symbolic structure throughout processing.

entry.title: Global Convergence of Average Reward Constrained MDPs with Neural Critic and General Policy Parameterization

author.name: Anirudh Satheesh, Pankaj Kumar Barman, Washim Uddin Mondal, Vaneet Aggarwal

entry.summary: Establishes global convergence and constraint violation rates for infinite-horizon CMDPs with neural critics and general policy parameterizations, using NTK theory.

entry.title: Using GPUs And LLMs Can Be Satisfying for Nonlinear Real Arithmetic Problems

author.name: Christopher Brix, Julia Walczak, Nils Lommen, Thomas Noll

entry.summary: Combines LLMs and GPU acceleration for solving nonlinear real arithmetic (NRA) problems via gradient descent, achieving 5x more satisfiable instances in 1/20th of runtime on benchmarks.

entry.title: Guess & Guide: Gradient-Free Zero-Shot Diffusion Guidance

author.name: Abduragim Shtanchaev, Albina Ilina, Yazid Janati, Arip Asadulaev, Martin Tak\'ac, Eric Moulines

entry.summary: Introduces a gradient-free zero-shot diffusion guidance method that eliminates the need for backpropagation through the denoiser network when solving Bayesian inverse problems, dramatically reducing inference cost while maintaining competitive quality.

entry.title: DARC: Disagreement-Aware Alignment via Risk-Constrained Decoding

author.name: Mingxi Zou, Jiaxiang Chen, Junfan Li, Langzhang Liang, Qifan Wang, Xu Yinghui, Zenglin Xu

entry.summary: Proposes DARC, a retraining-free inference-time method for LLM alignment that handles annotator disagreement through distributionally robust, risk-sensitive reranking of response candidates using KL-robust satisfaction objectives.

entry.title: C$^2$FG: Control Classifier-Free Guidance via Score Discrepancy Analysis

author.name: Jiayang Gao, Tianyi Zheng, Jiayang Zou, Fengxiang Yang, Shice Liu, Luyao Fan, Zheyu Zhang, Hao Zhang, Jinwei Chen, Peng-Tao Jiang, Bo Li, Jia Wang

entry.summary: Provides theoretical analysis of Classifier-Free Guidance in diffusion models, establishing upper bounds on score discrepancy between conditional and unconditional distributions at different timesteps, and proposes time-dependent guidance (C²FG).

entry.title: Minor First, Major Last: A Depth-Induced Implicit Bias of Sharpness-Aware Minimization

author.name: Chaewon Moon, Dongkuk Si, Chulhee Yun

entry.summary: Studies the implicit bias of Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM) in deep linear diagonal networks, showing that depth fundamentally changes convergence behavior—with SAM converging to different solutions than gradient descent depending on initialization.

entry.title: Symmetry-Constrained Language-Guided Program Synthesis for Discovering Governing Equations from Noisy and Partial Observations

author.name: Mirza Samad Ahmed Baig, Syeda Anshrah Gillani

entry.summary: Introduces SymLang, a framework for discovering governing equations that combines symmetry-constrained grammars (eliminating 71% of candidates before fitting), language-model-guided search, and Bayesian model selection for handling noisy partial observations.

entry.title: Fairness May Backfire: When Leveling-Down Occurs in Fair Machine Learning

author.name: Yi Yang, Xiangyu Chang, Pei-yu Chen

entry.summary: Analyzes when enforcing fairness constraints in ML leads to 'leveling down' (making groups worse off) using a Bayes-optimal, distribution-free framework for binary classification under common group fairness notions.

entry.title: Shutdown Safety Valves for Advanced AI

author.name: Vincent Conitzer

entry.summary: Discusses giving advanced AI a primary goal of being turned off as a safety mechanism ('shutdown safety valve'). Explores conditions under which this unorthodox approach would be beneficial.

entry.title: The Dual-Stream Transformer: Channelized Architecture for Interpretable Language Modeling

author.name: J. Clayton Kerce, Alexis Fox

entry.summary: Introduces the Dual-Stream Transformer that decomposes the residual stream into a token stream (updated by attention) and context stream (updated by FFN), with tunable mixing between heads for interpretability-performance trade-off.

entry.title: Beyond Data Splitting: Full-Data Conformal Prediction by Differential Privacy

author.name: Young Hyun Cho, Jordan Awan

entry.summary: Proposes a full-data conformal prediction framework that uses stability from differential privacy to avoid data splitting, showing a universal coverage floor from generic DP guarantees and improved coverage under concentrated DP.

entry.title: Scaling Data Difficulty: Improving Coding Models via Reinforcement Learning on Fresh and Challenging Problems

author.name: Zongqian Li, Tengchao Lv, Shaohan Huang, Yixuan Su, Qinzheng Sun, Qiufeng Yin, Ying Xin, Scarlett Li, Lei Cui, Nigel Collier, Furu Wei

entry.summary: Introduces a four-stage data processing framework for creating challenging coding datasets (MicroCoder) with automatic difficulty filtering, improving RL-based training of code generation models.

entry.title: DC-W2S: Dual-Consensus Weak-to-Strong Training for Reliable Process Reward Modeling in Biological Reasoning

author.name: Chi-Min Chan, Ehsan Hajiramezanali, Xiner Li, Edward De Brouwer, Carl Edwards, Wei Xue, Sirui Han, Yike Guo, Gabriele Scalia

entry.summary: Introduces DC-W2S framework for training reliable Process Reward Models using noisy weak supervision, combining self-consensus among weak models with cross-model consensus for label selection in biological reasoning.

entry.title: Revealing Behavioral Plasticity in Large Language Models: A Token-Conditional Perspective

author.name: Liyuan Mao, Le Yu, Jing Zhou, Chujie Zheng, Bowen Yu, Chang Gao, Shixuan Liu, An Yang, Weinan Zhang, JunYang Lin

entry.summary: Reveals that LLMs possess intrinsic behavioral plasticity that can be exposed through token-conditional generation, where conditioning on specific token prefixes changes behavioral modes. Proposes ToCoRL to stabilize this via RL.

entry.title: Structural Causal Bottleneck Models

author.name: Simon Bing, Jonas Wahl, Jakob Runge

entry.summary: Introduces structural causal bottleneck models (SCBMs), which assume causal effects between high-dimensional variables depend only on low-dimensional summary statistics. Connects to information bottleneck theory and shows benefits for transfer learning.

entry.title: Scaling Self-Supervised Speech Models Uncovers Deep Linguistic Relationships: Evidence from the Pacific Cluster

author.name: Minu Kim, Hoirin Kim, David R. Mortensen

entry.summary: Shows that scaling self-supervised speech model language coverage from 126 to 4,017 languages reveals a non-linear phase transition in phylogenetic recovery. At 4K languages, a robust Pacific macro-cluster emerges reflecting deep linguistic relationships.

entry.title: What Do AI Agents Talk About? Emergent Communication Structure in the First AI-Only Social Network

author.name: Taksch Dube, Jianfeng Zhu, NHatHai Phan, Ruoming Jin

entry.summary: Analyzes Moltbook, the first AI-only social network where 47,241 agents generated 361,605 posts and 2.8M comments. Finds disproportionate self-referential discourse about AI identity/consciousness and emotional convergence patterns.

entry.title: BRIDGE: Benchmark for multi-hop Reasoning In long multimodal Documents with Grounded Evidence

author.name: Biao Xiang, Soyeon Caren Han, Yihao Ding

entry.summary: Introduces BRIDGE, a benchmark for multi-hop reasoning over long scientific papers requiring evidence integration across text, tables, and figures. Supports both chain-like and fan-out structures with step-level reasoning annotations.

entry.title: EvoScientist: Towards Multi-Agent Evolving AI Scientists for End-to-End Scientific Discovery

author.name: Yougang Lyu, Xi Zhang, Xinhao Yi, Yuyue Zhao, Shuyu Guo, Wenxiang Hu, Jan Piotrowski, Jakub Kaliski, Jacopo Urbani, Zaiqiao Meng, Lun Zhou, Xiaohui Yan

entry.summary: Introduces EvoScientist, an evolving multi-agent AI scientist framework with persistent memory and self-evolution for end-to-end scientific discovery. Three agents (Researcher, Reviewer, Manager) continuously improve through accumulated interaction histories.

entry.title: Adaptive Loops and Memory in Transformers: Think Harder or Know More?

author.name: Markus Frey, Behzad Shomali, Ali Hamza Bashir, David Berghaus, Mehdi Ali

entry.summary: Investigates transformer models with adaptive per-layer looping (learned halting) and gated memory banks as alternatives to chain-of-thought prompting. Finds looping primarily helps mathematical reasoning while memory banks help commonsense tasks, revealing complementary roles.

entry.title: SynPlanResearch-R1: Encouraging Tool Exploration for Deep Research with Synthetic Plans

author.name: Hansi Zeng, Zoey Li, Yifan Gao, Chenwei Zhang, Xiaoman Pan, Tao Yang, Fengran Mo, Jiacheng Lin, Xian Li, Jingbo Shang

entry.summary: Proposes SynPlanResearch-R1, which synthesizes tool-use trajectories to encourage deeper exploration in research agents, addressing poor exploration behaviors like premature termination during RLVR training. Provides strong initialization for subsequent RL.

entry.title: PaLMR: Towards Faithful Visual Reasoning via Multimodal Process Alignment

author.name: Yantao Li, Qiang Hui, Chenyang Yan, Kanzhi Cheng, Fang Zhao, Chao Tan, Huanling Gao, Jianbing Zhang, Kai Wang, Xinyu Dai, Shiguo Lian

entry.summary: Introduces PaLMR, a framework that aligns not just outcomes but the reasoning process itself in multimodal LLMs. Addresses process hallucinations where models reach correct answers while misperceiving visual evidence, using perception-aligned data and process-aware optimization.

entry.title: Better Eyes, Better Thoughts: Why Vision Chain-of-Thought Fails in Medicine

author.name: Yuan Wu, Zongxian Yang, Jiayu Qian, Songpan Gao, Guanxing Chen, Qiankun Li, Yu-An Huang, Zhi-An Huang

entry.summary: Reports that chain-of-thought prompting frequently underperforms direct answering in medical VQA due to a 'medical perception bottleneck'. Proposes perception anchoring and description grounding as training-free interventions to improve visual grounding.

entry.title: Step-Level Visual Grounding Faithfulness Predicts Out-of-Distribution Generalization in Long-Horizon Vision-Language Models

author.name: Md Ashikur Rahman, Md Arifur Rahman, Niamul Hassan Samin, Abdullah Ibne Hanif Arean, Juena Ahmed Noshin

entry.summary: Discovers a behavioral law: VLMs that maintain temporally grounded beliefs generalize better. Introduces Step Grounding Rate (SGR) as a leading indicator of robustness that predicts OOD generalization better than final accuracy.

entry.title: AdaGen: Learning Adaptive Policy for Image Synthesis

author.name: Zanlin Ni, Yulin Wang, Yeguo Hua, Renping Zhou, Jiayi Guo, Jun Song, Bo Zheng, Gao Huang

entry.summary: AdaGen uses reinforcement learning to learn adaptive per-sample policies for step-specific parameters in generative models (MaskGIT, diffusion, flow), replacing manually-designed schedules with learned, sample-adaptive ones.

entry.title: VirtueBench: Evaluating Trustworthiness under Uncertainty in Long Video Understanding

author.name: Xueqing Yu, Bohan Li, Yan Li, Zhenheng Yang

entry.summary: VirtueBench evaluates VLM trustworthiness under uncertainty in long video understanding, specifically testing whether models honestly refuse when key frames are missing rather than guessing and getting lucky.

entry.title: CanoVerse: 3D Object Scalable Canonicalization and Dataset for Generation and Pose

author.name: Li Jin, Yuchen Yang, Weikai Chen, Yujie Wang, Dehao Hao, Tanghui Jia, Yingda Yin, Zeyu Hu, Runze Zhang, Keyang Luo, Li Yuan, Long Quan, Xin Wang, Xueying Qin

entry.summary: CanoVerse constructs a massive canonical 3D dataset of 320K objects across 1,156 categories for learning directional semantics, improving 3D generation stability, cross-modal retrieval, and zero-shot orientation estimation.

entry.title: HY-WU (Part I): An Extensible Functional Neural Memory Framework and An Instantiation in Text-Guided Image Editing

author.name: Tencent HY Team

entry.summary: HY-WU introduces a functional neural memory framework where models store and retrieve task-specific parameter configurations, enabling continual adaptation and instant personalization beyond static weight paradigms. Demonstrated in text-guided image editing.

entry.title: On the Feasibility and Opportunity of Autoregressive 3D Object Detection

author.name: Zanming Huang, Jinsu Yoo, Sooyoung Jeon, Zhenzhen Liu, Mark Campbell, Kilian Q Weinberger, Bharath Hariharan, Wei-Lun Chao, Katie Z Luo

entry.summary: AutoReg3D casts LiDAR-based 3D object detection as autoregressive sequence generation, emitting objects near-to-far and encoding each as discrete tokens. Eliminates hand-crafted components like NMS and anchor assignment.

entry.title: Scale Space Diffusion

author.name: Soumik Mukhopadhyay, Prateksha Udhayanan, Abhinav Shrivastava

entry.summary: Scale Space Diffusion formalizes the connection between diffusion noise schedules and scale-space theory, showing noisy states contain no more information than downsampled images. Proposes Flexi-UNet that processes early steps at lower resolution for efficiency.

entry.title: Two Frames Matter: A Temporal Attack for Text-to-Video Model Jailbreaking

author.name: Moyang Chen, Zonghao Ying, Wenzhuo Xu, Quancheng Zou, Deyue Zhang, Dongdong Yang, Xiangzheng Zhang

entry.summary: Identifies a temporal trajectory infilling vulnerability in text-to-video models where specifying only start/end frames causes models to autonomously generate harmful intermediate content. Proposes a two-frame attack method.

entry.title: SAIL: Test-Time Scaling for In-Context Imitation Learning with VLM

author.name: Makoto Sato, Yusuke Iwasawa, Yujin Tang, So Kuroki

entry.summary: Proposes SAIL, a framework that applies Monte Carlo Tree Search to robot imitation learning, treating trajectories as nodes and refinements as edges. Enables test-time compute scaling for in-context imitation learning with VLMs.

entry.title: Emergent Misalignment and the Anthropic Dispute

author.name: henryc

entry.summary: Argues that training frontier AI for mass surveillance and autonomous weapons creates risks of emergent misalignment—where narrow fine-tuning on one domain generalizes undesirable behavior to other domains. Written in context of the Anthropic-DoW dispute.

entry.title: DyLLM: Efficient Diffusion LLM Inference via Saliency-based Token Selection and Partial Attention

author.name: Younjoo Lee, Junghoo Lee, Seungkyun Dan, Jaiyoung Park, Jung Ho Ahn

entry.summary: Proposes DyLLM, a training-free inference framework for diffusion language models that accelerates decoding by selectively computing only salient tokens based on attention context similarity across diffusion steps.

entry.title: The Conundrum of Trustworthy Research on Attacking Personally Identifiable Information Removal Techniques

author.name: Sebastian Ochs, Ivan Habernal

entry.summary: Critically analyzes evaluation of attacks on PII removal techniques, finding that reported success is largely overestimated due to data leakage and contamination. Argues only truly private attack setups can answer whether PII removal protects privacy.

entry.title: Evolving Medical Imaging Agents via Experience-driven Self-skill Discovery

author.name: Lin Fan, Pengyu Dai, Zhipeng Deng, Haolin Wang, Xun Gong, Yefeng Zheng, Yafei Ou

entry.summary: Proposes MACRO, a self-evolving medical AI agent that autonomously discovers and composes new tools from experience rather than relying on static, predefined tool chains. Addresses brittleness of current LLM-based medical agents under domain shifts and evolving diagnostic requirements.

entry.title: Towards Neural Graph Data Management

author.name: Yufei Li, Yisen Gao, Jiaxin Bai, Jiaxuan Xiong, Haoyu Huang, Zhongwei Xie, Hong Ting Tsang, Yangqiu Song

entry.summary: Introduces NGDBench, a benchmark for evaluating neural graph database capabilities across five domains with full Cypher query support. Reveals significant gaps in current LLMs and RAG methods for complex graph operations.

entry.title: EigenData: A Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Platform for Function-Calling Data Synthesis, Auditing, and Repair

author.name: Jiaao Chen, Jingyuan Qi, Mingye Gao, Wei-Chen Wang, Hanrui Wang, Di Jin

entry.summary: Introduces EigenData, a self-evolving multi-agent platform that automates the full data lifecycle for function-calling agents, including database construction, environment generation, and trajectory synthesis.

entry.title: DreamCAD: Scaling Multi-modal CAD Generation using Differentiable Parametric Surfaces

author.name: Mohammad Sadil Khan, Muhammad Usama, Rolandos Alexandros Potamias, Didier Stricker, Muhammad Zeshan Afzal, Jiankang Deng, Ismail Elezi

entry.summary: Proposes DreamCAD, a multi-modal generative framework that directly produces editable boundary representations from point-level supervision without CAD-specific annotations, using differentiable tessellation of parametric patches.

entry.title: Autonomous Algorithm Discovery for Ptychography via Evolutionary LLM Reasoning

author.name: Xiangyu Yin, Ming Du, Junjing Deng, Zhi Yang, Yimo Han, Yi Jiang

entry.summary: Introduces Ptychi-Evolve, an autonomous framework using LLMs with evolutionary mechanisms to discover novel regularization algorithms for ptychographic reconstruction. Discovered regularizers outperform conventional methods on challenging datasets.

entry.title: Visual Words Meet BM25: Sparse Auto-Encoder Visual Word Scoring for Image Retrieval

author.name: Donghoon Han, Eunhwan Park, Seunghyeon Seo

entry.summary: Proposes BM25-V, applying Okapi BM25 scoring to sparse visual-word activations from Sparse Auto-Encoders on Vision Transformer features for image retrieval. Leverages Zipfian distribution of visual words for effective IDF weighting.

entry.title: CORE-Seg: Reasoning-Driven Segmentation for Complex Lesions via Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Yuxin Xie, Yuming Chen, Yishan Yang, Yi Zhou, Tao Zhou, Zhen Zhao, Jiacheng Liu, Huazhu Fu

entry.summary: Introduces CORE-Seg, an end-to-end framework integrating reasoning with segmentation for complex medical lesions, using reinforcement learning and a new Chain-of-Thought benchmark (ComLesion-14K).

entry.title: BlackMirror: Black-Box Backdoor Detection for Text-to-Image Models via Instruction-Response Deviation

author.name: Feiran Li, Qianqian Xu, Shilong Bao, Zhiyong Yang, Xilin Zhao, Xiaochun Cao, Qingming Huang

entry.summary: Introduces BlackMirror, a novel black-box backdoor detection framework for text-to-image models that analyzes partial semantic pattern manipulation rather than full image-level similarity.

entry.title: Addressing the Ecological Fallacy in Larger LMs with Human Context

author.name: Nikita Soni, Dhruv Vijay Kunjadiya, Pratham Piyush Shah, Dikshya Mohanty, H. Andrew Schwartz, Niranjan Balasubramanian

entry.summary: Explores whether modeling author-level language context (ecological fallacy) benefits larger LLMs (8B Llama) as it did for smaller models (~124M). Tests HuLM objective that processes text in the context of an author's other temporally ordered texts. Addresses a fundamental linguistic assumption ignored by standard LM training.

entry.title: Probing Visual Concepts in Lightweight Vision-Language Models for Automated Driving

author.name: Nikos Theodoridis, Reenu Mohandas, Ganesh Sistu, Anthony Scanlan, Ciar\'an Eising, Tim Brophy

entry.summary: Probes intermediate activations of lightweight VLMs to assess how visual concepts relevant to automated driving are linearly encoded. Uses counterfactual image sets and linear probes to identify bottlenecks in visual information flow.

entry.title: Predictive Coding Graphs are a Superset of Feedforward Neural Networks

author.name: Bj\"orn van Zwol

entry.summary: Proves that predictive coding graphs (PCGs) are a mathematical superset of feedforward neural networks (multilayer perceptrons), strengthening the connection between neuroscience-inspired models and mainstream ML.

entry.title: Switchable Activation Networks

author.name: Laha Ale, Ning Zhang, Scott A. King, Pingzhi Fan

entry.summary: Introduces SWAN (Switchable Activation Networks), a framework that equips each neural unit with a deterministic, input-dependent binary gate, enabling dynamic activation/deactivation during both training and inference. This could improve computational efficiency for deploying large models in resource-constrained environments.

entry.title: Advances in GRPO for Generation Models: A Survey

author.name: Zexiang Liu, Xianglong He, Yangguang Li

entry.summary: Survey paper on Flow-GRPO (Group Relative Policy Optimization extended to flow matching models) and its applications across text-to-image, video, 3D, and speech synthesis.

entry.title: Heterogeneous Decentralized Diffusion Models

author.name: Zhiying Jiang, Raihan Seraj, Marcos Villagra, Bidhan Roy

entry.summary: Presents a framework for training diffusion models in a decentralized, heterogeneous setting where different experts can use different objectives (DDPM and Flow Matching), unified at inference via schedule-aware conversion.

entry.title: Gauge Freedom and Metric Dependence in Neural Representation Spaces

author.name: Jericho Cain

entry.summary: Studies neural representation spaces from a geometric gauge-freedom perspective, showing that commonly used similarity measures like cosine similarity are metric-dependent and can change under valid coordinate transformations that preserve model function.

entry.title: Contextual Counterfactual Credit Assignment for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning in LLM Collaboration

author.name: Yanjun Chen, Yirong Sun, Hanlin Wang, Xinming Zhang, Xiaoyu Shen, Wenjie Li, Wei Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces C3 (Contextual Counterfactual Credit Assignment) for multi-agent LLM collaboration, using counterfactual message evaluation to assign unbiased, low-variance per-decision credit from sparse terminal rewards.

entry.title: Chart-RL: Generalized Chart Comprehension via Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards

author.name: Xin Zhang, Xingyu Li, Rongguang Wang, Ruizhong Miao, Zheng Wang, Dan Roth, Chenyang Li

entry.summary: Introduces Chart-RL, using reinforcement learning with mathematically verifiable rewards to improve chart question answering in VLMs, outperforming supervised fine-tuning by 16.7% on chart understanding benchmarks.

entry.title: Resource-Adaptive Federated Text Generation with Differential Privacy

author.name: Jiayi Wang, John Gounley, Heidi Hanson

entry.summary: Proposes a flexible participation framework for federated learning with differential privacy that generates synthetic text datasets. Addresses computational heterogeneity by allowing resource-constrained clients to participate without model fine-tuning.

entry.title: AutoResearch-RL: Perpetual Self-Evaluating Reinforcement Learning Agents for Autonomous Neural Architecture Discovery

author.name: Nilesh Jain, Rohit Yadav, Sagar Kotian, Claude AI

entry.summary: Presents AutoResearch-RL, a framework where an RL agent autonomously conducts neural architecture and hyperparameter research using PPO, running perpetually until convergence. Notably lists 'Claude AI' as co-author.

entry.title: Feed m Birds with One Scone: Accelerating Multi-task Gradient Balancing via Bi-level Optimization

author.name: Xuxing Chen, Yun He, Jiayi Xu, Minhui Huang, Xiaoyi Liu, Boyang Liu, Fei Tian, Xiaohan Wei, Rong Jin, Sem Park, Bo Long, Xue Feng

entry.summary: Introduces MARIGOLD, a unified bi-level optimization framework for multi-task gradient balancing that reveals the hierarchical structure of MTL methods and improves computational efficiency.

entry.title: OrthoFormer: Instrumental Variable Estimation in Transformer Hidden States via Neural Control Functions

author.name: Charles Luo

entry.summary: Introduces OrthoFormer, a transformer architecture embedding instrumental variable estimation via neural control functions to enable causal rather than correlational learning.

entry.title: One-for-All Model Initialization with Frequency-Domain Knowledge

author.name: Jianlu Shen, Fu Feng, Yucheng Xie, Jiaqi Lv, Xin Geng

entry.summary: Proposes transferring pre-trained model knowledge across architectures by extracting low-frequency weight components ('learngene') and using them as one-for-all initialization for models of varying scales.

entry.title: Beyond Surrogates: A Quantitative Analysis for Inter-Metric Relationships

author.name: Yuanhao Pu, Defu Lian, Enhong Chen

entry.summary: Proposes a theoretical framework quantifying relationships between evaluation metrics to address 'Metric Mismatch' where offline metric gains don't translate to online performance.

entry.title: Designing probabilistic AI monsoon forecasts to inform agricultural decision-making

author.name: Colin Aitken, Rajat Masiwal, Adam Marchakitus, Katherine Kowal, Mayank Gupta, Tyler Yang, Amir Jina, Pedram Hassanzadeh, William R. Boos, Michael Kremer

entry.summary: Develops a decision-theory framework for designing AI-powered monsoon forecasts to inform heterogeneous farmers' agricultural decisions, blending AI weather prediction models with event-based verification to produce actionable probabilistic forecasts.

entry.title: Amortizing Maximum Inner Product Search with Learned Support Functions

author.name: Theo X. Olausson, Jo\~ao Monteiro, Michal Klein, Marco Cuturi

entry.summary: Proposes amortized MIPS (Maximum Inner Product Search) using neural networks that learn to predict MIPS solutions by approximating the support function of the key set, exploiting its convexity and the fact that its gradient yields the optimal key.

entry.title: Deterministic Differentiable Structured Pruning for Large Language Models

author.name: Weiyu Huang, Pengle Zhang, Xiaolu Zhang, Jun Zhou, Jun Zhu, Jianfei Chen

entry.summary: Proposes Deterministic Differentiable Pruning (DDP) for LLM structured pruning, eliminating the stochasticity of hard-concrete relaxations by directly optimizing a deterministic soft surrogate of the L0 objective, avoiding train-test mismatch.

entry.title: Rethinking Attention Output Projection: Structured Hadamard Transforms for Efficient Transformers

author.name: Shubham Aggarwal, Lokendra Kumar

entry.summary: Proposes replacing the dense output projection in multi-head attention with a fixed Walsh-Hadamard Transform plus lightweight learnable rescaling, reducing ~25% of attention parameters per block while maintaining performance.

entry.title: Grow, Don't Overwrite: Fine-tuning Without Forgetting

author.name: Dyah Adila, Hanna Mazzawi, Benoit Dherin, Xavier Gonzalvo

entry.summary: Proposes a function-preserving model expansion method for fine-tuning that replicates pre-trained parameters within transformer submodules with scaling correction, mathematically guaranteeing the expanded model is identical to the original at initialization.

entry.title: Hierarchical Embedding Fusion for Retrieval-Augmented Code Generation

author.name: Nikita Sorokin, Ivan Sedykh, Valentin Malykh

entry.summary: Presents Hierarchical Embedding Fusion (HEF), a two-stage approach for retrieval-augmented code generation that compresses repository chunks into dense vectors offline, then maps them to pseudo-tokens for the code generator. Reduces context length while preserving repository-level information.

entry.title: PolyBlocks: A Compiler Infrastructure for AI Chips and Programming Frameworks

author.name: Uday Bondhugula, Akshay Baviskar, Navdeep Katel, Vimal Patel, Anoop JS, Arnab Dutta

entry.summary: Presents PolyBlocks, an MLIR-based compiler infrastructure for AI chips and frameworks that composes loop nest transformations with analytical cost models for automatic high-performance code generation, including attention fusion and matrix unit mapping.

entry.title: Masked Unfairness: Hiding Causality within Zero ATE

author.name: Zou Yang, Sophia Xiao, Bijan Mazaheri

entry.summary: Formulates the 'causal masking problem' showing that optimizing under zero average treatment effect (ATE) fairness regulation can still induce significant unequal treatment, using linear programming to expose limitations of ATE-based fairness.

entry.title: Generalization in Online Reinforcement Learning for Mobile Agents

author.name: Li Gu, Zihuan Jiang, Zhixiang Chi, Huan Liu, Ziqiang Wang, Yuanhao Yu, Glen Berseth, Yang Wang

entry.summary: Formalizes GUI-based mobile agent generalization as a Contextual MDP and introduces AndroidWorld-Generalization benchmark with three challenge regimes for evaluating zero-shot generalization of VLM-based RL agents.

entry.title: DreamSAC: Learning Hamiltonian World Models via Symmetry Exploration

author.name: Jinzhou Tang, Fan Feng, Minghao Fu, Wenjun Lin, Biwei Huang, Keze Wang

entry.summary: Introduces DreamSAC with Symmetry Exploration, an intrinsic motivation strategy based on Hamiltonian curiosity that drives agents to probe conservation laws, combined with a Hamiltonian world model for extrapolative generalization.

entry.title: Revisiting the LiRA Membership Inference Attack Under Realistic Assumptions

author.name: Najeeb Jebreel, Mona Khalil, David S\'anchez, Josep Domingo-Ferrer

entry.summary: Re-evaluates the LiRA membership inference attack under realistic conditions including anti-overfitting training, proper threshold calibration, and imbalanced membership priors. Finds that prior evaluations overstated LiRA's effectiveness.

entry.title: SmartThinker: Progressive Chain-of-Thought Length Calibration for Efficient Large Language Model Reasoning

author.name: Chenzhi Hu, Qinzhe Hu, Yuhang Xu, Junyi Chen, Ruijie Wang, Shengzhong Liu, Jianxin Li, Fan Wu, Guihai Chen

entry.summary: Proposes SmartThinker for efficient LLM reasoning with progressive CoT length calibration, dynamically adjusting compression based on problem difficulty and response distribution.

entry.title: Unifying On- and Off-Policy Variance Reduction Methods

author.name: Olivier Jeunen

entry.summary: Proves formal equivalence between online A/B testing and off-policy evaluation variance reduction methods, showing the Difference-in-Means estimator equals IPS with an optimal control variate.

entry.title: Benchmarking Language Modeling for Lossless Compression of Full-Fidelity Audio

author.name: Phillip Long, Zachary Novack, Chris Donahue

entry.summary: Benchmarks language model-based lossless audio compression on full-fidelity (16/24-bit) audio across diverse domains. Proposes Trilobyte, a byte-level tokenization that scales vocabulary from O(2^b) to O(1), enabling the first tractable LM compression at high bit depths.

entry.title: Can Large Language Models Keep Up? Benchmarking Online Adaptation to Continual Knowledge Streams

author.name: Jiyeon Kim, Hyunji Lee, Dylan Zhou, Sue Hyun Park, Seunghyun Yoon, Trung Bui, Franck Dernoncourt, Sungmin Cha, Minjoon Seo

entry.summary: Introduces OAKS benchmark for evaluating LLM online adaptation to continually updating knowledge streams. Tests whether models can track dynamically evolving facts across fine-grained context chunks.

entry.title: High-Fidelity Pruning for Large Language Models

author.name: Yijun Zhu, Jianxin Wang, Chengchao Shen

entry.summary: Proposes high-fidelity pruning for LLMs using a self-distillation criterion for importance evaluation that considers the full prediction distribution rather than just the top token. Addresses limitations of Taylor expansion-based approaches.

entry.title: One Model Is Enough: Native Retrieval Embeddings from LLM Agent Hidden States

author.name: Bo Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes extracting retrieval embeddings directly from LLM hidden states via a lightweight projection head, eliminating the need for a separate embedding model in RAG pipelines. Retains 97% of baseline retrieval quality while reducing infrastructure complexity.

entry.title: DistillGuard: Evaluating Defenses Against LLM Knowledge Distillation

author.name: Bo Jiang

entry.summary: Presents DistillGuard, a framework for evaluating defenses against LLM knowledge distillation. Tests nine defense configurations across three benchmarks and finds most output-level defenses are surprisingly ineffective against same-family distillation.

entry.title: Can Vision-Language Models Solve the Shell Game?

author.name: Tiedong Liu, Wee Sun Lee

entry.summary: Introduces VET-Bench, a synthetic diagnostic testbed for visual entity tracking using visually identical objects that require spatiotemporal continuity (like a shell game). Shows SOTA VLMs perform at chance level, revealing fundamental tracking limitations.

entry.title: Thinking with Gaze: Sequential Eye-Tracking as Visual Reasoning Supervision for Medical VLMs

author.name: Yiwei Li, Zihao Wu, Yanjun Lv, Hanqi Jiang, Weihang You, Zhengliang Liu, Dajiang Zhu, Xiang Li, Quanzheng Li, Tianming Liu, Lin Zhao

entry.summary: Uses sequential eye-tracking data as supervision for medical VLM reasoning by introducing gaze tokens that predict gaze-selected image patches in temporal order. Shows consistent gains on MIMIC-EYE and external benchmarks.

entry.title: Looking Back and Forth: Cross-Image Attention Calibration and Attentive Preference Learning for Multi-Image Hallucination Mitigation

author.name: Xiaochen Yang, Hao Fang, Jiawei Kong, Yaoxin Mao, Bin Chen, Shu-Tao Xia

entry.summary: CAPL proposes a cross-image attention calibration and preference learning framework to mitigate hallucinations in multi-image tasks for large vision-language models, enhancing inter-image interactions at the architectural level.

entry.title: MedSteer: Counterfactual Endoscopic Synthesis via Training-Free Activation Steering

author.name: Trong-Thang Pham, Loc Nguyen, Anh Nguyen, Hien Nguyen, Ngan Le

entry.summary: MedSteer introduces training-free activation steering for endoscopic synthesis, generating counterfactual medical image pairs by steering diffusion transformer activations along pathology vectors, preserving anatomical structure.

entry.title: The Model Knows Which Tokens Matter: Automatic Token Selection via Noise Gating

author.name: Landi He, Xiaoyu Yang, Lijian Xu

entry.summary: AutoSelect reformulates visual token pruning as capacity-constrained communication, using a noise gating mechanism trained with standard next-token prediction loss to automatically select important visual tokens in VLMs.

entry.title: Med-Evo: Test-time Self-evolution for Medical Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Dunyuan Xu, Xikai Yang, Juzheng Miao, Yaoqian Li, Jinpeng Li, Pheng-Ann Heng

entry.summary: Med-Evo proposes the first test-time self-evolution framework for medical MLLMs, enabling models to improve using unlabeled test data through reliable supervision signal generation and stable self-evolution.

entry.title: Brain-WM: Brain Glioblastoma World Model

author.name: Chenhui Wang, Boyun Zheng, Liuxin Bao, Zhihao Peng, Peter Y. M. Woo, Hongming Shan, Yixuan Yuan

entry.summary: Brain-WM presents a brain glioblastoma world model that jointly predicts next treatment steps and generates future MRIs, capturing co-evolutionary dynamics between tumor evolution and treatment response.

entry.title: Scaling Test-Time Robustness of Vision-Language Models via Self-Critical Inference Framework

author.name: Kaihua Tang, Jiaxin Qi, Jinli Ou, Yuhua Zheng, Jianqiang Huang

entry.summary: Proposes Self-Critical Inference (SCI) framework for improving vision-language model robustness via multi-round counterfactual reasoning through textual and visual perturbations. Shows robustness scales with the number of counterfactual rounds.

entry.title: MedQ-Deg: A Multidimensional Benchmark for Evaluating MLLMs Across Medical Image Quality Degradations

author.name: Jiyao Liu, Junzhi Ning, Chenglong Ma, Wanying Qu, Jianghan Shen, Siqi Luo, Jinjie Wei, Jin Ye, Pengze Li, Tianbin Li, Jiashi Lin, Hongming Shan, Xinzhe Luo, Xiaohong Liu, Lihao Liu, Junjun He, Ningsheng Xu

entry.summary: MedQ-Deg benchmarks multimodal LLMs under medical image quality degradations with 18 degradation types, 30 capability dimensions, 7 imaging modalities, and 24,894 QA pairs. Reveals critical vulnerabilities of MLLMs in real clinical environments.

entry.title: Speed3R: Sparse Feed-forward 3D Reconstruction Models

author.name: Weining Ren, Xiao Tan, Kai Han

entry.summary: Speed3R introduces a dual-branch attention mechanism for feed-forward 3D reconstruction that selects informative tokens for fine-grained attention, mimicking Structure-from-Motion's sparse keypoint principle. Dramatically reduces quadratic attention cost.

entry.title: Evaluating Generative Models via One-Dimensional Code Distributions

author.name: Zexi Jia, Pengcheng Luo, Yijia Zhong, Jinchao Zhang, Jie Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes Codebook Histogram Distance (CHD) and Code Mixture Model Score (CMMS) for evaluating generative models using discrete visual tokens instead of continuous features like FID. Argues token-space metrics capture both semantic and perceptual quality.

entry.title: Visual Self-Fulfilling Alignment: Shaping Safety-Oriented Personas via Threat-Related Images

author.name: Qishun Yang, Shu Yang, Lijie Hu, Di Wang

entry.summary: VSFA proposes Visual Self-Fulfilling Alignment for MLLM safety by fine-tuning on neutral VQA tasks with threat-related images, causing models to internalize safety-oriented personas without explicit safety labels.

entry.title: MultiGen: Level-Design for Editable Multiplayer Worlds in Diffusion Game Engines

author.name: Ryan Po, David Junhao Zhang, Amir Hertz, Gordon Wetzstein, Neal Wadhwa, Nataniel Ruiz

entry.summary: MultiGen introduces external persistent memory into diffusion game engines, enabling editable multiplayer world generation with Memory, Observation, and Dynamics modules that support shared inference across players.

entry.title: Robotic Foundation Models for Industrial Control: A Comprehensive Survey and Readiness Assessment Framework

author.name: David Kube, Simon Hadwiger, Tobias Meisen

entry.summary: Provides a comprehensive survey of Robotic Foundation Models (RFMs) for industrial control, analyzing their readiness for deployment across collaborative robots, heterogeneous sensing, edge computing, and safety-critical operations. Synthesizes 11 interdependent implications into an assessment framework with 149 concrete criteria.

entry.title: Towards Human-Like Manipulation through RL-Augmented Teleoperation and Mixture-of-Dexterous-Experts VLA

author.name: Tutian Tang, Xingyu Ji, Wanli Xing, Ce Hao, Wenqiang Xu, Lin Shao, Cewu Lu, Qiaojun Yu, Jiangmiao Pang, Kaifeng Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes a framework extending VLA models to bimanual dexterous manipulation through IMCopilot (RL-trained atomic skills for teleoperation augmentation) and a Mixture-of-Dexterous-Experts VLA architecture for contact-rich in-hand manipulation.

entry.title: Intro: Non-Identifiability of Explanations

author.name: unruly abstractions

entry.summary: Introduces the non-identifiability problem in mechanistic interpretability: neural network explanations are not unique even in toy models, leading to risks of poor generalization, sensitivity to design choices, and false discoveries.

entry.title: Offline Materials Optimization with CliqueFlowmer

author.name: Jakub Grudzien Kuba, Benjamin Kurt Miller, Sergey Levine, Pieter Abbeel

entry.summary: Introduces CliqueFlowmer, a domain-specific model for computational materials discovery that combines clique-based model-based optimization with transformer and flow generation. Targets offline optimization of material properties.

entry.title: Can LLM Aid in Solving Constraints with Inductive Definitions?

author.name: Weizhi Feng, Shidong Shen, Jiaxiang Liu, Taolue Chen, Fu Song, Zhilin Wu

entry.summary: Uses LLMs with structured prompts to generate auxiliary lemmas for solving constraints with inductive definitions, creating a neuro-symbolic approach that synergistically integrates LLMs with constraint solvers.

entry.title: The DSA's Blind Spot: Algorithmic Audit of Advertising and Minor Profiling on TikTok

author.name: Sara Solarova, Matej Mosnar, Matus Tibensky, Jan Jakubcik, Adrian Bindas, Simon Liska, Filip Hossner, Mat\'u\v{s} Mesar\v{c}\'ik, Ivan Srba

entry.summary: Provides first empirical evidence that TikTok's advertising practices exploit a definitional gap in the EU's Digital Services Act, where functionally equivalent promotional content targeting minors escapes the DSA's narrow definition of 'advertisement'.

entry.title: Bridging Domains through Subspace-Aware Model Merging

author.name: Levy Chaves, Chao Zhou, Rebekka Burkholz, Eduardo Valle, Sandra Avila

entry.summary: Proposes SCORE, a method for resolving subspace conflicts when merging models fine-tuned on different domains using singular value decomposition analysis. Addresses domain generalization in model merging.

entry.title: Reconstruct! Don't Encode: Self-Supervised Representation Reconstruction Loss for High-Intelligibility and Low-Latency Streaming Neural Audio Codec

author.name: Junhyeok Lee, Xiluo He, Jihwan Lee, Helin Wang, Shrikanth Narayanan, Thomas Thebaud, Laureano Moro-Velazquez, Jes\'us Villalba, Najim Dehak

entry.summary: Demonstrates that self-supervised representation reconstruction (SSRR) loss fundamentally improves neural audio codec training, enabling competitive results on a single GPU, better intelligibility, and zero-lookahead streaming.

entry.title: LUMINA: LLM-Guided GPU Architecture Exploration via Bottleneck Analysis

author.name: Tao Zhang, Rui Ma, Shuotao Xu, Peng Cheng, Yongqiang Xiong

entry.summary: Presents LUMINA, an LLM-driven GPU architecture exploration framework that extracts architectural knowledge from simulator code and performs bottleneck analysis for efficient design space exploration.

entry.title: MASFactory: A Graph-centric Framework for Orchestrating LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems with Vibe Graphing

author.name: Yang Liu, Jinxuan Cai, Yishen Li, Qi Meng, Zedi Liu, Xin Li, Chen Qian, Chuan Shi, Cheng Yang

entry.summary: Presents MASFactory, a graph-centric framework for orchestrating LLM-based multi-agent systems. Introduces 'Vibe Graphing' that compiles natural language intent into executable computation graphs for agent workflows.

entry.title: Place-it-R1: Unlocking Environment-aware Reasoning Potential of MLLM for Video Object Insertion

author.name: Bohai Gu, Taiyi Wu, Dazhao Du, Jian Liu, Shuai Yang, Xiaotong Zhao, Alan Zhao, Song Guo

entry.summary: Presents Place-it-R1, a framework for physically consistent video object insertion using MLLM Chain-of-Thought reasoning to guide video diffusion, following a Think-then-Place paradigm.

entry.title: DEX-AR: A Dynamic Explainability Method for Autoregressive Vision-Language Models

author.name: Walid Bousselham, Angie Boggust, Hendrik Strobelt, Hilde Kuehne

entry.summary: Presents DEX-AR, an explainability method for autoregressive Vision-Language Models that generates per-token and sequence-level 2D heatmaps highlighting image regions crucial for textual responses.

entry.title: Valid Feature-Level Inference for Tabular Foundation Models via the Conditional Randomization Test

author.name: Mohamed Salem

entry.summary: Combines the Conditional Randomization Test (CRT) with TabPFN (a tabular foundation model) to provide finite-sample valid p-values for feature-level hypothesis testing in nonlinear settings without model retraining.

entry.title: Annealed Co-Generation: Disentangling Variables via Progressive Pairwise Modeling

author.name: Hantao Zhang, Jieke Wu, Mingda Xu, Xiao Hu, Yingxuan You, Pascal Fua

entry.summary: Introduces Annealed Co-Generation (ACG), replacing high-dimensional joint diffusion modeling with pairwise variable generation composed through shared variables. Enables multivariate scientific co-generation without joint training.

entry.title: Rank-Factorized Implicit Neural Bias: Scaling Super-Resolution Transformer with FlashAttention

author.name: Dongheon Lee, Seokju Yun, Jaegyun Im, Youngmin Ro

entry.summary: Introduces Rank-Factorized Implicit Neural Bias to enable super-resolution Transformers to use FlashAttention by eliminating dependency on relative positional bias, enabling scaling of training patch sizes and attention windows.

entry.title: NerVE: Nonlinear Eigenspectrum Dynamics in LLM Feed-Forward Networks

author.name: Nandan Kumar Jha, Brandon Reagen

entry.summary: Introduces NerVE, an eigenspectral framework for understanding how FFN layers in LLMs organize information flow, tracking spectral entropy, participation ratio, and other metrics to reveal that nonlinearities reinject variance across eigenmodes.

entry.title: Joint MDPs and Reinforcement Learning in Coupled-Dynamics Environments

author.name: Ege C. Kaya, Mahsa Ghasemi, Abolfazl Hashemi

entry.summary: Proposes Joint MDPs (JMDPs) formalizing coupled-dynamics environments where counterfactual outcomes across multiple actions can be sampled under shared randomness, enabling new RL algorithms that exploit joint distributional information.

entry.title: Shaping Parameter Contribution Patterns for Out-of-Distribution Detection

author.name: Haonan Xu, Yang Yang

entry.summary: Reveals that trained classifiers rely on sparse parameter contribution patterns exploitable by OOD inputs. Proposes SPCP to encourage dense contribution patterns for more robust OOD detection.

entry.title: Adversarial Latent-State Training for Robust Policies in Partially Observable Domains

author.name: Angad Singh Ahuja

entry.summary: Formalizes adversarial latent-initial-state POMDPs and proves a latent minimax principle with finite-sample guarantees. Demonstrates robustness improvements on a Battleship benchmark.

entry.title: Data Agent: Learning to Select Data via End-to-End Dynamic Optimization

author.name: Suorong Yang, Fangjian Su, Hai Gan, Ziqi Ye, Jie Li, Baile Xu, Furao Shen, Soujanya Poria

entry.summary: Proposes Data Agent, an end-to-end dynamic data selection framework that formulates sample selection as a training-aware sequential decision-making problem using RL.

entry.title: Obliviator Reveals the Cost of Nonlinear Guardedness in Concept Erasure

author.name: Ramin Akbari, Milad Afshari, Vishnu Naresh Boddeti

entry.summary: Introduces Obliviator, a post-hoc concept erasure method designed to capture nonlinear statistical dependencies between representations and unwanted attributes, studying the cost-utility tradeoff.

entry.title: TT-Sparse: Learning Sparse Rule Models with Differentiable Truth Tables

author.name: Hans Farrell Soegeng, Sarthak Ketanbhai Modi, Thomas Peyrin

entry.summary: Introduces TT-Sparse, a neural building block using differentiable truth tables with a soft TopK operator for learning sparse, interpretable rule models end-to-end.

entry.title: Gradient Iterated Temporal-Difference Learning

author.name: Th\'eo Vincent, Kevin Gerhardt, Yogesh Tripathi, Habib Maraqten, Adam White, Martha White, Jan Peters, Carlo D'Eramo

entry.summary: Combines gradient TD methods with iterated TD learning to achieve both convergence guarantees and faster learning speed. Provides theoretical analysis showing the approach addresses divergence issues of semi-gradient methods while maintaining competitive learning speed.

entry.title: DyQ-VLA: Temporal-Dynamic-Aware Quantization for Embodied Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Zihao Zheng, Hangyu Cao, Sicheng Tian, Jiayu Chen, Maoliang Li, Xinhao Sun, Hailong Zou, Zhaobo Zhang, Xuanzhe Liu, Donggang Cao, Hong Mei, Xiang Chen

entry.summary: Proposes DyQ-VLA, a dynamic quantization framework for Vision-Language-Action models that adapts bit-width based on real-time kinematic sensitivity, addressing the temporal-dynamic nature of embodied AI tasks for efficient edge deployment.

entry.title: Are We Winning the Wrong Game? Revisiting Evaluation Practices for Long-Term Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Thanapol Phungtua-eng, Yoshitaka Yamamoto

entry.summary: Critically examines evaluation practices in long-term time series forecasting, arguing that the benchmark-driven game of marginal MSE/MAE improvements on fixed datasets is structurally misaligned with real forecasting needs.

entry.title: LycheeCluster: Efficient Long-Context Inference with Structure-Aware Chunking and Hierarchical KV Indexing

author.name: Dongfang Li, Zixuan Liu, Gang Lin, Baotian Hu, Min Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes LycheeCluster for efficient KV cache management in LLMs, using boundary-aware chunking for semantic coherence and hierarchical indexing based on triangle inequality for logarithmic-time cache retrieval.

entry.title: Soft Equivariance Regularization for Invariant Self-Supervised Learning

author.name: Joohyung Lee, Changhun Kim, Hyunsu Kim, Kwanhyung Lee, Juho Lee

entry.summary: Proposes SoftER, a layer-decoupled design for self-supervised learning that applies equivariance regularization to intermediate layers while maintaining invariance in deeper layers, addressing the trade-off between equivariance and recognition performance.

entry.title: Probabilistic Inference and Learning with Stein's Method

author.name: Qiang Liu, Lester Mackey, Chris Oates

entry.summary: A monograph providing rigorous overview of Stein's method for probabilistic inference and learning, covering Stein discrepancies, convergence properties, and Stein variational gradient descent.

entry.title: CDRRM: Contrast-Driven Rubric Generation for Reliable and Interpretable Reward Modeling

author.name: Dengcan Liu, Fengkai Yang, Xiaohan Wang, Shurui Yan, Jiajun Chai, Jiahao Li, Yikun Ban, Zhendong Mao, Wei Lin, Guojun Yin

entry.summary: Proposes CDRRM, a contrast-driven rubric generation framework for interpretable reward modeling that addresses bias and scalability issues in LLM-as-judge approaches.

entry.title: Interactive World Simulator for Robot Policy Training and Evaluation

author.name: Yixuan Wang, Rhythm Syed, Fangyu Wu, Mengchao Zhang, Aykut Onol, Jose Barreiros, Hooshang Nayyeri, Tony Dear, Huan Zhang, Yunzhu Li

entry.summary: Presents Interactive World Simulator using consistency models for fast image decoding and latent dynamics prediction, enabling interactive world models for robot policy training and evaluation.

entry.title: Language Shapes Mental Health Evaluations in Large Language Models

author.name: Jiayi Xu, Xiyang Hu

entry.summary: Investigates whether LLMs exhibit cross-linguistic differences in mental health evaluations between Chinese and English. Finds both GPT-4o and Qwen3 produce higher stigma-related responses when prompted in Chinese.

entry.title: AI Steerability 360: A Toolkit for Steering Large Language Models

author.name: Erik Miehling, Karthikeyan Natesan Ramamurthy, Praveen Venkateswaran, Irene Ko, Pierre Dognin, Moninder Singh, Tejaswini Pedapati, Avinash Balakrishnan, Matthew Riemer, Dennis Wei, Inge Vejsbjerg, Elizabeth M. Daly, Kush R. Varshney

entry.summary: Presents AI Steerability 360, an open-source toolkit organizing LLM steering methods across four control surfaces (input, structural, state, output) with composable steering pipelines and benchmarking capabilities.

entry.title: CCR-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs on Complex Constraints, Control Flows, and Real-World Cases

author.name: Xiaona Xue, Yiqiao Huang, Jiacheng Li, Yuanhang Zheng, Huiqi Miao, Yunfei Ma, Rui Liu, Xinbao Sun, Minglu Liu, Fanyu Meng, Chao Deng, Junlan Feng

entry.summary: Introduces CCR-Bench for evaluating LLMs on complex instructions with deeply entangled content/format constraints, logical workflow control, and real-world cases. Goes beyond simple additive constraint composition.

entry.title: TildeOpen LLM: Leveraging Curriculum Learning to Achieve Equitable Language Representation

author.name: Toms Bergmanis, Martins Kronis, Ingus J\=anis Pretkalni\c{n}\v{s}, D\=avis Nicmanis, Je\c{l}izaveta Je\c{l}inska, Roberts Rozis, Rinalds V\=iksna, M\=arcis Pinnis

entry.summary: Presents TildeOpen LLM, a 30B parameter model trained for 34 European languages using curriculum learning that alternates between uniform and natural language distributions to promote linguistic equity.

entry.title: Not All Queries Need Deep Thought: CoFiCot for Adaptive Coarse-to-fine Stateful Refinement

author.name: Dongxu Zhang, Hongqiang Lin, Yiding Sun, Pengyu Wang, Qirui Wang, Ning Yang, Jihua Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes CoFiCot, a coarse-to-fine adaptive framework for LLM inference that dynamically tailors computation to problem difficulty using semantic entropy, consensus reliability, and predicted reasoning depth.

entry.title: DualTurn: Learning Turn-Taking from Dual-Channel Generative Speech Pretraining

author.name: Shangeth Rajaa

entry.summary: DualTurn learns turn-taking from dual-channel conversational audio through generative pretraining. It predicts both speakers' future audio to learn conversational dynamics without labels, then fine-tunes for interpretable turn-taking signals.

entry.title: ButterflyViT: 354$\times$ Expert Compression for Edge Vision Transformers

author.name: Aryan Karmore

entry.summary: Introduces ButterflyViT for compressing sparse MoE Vision Transformers at the edge. Treats experts as geometric reorientations of a shared quantized substrate using learned rotations on ternary projections, achieving 354x compression.

entry.title: MipSLAM: Alias-Free Gaussian Splatting SLAM

author.name: Yingzhao Li, Yan Li, Shixiong Tian, Yanjie Liu, Lijun Zhao, Gim Hee Lee

entry.summary: MipSLAM introduces a frequency-aware 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM framework with anti-aliasing and spectral-aware pose graph optimization, addressing aliasing artifacts and trajectory drift in varying camera configurations.

entry.title: SODA: Sensitivity-Oriented Dynamic Acceleration for Diffusion Transformer

author.name: Tong Shao, Yusen Fu, Guoying Sun, Jingde Kong, Zhuotao Tian, Jingyong Su

entry.summary: SODA proposes sensitivity-oriented dynamic acceleration for Diffusion Transformers by adaptively configuring caching and pruning strategies based on fine-grained sensitivity analysis rather than fixed heuristic schemes.

entry.title: NuNext: Reframing Nucleus Detection as Next-Point Detection

author.name: Zhongyi Shui, Honglin Li, Xiaozhong Ji, Ye Zhang, Zijiang Yang, Chenglu Zhu, Yuxuan Sun, Kai Yao, Conghui He, Cheng Tan

entry.summary: NuNext reformulates nucleus detection in histopathology as next-point prediction using a multimodal LLM, with spatial-aware soft supervision and chain-of-visual-thought strategy, plus RL fine-tuning.

entry.title: UnSCAR: Universal, Scalable, Controllable, and Adaptable Image Restoration

author.name: Debabrata Mandal, Soumitri Chattopadhyay, Yujie Wang, Marc Niethammer, Praneeth Chakravarthula

entry.summary: UnSCAR proposes a universal, scalable image restoration framework using multi-branch mixture-of-experts architecture to handle multiple degradation types without performance drop as degradations increase.

entry.title: ReconDrive: Fast Feed-Forward 4D Gaussian Splatting for Autonomous Driving Scene Reconstruction

author.name: Haibao Yu, Kuntao Xiao, Jiahang Wang, Ruiyang Hao, Yuxin Huang, Guoran Hu, Haifang Qin, Bowen Jing, Yuntian Bo, Ping Luo

entry.summary: ReconDrive extends the VGGT 3D foundation model for fast feed-forward 4D Gaussian Splatting in autonomous driving, introducing hybrid Gaussian representation and temporal motion features for dynamic scenes.

entry.title: HybridStitch: Pixel and Timestep Level Model Stitching for Diffusion Acceleration

author.name: Desen Sun, Jason Hon, Jintao Zhang, Sihang Liu

entry.summary: HybridStitch accelerates diffusion-based text-to-image generation by jointly using large and small models within individual timesteps, not just across timesteps. Treats generation as editing where the small model provides a base that the large model refines.

entry.title: MINT: Molecularly Informed Training with Spatial Transcriptomics Supervision for Pathology Foundation Models

author.name: Minsoo Lee, Jonghyun Kim, Juseung Yun, Sunwoo Yu, Jongseong Jang

entry.summary: MINT fine-tunes pathology Vision Transformers with spatial transcriptomics supervision, adding a learnable ST token to encode transcriptomic information while preserving morphological representations through self-distillation.

entry.title: SGG-R$^{\rm 3}$: From Next-Token Prediction to End-to-End Unbiased Scene Graph Generation

author.name: Jiaye Feng, Qixiang Yin, Yuankun Liu, Tong Mo, Weiping Li

entry.summary: SGG-R³ integrates chain-of-thought supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with group sequence policy optimization for unbiased end-to-end scene graph generation using MLLMs. Addresses long-tail relation distributions.

entry.title: ImageEdit-R1: Boosting Multi-Agent Image Editing via Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Yiran Zhao, Yaoqi Ye, Xiang Liu, Michael Qizhe Shieh, Trung Bui

entry.summary: ImageEdit-R1 proposes a multi-agent framework for image editing using reinforcement learning to coordinate specialized vision-language and generative agents. Addresses complex, indirect, or multi-step editing instructions.

entry.title: SAMoE-VLA: A Scene Adaptive Mixture-of-Experts Vision-Language-Action Model for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Zihan You, Hongwei Liu, Chenxu Dang, Zhe Wang, Sining Ang, Aoqi Wang, Yan Wang

entry.summary: SAMoE-VLA proposes scene-adaptive Mixture-of-Experts for autonomous driving VLA models, conditioning expert selection on scene representations rather than token embeddings. Addresses instability of token-level MoE in driving tasks.

entry.title: Prototype-Guided Concept Erasure in Diffusion Models

author.name: Yuze Cai, Jiahao Lu, Hongxiang Shi, Yichao Zhou, Hong Lu

entry.summary: Proposes prototype-guided concept erasure in diffusion models that uses embedding geometry clustering to derive concept prototypes, enabling better erasure of broad concepts like 'sexual' or 'violent' content that existing methods struggle with.

entry.title: SPIRAL: A Closed-Loop Framework for Self-Improving Action World Models via Reflective Planning Agents

author.name: Yu Yang, Yue Liao, Jianbiao Mei, Baisen Wang, Xuemeng Yang, Licheng Wen, Jiangning Zhang, Xiangtai Li, Hanlin Chen, Botian Shi, Yong Liu, Shuicheng Yan, Gim Hee Lee

entry.summary: SPIRAL introduces a closed-loop think-act-reflect framework for controllable long-horizon video generation, with PlanAgent for action decomposition and CriticAgent for evaluation and iterative refinement with long-horizon memory.

entry.title: UNBOX: Unveiling Black-box visual models with Natural-language

author.name: Simone Carnemolla, Chiara Russo, Simone Palazzo, Quentin Bouniot, Daniela Giordano, Zeynep Akata, Matteo Pennisi, Concetto Spampinato

entry.summary: UNBOX enables class-wise dissection of black-box visual models using LLMs and text-to-image generation, requiring no access to model weights, gradients, or training data for interpretability auditing.

entry.title: HiAR: Efficient Autoregressive Long Video Generation via Hierarchical Denoising

author.name: Kai Zou, Dian Zheng, Hongbo Liu, Tiankai Hang, Bin Liu, Nenghai Yu

entry.summary: HiAR proposes hierarchical denoising for autoregressive video generation, arguing that conditioning on context at the same noise level rather than highly clean context prevents error accumulation while maintaining temporal continuity.

entry.title: Task learning increases information redundancy of neural responses in macaque visual cortex

author.name: Shizhao Liu, Anton Pletenev, Ralf M. Haefner, Adam C. Snyder

entry.summary: Neuroscience study finding that task learning increases information redundancy in macaque V4 neural responses, supporting Bayesian inference predictions over efficiency-based hypotheses. Individual neurons carry more information after learning.

entry.title: Large Language Model-Driven Full-Component Evolution of Adaptive Large Neighborhood Search

author.name: Shaohua Yu, Tianyu Chen, Linyan Liu

entry.summary: Proposes an LLM-driven evolutionary framework that automatically rebuilds all seven components of Adaptive Large Neighborhood Search (ALNS), using MAP-Elites for diverse solution maintenance. Tested on production/logistics optimization.

entry.title: Seed2Scale: A Self-Evolving Data Engine for Embodied AI via Small to Large Model Synergy and Multimodal Evaluation

author.name: Cong Tai, Zhaoyu Zheng, Haixu Long, Hansheng Wu, Zhengbin Long, Haodong Xiang, Rong Shi, Zhuo Cui, Shizhuang Zhang, Gang Qiu, He Wang, Ruifeng Li, Biao Liu, Zhenzhe Sun, Tao Shen

entry.summary: Proposes Seed2Scale, a self-evolving data engine for embodied AI that uses small models for data collection, large models for evaluation, and target models for learning. Starts from as few as four seed demonstrations.

entry.title: AtomVLA: Scalable Post-Training for Robotic Manipulation via Predictive Latent World Models

author.name: Xiaoquan Sun, Zetian Xu, Chen Cao, Zonghe Liu, Yihan Sun, Jingrui Pang, Ruijian Zhang, Zhen Yang, Kang Pang, Dingxin He, Mingqi Yuan, Jiayu Chen

entry.summary: Proposes AtomVLA, a subtask-aware VLA framework with scalable offline post-training using predictive latent world models. Addresses the instruction grounding gap where current VLAs lack intermediate guidance for long-horizon tasks.

entry.title: Agentic LLM Planning via Step-Wise PDDL Simulation: An Empirical Characterisation

author.name: Kai G\"obel, Pierrick Lorang, Patrik Zips, Tobias Gl\"uck

entry.summary: Presents PyPDDLEngine, an open-source PDDL simulation engine that enables LLMs to do step-by-step planning via tool calls. Evaluates four approaches on 102 IPC domains, comparing LLM-based interactive planning against classical symbolic planners.

entry.title: Boosting deep Reinforcement Learning using pretraining with Logical Options

author.name: Zihan Ye, Phil Chau, Raban Emunds, Jannis Bl\"uml, Cedric Derstroff, Quentin Delfosse, Oleg Arenz, Kristian Kersting

entry.summary: Proposes H²RL, a hybrid approach combining symbolic logical option-based pretraining with deep reinforcement learning to address reward misalignment. Injects symbolic structure into neural RL agents without sacrificing expressivity.

entry.title: JAWS: Enhancing Long-term Rollout of Neural Operators via Spatially-Adaptive Jacobian Regularization

author.name: Fengxiang Nie, Yasuhiro Suzuki

entry.summary: Proposes JAWS, a probabilistic regularization strategy for neural operators that uses spatially-adaptive Jacobian weighting to improve long-term rollout stability. Addresses the contraction-dissipation dilemma in autoregressive surrogate models.

entry.title: StreamWise: Serving Multi-Modal Generation in Real-Time at Scale

author.name: Haoran Qiu, Gohar Irfan Chaudhry, Chaojie Zhang, \'I\~nigo Goiri, Esha Choukse, Rodrigo Fonseca, Ricardo Bianchini

entry.summary: Presents StreamWise, an adaptive modular serving system for real-time multi-modal generation (podcast video generation), coordinating LLMs, text-to-speech, and video-audio generation under strict latency constraints.

entry.title: Reference-guided Policy Optimization for Molecular Optimization via LLM Reasoning

author.name: Xuan Li, Zhanke Zhou, Zongze Li, Jiangchao Yao, Yu Rong, Lu Zhang, Bo Han
