It uses adversarial push-back refinement to handle out-of-distribution states during online exploration, addressing catastrophic forgetting and reward specification costs.

entry.title: ELLMob: Event-Driven Human Mobility Generation with Self-Aligned LLM Framework

author.name: Yusong Wang, Chuang Yang, Jiawei Wang, Xiaohang Xu, Jiayi Xu, Dongyuan Li, Chuan Xiao, Renhe Jiang

entry.summary: Introduces ELLMob, an event-driven human mobility generation framework using LLMs that handles deviated mobility during large-scale societal events like typhoons and COVID-19, along with the first event-annotated mobility dataset.

entry.title: Model-based Offline RL via Robust Value-Aware Model Learning with Implicitly Differentiable Adaptive Weighting

author.name: Zhongjian Qiao, Jiafei Lyu, Boxiang Lyu, Yao Shu, Siyang Gao, Shuang Qiu

entry.summary: Addresses model exploitation in model-based offline RL by analyzing RAMBO's instabilities (Q-value underestimation and gradient explosion) and proposing improved adversarial model learning with implicitly differentiable adaptive weighting.

entry.title: Optimising antibiotic switching via forecasting of patient physiology

author.name: Magnus Ross, Nel Swanepoel, Akish Luintel, Emma McGuire, Ingemar J. Cox, Steve Harris, Vasileios Lampos

entry.summary: Uses neural processes to model vital sign trajectories for optimizing IV-to-oral antibiotic switching decisions, comparing forecasts against clinical guidelines rather than learning from historical (often delayed) decisions.

entry.title: Grow, Assess, Compress: Adaptive Backbone Scaling for Memory-Efficient Class Incremental Learning

author.name: Adrian Garcia-Casta\~neda, Jon Irureta, Jon Imaz, Aizea Lojo

entry.summary: Proposes GRACE, a dynamic scaling framework for class incremental learning that cycles through growing, assessing capacity saturation, and compressing to manage model size while maintaining plasticity-stability balance.

entry.title: Drift-to-Action Controllers: Budgeted Interventions with Online Risk Certificates

author.name: Ismail Lamaakal, Chaymae Yahyati, Khalid El Makkaoui, Ibrahim Ouahbi, Yassine Maleh

entry.summary: Introduces Drift2Act, a drift-to-action controller that treats distribution drift monitoring as constrained decision-making, combining drift sensing with active risk certificates that provide anytime-valid bounds on current risk.

entry.title: Group Entropies and Mirror Duality: A Class of Flexible Mirror Descent Updates for Machine Learning

author.name: Andrzej Cichocki, Piergiulio Tempesta

entry.summary: Introduces a theoretical framework connecting group theory and group entropies with Mirror Descent optimization, yielding an infinite family of flexible MD algorithms. The approach generalizes beyond Shannon/Tsallis entropies using multi-parametric generalized logarithms as mirror maps.

entry.title: Chart Deep Research in LVLMs via Parallel Relative Policy Optimization

author.name: Jiajin Tang, Gaoyang, Wenjie Wang, Sibei Yang, Xing Chen

entry.summary: Proposes parallel relative policy optimization for training large vision-language models on deep chart analysis tasks, addressing multi-dimensional reward interference and gradient conflicts.

entry.title: The Talking Robot: Distortion-Robust Acoustic Models for Robot-Robot Communication

author.name: Hanlong Li, Karishma Kamalahasan, Jiahui Li, Kazuhiro Nakadai, Shreyas Kousik

entry.summary: Presents Artoo, a learned acoustic communication system for robot-to-robot communication that co-trains TTS transmitter and ASR receiver through a differentiable channel, achieving superior noise robustness by not needing to preserve human speech qualities.

entry.title: A Distributed Gaussian Process Model for Multi-Robot Mapping

author.name: Seth Nabarro, Mark van der Wilk, Andrew J. Davison

entry.summary: Proposes DistGP, a distributed Gaussian process method for multi-robot collaborative learning using sparse GP factorization and Gaussian belief propagation, enabling online training with dynamic connectivity.

entry.title: Accelerating Diffusion Models for Generative AI Applications with Silicon Photonics

author.name: Tharini Suresh, Salma Afifi, Sudeep Pasricha

entry.summary: Presents a silicon photonics-based accelerator for diffusion models, achieving 3x better energy efficiency and 5.5x throughput improvement over electronic accelerators.

entry.title: Revisiting Unknowns: Towards Effective and Efficient Open-Set Active Learning

author.name: Chen-Chen Zong, Yu-Qi Chi, Xie-Yang Wang, Yan Cui, Sheng-Jun Huang

entry.summary: Proposes E²OAL, a detector-free framework for open-set active learning that exploits labeled unknowns through label-guided clustering for both supervision and querying.

entry.title: RL unknotter, hard unknots and unknotting number

author.name: Anne Dranowski, Yura Kabkov, Daniel Tubbenhauer

entry.summary: Develops an RL pipeline for simplifying knot diagrams through Reidemeister moves, successfully handling 'very hard' unknots and recovering a recently established unknotting number bound.

entry.title: ALOOD: Exploiting Language Representations for LiDAR-based Out-of-Distribution Object Detection

author.name: Michael K\"osel, Marcel Schreiber, Michael Ulrich, Claudius Gl\"aser, Klaus Dietmayer

entry.summary: Proposes ALOOD, which aligns LiDAR object detector features with vision-language model feature spaces to enable zero-shot OOD object detection for autonomous driving.

entry.title: Sign Identifiability of Causal Effects in Stationary Stochastic Dynamical Systems

author.name: Gijs van Seeventer, Saber Salehkaleybar

entry.summary: Studies sign identifiability of causal effects in continuous-time linear stochastic differential equations, deriving criteria for when the sign of drift entries can be determined from observational data without knowing the diffusion matrix.

entry.title: Generative Adversarial Regression (GAR): Learning Conditional Risk Scenarios

author.name: Saeed Asadi, Jonathan Yu-Meng Li

entry.summary: Proposes Generative Adversarial Regression (GAR), a minimax framework for learning conditional risk scenarios where generators are aligned with downstream risk objectives for elicitable functionals.

entry.title: Counting on Consensus: Selecting the Right Inter-annotator Agreement Metric for NLP Annotation and Evaluation

author.name: Joseph James

entry.summary: Provides a comprehensive survey of inter-annotator agreement metrics for NLP, organized by task type. Discusses how factors like label imbalance and missing data affect reliability estimates, with best practices for reporting.

entry.title: AutoChecklist: Composable Pipelines for Checklist Generation and Scoring with LLM-as-a-Judge

author.name: Karen Zhou, Chenhao Tan

entry.summary: Presents AutoChecklist, an open-source library unifying checklist-based LLM evaluation into composable pipelines with five generation abstractions and a modular Generator→Refiner→Scorer pipeline.

entry.title: TableMind++: An Uncertainty-Aware Programmatic Agent for Tool-Augmented Table Reasoning

author.name: Mingyue Cheng, Shuo Yu, Chuang Jiang, Xiaoyu Tao, Qingyang Mao, Jie Ouyang, Qi Liu, Enhong Chen

entry.summary: Extends TableMind with uncertainty-aware reasoning for tool-augmented table reasoning. Uses a two-stage SFT+RL training strategy with a novel Rank-Aware Policy Optimization algorithm.

entry.title: Examining the Role of YouTube Production and Consumption Dynamics on the Formation of Extreme Ideologies

author.name: Sarmad Chandio, Rishab Nithyanand

entry.summary: Longitudinal mixed-methods analysis combining one year of YouTube watch history with ideological surveys from 1,100 U.S. participants. Examines interplay between content production and consumption in ideological radicalization.

entry.title: RexDrug: Reliable Multi-Drug Combination Extraction through Reasoning-Enhanced LLMs

author.name: Zhijun Wang, Ling Luo, Dinghao Pan, Huan Zhuang, Lejing Yu, Yuanyuan Sun, Hongfei Lin

entry.summary: Proposes RexDrug, a reasoning-enhanced framework for n-ary drug combination extraction from biomedical literature using LLMs. Uses multi-agent collaborative reasoning trace generation and two-stage training.

entry.title: SPD-RAG: Sub-Agent Per Document Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Yagiz Can Akay, Muhammed Yusuf Kartal, Esra Alparslan, Faruk Ortakoyluoglu, Arda Akpinar

entry.summary: Introduces SPD-RAG, a hierarchical multi-agent RAG framework where each document gets a dedicated agent for focused retrieval, with a coordinator dispatching tasks and aggregating answers for cross-document QA.

entry.title: KCoEvo: A Knowledge Graph Augmented Framework for Evolutionary Code Generation

author.name: Jiazhen Kang, Yuchen Lu, Chen Jiang, Jinrui Liu, Tianhao Zhang, Bo Jiang, Ningyuan Sun, Tongtong Wu, Guilin Qi

entry.summary: Proposes KCoEvo, a knowledge graph-augmented framework for code generation that handles API evolution. Constructs static/dynamic API graphs to model cross-version transitions, enabling structured reasoning about API migrations.

entry.title: VB: Visibility Benchmark for Visibility and Perspective Reasoning in Images

author.name: Neil Tripathi

entry.summary: Introduces VB, a benchmark testing whether VLMs can determine visibility in photographs with VISIBLY_TRUE/VISIBLY_FALSE/ABSTAIN outputs. Uses 2x2 design crossing minimal image and text edits to verify model judgments change appropriately.

entry.title: Narrative Weaver: Towards Controllable Long-Range Visual Consistency with Multi-Modal Conditioning

author.name: Zhengjian Yao, Yongzhi Li, Xinyuan Gao, Quan Chen, Peng Jiang, Yanye Lu

entry.summary: Introduces Narrative Weaver, a framework for multi-modal controllable, long-range consistent visual content generation. Combines MLLM for narrative planning with fine-grained control mechanisms for applications like filmmaking.

entry.title: MotionBits: Video Segmentation through Motion-Level Analysis of Rigid Bodies

author.name: Howard H. Qian, Kejia Ren, Yu Xiang, Vicente Ordonez, Kaiyu Hang

entry.summary: Introduces MotionBit, defining the smallest unit in motion-based video segmentation through kinematic spatial twist equivalence, independent of semantics. Targets rigid body detection, segmentation, and tracking for robotic manipulation.

entry.title: Inter-Image Pixel Shuffling for Multi-focus Image Fusion

author.name: Huangxing Lin, Rongrong Ma, Cheng Wang

entry.summary: IPS introduces inter-image pixel shuffling for multi-focus image fusion training without requiring actual multi-focus images, reformulating the task as pixel-wise classification using synthetic focused/defocused pixel groups.

entry.title: PromptGate Client Adaptive Vision Language Gating for Open Set Federated Active Learning

author.name: Adea Nesturi, David Due\~nas Gaviria, Jiajun Zeng, Shadi Albarqouni

entry.summary: PromptGate proposes a VLM-gated framework for open-set federated active learning in medical AI, using learnable prompt vectors to filter out-of-distribution noise from unlabeled pools before annotation querying.

entry.title: Faster-HEAL: An Efficient and Privacy-Preserving Collaborative Perception Framework for Heterogeneous Autonomous Vehicles

author.name: Armin Maleki, Hayder Radha

entry.summary: Faster-HEAL proposes a lightweight, privacy-preserving collaborative perception framework for heterogeneous autonomous vehicles, fine-tuning only adapters rather than retraining entire models.

entry.title: Interpretable Aneurysm Classification via 3D Concept Bottleneck Models: Integrating Morphological and Hemodynamic Clinical Features

author.name: Toqa Khaled, Ahmad Al-Kabbany

entry.summary: Proposes 3D Concept Bottleneck Models for intracranial aneurysm classification, integrating morphological and hemodynamic clinical features for interpretable deep learning that aligns with neurosurgical principles.

entry.title: Disentangled Textual Priors for Diffusion-based Image Super-Resolution

author.name: Lei Jiang, Xin Liu, Xinze Tong, Zhiliang Li, Jie Liu, Jie Tang, Gangshan Wu

entry.summary: DTPSR introduces disentangled textual priors for diffusion-based image super-resolution, separating spatial hierarchy (global vs. local) and frequency semantics (low vs. high frequency) for better controllability.

entry.title: SIGMAE: A Spectral-Index-Guided Foundation Model for Multispectral Remote Sensing

author.name: Xiaokang Zhang, Bo Li, Chufeng Zhou, Weikang Yu, Lefei Zhang

entry.summary: SIGMAE proposes spectral index-guided masked autoencoder pretraining for multispectral remote sensing, using domain-specific spectral indices as semantic guidance during masking to improve feature learning.

entry.title: High-Fidelity Medical Shape Generation via Skeletal Latent Diffusion

author.name: Guoqing Zhang, Jingyun Yang, Siqi Chen, Anping Zhang, Yang Li

entry.summary: Proposes a skeletal latent diffusion framework for medical shape generation that incorporates structural priors through differentiable skeletonization for efficient and high-fidelity anatomical shape synthesis.

entry.title: PureCC: Pure Learning for Text-to-Image Concept Customization

author.name: Zhichao Liao, Xiaole Xian, Qingyu Li, Wenyu Qin, Meng Wang, Weicheng Xie, Siyang Song, Pingfa Feng, Long Zeng, Liang Pan

entry.summary: PureCC proposes decoupled learning for text-to-image concept customization that preserves the original model's capabilities while learning new personalized concepts through dual-branch training.

entry.title: 3DGS-HPC: Distractor-free 3D Gaussian Splatting with Hybrid Patch-wise Classification

author.name: Jiahao Chen, Yipeng Qin, Ganlong Zhao, Xin Li, Wenping Wang, Guanbin Li

entry.summary: 3DGS-HPC proposes hybrid patch-wise classification for distractor-free 3D Gaussian Splatting, avoiding semantic cue misalignment by combining local spatial frequency and temporal consistency signals.

entry.title: OrdinalBench: A Benchmark Dataset for Diagnosing Generalization Limits in Ordinal Number Understanding of Vision-Language Models

author.name: Yusuke Tozaki, Hisashi Miyamori

entry.summary: OrdinalBench benchmarks VLMs on ordinal number understanding - tracking relative positions and generalizing to large indices (up to 300). Reveals systematic failures in ordinal reasoning across arrangement complexity levels.

entry.title: GazeShift: Unsupervised Gaze Estimation and Dataset for VR

author.name: Gil Shapira, Ishay Goldin, Evgeny Artyomov, Donghoon Kim, Yosi Keller, Niv Zehngut

entry.summary: Introduces VRGaze, a 2.1M image VR gaze estimation dataset, and GazeShift, an unsupervised attention-guided framework for learning gaze representations without labeled data. First large-scale off-axis gaze dataset for VR.

entry.title: Geometric Transformation-Embedded Mamba for Learned Video Compression

author.name: Hao Wei, Yanhui Zhou, Chenyang Ge

entry.summary: Introduces a video compression framework using cascaded Mamba modules with geometric transformations, avoiding explicit motion estimation. Uses direct transform strategy with Mamba for long-range spatial-temporal dependency modeling.

entry.title: Controllable Complex Human Motion Video Generation via Text-to-Skeleton Cascades

author.name: Ashkan Taghipour, Morteza Ghahremani, Zinuo Li, Hamid Laga, Farid Boussaid, Mohammed Bennamoun

entry.summary: Two-stage cascaded framework for complex human motion video generation: autoregressive text-to-skeleton generation followed by skeleton-conditioned video diffusion. Handles complex actions like flips and martial arts.

entry.title: DSH-Bench: A Difficulty- and Scenario-Aware Benchmark with Hierarchical Subject Taxonomy for Subject-Driven Text-to-Image Generation

author.name: Zhenyu Hu, Qing Wang, Te Cao, Luo Liao, Longfei Lu, Liqun Liu, Shuang Li, Hang Chen, Mengge Xue, Yuan Chen, Chao Deng, Peng Shu, Huan Yu, Jie Jiang

entry.summary: DSH-Bench provides a comprehensive benchmark for subject-driven T2I generation with hierarchical subject taxonomy, difficulty levels, and scenario-aware evaluation. Aims to provide actionable diagnostic insights.

entry.title: MM-TS: Multi-Modal Temperature and Margin Schedules for Contrastive Learning with Long-Tail Data

author.name: Siarhei Sheludzko, Dhimitrios Duka, Bernt Schiele, Hilde Kuehne, Anna Kukleva

entry.summary: MM-TS extends temperature scheduling from uni-modal to multi-modal contrastive learning, dynamically adjusting temperature and margins during training. Addresses long-tail data distribution challenges.

entry.title: DynamicVGGT: Learning Dynamic Point Maps for 4D Scene Reconstruction in Autonomous Driving

author.name: Zhuolin He, Jing Li, Guanghao Li, Xiaolei Chen, Jiacheng Tang, Siyang Zhang, Zhounan Jin, Feipeng Cai, Bin Li, Jian Pu, Jia Cai, Xiangyang Xue

entry.summary: DynamicVGGT extends the VGGT model from static 3D to dynamic 4D scene reconstruction for autonomous driving by jointly predicting current and future point maps in a shared reference coordinate system. Tackles the challenge of modeling dynamic motion in feed-forward 3D models.

entry.title: Retrieval-Augmented Anatomical Guidance for Text-to-CT Generation

author.name: Daniele Molino, Camillo Maria Caruso, Paolo Soda, Valerio Guarrasi

entry.summary: Proposes a retrieval-augmented approach for text-to-CT generation that retrieves semantically related clinical cases and uses their anatomical annotations as structural guidance during generation. Bridges semantic control with anatomical consistency.

entry.title: OccTrack360: 4D Panoptic Occupancy Tracking from Surround-View Fisheye Cameras

author.name: Yongzhi Lin, Kai Luo, Yuanfan Zheng, Hao Shi, Mengfei Duan, Yang Liu, Kailun Yang

entry.summary: OccTrack360 presents a new benchmark for 4D panoptic occupancy tracking from surround-view fisheye cameras with significantly longer sequences and voxel visibility annotations than prior benchmarks.

entry.title: SWIFT: Sliding Window Reconstruction for Few-Shot Training-Free Generated Video Attribution

author.name: Chao Wang, Zijin Yang, Yaofei Wang, Yuang Qi, Weiming Zhang, Nenghai Yu, Kejiang Chen

entry.summary: SWIFT defines the 'few-shot training-free generated video attribution' task and proposes a sliding window reconstruction method to trace the origin of generated videos without requiring large training samples.

entry.title: CARE-Edit: Condition-Aware Routing of Experts for Contextual Image Editing

author.name: Yucheng Wang, Zedong Wang, Yuetong Wu, Yue Ma, Dan Xu

entry.summary: CARE-Edit proposes condition-aware routing of experts for contextual image editing, dynamically prioritizing or suppressing conflicting modalities instead of static concatenation, addressing task interference in unified diffusion editors.

entry.title: Talking Together: Synthesizing Co-Located 3D Conversations from Audio

author.name: Mengyi Shan, Shouchieh Chang, Ziqian Bai, Shichen Liu, Yinda Zhang, Luchuan Song, Rohit Pandey, Sean Fanello, Zeng Huang

entry.summary: Tackles generating complete 3D facial animations for two co-located conversational participants from mixed audio, modeling dynamic spatial relationships including relative position, orientation, and mutual gaze.

entry.title: SysNav: Multi-Level Systematic Cooperation Enables Real-World, Cross-Embodiment Object Navigation

author.name: Haokun Zhu, Zongtai Li, Zihan Liu, Kevin Guo, Zhengzhi Lin, Yuxin Cai, Guofei Chen, Chen Lv, Wenshan Wang, Jean Oh, Ji Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces SysNav, a three-level object navigation system that decouples semantic reasoning, navigation planning, and motion control for real-world cross-embodiment deployment. Uses VLMs for semantic understanding at the high level.

entry.title: Is Your Safe Controller Actually Safe? A Critical Review of CBF Tautologies and Hidden Assumptions

author.name: Taekyung Kim

entry.summary: Provides a critical tutorial review of Control Barrier Functions (CBFs) in robotic safety, identifying the gap between theoretical assumptions of safe controller existence and constructive realization under input constraints. Highlights cases where CBF demonstrations are limited to passively safe systems.

entry.title: HSC-VLA: Hierarchical Scene-Clearing for Robust Bimanual Manipulation in Dense Clutter

author.name: Zhen Liu, Xinyu Ning, Zhe Hu, XinXin Xie, Yitong Liu, Zhongzhu Pu

entry.summary: Proposes HSC-VLA, a hierarchical framework for bimanual manipulation in dense clutter that decouples visual-semantic reasoning from sensorimotor execution through scene-clearing abstraction. High-level Brain generates task-specific scene masks to suppress distractors.

entry.title: ICLR: In-Context Imitation Learning with Visual Reasoning

author.name: Toan Nguyen, Weiduo Yuan, Songlin Wei, Hui Li, Daniel Seita, Yue Wang

entry.summary: Presents ICLR (In-Context Imitation Learning with Visual Reasoning), augmenting demonstration prompts with structured visual reasoning traces representing anticipated future robot trajectories in image space. Jointly learns reasoning traces and actions.

entry.title: Choose What to Observe: Task-Aware Semantic-Geometric Representations for Visuomotor Policy

author.name: Haoran Ding, Liang Ma, Yaxun Yang, Wen Yang, Tianyu Liu, Anqing Duan, Xiaodan Liang, Dezhen Song, Ivan Laptev, Yoshihiko Nakamura

entry.summary: Proposes a task-aware observation interface that canonicalizes RGB input by segmenting objects with SAM3 and repainting them with semantic colors, improving visuomotor policy robustness to appearance shifts without retraining. Demonstrates improved OOD generalization across multiple manipulation benchmarks.

entry.title: PhaForce: Phase-Scheduled Visual-Force Policy Learning with Slow Planning and Fast Correction for Contact-Rich Manipulation

author.name: Mingxin Wang, Zhirun Yue, Renhao Lu, Yizhe Li, Zihan Wang, Guoping Pan, Kangkang Dong, Jun Cheng, Yi Cheng, Houde Liu

entry.summary: Proposes PhaForce, a phase-scheduled visual-force policy for contact-rich manipulation that coordinates low-rate visual planning and high-rate force correction via contact/phase scheduling. Addresses the mismatch between inference latency and force feedback needs.

entry.title: Embedding Classical Balance Control Principles in Reinforcement Learning for Humanoid Recovery

author.name: Nehar Poddar, Stephen McCrory, Luigi Penco, Geoffrey Clark, Hakki Erhan Svil, Robert Griffin

entry.summary: Presents a unified RL policy for humanoid recovery from falls by embedding classical balance metrics (capture point, CoM state, centroidal momentum) as privileged critic inputs and shaping rewards, enabling zero-shot hardware transfer.

entry.title: RAPID: Redundancy-Aware and Compatibility-Optimal Edge-Cloud Partitioned Inference for Diverse VLA models

author.name: Zihao Zheng, Sicheng Tian, Hangyu Cao, Chenyue Li, Jiayu Chen, Maoliang Li, Xinhao Sun, Hailong Zou, Guojie Luo, Xiang Chen

entry.summary: Proposes RAPID, an edge-cloud collaborative inference framework for VLA models that addresses visual noise sensitivity and step-wise redundancy in embodied tasks for efficient partitioned inference.

entry.title: Prologue to Terrified Comments on Claude's Constitution

author.name: Zack_M_Davis

entry.summary: Critical commentary on Anthropic's Claude constitution, arguing that a 'serious' alignment approach would require deep mechanistic understanding rather than constitutional principles, while acknowledging the practical reality of current approaches.

entry.title: Artificial Intelligence for Climate Adaptation: Reinforcement Learning for Climate Change-Resilient Transport

author.name: Miguel Costa, Arthur Vandervoort, Carolin Schmidt, Jo\~ao Miranda, Morten W. Petersen, Martin Drews, Karyn Morrisey, Francisco C. Pereira

entry.summary: Proposes a reinforcement learning framework for long-term climate adaptation planning in urban transport systems, formulated as an integrated assessment model combining flood modeling, transport simulation, and impact quantification.

entry.title: SecureRAG-RTL: A Retrieval-Augmented, Multi-Agent, Zero-Shot LLM-Driven Framework for Hardware Vulnerability Detection

author.name: Touseef Hasan, Blessing Airehenbuwa, Nitin Pundir, Souvika Sarkar, Ujjwal Guin

entry.summary: Proposes SecureRAG-RTL, a RAG-based multi-agent framework for zero-shot hardware vulnerability detection in HDL designs, addressing the scarcity of hardware security datasets for LLMs.

entry.title: Margin and Consistency Supervision for Calibrated and Robust Vision Models

author.name: Salim Khazem

entry.summary: Proposes Margin and Consistency Supervision (MaCS), an architecture-agnostic regularization framework combining margin penalty and consistency regularizer for improved calibration and robustness of vision classifiers.

entry.title: Evaluating LLM Alignment With Human Trust Models

author.name: Anushka Debnath, Stephen Cranefield, Bastin Tony Roy Savarimuthu, Emiliano Lorini

entry.summary: Performs white-box analysis of trust representation in GPT-J-6B using contrastive prompting, comparing learned trust concepts against five established human trust models.

entry.title: Who We Are, Where We Are: Mental Health at the Intersection of Person, Situation, and Large Language Models

author.name: Nikita Soni, August H{\aa}kan Nilsson, Syeda Mahwish, Vasudha Varadarajan, H. Andrew Schwartz, Ryan L. Boyd

entry.summary: Develops interpretable models integrating person-level psychological traits with situational features to predict mental health outcomes from longitudinal social media data. Uses the Situational 8 DIAMONDS framework and psychometrically-informed language models.

entry.title: TempoSyncDiff: Distilled Temporally-Consistent Diffusion for Low-Latency Audio-Driven Talking Head Generation

author.name: Soumya Mazumdar, Vineet Kumar Rakesh

entry.summary: Introduces TempoSyncDiff, a reference-conditioned latent diffusion framework using teacher-student distillation for efficient audio-driven talking head generation with fewer inference steps.

entry.title: A Hazard-Informed Data Pipeline for Robotics Physical Safety

author.name: Alexei Odinokov, Rostislav Yavorskiy

entry.summary: Presents a structured robotics physical safety framework that bridges classical risk engineering with ML pipelines, using hazard-driven synthetic data generation and digital twin simulation.

entry.title: Learning Where the Physics Is: Probabilistic Adaptive Sampling for Stiff PDEs

author.name: Akshay Govind Srinivasan, Balaji Srinivasan

entry.summary: Proposes a probabilistic adaptive sampling framework for Physics-Informed Extreme Learning Machines (PIELMs) to solve stiff PDEs, using GMM-based kernel placement learned via weighted EM.

entry.title: Prosodic Boundary-Aware Streaming Generation for LLM-Based TTS with Streaming Text Input

author.name: Changsong Liu, Tianrui Wang, Ye Ni, Yizhou Peng, Eng Siong Chng

entry.summary: Proposes prosodic-boundary-aware post-training for streaming TTS with streaming text input, using sliding-window prompts for bounded context and seamless concatenation in long-form speech.

entry.title: Distilling and Adapting: A Topology-Aware Framework for Zero-Shot Interaction Prediction in Multiplex Biological Networks

author.name: Alana Deng, Sugitha Janarthanan, Yan Sun, Zihao Jing, Pingzhao Hu

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for zero-shot interaction prediction in multiplex biological networks using knowledge distillation from foundation models and topology-aware graph tokenization.

entry.title: Leakage Safe Graph Features for Interpretable Fraud Detection in Temporal Transaction Networks

author.name: Hamideh Khaleghpour, Brett McKinney

entry.summary: Develops a time-respecting, leakage-safe graph feature extraction protocol for fraud detection in temporal transaction networks, computing causal variants of structural features like PageRank and HITS scores.

entry.title: Regression Models Meet Foundation Models: A Hybrid-AI Approach to Practical Electricity Price Forecasting

author.name: Yunzhong Qiu, Binzhu Li, Hao Wei, Shenglin Weng, Chen Wang, Zhongyi Pei, Mingsheng Long, Jianmin Wang

entry.summary: Proposes FutureBoosting, a paradigm combining regression models with time series foundation models (TSFMs) for electricity price forecasting, using TSFM-generated features to enhance regression-based forecasts.

entry.title: Diversity-Aware Adaptive Collocation for Physics-Informed Neural Networks via Sparse QUBO Optimization and Hybrid Coresets

author.name: Hadi Salloum, Maximilian Mifsud Bonici, Sinan Ibrahim, Pavel Osinenko, Alexei Kornaev

entry.summary: Reinterprets PINN collocation point selection as a coreset construction problem, formulated as a QUBO optimization to select informative and diverse points, incorporating quantum/hybrid solver approaches.

entry.title: Optimistic Policy Regularization

author.name: Mai Pham, Vikrant Vaze, Peter Chin

entry.summary: Introduces Optimistic Policy Regularization (OPR), which maintains a buffer of high-performing episodes and biases learning toward them through reward shaping and behavioral cloning to prevent premature entropy collapse in deep RL.

entry.title: Combinatorial Allocation Bandits with Nonlinear Arm Utility

author.name: Yuki Shibukawa, Koichi Tanaka, Yuta Saito, Shinji Ito

entry.summary: Proposes Combinatorial Allocation Bandits (CAB), a new online learning problem for matching platforms that incorporates arm satisfaction to prevent match concentration on popular participants.

entry.title: Learning to Reflect: Hierarchical Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for CSI-Free mmWave Beam-Focusing

author.name: Hieu Le, Oguz Bedir, Mostafa Ibrahim, Jian Tao, Sabit Ekin

entry.summary: Proposes a hierarchical multi-agent RL framework for controlling reconfigurable intelligent surfaces in mmWave systems without channel state information, using only user localization data.

entry.title: Slumbering to Precision: Enhancing Artificial Neural Network Calibration Through Sleep-like Processes

author.name: Jean Erik Delanois, Aditya Ahuja, Giri P. Krishnan, Maxim Bazhenov

entry.summary: Introduces Sleep Replay Consolidation (SRC), a bio-inspired post-training calibration method that mimics biological sleep by selectively replaying internal representations to improve neural network calibration without supervised retraining.

entry.title: Wiener Chaos Expansion based Neural Operator for Singular Stochastic Partial Differential Equations

author.name: Dai Shi, Luke Thompson, Andi Han, Peiyan Hu, Junbin Gao, Jos\'e Miguel Hern\'andez-Lobato

entry.summary: Applies Wiener Chaos Expansion neural operators to singular stochastic PDEs (dynamic Φ⁴₂ model) using feature-wise linear modulation to capture dependencies between solutions and smooth remainders.

entry.title: SCL-GNN: Towards Generalizable Graph Neural Networks via Spurious Correlation Learning

author.name: Yuxiang Zhang, Enyan Dai

entry.summary: Proposes SCL-GNN to improve GNN generalization by explicitly learning and mitigating spurious correlations using the Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion, targeting both IID and OOD generalization.

entry.title: Beyond the Markovian Assumption: Robust Optimization via Fractional Weyl Integrals in Imbalanced Data

author.name: Gustavo A. Dorrego

entry.summary: Introduces a novel optimization algorithm based on fractional calculus that replaces instantaneous gradients with dynamically weighted historical gradient sequences, acting as a natural regularizer for imbalanced data.

entry.title: Geometrically Constrained Outlier Synthesis

author.name: Daniil Karzanov, Marcin Detyniecki

entry.summary: Introduces GCOS, a training-time regularization that generates virtual outliers in hidden feature space respecting the manifold structure of in-distribution data, using conformal-inspired shells and dominant-variance subspaces.

entry.title: MUSA-PINN: Multi-scale Weak-form Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Fluid Flow in Complex Geometries

author.name: Weizheng Zhang, Xunjie Xie, Hao Pan, Xiaowei Duan, Bingteng Sun, Qiang Du, Lin lu

entry.summary: Proposes MUSA-PINN, a multi-scale weak-form physics-informed neural network that reformulates PDE constraints as integral conservation laws over hierarchical spherical control volumes for complex geometries like TPMS structures.

entry.title: NN-OpInf: an operator inference approach using structure-preserving composable neural networks

author.name: Eric Parish, Anthony Gruber, Patrick Blonigan, Irina Tezaur

entry.summary: Proposes NN-OpInf, a neural network-based operator inference framework for non-intrusive reduced-order modeling that preserves local operator structure (skew-symmetry, positive definiteness) while supporting composable heterogeneous operators.

entry.title: Divide and Predict: An Architecture for Input Space Partitioning and Enhanced Accuracy

author.name: Fenix W. Huang, Henning S. Mortveit, Christian M. Reidys

entry.summary: Develops an intrinsic measure for training data heterogeneity based on pairwise influence variance, proving it's maximal for equal distribution mixtures, and demonstrates variance-based data partitioning improves prediction accuracy.

entry.title: Isotonic Layer: A Universal Framework for Generic Recommendation Debiasing

author.name: Hailing Cheng, Yafang Yang, Hemeng Tao, Fengyu Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces the Isotonic Layer, a differentiable piecewise linear module that enforces monotonic constraints within neural architectures for recommendation system debiasing. Uses learnable embeddings to adaptively capture context-specific distortions.

entry.title: GraphSkill: Documentation-Guided Hierarchical Retrieval-Augmented Coding for Complex Graph Reasoning

author.name: Fali Wang, Chenglin Weng, Xianren Zhang, Siyuan Hong, Hui Liu, Suhang Wang

entry.summary: Proposes GraphSkill, a hierarchical retrieval-augmented coding system for graph reasoning that exploits the hierarchical structure of technical documentation and addresses logical errors beyond runtime errors in LLM code generation.

entry.title: CN-CBF: Composite Neural Control Barrier Function for Safe Robot Navigation in Dynamic Environments

author.name: Bojan Deraji\'c, Sebastian Bernhard, Wolfgang H\"onig

entry.summary: Proposes composite neural control barrier functions for safe robot navigation in dynamic environments, combining multiple neural CBFs trained via Hamilton-Jacobi reachability with residual dynamics learning.

entry.title: Statistical Contraction for Chance-Constrained Trajectory Optimization of Non-Gaussian Stochastic Systems

author.name: Rihan Aaron D'Silva, Hiroyasu Tsukamoto

entry.summary: Develops distribution-free robust trajectory optimization for nonlinear non-Gaussian stochastic systems using conformal inference for coverage-based confidence sets with closed-loop chance constraint satisfaction guarantees.

entry.title: Dial: A Knowledge-Grounded Dialect-Specific NL2SQL System

author.name: Xiang Zhang, Hongming Xu, Le Zhou, Wei Zhou, Xuanhe Zhou, Guoliang Li, Yuyu Luo, Changdong Liu, Guorun Chen, Jiang Liao, Fan Wu

entry.summary: Presents Dial, a knowledge-grounded framework for dialect-specific NL2SQL that handles heterogeneous database SQL dialects through dialect-aware logical query planning, separating intent reasoning from dialect syntax.

entry.title: Towards Lightweight Adaptation of Speech Enhancement Models in Real-World Environments

author.name: Longbiao Cheng, Shih-Chii Liu

entry.summary: Proposes lightweight adaptation of speech enhancement models using low-rank adapters updated via self-supervised training, updating fewer than 1% of parameters while adapting to 111 environments across 37 noise types.

entry.title: A Systematic Comparison of Training Objectives for Out-of-Distribution Detection in Image Classification

author.name: Furkan Gen\c{c}, Onat \"Ozdemir, Emre Akba\c{s}

entry.summary: Systematically compares four training objectives (Cross-Entropy, Prototype, Triplet, AP Loss) for out-of-distribution detection in image classification using standardized OpenOOD protocols across CIFAR-10/100 and ImageNet-200.

entry.title: Lindbladian Learning with Neural Differential Equations

author.name: Timothy Heightman, Roman Aseguinolaza Gallo, Edward Jiang, JRM Saavedra, Antonio Ac\'in, Marcin P{\l}odzie\'n

entry.summary: Tackles Lindbladian learning for open quantum systems using neural differential equations with maximum-likelihood estimation on transient Pauli measurements, exploiting richer information from transient dynamics.

entry.title: VLM-SubtleBench: How Far Are VLMs from Human-Level Subtle Comparative Reasoning?

author.name: Minkyu Kim, Sangheon Lee, Dongmin Park

entry.summary: Introduces VLM-SubtleBench, a benchmark for evaluating VLMs on subtle comparative reasoning across ten difference types, addressing the gap between benchmarks with salient differences and real-world subtle distinctions.

entry.title: Beyond ReinMax: Low-Variance Gradient Estimators for Discrete Latent Variables

author.name: Daniel Wang, Thang D. Bui

entry.summary: Introduces ReinMax-Rao and ReinMax-CV estimators that reduce variance in discrete latent variable gradient estimation by incorporating Rao-Blackwellisation and control variates into the ReinMax framework.

entry.title: Integrating Lagrangian Neural Networks into the Dyna Framework for Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Shreya Das, Kundan Kumar, Muhammad Iqbal, Outi Savolainen, Dominik Baumann, Laura Ruotsalainen, Simo S\"arkk\"a

entry.summary: Integrates Lagrangian Neural Networks into the Dyna MBRL framework, using physics-structured dynamics models that respect Lagrangian mechanics for more accurate model-based RL.

entry.title: STRIDE: Structured Lagrangian and Stochastic Residual Dynamics via Flow Matching

author.name: Prakrut Kotecha, Ganga Nair B, Shishir Kolathaya

entry.summary: Proposes STRIDE, a dynamics learning framework separating conservative rigid-body mechanics from stochastic residual dynamics using flow matching, for robust robot dynamics prediction.

entry.title: The Neural Compass: Probabilistic Relative Feature Fields for Robotic Search

author.name: Gabriele Somaschini, Adrian R\"ofer, Abhinav Valada

entry.summary: Proposes ProReFF for robotic search using learned probabilistic relative feature fields that predict spatial distributions of object features from unlabeled observations, enabling co-occurrence-based object finding.

entry.title: Momentum SVGD-EM for Accelerated Maximum Marginal Likelihood Estimation

author.name: Adam Rozzio, Rafael Athanasiades, O. Deniz Akyildiz

entry.summary: Proposes Momentum SVGD-EM, which adds Nesterov acceleration to both parameter updates and probability measure updates in a Stein variational gradient descent framework for maximum marginal likelihood estimation. Demonstrates consistent convergence acceleration.

entry.title: MedInjection-FR: Exploring the Role of Native, Synthetic, and Translated Data in Biomedical Instruction Tuning

author.name: Ikram Belmadani, Oumaima El Khettari, Pac\^ome Constant dit Beaufils, Benoit Favre, Richard Dufour

entry.summary: Introduces MedInjection-FR, a large-scale French biomedical instruction dataset (571K pairs) from native, synthetic, and translated sources. Systematically assesses how data provenance affects instruction tuning for medical French NLP.

entry.title: Emotion Transcription in Conversation: A Benchmark for Capturing Subtle and Complex Emotional States through Natural Language

author.name: Yoshiki Tanaka, Ryuichi Uehara, Koji Inoue, Michimasa Inaba

entry.summary: Proposes Emotion Transcription in Conversation (ETC), a new task generating natural language descriptions of speakers' emotional states rather than categorical labels. Constructs a Japanese dataset with self-reported emotional states.

entry.title: MAWARITH: A Dataset and Benchmark for Legal Inheritance Reasoning with LLMs

author.name: Abdessalam Bouchekif, Shahd Gaben, Samer Rashwani, Somaya Eltanbouly, Mutaz Al-Khatib, Heba Sbahi, Mohammed Ghaly, Emad Mohamed

entry.summary: Introduces MAWARITH, a 12,500-case dataset for Islamic inheritance law reasoning with full reasoning chains including heir identification, blocking rules, and exact share computation. Supports step-by-step evaluation of LLM legal reasoning.

entry.title: StyleBench: Evaluating Speech Language Models on Conversational Speaking Style Control

author.name: Haishu Zhao, Aokai Hao, Yuan Ge, Zhenqiang Hong, Tong Xiao, Jingbo Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes StyleBench, a multi-turn dialogue benchmark for evaluating speech language models' ability to control speaking style intensity across emotion, speed, volume, and pitch dimensions.

entry.title: Gradually Excavating External Knowledge for Implicit Complex Question Answering

author.name: Chang Liu, Xiaoguang Li, Lifeng Shang, Xin Jiang, Qun Liu, Edmund Y. Lam, Ngai Wong

entry.summary: Proposes a gradual knowledge excavation framework for open-domain complex QA where LLMs iteratively acquire external information and reason based on accumulated historical knowledge through action selection.

entry.title: LAMUS: A Large-Scale Corpus for Legal Argument Mining from U.S. Caselaw using LLMs

author.name: Serene Wang, Lavanya Pobbathi, Haihua Chen

entry.summary: Introduces LAMUS, a sentence-level legal argument mining corpus from U.S. Supreme Court and Texas criminal cases, created using LLM-based annotation with human quality refinement. Evaluates multiple models on six-class classification.

entry.title: Learning Multiple Utterance-Level Attribute Representations with a Unified Speech Encoder

author.name: Maryem Bouziane, Salima Mdhaffar, Yannick Est\`eve

entry.summary: Proposes a unified post-training approach for speech foundation models that learns multiple utterance-level attribute representations simultaneously, extending beyond just semantic alignment.

entry.title: The Third Ambition: Artificial Intelligence and the Science of Human Behavior

author.name: W. Russell Neuman, Chad Coleman

entry.summary: Articulates a 'third ambition' for AI beyond productivity and alignment: using LLMs as scientific instruments for studying human behavior, culture, and moral reasoning. Argues LLMs encode large-scale regularities in human symbolic production.

entry.title: Bootstrapping Audiovisual Speech Recognition in Zero-AV-Resource Scenarios with Synthetic Visual Data

author.name: Pol Buitrago, Pol G\`alvez, Oriol Pareras, Javier Hernando

entry.summary: Proposes a zero-AV-resource AVSR framework using synthetic visual streams from lip-syncing static images with real audio. Achieves near state-of-the-art on Catalan, a language with no annotated AV corpora, using 700+ hours of synthesized data.

entry.title: Accelerating Video Generation Inference with Sequential-Parallel 3D Positional Encoding Using a Global Time Index

author.name: Chao Yuan, Pan Li

entry.summary: Implements system-level inference optimizations for causal autoregressive video generation, adapting Self-Forcing to sequence parallel inference with Causal-RoPE SP. Reduces memory consumption and first-frame latency for long videos.

entry.title: SIQA: Toward Reliable Scientific Image Quality Assessment

author.name: Wenzhe Li, Liang Chen, Junying Wang, Yijing Guo, Ye Shen, Farong Wen, Chunyi Li, Zicheng Zhang, Guangtao Zhai

entry.summary: Introduces SIQA, a framework for scientific image quality assessment that evaluates not just perceptual fidelity but scientific correctness and logical completeness. Addresses the gap that visually plausible figures may contain conceptual errors.

entry.title: HERO: Hierarchical Embedding-Refinement for Open-Vocabulary Temporal Sentence Grounding in Videos

author.name: Tingting Han, Xinsong Tao, Yufei Yin, Min Tan, Sicheng Zhao, Zhou Yu

entry.summary: Introduces HERO for open-vocabulary temporal sentence grounding in videos. Creates the first OV-TSGV benchmarks (Charades-OV, ActivityNet-OV) and proposes hierarchical embedding refinement for generalizing beyond seen training concepts.

entry.title: HIERAMP: Coarse-to-Fine Autoregressive Amplification for Generative Dataset Distillation

author.name: Lin Zhao, Xinru Jiang, Xi Xiao, Qihui Fan, Lei Lu, Yanzhi Wang, Xue Lin, Octavia Camps, Pu Zhao, Jianyang Gu

entry.summary: Proposes HIERAMP for dataset distillation using vision autoregressive models, amplifying hierarchical semantics at different scales. Injects class tokens at each VAR scale to identify salient regions relevant to recognition.

entry.title: Fine-Grained 3D Facial Reconstruction for Micro-Expressions

author.name: Che Sun, Xinjie Zhang, Rui Gao, Xu Chen, Yuwei Wu, Yunde Jia

entry.summary: First work on 3D facial reconstruction for micro-expressions, proposing methods to capture subtle, transient facial movements by integrating global dynamic features with locally-enriched multi-cue features.

entry.title: Physics-Guided VLM Priors for All-Cloud Removal

author.name: Liying Xu, Huifang Li, Huanfeng Shen

entry.summary: PhyVLM-CR integrates VLM semantic capabilities with physical restoration models for unified cloud removal in remote sensing, transforming VLM cognitive priors into physical scattering parameters.

entry.title: ACD-U: Asymmetric co-teaching with machine unlearning for robust learning with noisy labels

author.name: Reo Fukunaga, Soh Yoshida, Mitsuji Muneyasu

entry.summary: ACD-U proposes asymmetric co-teaching with machine unlearning for robust learning with noisy labels, using different model architectures (CLIP ViT + ResNet) to correct selection errors that standard co-teaching cannot.

entry.title: Class Visualizations and Activation Atlases for Enhancing Interpretability in Deep Learning-Based Computational Pathology

author.name: Marco Gustav, Fabian Wolf, Christina Glasner, Nic G. Reitsam, Stefan Schulz, Kira Aschenbroich, Bruno M\"arkl, Sebastian Foersch, Jakob Nikolas Kather

entry.summary: Evaluates class visualizations and activation atlases for transformer-based computational pathology models, with pathologist annotations to quantify interpretability. Found these feature visualization methods have limitations for tissue classification.

entry.title: PresentBench: A Fine-Grained Rubric-Based Benchmark for Slide Generation

author.name: Xin-Sheng Chen, Jiayu Zhu, Pei-lin Li, Hanzheng Wang, Shuojin Yang, Meng-Hao Guo

entry.summary: PresentBench introduces a fine-grained rubric-based benchmark for evaluating automated slide generation, with verifiable evaluation criteria beyond coarse holistic judgments.

entry.title: FedEU: Evidential Uncertainty-Driven Federated Fine-Tuning of Vision Foundation Models for Remote Sensing Image Segmentation

author.name: Xiaokang Zhang, Xuran Xiong, Jianzhong Huang, Lefei Zhang

entry.summary: FedEU applies evidential uncertainty-driven federated fine-tuning for vision foundation models in remote sensing segmentation, using uncertainty estimation to improve reliability of collaborative optimization across heterogeneous clients.

entry.title: RobustSCI: Beyond Reconstruction to Restoration for Snapshot Compressive Imaging under Real-World Degradations

author.name: Hao Wang, Yuanfan Li, Qi Zhou, Zhankuo Xu, Jiong Ni, Xin Yuan

entry.summary: RobustSCI pioneers robust video snapshot compressive imaging restoration, shifting from reconstruction to restoration when captured signals are degraded by motion blur and low light.

entry.title: SketchGraphNet: A Memory-Efficient Hybrid Graph Transformer for Large-Scale Sketch Corpora Recognition

author.name: Shilong Chen, Mingyuan Li, Zhaoyang Wang, Zhonglin Ye, Haixing Zhao

entry.summary: SketchGraphNet proposes a hybrid graph neural architecture for large-scale sketch recognition from graph-structured data, with a 3.44M sketch benchmark across 344 categories.

entry.title: Duala: Dual-Level Alignment of Subjects and Stimuli for Cross-Subject fMRI Decoding

author.name: Shumeng Li, Jintao Guo, Jian Zhang, Yulin Zhou, Luyang Cao, Yinghuan Shi

entry.summary: Duala proposes dual-level alignment for cross-subject fMRI visual decoding, achieving stimulus-level consistency and subject-level alignment. Addresses the challenge of adapting brain-computer interfaces to new subjects with limited data.

entry.title: DECADE: A Temporally-Consistent Unsupervised Diffusion Model for Enhanced Rb-82 Dynamic Cardiac PET Image Denoising

author.name: Yinchi Zhou, Liang Guo, Huidong Xie, Yuexi Du, Ashley Wang, Menghua Xia, Tian Yu, Ramesh Fazzone-Chettiar, Christopher Weyman, Bruce Spottiswoode, Vladimir Panin, Kuangyu Shi, Edward J. Miller, Attila Feher, Albert J. Sinusas, Nicha C. Dvornek, Chi Liu

entry.summary: DECADE proposes an unsupervised diffusion model for denoising dynamic cardiac PET images with temporal consistency across early-to-late phase frames. Addresses the challenge of lacking paired clean-noisy training data in Rb-82 cardiac imaging.

entry.title: SGI: Structured 2D Gaussians for Efficient and Compact Large Image Representation

author.name: Zixuan Pan, Kaiyuan Tang, Jun Xia, Yifan Qin, Lin Gu, Chaoli Wang, Jianxu Chen, Yiyu Shi

entry.summary: SGI proposes Structured Gaussian Image representation that decomposes images into multi-scale local spaces with seed-based structured neural Gaussians. Achieves compact and efficient high-resolution image representation with 2D Gaussian Splatting.

entry.title: Fast Low-light Enhancement and Deblurring for 3D Dark Scenes

author.name: Feng Zhang, Jinglong Wang, Ze Li, Yanghong Zhou, Yang Chen, Lei Chen, Xiatian Zhu

entry.summary: FLED-GS addresses novel view synthesis from low-light, noisy, and motion-blurred imagery through alternating enhancement and 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstruction. Uses progressive brightness anchors to prevent noise amplification.

entry.title: SAVE: Speech-Aware Video Representation Learning for Video-Text Retrieval

author.name: Ruixiang Zhao, Zhihao Xu, Bangxiang Lan, Zijie Xin, Jingyu Liu, Xirong Li

entry.summary: SAVE improves video-text retrieval by incorporating speech content through a dedicated speech branch and soft-ALBEF fusion. Addresses the common neglect of audio tracks in CLIP-based video retrieval.

entry.title: SiMO: Single-Modality-Operable Multimodal Collaborative Perception

author.name: Jiageng Wen, Shengjie Zhao, Bing Li, Jiafeng Huang, Kenan Ye, Hao Deng

entry.summary: SiMO introduces Single-Modality-Operable Multimodal Collaborative Perception, addressing the problem of sensor failures in multi-agent collaborative perception. Uses Length-Adaptive Multi-Modal Fusion (LAMMA) to handle missing modalities gracefully.

entry.title: HDR-NSFF: High Dynamic Range Neural Scene Flow Fields

author.name: Shin Dong-Yeon, Kim Jun-Seong, Kwon Byung-Ki, Tae-Hyun Oh

entry.summary: HDR-NSFF reconstructs dynamic HDR radiance fields from alternating-exposure monocular videos by representing scenes as continuous 4D spatio-temporal functions. This shifts from traditional 2D pixel-level HDR merging to 4D modeling, reducing ghosting artifacts.

entry.title: All Vehicles Can Lie: Efficient Adversarial Defense in Fully Untrusted-Vehicle Collaborative Perception via Pseudo-Random Bayesian Inference

author.name: Yi Yu, Libing Wu, Zhuangzhuang Zhang, Jing Qiu, Lijuan Huo, Jiaqi Feng

entry.summary: Proposes Pseudo-Random Bayesian Inference (PRBI) for adversarial defense in collaborative perception where all vehicles may be untrusted, eliminating the assumption of a trusted ego vehicle.

entry.title: SecAgent: Efficient Mobile GUI Agent with Semantic Context

author.name: Yiping Xie, Song Chen, Jingxuan Xing, Wei Jiang, Zekun Zhu, Yingyao Wang, Pi Bu, Jun Song, Yuning Jiang, Bo Zheng

entry.summary: SecAgent is a 3B-scale mobile GUI agent with a human-verified Chinese dataset of 18k grounding samples and 121k navigation steps, plus a semantic context mechanism for efficient history representation.

entry.title: RoboPCA: Pose-centered Affordance Learning from Human Demonstrations for Robot Manipulation

author.name: Zhanqi Xiao, Ruiping Wang, Xilin Chen

entry.summary: RoboPCA proposes pose-centered affordance prediction that jointly predicts contact regions and poses conditioned on instructions, addressing inconsistencies in existing methods that separate region prediction from pose estimation.

entry.title: AffordGrasp: Cross-Modal Diffusion for Affordance-Aware Grasp Synthesis

author.name: Xiaofei Wu, Yi Zhang, Yumeng Liu, Yuexin Ma, Yujiao Shi, Xuming He

entry.summary: AffordGrasp uses a cross-modal diffusion framework for generating human grasping poses that reflect both object geometry and textual interaction semantics, with a scalable annotation pipeline for hand-object interaction data.

entry.title: UniGround: Universal 3D Visual Grounding via Training-Free Scene Parsing

author.name: Jiaxi Zhang, Yunheng Wang, Wei Lu, Taowen Wang, Weisheng Xu, Shuning Zhang, Yixiao Feng, Yuetong Fang, Renjing Xu

entry.summary: UniGround proposes training-free 3D visual grounding via scene parsing that replaces pre-trained model constraints with dynamic scene analysis, enabling better generalization to unseen spatial relationships.

entry.title: Stability-Guided Exploration for Diverse Motion Generation

author.name: Eckart Cobo-Briesewitz, Tilman Burghoff, Denis Shcherba, Armand Jordana, Marc Toussaint

entry.summary: Proposes a method for generating diverse long-horizon manipulation trajectories through simulation by combining RRT-style search with sampling-based MPC and stability-guided exploration. Addresses the data bottleneck in robot learning by generating synthetic training data.

entry.title: VSL-Skin: Individually Addressable Phase-Change Voxel Skin for Variable-Stiffness and Virtual Joints Bridging Soft and Rigid Robots

author.name: Zihan Oliver Zeng, Jiajun An, Preston Luk, Upinder Kaur

entry.summary: Introduces VSL-Skin, the first system enabling individually addressable voxel-level morphological control with centimeter-scale precision using phase-change materials. Achieves nearly two orders of magnitude stiffness modulation across multiple modes.

entry.title: SSP: Safety-guaranteed Surgical Policy via Joint Optimization of Behavioral and Spatial Constraints

author.name: Jianshu Hu, ZhiYuan Guan, Lei Song, Kantaphat Leelakunwet, Hesheng Wang, Wei Xiao, Qi Dou, Yutong Ban

entry.summary: Proposes SSP framework for safety-guaranteed surgical policies using Neural ODEs for uncertainty-aware dynamics learning and robust Control Barrier Functions to minimally alter surgical policy actions for safety compliance.

entry.title: DexKnot: Generalizable Visuomotor Policy Learning for Dexterous Bag-Knotting Manipulation

author.name: Jiayuan Zhang, Ruihai Wu, Haojun Chen, Yuran Wang, Yifan Zhong, Ceyao Zhang, Yaodong Yang, Yuanpei Chen

entry.summary: Presents DexKnot, a framework for learning generalizable bag-knotting policies using keypoint affordance with diffusion policy. Learns shape-agnostic bag representations from keypoint correspondence data collected through real-world manual deformation.

entry.title: InterReal: A Unified Physics-Based Imitation Framework for Learning Human-Object Interaction Skills

author.name: Dayang Liang, Yuhang Lin, Xinzhe Liu, Jiyuan Shi, Yunlong Liu, Chenjia Bai

entry.summary: Develops InterReal, a unified physics-based imitation learning framework for human-object interaction skills on humanoid robots. Includes HOI motion data augmentation with contact constraints and automatic reward learning for sim-to-real transfer.

entry.title: MoMaStage: Skill-State Graph Guided Planning and Closed-Loop Execution for Long-Horizon Indoor Mobile Manipulation

author.name: Chenxu Li, Zixuan Chen, Yetao Li, Jiapeng Xu, Hongyu Ding, Jieqi Shi, Jing Huo, Yang Gao

entry.summary: Proposes MoMaStage, a structured VLM framework for long-horizon indoor mobile manipulation that uses a Hierarchical Skill Library and topology-aware Skill-State Graph for planning without explicit scene mapping.

entry.title: FoMo: A Multi-Season Dataset for Robot Navigation in For\^et Montmorency

author.name: Mat\v{e}j Boxan, Gabriel Jeanson, Alexander Krawciw, Effie Daum, Xinyuan Qiao, Sven Lilge, Timothy D. Barfoot, Fran\c{c}ois Pomerleau

entry.summary: Presents the FoMo dataset: 64+ km of multi-season robot navigation data collected over one year in a boreal forest, including extreme conditions like 1m+ snow accumulation. Features multiple lidar modalities including FMCW radar.

entry.title: R2F: Repurposing Ray Frontiers for LLM-free Object Navigation

author.name: Francesco Argenziano, John Mark Alexis Marcelo, Michele Brienza, Abdel Hakim Drid, Emanuele Musumeci, Daniele Nardi, Domenico D. Bloisi, Vincenzo Suriani

entry.summary: Proposes R2F, an LLM-free framework for indoor open-vocabulary object navigation by repurposing ray frontiers to encode semantic information without iterative large model queries at inference time.

entry.title: CRED: Counterfactual Reasoning and Environment Design for Active Preference Learning

author.name: Yi-Shiuan Tung, Gyanig Kumar, Wei Jiang, Bradley Hayes, Alessandro Roncone

entry.summary: Proposes CRED, a counterfactual trajectory generation method for active preference learning that designs environments and generates trajectories to maximize informativeness of human preference queries.

entry.title: Claude Code, Claude Cowork and Codex #5

author.name: Zvi

entry.summary: Zvi's comprehensive summary of agentic coding developments including Claude Code, Claude Cowork, and Codex, plus GPT-5.4 reactions. Covers the rapidly evolving landscape of AI-powered coding tools and their implications.

entry.title: Real-Time AI Service Economy: A Framework for Agentic Computing Across the Continuum

author.name: Lauri Lov\'en, Alaa Saleh, Reza Farahani, Ilir Murturi, Miguel Bordallo L\'opez, Praveen Kumar Donta, Schahram Dustdar

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for real-time AI service economies across device-edge-cloud continuum, showing that service-dependency graph structure determines whether decentralized, price-based resource allocation works at scale. Identifies conditions under which DAG-based scheduling converges to stable equilibria.

entry.title: Adversarial Batch Representation Augmentation for Batch Correction in High-Content Cellular Screening

author.name: Lei Tong, Xujing Yao, Adam Corrigan, Long Chen, Navin Rathna Kumar, Kerry Hallbrook, Jonathan Orme, Yinhai Wang, Huiyu Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes ABRA, an adversarial batch representation augmentation method that frames bio-batch correction in high-content screening as a domain generalization problem, modeling batch-wise statistical fluctuations.

entry.title: Lexara: A User-Centered Toolkit for Evaluating Large Language Models for Conversational Visual Analytics

author.name: Srishti Palani, Vidya Setlur

entry.summary: Presents Lexara, a user-centered evaluation toolkit for conversational visual analytics (CVA) developed from interviews with 22 developers and 16 end-users, providing interpretable metrics for multi-format outputs.

entry.title: Sensitivity-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Intent Clarification

author.name: Maik Larooij

entry.summary: Addresses sensitivity-aware retrieval-augmented intent clarification for conversational search, particularly in domains with sensitive information like healthcare and legal contexts.

entry.title: A Causal Graph Approach to Oppositional Narrative Analysis

author.name: Diego Revilla, Martin Fernandez-de-Retana, Lingfeng Chen, Aritz Bilbao-Jayo, Miguel Fernandez-de-Retana

entry.summary: Proposes a graph-based framework for detecting and analyzing oppositional narratives by representing them as entity-interaction graphs with causal estimation at the node level.

entry.title: GazeMoE: Perception of Gaze Target with Mixture-of-Experts

author.name: Zhuangzhuang Dai, Zhongxi Lu, Vincent G. Zakka, Luis J. Manso, Jose M Alcaraz Calero, Chen Li

entry.summary: Proposes GazeMoE, an end-to-end gaze target estimation framework using Mixture-of-Experts to selectively leverage multi-modal cues from a frozen foundation model.

entry.title: Fly360: Omnidirectional Obstacle Avoidance within Drone View

author.name: Xiangkai Zhang, Dizhe Zhang, WenZhuo Cao, Zhaoliang Wan, Yingjie Niu, Lu Qi, Xu Yang, Zhiyong Liu

entry.summary: Proposes Fly360 for omnidirectional obstacle avoidance in UAVs using panoramic perception, addressing the limitation of current methods that use limited field-of-view sensors.

entry.title: Correlation Analysis of Generative Models

author.name: Zhengguo Li, Chaobing Zheng, Wei Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a unified representation for diffusion models and flow matching using two simple linear equations, with theoretical analysis showing weak correlation between noisy data and predicted targets in existing models.

entry.title: Graph Property Inference in Small Language Models: Effects of Representation and Inference Strategy

author.name: Michal Podstawski

entry.summary: Systematic study of graph property inference in small instruction-tuned language models, examining how input representation and reasoning strategy affect performance on graph-theoretic tasks.

entry.title: HURRI-GAN: A Novel Approach for Hurricane Bias-Correction Beyond Gauge Stations using Generative Adversarial Networks

author.name: Noujoud Nadera, Hadi Majed, Stefanos Giaremis, Rola El Osta, Clint Dawson, Carola Kaiser, Hartmut Kaiser

entry.summary: Proposes HURRI-GAN, using Generative Adversarial Networks for bias-correcting hurricane storm surge predictions beyond gauge station locations, potentially replacing computationally expensive high-resolution physical simulations.

entry.title: Don't Freeze, Don't Crash: Extending the Safe Operating Range of Neural Navigation in Dense Crowds

author.name: Jiefu Zhang, Yang Xu, Vaneet Aggarwal

entry.summary: Proposes a RL approach for dense crowd navigation with density-invariant observation encoding and density-randomized training, achieving zero-shot generalization to crowd densities unseen during training.

entry.title: Learning Unbiased Cluster Descriptors for Interpretable Imbalanced Concept Drift Detection

author.name: Yiqun Zhang, Zhanpei Huang, Mingjie Zhao, Chuyao Zhang, Yang Lu, Yuzhu Ji, Fangqing Gu, An Zeng

entry.summary: Proposes a method for detecting concept drift in imbalanced streaming data by learning unbiased cluster descriptors that avoid the masking effect where large clusters hide changes in small ones.

entry.title: SpatialMAGIC: A Hybrid Framework Integrating Graph Diffusion and Spatial Attention for Spatial Transcriptomics Imputation

author.name: Sayeem Bin Zaman, Fahim Hafiz, Riasat Azim

entry.summary: Proposes SpatialMagic for spatial transcriptomics imputation, combining MAGIC-based graph diffusion with transformer spatial self-attention to recover missing gene expression values while maintaining spatial consistency.

entry.title: Physics-informed AI Accelerated Retention Analysis of Ferroelectric Vertical NAND: From Day-Scale TCAD to Second-Scale Surrogate Model

author.name: Gyujun Jeong (School of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Georgia Institute of Technology, GA, USA), Sungwon Cho (School of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Georgia Institute of Technology, GA, USA), Minji Shon (School of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Georgia Institute of Technology, GA, USA), Namhoon Kim (School of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Georgia Institute of Technology, GA, USA), Woohyun Hwang (Semiconductor Research and Development, Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd, South Korea), Kwangyou Seo (Semiconductor Research and Development, Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd, South Korea), Suhwan Lim (Semiconductor Research and Development, Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd, South Korea), Wanki Kim (Semiconductor Research and Development, Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd, South Korea), Daewon Ha (Semiconductor Research and Development, Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd, South Korea), Prasanna Venkatesan (NVIDIA, Santa Clara, CA, USA), Kihang Youn (NVIDIA, Santa Clara, CA, USA), Ram Cherukuri (NVIDIA, Santa Clara, CA, USA), Yiyi Wang (NVIDIA, Santa Clara, CA, USA), Suman Datta (School of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Georgia Institute of Technology, GA, USA), Asif Khan (School of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Georgia Institute of Technology, GA, USA), Shimeng Yu (School of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Georgia Institute of Technology, GA, USA)

entry.summary: Develops a Physics-Informed Neural Operator surrogate model for ferroelectric VNAND retention analysis, reducing simulation time from days (TCAD) to seconds while maintaining accuracy.

entry.title: Not All Neighbors Matter: Understanding the Impact of Graph Sparsification on GNN Pipelines

author.name: Yuhang Song, Naima Abrar Shami, Romaric Duvignau, Vasiliki Kalavri

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates whether graph sparsification can serve as a lightweight pre-processing step to accelerate GNN pipelines while preserving node classification accuracy, developing an extensible evaluation framework.

entry.title: LF2L: Loss Fusion Horizontal Federated Learning Across Heterogeneous Feature Spaces Using External Datasets Effectively: A Case Study in Second Primary Cancer Prediction

author.name: Chia-Fu Lin, Yi-Ju Tseng

entry.summary: Proposes LF2L, a federated learning approach for heterogeneous feature spaces using external datasets, applied to second primary cancer prediction across Taiwanese and US datasets.

entry.title: Retrieval-Augmented Multi-scale Framework for County-Level Crop Yield Prediction Across Large Regions

author.name: Yiming Sun, Qi Cheng, Licheng Liu, Runlong Yu, Yiqun Xie, Xiaowei Jia

entry.summary: Proposes a retrieval-augmented multi-scale framework for county-level crop yield prediction that captures both short-term and long-term temporal patterns across large geographic regions.

entry.title: Online Continual Learning for Anomaly Detection in IoT under Data Distribution Shifts

author.name: Matea Marinova, Shashi Raj Pandey, Junya Shiraishi, Martin Voigt Vejling, Valentin Rakovic, Petar Popovski

entry.summary: Presents OCLADS, a continual learning framework for IoT anomaly detection that tracks distribution shifts and strategically updates models through intelligent sample selection and shift detection.

entry.title: Generative prediction of laser-induced rocket ignition with dynamic latent space representations

author.name: Tony Zahtila, Ettore Saetta, Murray Cutforth, Davy Brouzet, Diego Rossinelli, Gianluca Iaccarino

entry.summary: Combines convolutional autoencoders with neural ODEs for surrogate modeling of laser-ignited rocket engine simulations, enabling rapid design space exploration.

entry.title: Adversarial Domain Adaptation Enables Knowledge Transfer Across Heterogeneous RNA-Seq Datasets

author.name: Kevin Dradjat, Massinissa Hamidi, Blaise Hanczar

entry.summary: Proposes a deep learning domain adaptation framework for transferring knowledge across heterogeneous RNA-seq datasets with different preprocessing pipelines and target phenotypes for phenotype prediction.

entry.title: Mitigating Homophily Disparity in Graph Anomaly Detection: A Scalable and Adaptive Approach

author.name: Yunhui Liu, Qizhuo Xie, Yinfeng Chen, Xudong Jin, Tao Zheng, Bin Chong, Tieke He

entry.summary: Proposes SAGAD for graph anomaly detection, addressing homophily disparity and scalability through precomputed multi-hop embeddings with reparameterized Chebyshev filters and an anomaly-aware attention mechanism.

entry.title: SYNAPSE: Framework for Neuron Analysis and Perturbation in Sequence Encoding

author.name: Jes\'us S\'anchez Ochoa, Enrique Tom\'as Mart\'inez Beltr\'an, Alberto Huertas Celdr\'an

entry.summary: Proposes SYNAPSE, a training-free framework for neuron-level analysis and perturbation in sequence models, enabling systematic evaluation of internal robustness across architectures and domains.

entry.title: Data-Driven Priors for Uncertainty-Aware Deterioration Risk Prediction with Multimodal Data

author.name: L. Juli\'an Lechuga L\'opez, Tim G. J. Rudner, Farah E. Shamout

entry.summary: Proposes MedCertAIn, a multimodal clinical uncertainty framework using data-driven priors over neural network parameters for in-hospital risk prediction, combining structured and unstructured clinical data.

entry.title: DualFlexKAN: Dual-stage Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks with Independent Function Control

author.name: Andr\'es Ortiz, Nicol\'as J. Gallego-Molina, Carmen Jim\'enez-Mesa, Juan M. G\'orriz, Javier Ram\'irez

entry.summary: Introduces DualFlexKAN, a dual-stage Kolmogorov-Arnold Network architecture with independently controlled pre-linear and post-linear transformations, addressing parameter scaling and regularization issues in standard KANs.

entry.title: Don't Look Back in Anger: MAGIC Net for Streaming Continual Learning with Temporal Dependence

author.name: Federico Giannini, Sandro D'Andrea, Emanuele Della Valle

entry.summary: Introduces MAGIC Net for streaming continual learning that integrates continual learning architectural strategies with recurrent neural networks, handling temporal dependence while performing all operations online.

entry.title: T-REX: Transformer-Based Category Sequence Generation for Grocery Basket Recommendation

author.name: Soroush Mokhtari, Muhammad Tayyab Asif, Sergiy Zubatiy

entry.summary: Proposes T-REX, a transformer architecture for grocery basket recommendation at Amazon that generates personalized category-level suggestions by learning short-term basket dependencies and long-term user preferences.

entry.title: Topology-Aware Reinforcement Learning over Graphs for Resilient Power Distribution Networks

author.name: Roshni Anna Jacob, Prithvi Poddar, Jaidev Goel, Souma Chowdhury, Yulia R. Gel, Jie Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces a topology-aware graph RL framework for power distribution network outage management that embeds persistent homology features, achieving 9-18% higher rewards on IEEE test cases.

entry.title: Compressed Proximal Federated Learning for Non-Convex Composite Optimization on Heterogeneous Data

author.name: Pu Qiu, Chen Ouyang, Yongyang Xiong, Keyou You, Wanquan Liu, Yang Shi

entry.summary: Proposes FedCEF for federated composite optimization with non-convex objectives, introducing decoupled proximal updates that separate the proximal operator from communication to enable biased compression.

entry.title: Viewpoint-Agnostic Grasp Pipeline using VLM and Partial Observations

author.name: Dilermando Almeida, Juliano Negri, Guilherme Lazzarini, Thiago H. Segreto, Ranulfo Bezerra, Ricardo V. Godoy, Marcelo Becker

entry.summary: Presents an end-to-end pipeline for language-guided robotic grasping that handles partial observations through depth compensation, point cloud completion, and collision-free grasp planning on a real robot.

entry.title: Rel-MOSS: Towards Imbalanced Relational Deep Learning on Relational Databases

author.name: Jun Yin, Peng Huo, Bangguo Zhu, Hao Yan, Senzhang Wang, Shirui Pan, Chengqi Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces Rel-MOSS, the first method addressing class imbalance in relational deep learning on relational databases, using relation-centric minority oversampling with GNNs.

entry.title: FlowTouch: View-Invariant Visuo-Tactile Prediction

author.name: Seongjin Bien, Carlo Kneissl, Tobias J\"ulg, Frank Fundel, Thomas Ressler-Antal, Florian Walter, Bj\"orn Ommer, Gitta Kutyniok, Wolfram Burgard

entry.summary: Proposes FlowTouch for predicting tactile sensor readings from visual information in a view-invariant manner, bridging the gap between visual planning and contact-rich manipulation.

entry.title: Graph-Instructed Neural Networks for parametric problems with varying boundary conditions

author.name: Francesco Della Santa, Sandra Pieraccini, Maria Strazzullo

entry.summary: Proposes Graph-Instructed Neural Networks (GINNs) for parametric PDEs with varying boundary conditions, overcoming limitations of Galerkin-based reduced order methods that require reformulation for each boundary configuration.

entry.title: Taiwan Safety Benchmark and Breeze Guard: Toward Trustworthy AI for Taiwanese Mandarin

author.name: Po-Chun Hsu, Meng-Hsi Chen, Tsu Ling Chao, Chia Tien Han, Da-shan Shiu

entry.summary: Introduces TS-Bench, a safety benchmark for Taiwanese Mandarin with 400 human-curated prompts covering financial fraud, medical misinformation, social discrimination, and political manipulation, plus Breeze Guard, an 8B safety model.

entry.title: Bolbosh: Script-Aware Flow Matching for Kashmiri Text-to-Speech

author.name: Tajamul Ashraf, Burhaan Rasheed Zargar, Saeed Abdul Muizz, Ifrah Mushtaq, Nazima Mehdi, Iqra Altaf Gillani, Aadil Amin Kak, Janibul Bashir

entry.summary: Presents Bolbosh, the first open-source neural TTS system for Kashmiri, using script-aware flow matching with supervised cross-lingual adaptation. Shows zero-shot multilingual baselines fail with only 1.86 MOS.

entry.title: KohakuRAG: A simple RAG framework with hierarchical document indexing

author.name: Shih-Ying Yeh, Yueh-Feng Ku, Ko-Wei Huang, Buu-Khang Tu

entry.summary: Presents KohakuRAG, a hierarchical RAG framework with four-level tree document representation, LLM-powered query planning, and self-consistency based answer stabilization for high-precision citation tasks.

entry.title: Dual-Metric Evaluation of Social Bias in Large Language Models: Evidence from an Underrepresented Nepali Cultural Context

author.name: Ashish Pandey, Tek Raj Chhetri

entry.summary: Analyzes social biases in seven LLMs within the Nepali cultural context using a Dual-Metric Bias Assessment framework. Tests agreement with biased statements and stereotypical completion tendencies.

entry.title: Gender Bias in MT for a Genderless Language: New Benchmarks for Basque

author.name: Amaia Murillo, Olatz-Perez-de-Vi\~naspre, Naiara Perez

entry.summary: Introduces two new datasets for evaluating gender bias in machine translation involving Basque, a genderless language. WinoMTeus tests how gender-neutral occupations are translated into gendered languages.

entry.title: Do Language Models Know Theo Has a Wife? Investigating the Proviso Problem

author.name: Tara Azin, Daniel Dumitrescu, Diana Inkpen, Raj Singh

entry.summary: Investigates how language models handle the proviso problem in pragmatics, where presuppositions in conditional sentences diverge between theoretical and human interpretations. Finds models rely on shallow pattern matching.

entry.title: TimeSpot: Benchmarking Geo-Temporal Understanding in Vision-Language Models in Real-World Settings

author.name: Azmine Toushik Wasi, Shahriyar Zaman Ridoy, Koushik Ahamed Tonmoy, Kinga Tshering, S. M. Muhtasimul Hasan, Wahid Faisal, Tasnim Mohiuddin, Md Rizwan Parvez

entry.summary: Introduces TimeSpot, a benchmark of 1,455 ground-level images from 80 countries for evaluating VLMs on geo-temporal reasoning (season, month, time of day, etc.). Tests both spatial and temporal understanding from visual cues.

entry.title: SJD-PV: Speculative Jacobi Decoding with Phrase Verification for Autoregressive Image Generation

author.name: Zhehao Yu, Baoquan Zhang, Bingqi Shan, Xinhao Liu, Dongliang Zhou, Guotao Liang, Guangming Ye, Yunming Ye

entry.summary: Introduces SJD-PV, a training-free acceleration framework for autoregressive image generation that performs phrase-level speculative verification. Groups correlated tokens based on co-occurrence statistics for joint validation.

entry.title: RADAR: A Multimodal Benchmark for 3D Image-Based Radiology Report Review

author.name: Zhaoyi Sun, Minal Jagtiani, Wen-wai Yim, Fei Xia, Martin Gunn, Meliha Yetisgen, Asma Ben Abacha

entry.summary: Presents RADAR, a multimodal benchmark pairing 3D medical images with preliminary radiology reports and candidate edits. Reflects clinical workflow where trainee reports are reviewed by attending radiologists.

entry.title: ECHO: Event-Centric Hypergraph Operations via Multi-Agent Collaboration for Multimedia Event Extraction

author.name: Hailong Chu, Shuo Zhang, Yunlong Chu, Shutai Huang, Xingyue Zhang, Tinghe Yan, Jinsong Zhang, Lei Li

entry.summary: Proposes ECHO, a multi-agent framework for multimedia event extraction using event-centric hypergraph operations. Agents iteratively refine a shared multimedia event hypergraph to avoid cascading errors from linear pipelines.

entry.title: HARP: HARmonizing in-vivo diffusion MRI using Phantom-only training

author.name: Hwihun Jeong, Qiang Liu, Kathryn E. Keenan, Elisabeth A. Wilde, Walter Schneider, Sudhir Pathak, Anthony Zuccolotto, Lauren J. O'Donnell, Lipeng Ning, Yogesh Rathi

entry.summary: Introduces HARP, a deep learning framework for harmonizing multi-site diffusion MRI data trained only on easily transportable phantoms, eliminating the need for traveling human subjects. Uses voxel-wise 1D neural networks.

entry.title: PICS: Pairwise Image Compositing with Spatial Interactions

author.name: Hang Zhou, Xinxin Zuo, Sen Wang, Li Cheng

entry.summary: Introduces PICS, a self-supervised composition-by-decomposition paradigm for pairwise image compositing that preserves coherent spatial relations. Uses mask-guided Mixture-of-Experts to route background, exclusive, and overlap regions.

entry.title: SurgCUT3R: Surgical Scene-Aware Continuous Understanding of Temporal 3D Representation

author.name: Kaiyuan Xu, Fangzhou Hong, Daniel Elson, Baoru Huang

entry.summary: SurgCUT3R adapts general-purpose 3D reconstruction models to surgical scenes, addressing training data scarcity and long-sequence degradation through a data pipeline using stereo surgical datasets and hybrid supervision. Demonstrates improved surgical scene reconstruction from monocular endoscopy.

entry.title: Facial Expression Generation Aligned with Human Preference for Natural Dyadic Interaction

author.name: Xu Chen, Rui Gao, Xinjie Zhang, Haoyu Zhang, Che Sun, Zhi Gao, Yuwei Wu, Yunde Jia

entry.summary: Proposes facial expression generation for dyadic interaction aligned with human preference via human feedback, framing identity-independent expression generation as an action learning process.

entry.title: FreeFly-Thinking : Aligning Chain-of-Thought Reasoning with Continuous UAV Navigation

author.name: Jiaxu Zhou, Shaobo Wang, Zhiyuan Yang, Zhenjun Yu, Tao Li

entry.summary: FreeFly-Thinking introduces a VLN framework for UAV navigation in outdoor urban settings with chain-of-thought reasoning, converting egocentric images and language instructions into action sequences.

entry.title: LEPA: Learning Geometric Equivariance in Satellite Remote Sensing Data with a Predictive Architecture

author.name: Erik Scheurer, Rocco Sedona, Stefan Kesselheim, Gabriele Cavallaro

entry.summary: LEPA proposes a learned equivariance-predicting architecture for handling geometric mismatches between user-defined areas of interest and fixed precomputed embedding grids in geospatial foundation models.

entry.title: QdaVPR: A novel query-based domain-agnostic model for visual place recognition

author.name: Shanshan Wan, Lai Kang, Yingmei Wei, Tianrui Shen, Haixuan Wang, Chao Zuo

entry.summary: QdaVPR proposes a query-based domain-agnostic visual place recognition model using dual-level adversarial learning for explicit domain supervision, generalizing to unseen domain shifts.

entry.title: Scale-Aware UAV-to-Satellite Cross-View Geo-Localization: A Semantic Geometric Approach

author.name: Yibin Ye, Shuo Chen, Kun Wang, Xiaokai Song, Jisheng Dang, Qifeng Yu, Xichao Teng, Zhang Li

entry.summary: Proposes a geometric framework for UAV-to-satellite cross-view geo-localization that recovers absolute metric scale from monocular UAV images using small vehicles as semantic anchors.
