entry.title: Active Inference for Micro-Gesture Recognition: EFE-Guided Temporal Sampling and Adaptive Learning

author.name: Weijia Feng, Jingyu Yang, Ruojia Zhang, Fengtao Sun, Qian Gao, Chenyang Wang, Tongtong Su, Jia Guo, Xiaobai Li, Minglai Shao

entry.summary: Applies active inference with Expected Free Energy-guided temporal sampling for micro-gesture recognition, actively selecting discriminative temporal segments under uncertainty.

entry.title: Efficient RGB-D Scene Understanding via Multi-task Adaptive Learning and Cross-dimensional Feature Guidance

author.name: Guodong Sun, Junjie Liu, Gaoyang Zhang, Bo Wu, Yang Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes an efficient RGB-D scene understanding model performing semantic/instance/panoptic segmentation, orientation estimation, and classification with adaptive attention and cross-dimensional feature guidance.

entry.title: EmbedTalk: Triplane-Free Talking Head Synthesis using Embedding-Driven Gaussian Deformation

author.name: Arpita Saggar, Jonathan C. Darling, Duygu Sarikaya, David C. Hogg

entry.summary: EmbedTalk replaces tri-plane representations with learnt embeddings for 3D Gaussian Splatting-based talking head synthesis. Shows that direct embeddings can outperform tri-plane encoding for modeling speech-driven facial deformations.

entry.title: Learning Context-Adaptive Motion Priors for Masked Motion Diffusion Models with Efficient Kinematic Attention Aggregation

author.name: Junkun Jiang, Jie Chen, Ho Yin Au, Jingyu Xiang

entry.summary: Introduces Masked Motion Diffusion Model (MMDM) for reconstructing incomplete motion capture data using a diffusion-based framework with Kinematic Attention Aggregation. Handles occlusions and noisy data from both vision-based and wearable motion capture.

entry.title: Training-free Temporal Object Tracking in Surgical Videos

author.name: Subhadeep Koley, Abdolrahim Kadkhodamohammadi, Santiago Barbarisi, Danail Stoyanov, Imanol Luengo

entry.summary: Leverages pre-trained text-to-image diffusion model features for training-free object tracking in laparoscopic surgical videos. Uses cross-frame affinity matrices for temporal continuity without fine-tuning.

entry.title: Structure and Progress Aware Diffusion for Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Siyuan Song, Guyue Hu, Chenglong Li, Dengdi Sun, Zhe Jin, Jin Tang

entry.summary: SPAD proposes structure and progress-aware diffusion for medical image segmentation that separates learning of coarse structures from fine boundaries. Uses curriculum-style progressive training to handle boundary ambiguity.

entry.title: RLPR: Radar-to-LiDAR Place Recognition via Two-Stage Asymmetric Cross-Modal Alignment for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Zhangshuo Qi, Jingyi Xu, Luqi Cheng, Shichen Wen, Guangming Xiong

entry.summary: RLPR addresses radar-to-LiDAR place recognition for autonomous driving, enabling localization of radar scans within existing LiDAR maps. Handles cross-modal alignment challenges and scarcity of paired training data.

entry.title: It's Time to Get It Right: Improving Analog Clock Reading and Clock-Hand Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models

author.name: Jaeha Choi, Jin Won Lee, Siwoo You, Jangho Lee

entry.summary: Reveals that state-of-the-art VLMs struggle with analog clock reading in real-world environments despite success on complex reasoning tasks. Introduces real-world clock dataset exposing spatial-temporal reasoning failures.

entry.title: Adaptive MLP Pruning for Large Vision Transformers

author.name: Chengchao Shen

entry.summary: Proposes Adaptive MLP Pruning for large Vision Transformers using Taylor-based importance evaluation with knowledge distillation loss. Targets MLP modules as the largest parameter component.

entry.title: VesselFusion: Diffusion Models for Vessel Centerline Extraction from 3D CT Images

author.name: Soichi Mita, Shumpei Takezaki, Ryoma Bise

entry.summary: VesselFusion uses diffusion models for vessel centerline extraction from 3D CT images with coarse-to-fine representation and voting-based aggregation. Achieves more natural vessel structures than deterministic approaches.

entry.title: Novel Semantic Prompting for Zero-Shot Action Recognition

author.name: Salman Iqbal, Waheed Rehman

entry.summary: SP-CLIP introduces structured semantic prompts at multiple abstraction levels (intent, motion, object interaction) for zero-shot action recognition without modifying the visual encoder. Demonstrates that enriched semantic prompting alone can significantly improve performance.

entry.title: Real-Time Drone Detection in Event Cameras via Per-Pixel Frequency Analysis

author.name: Michael Bezick, Majid Sahin

entry.summary: DDHF uses Non-uniform Discrete Fourier Transform for per-pixel frequency analysis of event camera data to detect drones via their rotor frequency signatures. Purely analytical approach without neural networks.

entry.title: Information Maximization for Long-Tailed Semi-Supervised Domain Generalization

author.name: Leo Fillioux, Omprakash Chakraborty, Quentin Gop\'ee, Pierre Marza, Paul-Henry Courn\`ede, Stergios Christodoulidis, Maria Vakalopoulou, Ismail Ben Ayed, Jose Dolz

entry.summary: IMaX applies the InfoMax principle to semi-supervised domain generalization under long-tailed class distributions, maximizing mutual information between learned features and latent labels to handle class imbalance.

entry.title: Improving Continual Learning for Gaussian Splatting based Environments Reconstruction on Commercial Off-the-Shelf Edge Devices

author.name: Ivan Zaino, Matteo Risso, Daniele Jahier Pagliari, Miguel de Prado, Toon Van de Maele, Alessio Burrello

entry.summary: Presents a precision-adaptive optimization framework for running Variational Bayesian Gaussian Splatting on edge devices, enabling continual 3D scene learning on resource-constrained hardware through mixed-precision and kernel fusion.

entry.title: BioGait-VLM: A Tri-Modal Vision-Language-Biomechanics Framework for Interpretable Clinical Gait Assessment

author.name: Erdong Chen, Yuyang Ji, Jacob K. Greenberg, Benjamin Steel, Faraz Arkam, Abigail Lewis, Pranay Singh, Feng Liu

entry.summary: BioGait-VLM proposes a tri-modal Vision-Language-Biomechanics framework for clinical gait assessment, incorporating temporal evidence distillation and biomechanical tokenization to reason about joint mechanics independent of visual shortcuts.

entry.title: CAST: Modeling Visual State Transitions for Consistent Video Retrieval

author.name: Yanqing Liu, Yingcheng Liu, Fanghong Dong, Budianto Budianto, Cihang Xie, Yan Jiao

entry.summary: CAST formalizes Consistent Video Retrieval (CVR) and proposes a plug-and-play adapter that predicts state-conditioned residual updates from visual history for coherent storyline composition from short clips.

entry.title: ProFocus: Proactive Perception and Focused Reasoning in Vision-and-Language Navigation

author.name: Wei Xue, Mingcheng Li, Xuecheng Wu, Jingqun Tang, Dingkang Yang, Lihua Zhang

entry.summary: ProFocus is a training-free VLN framework combining proactive perception via ego-centric semantic maps with focused reasoning through LLM-VLM collaboration for navigation decision-making.

entry.title: StructBiHOI: Structured Articulation Modeling for Long--Horizon Bimanual Hand--Object Interaction Generation

author.name: Zhi Wang, Liu Liu, Ruonan Liu, Dan Guo, Meng Wang

entry.summary: StructBiHOI proposes structured articulation modeling for long-horizon bimanual hand-object interaction generation, disentangling temporal joint planning from frame-level manipulation refinement.

entry.title: HybridMimic: Hybrid RL-Centroidal Control for Humanoid Motion Mimicking

author.name: Ludwig Chee-Ying Tay, I-Chia Chang, Yan Gu

entry.summary: Introduces HybridMimic, a framework combining reinforcement learning with centroidal model-based control for humanoid motion mimicking. The learned policy dynamically modulates centroidal control without requiring predefined contact timing, improving versatility over existing hybrid approaches.

entry.title: SurgSync: Time-Synchronized Multi-Modal Data Collection Framework and Dataset for Surgical Robotics

author.name: Haoying Zhou, Chang Liu, Yimeng Wu, Junlin Wu, Zijian Wu, Yu Chung Lee, Sara Martuscelli, Spetimiu E. Salcudean, Gregory S. Fischer, Peter Kazanzides

entry.summary: Presents SurgSync, a multi-modal data collection framework with offline and online synchronization for surgical robotics, implemented on the da Vinci Research Kit with modern stereo endoscope and comprehensive data recording.

entry.title: TacDexGrasp: Compliant and Robust Dexterous Grasping with Tactile Feedback

author.name: Yubin Ke, Jiayi Chen, Hang Lv, Xiao Zhou, He Wang

entry.summary: Addresses compliant dexterous grasping with tactile feedback using SOCP-based control without explicit torque modeling or slip detection. Key insight: rotational slip induces detectable translational slip at contact points.

entry.title: RoTri-Diff: A Spatial Robot-Object Triadic Interaction-Guided Diffusion Model for Bimanual Manipulation

author.name: Zixuan Chen, Nga Teng Chan, Yiwen Hou, Chenrui Tie, Zixuan Liu, Haonan Chen, Junting Chen, Jieqi Shi, Yang Gao, Jing Huo, Lin Shao

entry.summary: Proposes RoTri-Diff, a diffusion model for bimanual manipulation that explicitly models the triadic spatial relationship (Robot-Object Triadic Interaction) between two arms and the manipulated object using relative 6D poses.

entry.title: Approximate Imitation Learning for Event-based Quadrotor Flight in Cluttered Environments

author.name: Nico Messikommer, Jiaxu Xing, Leonard Bauersfeld, Marco Cannici, Elie Aljalbout, Davide Scaramuzza

entry.summary: Enables quadrotor flight through cluttered environments using only a single event camera, with an end-to-end neural network mapping event data to control commands. From Davide Scaramuzza's group at UZH.

entry.title: Omnidirectional Humanoid Locomotion on Stairs via Unsafe Stepping Penalty and Sparse LiDAR Elevation Mapping

author.name: Yuzhi Jiang, Yujun Liang, Junhao Li, Han Ding, Lijun Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes a single-stage training framework for omnidirectional humanoid stair locomotion using a dense unsafe stepping penalty and sparse LiDAR elevation mapping for 360° terrain perception. Addresses blind zones from forward-facing cameras.

entry.title: DeReCo: Decoupling Representation and Coordination Learning for Object-Adaptive Decentralized Multi-Robot Cooperative Transport

author.name: Kazuki Shibata, Ryosuke Sota, Shandil Dhiresh Bosch, Yuki Kadokawa, Tsurumine Yoshihisa, Takamitsu Matsubara

entry.summary: Introduces DeReCo, which decouples representation learning from coordination learning for decentralized multi-robot cooperative transport across diverse objects. Addresses bidirectional interference between representation and policy learning in MARL.

entry.title: LAR-MoE: Latent-Aligned Routing for Mixture of Experts in Robotic Imitation Learning

author.name: Ariel Rodriguez, Chenpan Li, Lorenzo Mazza, Rayan Younis, Ortrun Hellig, Sebastian Bodenstedt, Martin Wagner, Stefanie Speidel

entry.summary: Introduces LAR-MoE, a two-stage framework decoupling unsupervised skill discovery from policy learning in imitation learning via Mixture-of-Experts with latent-aligned routing for handling heterogeneous task dynamics.

entry.title: EquiBim: Learning Symmetry-Equivariant Policy for Bimanual Manipulation

author.name: Zhiyuan Zhang, Aditya Mohan, Seungho Han, Wan Shou, Dongyi Wang, Yu She

entry.summary: Introduces EquiBim, a symmetry-equivariant policy learning framework for bimanual manipulation that enforces bilateral equivariance between observations and actions during training.

entry.title: Bilevel Planning with Learned Symbolic Abstractions from Interaction Data

author.name: Fatih Dogangun, Burcu Kilic, Serdar Bahar, Emre Ugur

entry.summary: Proposes a bilevel neuro-symbolic framework where learned probabilistic symbolic rules generate candidate plans at high level and learned continuous models verify plans and resolve parameter values at low level.

entry.title: Kernel Methods for Some Transport Equations with Application to Learning Kernels for the Approximation of Koopman Eigenfunctions: A Unified Approach via Variational Methods, Green's Functions and the Method of Characteristics

author.name: Boumediene Hamzi, Houman Owhadi, Umesh Vaidya

entry.summary: Presents a unified theoretical framework for constructing reproducing kernels for transport equations and Koopman eigenfunctions, proving equivalence of three construction methods: variational, Green's function, and characteristic flow-based.

entry.title: Sensivity of LLMs' Explanations to the Training Randomness:Context, Class & Task Dependencies

author.name: Romain Loncour, J\'er\'emie Bogaert, Fran\c{c}ois-Xavier Standaert

entry.summary: Investigates how syntactic context, class labels, and task type affect the sensitivity of transformer explanations to training randomness. Shows all factors have statistically significant impact, with tasks having the largest effect.

entry.title: Asymmetric Distillation and Information Retention in Capacity-Constrained Cross-Modal Transfer

author.name: Kabir Thayani

entry.summary: Investigates dimensional collapse when distilling CLIP ViT-B/32 into capacity-constrained CNNs. Finds a capacity-agnostic phase transition where all student models experience severe dimensional collapse regardless of size.

entry.title: Single Image Super-Resolution via Bivariate `A Trous Wavelet Diffusion

author.name: Heidari Maryam, Anantrasirichai Nantheera, Achim Alin

entry.summary: Proposes a wavelet-domain diffusion approach for single image super-resolution using bivariate à trous wavelets, avoiding spatial-domain hallucinations by operating in the frequency domain.

entry.title: Compressed-Domain-Aware Online Video Super-Resolution

author.name: Yuhang Wang, Hai Li, Shujuan Hou, Zhetao Dong, Xiaoyao Yang

entry.summary: CDA-VSR leverages compressed-domain information (motion vectors, residual maps, frame types) for efficient online video super-resolution in bandwidth-limited streaming. Proposes motion-vector-guided deformable alignment to reduce computational overhead.

entry.title: VSDiffusion: Taming Ill-Posed Shadow Generation via Visibility-Constrained Diffusion

author.name: Jing Li, Jing Zhang

entry.summary: VSDiffusion generates realistic cast shadows for composited objects using visibility-constrained diffusion in two stages: coarse shadow mask prediction followed by conditional diffusion guided by lighting and depth cues.

entry.title: From Reactive to Map-Based AI: Tuned Local LLMs for Semantic Zone Inference in Object-Goal Navigation

author.name: Yudai Noda, Kanji Tanaka

entry.summary: Proposes transitioning from reactive LLM-based navigation to map-based approach using fine-tuned Llama-2 for semantic zone inference. Integrates LLM reasoning with hybrid topological-grid mapping.

entry.title: CAR: Cross-Vehicle Kinodynamics Adaptation via Mobility Representation

author.name: Tong Xu, Chenhui Pan, Xuesu Xiao

entry.summary: Proposes CAR, a framework for cross-vehicle kinodynamics adaptation using a Transformer encoder with Adaptive Layer Normalization to embed vehicle trajectory transitions into a shared mobility latent space, enabling rapid transfer to new platforms.

entry.title: Towards Scalable Probabilistic Human Motion Prediction with Gaussian Processes for Safe Human-Robot Collaboration

author.name: Jinger Chong, Xiaotong Zhang, Kamal Youcef-Toumi

entry.summary: Proposes a structured multitask variational Gaussian Process framework for full-body human motion prediction using 6D rotation representation, achieving strong uncertainty calibration and up to 50x better KDE NLL than baselines on Human3.6M.

entry.title: FeasibleCap: Real-Time Embodiment Constraint Guidance for In-the-Wild Robot Demonstration Collection

author.name: Zi Yin, Fanhong Li, Yun Gui, Jia Liu

entry.summary: Presents FeasibleCap, a gripper-in-hand data collection system providing real-time executability feedback during demonstration collection, eliminating the need for separate replay-and-validation stages to verify robot feasibility.

entry.title: Failure Detection in Chemical Processes using Symbolic Machine Learning: A Case Study on Ethylene Oxidation

author.name: Julien Amblard, Niklas Groll, Matthew Tait, Mark Law, G\"urkan Sin, Alessandra Russo

entry.summary: Investigates symbolic machine learning for failure prediction in chemical processes (ethylene oxidation), using probabilistic rule learning as an explainable alternative to neural approaches in safety-critical industrial settings.

entry.title: FusionRegister: Every Infrared and Visible Image Fusion Deserves Registration

author.name: Congcong Bian, Haolong Ma, Hui Li, Zhongwei Shen, Xiaoqing Luo, Xiaoning Song, Xiao-Jun Wu

entry.summary: FusionRegister proposes a general cross-modality registration method for infrared-visible image fusion guided by visual priors, eliminating need for extensive pre-registration. Learns misregistration representations rather than forcing alignment of all differences.

entry.title: ViSA-Enhanced Aerial VLN: A Visual-Spatial Reasoning Enhanced Framework for Aerial Vision-Language Navigation

author.name: Haoyu Tong, Xiangyu Dong, Xiaoguang Ma, Haoran Zhao, Yaoming Zhou, Chenghao Lin

entry.summary: ViSA proposes a visual-spatial reasoning enhanced framework for aerial vision-language navigation using structured visual prompting. Enables VLMs to perform direct spatial reasoning on image planes without additional training.

entry.title: SRNeRV: A Scale-wise Recursive Framework for Neural Video Representation

author.name: Jia Wang, Jun Zhu, Xinfeng Zhang

entry.summary: SRNeRV proposes scale-wise recursive framework for implicit neural video representation, sharing channel mixing modules across scales while keeping spatial mixing scale-specific. Reduces parameter redundancy.

entry.title: Rectified flow-based prediction of post-treatment brain MRI from pre-radiotherapy priors for patients with glioma

author.name: Selena Huisman, Nordin Belkacemi, Vera Keil, Joost Verhoeff, Szabolcs David

entry.summary: Uses rectified flow models conditioned on pre-treatment MRI and radiation dose maps to predict post-radiotherapy brain MRI in glioma patients, enabling treatment optimization through realistic simulation.

entry.title: Learning-Based Robust Control: Unifying Exploration and Distributional Robustness for Reliable Robotics via Free Energy

author.name: Hozefa Jesawada, Giovanni Russo, Abdalla Swikir, Fares Abu-Dakka

entry.summary: Proposes a learning-based robust control method inspired by the free energy principle that jointly learns environment dynamics and rewards while ensuring robustness to epistemic uncertainties. Modifies the maximum diffusion learning framework with distributional robustness.

entry.title: Kinematics-Aware Latent World Models for Data-Efficient Autonomous Driving

author.name: Jiazhuo Li, Linjiang Cao, Qi Liu, Xi Xiong

entry.summary: Proposes a kinematics-aware latent world model for autonomous driving that incorporates vehicle kinematic information into the RSSM observation encoder and uses geometry-aware supervision for data-efficient learning.

entry.title: DAISS: Phase-Aware Imitation Learning for Dual-Arm Robotic Ultrasound-Guided Interventions

author.name: Feng Li, Pei Liu, Shiting Wang, Ning Wang, Zhongliang Jiang, Nassir Navab, Yuan Bi

entry.summary: Presents DAISS, a dual-arm interventional surgical system for ultrasound-guided needle insertion that collects teleoperation demonstrations and learns phase-aware imitation policies for the asymmetric bimanual workflow.

entry.title: The EpisTwin: A Knowledge Graph-Grounded Neuro-Symbolic Architecture for Personal AI

author.name: Giovanni Servedio, Potito Aghilar, Alessio Mattiace, Gianni Carmosino, Francesco Musicco, Gabriele Conte, Vito Walter Anelli, Tommaso Di Noia, Francesco Maria Donini

entry.summary: Introduces EpisTwin, a neuro-symbolic framework that grounds generative reasoning in a user-centric Personal Knowledge Graph. Uses multimodal language models to convert heterogeneous data into semantic triples for personal AI applications.

entry.title: From Toil to Thought: Designing for Strategic Exploration and Responsible AI in Systematic Literature Reviews

author.name: Runlong Ye, Naaz Sibia, Angela Zavaleta Bernuy, Tingting Zhu, Carolina Nobre, Viktoria Pammer-Schindler, Michael Liut

entry.summary: Investigates friction points in systematic literature reviews through a design study with 20 researchers, then develops ARC, a design probe for AI-assisted literature review with multi-database integration.

entry.title: Human-Data Interaction, Exploration, and Visualization in the AI Era: Challenges and Opportunities

author.name: Jean-Daniel Fekete, Yifan Hu, Dominik Moritz, Arnab Nandi, Senjuti Basu Roy, Eugene Wu, Nikos Bikakis, George Papastefanatos, Panos K. Chrysanthis, Guoliang Li, Lingyun Yu

entry.summary: Position paper examining how AI transforms human-data interaction, data exploration, and visualization, identifying challenges including perceptually misaligned latency, scalability constraints, and uncertainty in AI-generated insights.

entry.title: PVminerLLM: Structured Extraction of Patient Voice from Patient-Generated Text using Large Language Models

author.name: Samah Fodeh, Linhai Ma, Ganesh Puthiaraju, Srivani Talakokkul, Afshan Khan, Ashley Hagaman, Sarah Lowe, Aimee Roundtree

entry.summary: Introduces PVminerLLM, a supervised fine-tuned LLM for structured extraction of patient voice signals from patient-generated text, addressing the gap in capturing lived experience data for health outcomes research.

entry.title: Learning to Solve Orienteering Problem with Time Windows and Variable Profits

author.name: Songqun Gao, Zanxi Ruan, Patrick Floor, Marco Roveri, Luigi Palopoli, Daniele Fontanelli

entry.summary: Proposes a learning-based two-stage approach (DeCoST) for the orienteering problem with time windows and variable profits, decoupling discrete routing from continuous service time optimization.

entry.title: Kinetic-based regularization: Learning spatial derivatives and PDE applications

author.name: Abhisek Ganguly, Santosh Ansumali, Sauro Succi

entry.summary: Extends kinetic-based regularization for learning spatial derivatives from discrete noisy data with provable second-order accuracy. Proposes explicit and implicit schemes for derivative estimation.

entry.title: A Reference Architecture of Reinforcement Learning Frameworks

author.name: Xiaoran Liu, Istvan David

entry.summary: Proposes a reference architecture for RL frameworks based on grounded theory analysis of 18 state-of-practice frameworks, identifying recurring architectural components and patterns.

entry.title: Khatri-Rao Clustering for Data Summarization

author.name: Martino Ciaperoni, Collin Leiber, Aristides Gionis, Heikki Mannila

entry.summary: Proposes Khatri-Rao clustering, extending centroid-based clustering to produce more compact data summaries by modeling centroids as arising from interactions (Khatri-Rao products). Addresses redundancy in traditional clustering summaries for datasets with many clusters.

entry.title: ERP-RiskBench: Leakage-Safe Ensemble Learning for Financial Risk

author.name: Sanjay Mishra

entry.summary: Presents ERP-RiskBench, a rebuilt experimental framework for financial risk detection in ERP systems, addressing common methodological flaws (leakage, inflated metrics) in prior published studies with proper nested cross-validation.

entry.title: Enhancing SHAP Explainability for Diagnostic and Prognostic ML Models in Alzheimer Disease

author.name: Pablo Guill\'en, Enrique Frias-Martinez

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-level SHAP explainability framework for Alzheimer's disease ML models, measuring coherence, stability, and consistency of explanations across disease stages and model architectures.

entry.title: HGT-Scheduler: Deep Reinforcement Learning for the Job Shop Scheduling Problem via Heterogeneous Graph Transformers

author.name: Bulent Soykan

entry.summary: Proposes HGT-Scheduler, a reinforcement learning framework for job shop scheduling that models the problem as a heterogeneous graph, using Heterogeneous Graph Transformers to capture distinct job-precedence and machine-contention relations.

entry.title: IGLU: The Integrated Gaussian Linear Unit Activation Function

author.name: Mingi Kang, Zai Yang, Jeova Farias Sales Rocha Neto

entry.summary: Introduces IGLU, a parametric activation function derived as a scale mixture of GELU gates under half-normal mixing, offering a principled mathematical derivation connecting various smooth activation functions.

entry.title: A Dual-Graph Spatiotemporal GNN Surrogate for Nonlinear Response Prediction of Reinforced Concrete Beams under Four-Point Bending

author.name: Zhaoyang Ren, Qilin Li

entry.summary: Develops a dual-graph spatiotemporal GNN surrogate for simulating nonlinear response of reinforced concrete beams, replacing costly finite element simulations.

entry.title: Generalizing Linear Autoencoder Recommenders with Decoupled Expected Quadratic Loss

author.name: Ruixin Guo, Xinyu Li, Hao Zhou, Yang Zhou, Ruoming Jin

entry.summary: Generalizes the EDLAE recommender system objective into Decoupled Expected Quadratic Loss, revealing closed-form solutions in broader hyperparameter ranges.

entry.title: Enhanced Random Subspace Local Projections for High-Dimensional Time Series Analysis

author.name: Eman Khalid, Moimma Ali Khan, Zarmeena Ali, Abdullah Illyas, Muhammad Usman, Saoud Ahmed

entry.summary: Proposes an enhanced Random Subspace Local Projection framework for high-dimensional time series with weighted aggregation, category-aware sampling, and adaptive subspace selection.

entry.title: Step-Size Decay and Structural Stagnation in Greedy Sparse Learning

author.name: Pablo M. Bern\'a

entry.summary: Studies failure of greedy algorithms with over-decaying step sizes in sparse approximation, deriving explicit lower bounds showing structural stagnation even in low-dimensional settings.

entry.title: PSTNet: Physically-Structured Turbulence Network

author.name: Boris Kriuk, Fedor Kriuk

entry.summary: Introduces PSTNet, a lightweight neural architecture for atmospheric turbulence estimation that embeds Monin-Obukhov scaling theory directly into its structure, coupling physics-derived components with learned corrections.

entry.title: GCGNet: Graph-Consistent Generative Network for Time Series Forecasting with Exogenous Variables

author.name: Zhengyu Li, Xiangfei Qiu, Yuhan Zhu, Xingjian Wu, Jilin Hu, Chenjuan Guo, Bin Yang

entry.title: FedPrism: Adaptive Personalized Federated Learning under Non-IID Data

author.name: Prakash Kumbhakar, Shrey Srivastava, Haroon R Lone

entry.title: Towards plausibility in time series counterfactual explanations

author.name: Marcin Kostrzewa, Krzysztof Galus, Maciej Zi\k{e}ba

entry.summary: Presents a method for generating plausible counterfactual explanations for time series classification using gradient-based optimization with soft-DTW alignment to ensure temporal realism.

entry.title: Meta-RL with Shared Representations Enables Fast Adaptation in Energy Systems

author.name: Th\'eo Zangato, Aomar Osmani, Pegah Alizadeh

entry.summary: Introduces a Meta-RL framework with shared state feature extractors jointly optimized across actor and critic networks, featuring bi-level optimization and parameter sharing for improved sample efficiency in energy systems.

entry.title: Towards Effective and Efficient Graph Alignment without Supervision

author.name: Songyang Chen, Youfang Lin, Yu Liu, Shuai Zheng, Lei Zou

entry.summary: Proposes GlobAlign, an unsupervised graph alignment method using a 'global representation and alignment' paradigm with optimal transport, addressing accuracy-efficiency tradeoffs of existing approaches.

entry.title: Split Federated Learning Architectures for High-Accuracy and Low-Delay Model Training

author.name: Yiannis Papageorgiou, Yannis Thomas, Ramin Khalili, Iordanis Koutsopoulos

entry.summary: Investigates how model partitioning in Split Federated Learning architectures affects training accuracy and delay. Proposes optimized Hierarchical SFL architectures that improve both accuracy and communication efficiency.

entry.title: XInsight: Integrative Stage-Consistent Psychological Counseling Support Agents for Digital Well-Being

author.name: Fei Wang, Jiangnan Yang, Junjie Chen, Yuxin Liu, Kun Li, Yanyan Wei, Dan Guo, Meng Wang

entry.summary: Presents XInsight, a multi-agent LLM framework for psychological counseling that follows the Exploration-Insight-Action therapeutic paradigm. Orchestrates specialized agents in a structured workflow for digital mental health support.

entry.title: Scaling Strategy, Not Compute: A Stand-Alone, Open-Source StarCraft II Benchmark for Accessible Reinforcement Learning Research

author.name: Sourav Panda, Shreyash Kale, Tanmay Ambadkar, Abhinav Verma, Jonathan Dodge

entry.summary: Introduces the Two-Bridge Map Suite for StarCraft II as an intermediate benchmark between full games and mini-games, designed to be accessible under realistic compute budgets while testing strategic RL capabilities.

entry.title: RECAP: Local Hebbian Prototype Learning as a Self-Organizing Readout for Reservoir Dynamics

author.name: Heng Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces RECAP, a bio-inspired learning system coupling untrained reservoir dynamics with Hebbian prototype readout for image classification, avoiding backpropagation entirely.

entry.title: EnsAug: Augmentation-Driven Ensembles for Human Motion Sequence Analysis

author.name: Bikram De, Habib Irani, Vangelis Metsis

entry.summary: Proposes EnsAug, a training paradigm that creates diverse ensemble models by training each specialist on a single augmentation type for human motion analysis, rather than mixing all augmentations for one model.

entry.title: Bilateral Trade Under Heavy-Tailed Valuations: Minimax Regret with Infinite Variance

author.name: Hangyi Zhao

entry.summary: Studies contextual bilateral trade under heavy-tailed valuations with infinite variance, proving matching upper and lower bounds for epoch-based algorithms under bounded density.

entry.title: A Dynamic Self-Evolving Extraction System

author.name: Moin Amin-Naseri, Hannah Kim, Estevam Hruschka

entry.summary: Proposes DySECT, a dynamic self-evolving extraction system that incrementally populates a self-expanding knowledge base while adapting to shifting terminology across specialized domains.

entry.title: Adaptive Discovery of Interpretable Audio Attributes with Multimodal LLMs for Low-Resource Classification

author.name: Kosuke Yoshimura, Hisashi Kashima

entry.summary: Proposes using multimodal LLMs to adaptively discover interpretable audio attributes for low-resource classification, replacing human-driven attribute discovery in the AdaFlock framework.

entry.title: Deep Generative Spatiotemporal Engression for Probabilistic Forecasting of Epidemics

author.name: Rajdeep Pathak, Tanujit Chakraborty

entry.summary: Presents deep spatiotemporal engression methods for probabilistic epidemic forecasting that generate calibrated prediction intervals, acting as distributional lenses on low-frequency epidemic datasets.

entry.title: AgrI Challenge: A Data-Centric AI Competition for Cross-Team Validation in Agricultural Vision

author.name: Mohammed Brahimi, Karim Laabassi, Mohamed Seghir Hadj Ameur, Aicha Boutorh, Badia Siab-Farsi, Amin Khouani, Omar Farouk Zouak, Seif Eddine Bouziane, Kheira Lakhdari, Abdelkader Nabil Benghanem

entry.summary: Introduces the AgrI Challenge, a data-centric competition where teams independently collect agricultural field datasets, creating a heterogeneous benchmark for evaluating cross-domain generalization under realistic distribution shifts.

entry.title: SLNet: A Super-Lightweight Geometry-Adaptive Network for 3D Point Cloud Recognition

author.name: Mohammad Saeid, Amir Salarpour, Pedram MohajerAnsari, Mert D. Pes\'e

entry.summary: Proposes SLNet, a super-lightweight backbone for 3D point cloud recognition using nonparametric adaptive point embedding and geometric modulation, achieving competitive performance with minimal parameters.

entry.title: SMAT: Staged Multi-Agent Training for Co-Adaptive Exoskeleton Control

author.name: Yifei Yuan, Ghaith Androwis, Xianlian Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes SMAT, a four-stage multi-agent training curriculum for exoskeleton control that mirrors human motor adaptation, training musculoskeletal and exoskeleton actors progressively.

entry.title: Transferable Optimization Network for Cross-Domain Image Reconstruction

author.name: Yunmei Chen, Chi Ding, Xiaojing Ye

entry.summary: Develops a transfer learning framework for image reconstruction with limited training data using bi-level optimization to train universal feature extractors and domain-specific adapters.

entry.title: An Interpretable Generative Framework for Anomaly Detection in High-Dimensional Financial Time Series

author.name: Waldyn G Martinez

entry.summary: Proposes ReGEN-TAD, an interpretable generative framework for anomaly detection in financial time series combining convolutional-transformer architecture with multiple complementary signals for unsupervised anomaly scoring.

entry.title: Tau-BNO: Brain Neural Operator for Tau Transport Model

author.name: Nuutti Barron, Heng Rao, Urmi Saha, Yu Gu, Zhenghao Liu, Ge Yu, Defu Yang, Ashish Raj, Minghan Chen

entry.summary: Proposes Tau-BNO, a neural operator for accelerating tau protein transport modeling in Alzheimer's disease, enabling parameter inference for complex PDE systems on brain connectomes.

entry.title: Towards a more efficient bias detection in financial language models

author.name: Firas Hadj Kacem, Ahmed Khanfir, Mike Papadakis

entry.summary: Conducts large-scale study of bias detection efficiency in five financial language models, examining similarities in bias tendencies to reduce computational cost of exhaustive mutation-based testing.

entry.title: Retrieval-Augmented Gaussian Avatars: Improving Expression Generalization

author.name: Matan Levy, Gavriel Habib, Issar Tzachor, Dvir Samuel, Rami Ben-Ari, Nir Darshan, Or Litany, Dani Lischinski

entry.summary: Introduces RAF, a retrieval-augmented training approach for template-free head avatars that augments limited single-identity expression data with expressions from a large unlabeled bank during training.

entry.title: To Predict or Not to Predict? Towards reliable uncertainty estimation in the presence of noise

author.name: Nouran Khallaf, Serge Sharoff

entry.summary: Evaluates uncertainty estimation methods for multilingual text classification under noisy conditions. Finds Monte Carlo dropout approaches outperform softmax-based methods in low-resource and domain-shift scenarios.

entry.title: RILEC: Detection and Generation of L1 Russian Interference Errors in English Learner Texts

author.name: Darya Kharlamova, Irina Proskurina

entry.summary: Introduces RILEC, an 18K sentence dataset for detecting L1 Russian interference errors in English learner texts. Proposes a framework using PPO-optimized generative models for creating realistic L1-motivated errors.

entry.title: A Joint Neural Baseline for Concept, Assertion, and Relation Extraction from Clinical Text

author.name: Fei Cheng, Ribeka Tanaka, Sadao Kurohashi

entry.summary: Proposes a joint end-to-end system for clinical concept recognition, assertion classification, and relation extraction. Defines a joint task setting addressing comparability issues with existing pipeline approaches.

entry.title: Learning-free L2-Accented Speech Generation using Phonological Rules

author.name: Thanathai Lertpetchpun, Yoonjeong Lee, Jihwan Lee, Tiantian Feng, Dani Byrd, Shrikanth Narayanan

entry.summary: Proposes a learning-free accented TTS framework combining phonological rules with multilingual TTS models for phoneme-level accent manipulation. Designs rule sets for Spanish- and Indian-accented English.

entry.title: Nw\=ach\=a Mun\=a: A Devanagari Speech Corpus and Proximal Transfer Benchmark for Nepal Bhasha ASR

author.name: Rishikesh Kumar Sharma, Safal Narshing Shrestha, Jenny Poudel, Rupak Tiwari, Arju Shrestha, Rupak Raj Ghimire, Bal Krishna Bal

entry.title: Benchmarking Large Language Models for Quebec Insurance: From Closed-Book to Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: David Beauchemin, Richard Khoury

entry.summary: Introduces AEPC-QA, an 807-question benchmark for Quebec insurance domain, evaluating 51 LLMs in closed-book and RAG paradigms. Addresses the 'advice gap' in digitized insurance distribution.

entry.title: Ramsa: A Large Sociolinguistically Rich Emirati Arabic Speech Corpus for ASR and TTS

author.name: Rania Al-Sabbagh

entry.summary: Introduces Ramsa, a 41-hour Emirati Arabic speech corpus with 157 speakers covering subdialects (Urban, Bedouin, Mountain/Shihhi) for ASR and TTS evaluation. Includes sociolinguistic richness across topics and recording conditions.

entry.title: Using Multimodal and Language-Agnostic Sentence Embeddings for Abstractive Summarization

author.name: Chaimae Chellaf, Salima Mdhaffar, Yannick Est\`eve, St\'ephane Huet

entry.summary: Introduces SBARThez, a French abstractive summarization framework using multimodal and multilingual sentence embeddings with a Named Entity Injection mechanism for improved factual consistency, applicable to both text and speech.

entry.title: Supporting Artifact Evaluation with LLMs: A Study with Published Security Research Papers

author.name: David Heye, Karl Kindermann, Robin Decker, Johannes Lohm\"oller, Anastasiia Belova, Sandra Geisler, Klaus Wehrle, Jan Pennekamp

entry.summary: Demonstrates that LLMs can support artifact evaluation in security research: text-based reproducibility rating, autonomous sandboxed execution, and assessment of methodological pitfalls. Achieves reasonable accuracy on reproducibility assessment.

entry.title: AQuA: Toward Strategic Response Generation for Ambiguous Visual Questions

author.name: Jihyoung Jang, Hyounghun Kim

entry.summary: Introduces AQuA, a dataset that classifies ambiguous VQA instances into four levels of ambiguity, along with strategy-aware response models. Addresses the gap that existing VQA benchmarks rarely handle ambiguous questions.

entry.title: ASMIL: Attention-Stabilized Multiple Instance Learning for Whole Slide Imaging

author.name: Linfeng Ye, Shayan Mohajer Hamidi, Zhixiang Chi, Guang Li, Mert Pilanci, Takahiro Ogawa, Miki Haseyama, Konstantinos N. Plataniotis

entry.summary: Identifies unstable attention dynamics as a failure mode in attention-based MIL for whole slide image diagnosis. Proposes ASMIL to simultaneously address attention instability, overfitting, and over-concentrated attention.

entry.title: AutoFigure-Edit: Generating Editable Scientific Illustration

author.name: Zhen Lin, Qiujie Xie, Minjun Zhu, Shichen Li, Qiyao Sun, Enhao Gu, Yiran Ding, Ke Sun, Fang Guo, Panzhong Lu, Zhiyuan Ning, Yixuan Weng, Yue Zhang

entry.summary: Presents AutoFigure-Edit, an end-to-end system generating fully editable SVG scientific illustrations from long-form text with reference-guided styling. Enables efficient creation and refinement of scientific figures.

entry.title: Active View Selection with Perturbed Gaussian Ensemble for Tomographic Reconstruction

author.name: Yulun Wu, Ruyi Zha, Wei Cao, Yingying Li, Yuanhao Cai, Yaoyao Liu

entry.summary: Presents Perturbed Gaussian Ensemble for active view selection in sparse-view CT reconstruction using 3D Gaussian Splatting. Addresses unique geometric ambiguities and physical attenuation properties of X-ray imaging.

entry.title: PaQ-DETR: Learning Pattern and Quality-Aware Dynamic Queries for Object Detection

author.name: Zhengjian Kang, Jun Zhuang, Kangtong Mo, Qi Chen, Rui Liu, Ye Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes PaQ-DETR enhancing DETR with dynamic image-specific queries generated through content-conditioned weighting of shared latent patterns, plus quality-aware one-to-many assignment.

entry.title: Virtual Intraoperative CT (viCT): Sequential Anatomic Updates for Modeling Tissue Resection Throughout Endoscopic Sinus Surgery

author.name: Nicole M. Gunderson, Graham J. Harris, Jeremy S. Ruthberg, Pengcheng Chen, Di Mao, Randall A. Bly, Waleed M. Abuzeid, Eric J. Seibel

entry.summary: Presents Virtual Intraoperative CT (viCT), a method that updates preoperative CT scans during endoscopic sinus surgery using monocular endoscopic video processed through depth-supervised NeRF. This enables visualization of evolving anatomy in CT format during surgery.

entry.title: Retinex Meets Language: A Physics-Semantics-Guided Underwater Image Enhancement Network

author.name: Shixuan Xu, Yabo Liu, Junyu Dong, Xinghui Dong

entry.summary: PSG-UIENet couples Retinex-based illumination correction with language-informed guidance for underwater image enhancement, combining physical priors with VLM semantic understanding.

entry.title: MAviS: A Multimodal Conversational Assistant For Avian Species

author.name: Yevheniia Kryklyvets, Mohammed Irfan Kurpath, Sahal Shaji Mullappilly, Jinxing Zhou, Fahad Shabzan Khan, Rao Anwer, Salman Khan, Hisham Cholakkal

entry.summary: MAviS introduces a multimodal avian species dataset and conversational assistant integrating image, audio, and text for 1,000+ bird species, supporting biodiversity conservation and ecological monitoring.

entry.title: RPG-SAM: Reliability-Weighted Prototypes and Geometric Adaptive Threshold Selection for Training-Free One-Shot Polyp Segmentation

author.name: Weikun Lin, Yunhao Bai, Yan Wang

entry.summary: RPG-SAM proposes reliability-weighted prototype mining and geometric adaptive threshold selection for training-free one-shot polyp segmentation, addressing regional and response heterogeneity.

entry.title: Classifying Novel 3D-Printed Objects without Retraining: Towards Post-Production Automation in Additive Manufacturing

author.name: Fanis Mathioulakis, Gorjan Radevski, Silke GC Cleuren, Michel Janssens, Brecht Das, Koen Schauwaert, Tinne Tuytelaars

entry.summary: Introduces ThingiPrint dataset for classifying 3D-printed objects without retraining, enabling post-production automation in additive manufacturing using CAD models as references.

entry.title: AMR-CCR: Anchored Modular Retrieval for Continual Chinese Character Recognition

author.name: Yuchuan Wu, Yinglian Zhu, Haiyang Yu, Ke Niu, Bin Li, Xiangyang Xue

entry.summary: AMR-CCR proposes anchored modular retrieval for continual Chinese character recognition, handling script-staged class-incremental learning with writing-style variations across historical materials.

entry.title: CONSTANT: Towards High-Quality One-Shot Handwriting Generation with Patch Contrastive Enhancement and Style-Aware Quantization

author.name: Anh-Duy Le, Van-Linh Pham, Thanh-Nam Vo, Xuan Toan Mai, Tuan-Anh Tran

entry.title: Fast Attention-Based Simplification of LiDAR Point Clouds for Object Detection and Classification

author.name: Z. Rozsa, \'A. Madaras, Q. Wei, X. Lu, M. Golarits, H. Yuan, T. Sziranyi, R. Hamzaoui

entry.summary: Proposes an attention-based learned method for simplifying LiDAR point clouds that prioritizes task-relevant points for object detection/classification. Balances speed and accuracy better than existing sampling approaches for autonomous driving deployment.

entry.title: AR2-4FV: Anchored Referring and Re-identification for Long-Term Grounding in Fixed-View Videos

author.name: Teng Yan, Yihan Liu, Jiongxu Chen, Teng Wang, Jiaqi Li, Bingzhuo Zhong

entry.summary: AR2-4FV addresses long-term language-guided referring in fixed-view videos where referents may leave and re-enter the scene. Uses an anchor bank from static backgrounds as persistent semantic memory with re-identification gating.

entry.title: Not Like Transformers: Drop the Beat Representation for Dance Generation with Mamba-Based Diffusion Model

author.name: Sangjune Park, Inhyeok Choi, Donghyeon Soon, Youngwoo Jeon, Kyungdon Joo

entry.summary: MambaDance uses Mamba-based diffusion model for dance generation, replacing Transformers. Proposes Gaussian-based beat representation instead of binary beat markers for smoother music-synchronized motion.

entry.title: Enhancing Cross-View UAV Geolocalization via LVLM-Driven Relational Modeling

author.name: Bowen Liu, Pengyue Jia, Wanyu Wang, Derong Xu, Jiawei Cheng, Jiancheng Dong, Xiao Han, Zimo Zhao, Chao Zhang, Bowen Yu, Fangyu Hong, Xiangyu Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes LVLM-driven relational modeling for cross-view UAV geolocalization, using a large vision-language model to learn deep visual-semantic correlations between drone and satellite imagery.

entry.title: Edged USLAM: Edge-Aware Event-Based SLAM with Learning-Based Depth Priors

author.name: \c{S}ebnem Sar{\i}\"ozkan, H\"urkan \c{S}ahin, Olaya \'Alvarez-Tu\~n\'on, Erdal Kayacan

entry.summary: Edged USLAM extends Ultimate SLAM with edge-aware front-end and depth module for event camera-based visual-inertial SLAM. Enhances feature tracking and depth estimation for challenging motion/lighting conditions.

entry.title: GarmentPainter: Efficient 3D Garment Texture Synthesis with Character-Guided Diffusion Model

author.name: Jinbo Wu, Xiaobo Gao, Xing Liu, Chen Zhao, Jialun Liu

entry.summary: GarmentPainter introduces a framework for synthesizing 3D-aware garment textures in UV space using a UV position map for structural guidance and a character-guided diffusion model. This addresses the challenge of generating high-fidelity, globally consistent textures for 3D garments without expensive multi-step optimization.

entry.title: Local-Global Prompt Learning via Sparse Optimal Transport

author.name: Deniz Kizaro\u{g}lu, \"Ulku Tuncer K\"u\c{c}\"uktas, Emre \c{C}akmakyurdu, Alptekin Temizel

entry.summary: SOT-GLP introduces sparse optimal transport allocation to partition salient visual regions among class-specific local prompts in CLIP-based few-shot adaptation, avoiding redundant feature usage across prompts.

entry.title: AULLM++: Structural Reasoning with Large Language Models for Micro-Expression Recognition

author.name: Zhishu Liu, Kaishen Yuan, Bo Zhao, Hui Ma, Zitong Yu

entry.summary: AULLM++ uses LLMs for micro-expression Action Unit detection by injecting visual features into textual prompts as semantic premises, framing AU prediction as a structural reasoning task over inter-AU correlations.

entry.title: Spherical-GOF: Geometry-Aware Panoramic Gaussian Opacity Fields for 3D Scene Reconstruction

author.name: Zhe Yang, Guoqiang Zhao, Sheng Wu, Kai Luo, Kailun Yang

entry.summary: Spherical-GOF performs Gaussian Opacity Field ray sampling directly on the unit sphere for panoramic rendering, avoiding distortions from naive perspective-to-panoramic adaptations of 3DGS.

entry.title: BuildMamba: A Visual State-Space Based Model for Multi-Task Building Segmentation and Height Estimation from Satellite Images

author.name: Sinan U. Ulu, A. Enes Doruk, I. Can Yagmur, Bahadir K. Gunturk, Oguz Hanoglu, Hasan F. Ates

entry.summary: BuildMamba uses visual state-space models (Mamba) for joint building segmentation and height estimation from satellite imagery, exploiting linear-time global modeling for computational efficiency.

entry.title: ER-Pose: Rethinking Keypoint-Driven Representation Learning for Real-Time Human Pose Estimation

author.name: Nanjun Li, Pinqi Cheng, Zean Liu, Minghe Tian, Xuanyin Wang

entry.summary: ER-Pose rethinks keypoint-driven representation learning for real-time multi-person pose estimation, addressing biases from box-driven modeling paradigms inherited from object detection.

entry.title: FVG-PT: Adaptive Foreground View-Guided Prompt Tuning for Vision-Language Models

author.name: Haoyang Li, Liang Wang, Siyu Zhou, Jiacheng Sun, Jing Jiang, Chao Wang, Guodong Long, Yan Peng

entry.summary: FVG-PT proposes Foreground View-Guided Prompt Tuning for VLMs, attributing prompt tuning failures to foreground attention shifts and introducing learnable gates and distillation modules to preserve foreground focus.

entry.title: HiDE: Hierarchical Dictionary-Based Entropy Modeling for Learned Image Compression

author.name: Haoxuan Xiong, Yuanyuan Xu, Kun Zhu, Yiming Wang, Baoliu Ye

entry.summary: HiDE proposes hierarchical dictionary-based entropy modeling for learned image compression, organizing external priors across multiple dictionary levels for more balanced utilization and improved compression.

entry.title: See and Switch: Vision-Based Branching for Interactive Robot-Skill Programming

author.name: Petr Vanc, Jan Kristof Behrens, V\'aclav Hlav\'a\v{c}, Karla Stepanova

entry.summary: See & Switch enables vision-based conditional branching during robot skill replay, representing tasks as user-extendable graphs with decision states for branching based on visual perception.

entry.title: Topologically Stable Hough Transform

author.name: Stefan Huber, Krist\'of Husz\'ar, Michael Kerber, Martin Uray

entry.summary: Proposes a topologically stable Hough transform using persistent homology to detect lines in point clouds, replacing the discretized voting scheme with a continuous score function.

entry.title: Self-Supervised Evolutionary Learning of Neurodynamic Progression and Identity Manifolds from EEG During Safety-Critical Decision Making

author.name: Xiaoshan Zhou, Carol C. Menassa, Vineet R. Kamat

entry.summary: SSEL proposes self-supervised evolutionary learning to discover individualized neurodynamic progressions and identity manifolds from continuous EEG during safety-critical decision making, without external labels.

entry.title: Multi-Objective Evolutionary Optimization of Chance-Constrained Multiple-Choice Knapsack Problems with Implicit Probability Distributions

author.name: Xuanfeng Li, Shengcai Liu, Wenjie Chen, Yew-Soon Ong, Ke Tang

entry.summary: Proposes OPERA-MC for multi-objective chance-constrained multiple-choice knapsack problems under implicit distributions, with adaptive sampling allocation and evolutionary optimization applied to 5G network configuration.

entry.title: A Comprehensive Analysis of the Effects of Network Quality of Service on Robotic Telesurgery

author.name: Zhaomeng Zhang, Seyed Hamid Reza Roodabeh, Homa Alemzadeh

entry.summary: Presents NetFI, a fault injection tool that emulates realistic network conditions for telesurgery, and conducts a user study with 15 participants analyzing how packet loss, delay, and communication loss affect surgical task execution across proficiency levels.

entry.title: T2Nav Algebraic Topology Aware Temporal Graph Memory and Loop Detection for ZeroShot Visual Navigation

author.name: Quang-Anh N. D., Duc Pham, Minh-Anh Nguyen, Tung Doan, Tuan Dang

entry.summary: Introduces T2Nav, a zero-shot visual navigation system using algebraic topology-aware temporal graph memory and loop detection. Leverages foundation models for navigation without task-specific training.

entry.title: Feasibility Restoration under Conflicting STL Specifications with Pareto-Optimal Refinement

author.name: Tianhao Wu, Yiwei Lyu

entry.summary: Proposes a two-stage framework for handling conflicting Signal Temporal Logic specifications in robotics: first restoring feasibility via minimal relaxation, then refining via Pareto-optimal solutions, addressing cases where safety rules and task objectives conflict.

entry.title: ACLM: ADMM-Based Distributed Model Predictive Control for Collaborative Loco-Manipulation

author.name: Ziyi Zhou, Pengyuan Shu, Ruize Cao, Yuntian Zhao, Ye Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes ADMM-based distributed model predictive control for collaborative loco-manipulation with multiple quadruped robots carrying payloads. Balances dynamic coupling awareness with computational scalability.

entry.title: Learning From Failures: Efficient Reinforcement Learning Control with Episodic Memory

author.name: Chenyang Miao

entry.summary: Proposes FEMA (Failure Episodic Memory Alert) that stores short-horizon failure experiences in episodic memory to prevent RL policies from repeatedly entering unstable states during training, guiding exploration toward longer horizons.

entry.title: Perceptive Variable-Timing Footstep Planning for Humanoid Locomotion on Disconnected Footholds

author.name: Zhaoyang Xiang, Upama Pant, Ayonga Hereid

entry.summary: Proposes perceptive mixed-integer MPC for humanoid footstep planning on disconnected footholds, jointly optimizing foot placement and step duration using DCM dynamics with ego-centric depth perception for steppable region extraction.

entry.title: Residual Control for Fast Recovery from Dynamics Shifts

author.name: Nethmi Jayasinghe, Diana Gontero, Francesco Migliarba, Spencer T. Brown, Vinod K. Sangwan, Mark C. Hersam, Amit Ranjan Trivedi

entry.summary: Proposes a residual control architecture for fast recovery from unobserved dynamics shifts during robot deployment. RL-trained residual policy shapes disturbances around a nominal stabilizing controller under frozen parameters.

entry.title: Uncertainty Mitigation and Intent Inference: A Dual-Mode Human-Machine Joint Planning System

author.name: Zeyu Fang, Yuxin Lin, Cheng Liu, Beomyeol Yu, Zeyuan Yang, Rongqian Chen, Taeyoung Lee, Mahdi Imani, Tian Lan

entry.summary: Proposes a unified human-robot joint planning system addressing both task knowledge gaps and latent human intent through two complementary modes: uncertainty-mitigation conversation and intent inference from human behavior.

entry.title: Long-Short Term Agents for Pure-Vision Bronchoscopy Robotic Autonomy

author.name: Junyang Wu, Mingyi Luo, Fangfang Xie, Minghui Zhang, Hanxiao Zhang, Chunxi Zhang, Junhao Wang, Jiayuan Sun, Yun Gu, Guang-Zhong Yang

entry.summary: Presents a vision-only bronchoscopic navigation framework using hierarchical long-short agents for long-horizon navigation without external tracking. Uses preoperative CT-derived targets and live endoscopic video.

entry.title: VORL-EXPLORE: A Hybrid Learning Planning Approach to Multi-Robot Exploration in Dynamic Environments

author.name: Ning Liu, Sen Shen, Zheng Li, Sheng Liu, Dongkun Han, Shangke Lyu, Thomas Braunl

entry.summary: Proposes VORL-EXPLORE, a hybrid learning-planning framework for multi-robot exploration in dynamic environments using 'execution fidelity' to couple task allocation with motion execution, addressing bottleneck clustering and oscillatory replanning.

entry.title: Multifingered force-aware control for humanoid robots

author.name: Pasquale Marra, Gabriele M. Caddeo, Ugo Pattacini, Lorenzo Natale

entry.summary: Addresses force-aware multi-fingered control for humanoid robots by training force estimators from tactile sensors and designing a controller that minimizes distance between Center of Pressure and fingertip contact polygon centroid.

entry.title: A General Lie-Group Framework for Continuum Soft Robot Modeling

author.name: Lingxiao Xun, Beno\^it Rosa, J\'er\^ome Szewczyk, Brahim Tamadazte

entry.summary: Introduces a general Lie group framework for continuum soft robot modeling using Cosserat rod theory with cumulative parameterization on SE(3). Provides unified analytical expressions for kinematics, statics, and dynamics.

entry.title: An Open-Source Robotics Research Platform for Autonomous Laparoscopic Surgery

author.name: Ariel Rodriguez, Lorenzo Mazza, Martin Lelis, Rayan Younis, Sebastian Bodenstedt, Martin Wagner, Stefanie Speidel

entry.summary: Presents an open-source, robot-agnostic Remote Center of Motion controller for autonomous laparoscopic surgery with a closed-form analytical velocity solver that enforces trocar constraints deterministically.

entry.title: CONTACT: CONtact-aware TACTile Learning for Robotic Disassembly

author.name: Yosuke Saka, Jyun-Chi Hu, Adeesh Desai, Zhiyuan Zhang, Bihao Zhang, Quan Khanh Luu, Md Rakibul Islam Prince, Minghui Zheng, Yu She

entry.summary: Systematically investigates the role of tactile sensing in robotic disassembly through simulation and real-world experiments across rigid and deformable scenarios, demonstrating when tactile feedback is critical.

entry.title: Diff-Muscle: Efficient Learning for Musculoskeletal Robotic Table Tennis

author.name: Wentao Zhao, Jun Guo, Kangyao Huang, Xin Liu, Huaping Liu

entry.summary: Proposes Diff-Muscle, using differential flatness to reformulate musculoskeletal robot control from high-dimensional muscle-activation space to lower-dimensional joint space, demonstrated on table tennis.

entry.title: Exp-Force: Experience-Conditioned Pre-Grasp Force Selection with Vision-Language Models

author.name: Siqi Shang, Minchao Huang, Bill Fan, Lillian Chin

entry.summary: Proposes Exp-Force, an experience-conditioned framework that predicts minimum feasible grasping force from a single RGB image by retrieving relevant prior experiences and conditioning a VLM for in-context force prediction.

entry.title: Missing No More: Dictionary-Guided Cross-Modal Image Fusion under Missing Infrared

author.name: Yafei Zhang, Meng Ma, Huafeng Li, Yu Liu

entry.summary: Addresses infrared-visible image fusion when the infrared modality is missing, using a dictionary-guided coefficient-domain framework. Learns shared convolutional dictionary to transfer visible coefficients to pseudo-IR representations.

entry.title: VertiAdaptor: Online Kinodynamics Adaptation for Vertically Challenging Terrain

author.name: Tong Xu, Chenhui Pan, Aniket Datar, Xuesu Xiao

entry.summary: Proposes VertiAdaptor, an online adaptation framework that integrates elevation with semantic embeddings for terrain-aware kinodynamic modeling using function encoders and neural ODE basis functions for off-road navigation.

entry.title: Preference-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning for Space-Time Efficient Online 3D Bin Packing

author.name: Nikita Sarawgi, Omey M. Manyar, Fan Wang, Thinh H. Nguyen, Daniel Seita, Satyandra K. Gupta

entry.summary: Proposes STEP for bin packing that explicitly reasons about the space-time trade-off between compact placement and execution speed, using preference-conditioned RL to balance packing benefit against operational time.

entry.title: Joint 3D Gravity and Magnetic Inversion via Rectified Flow and Ginzburg-Landau Guidance

author.name: Dhruman Gupta (Ashoka University), Yashas Shende (Ashoka University), Aritra Das (Ashoka University), Chanda Grover Kamra (Ashoka University), Debayan Gupta (Ashoka University)

entry.summary: Applies rectified flow models with Ginzburg-Landau guidance for joint 3D gravity and magnetic inversion in subsurface ore detection, capturing the distribution of possible solutions rather than a single regularized one.

entry.title: Physics-Consistent Neural Networks for Learning Deformation and Director Fields in Microstructured Media with Loss-Based Validation Criteria

author.name: Milad Shirani, Pete H. Gueldner, Murat Khidoyatov, Jeremy L. Warren, Federica Ninno

entry.summary: Develops physics-consistent neural networks for Cosserat elasticity problems, enforcing frame invariance and unit-length director constraints in the architecture for deformation and director field learning.

entry.title: Learning Hierarchical Knowledge in Text-Rich Networks with Taxonomy-Informed Representation Learning

author.name: Yunhui Liu, Yongchao Liu, Yinfeng Chen, Chuntao Hong, Tao Zheng, Tieke He

entry.summary: Proposes TIER, a taxonomy-informed representation learning method for text-rich networks that captures hierarchical knowledge structures from coarse to fine semantic levels.

entry.title: Fusion Complexity Inversion: Why Simpler Cross View Modules Outperform SSMs and Cross View Attention Transformers for Pasture Biomass Regression

author.name: Mridankan Mandal

entry.summary: Discovers 'fusion complexity inversion' principle in agricultural biomass estimation: simpler cross-view fusion modules outperform SSMs and attention transformers on scarce agricultural datasets.

entry.title: How Much Noise Can BERT Handle? Insights from Multilingual Sentence Difficulty Detection

author.name: Nouran Khallaf, Serge Sharoff

entry.summary: Assesses BERT's robustness to noisy training data for multilingual sentence difficulty detection. Evaluates denoising strategies including GMMs, Co-Teaching, and Label Smoothing for cross-lingual transfer settings.

entry.title: Supporting Workflow Reproducibility by Linking Bioinformatics Tools across Papers and Executable Code

author.name: Cl\'emence Sebe, Olivier Ferret, Aur\'elie N\'ev\'eol, Mahdi Esmailoghli, Ulf Leser, Sarah Cohen-Boulakia

entry.summary: Presents CoPaLink for linking bioinformatics tools across papers and executable code to support workflow reproducibility. Combines NER for tool mentions in text and code with entity linking grounded on knowledge bases.

entry.title: Margin-Consistent Deep Subtyping of Invasive Lung Adenocarcinoma via Perturbation Fidelity in Whole-Slide Image Analysis

author.name: Meghdad Sabouri Rad (Vincent), Junze (Vincent), Huang, Mohammad Mehdi Hosseini, Rakesh Choudhary, Saverio J. Carello, Ola El-Zammar, Michel R. Nasr, Bardia Rodd

entry.summary: Proposes a margin consistency framework for invasive lung adenocarcinoma subtyping in whole-slide images, combining attention-weighted patch aggregation with margin-aware training. Achieves robust feature-logit alignment across five subtypes.

entry.title: ColonSplat: Reconstruction of Peristaltic Motion in Colonoscopy with Dynamic Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Weronika Smolak-Dy\.zewska, Joanna Kaleta, Diego Dall'Alba, Przemys{\l}aw Spurek

entry.summary: Proposes ColonSplat for reconstructing peristaltic motion in colonoscopy using dynamic Gaussian splatting. Encodes deformation through rotation, scale, or opacity rather than spatial coordinate updates for the constrained colon environment.

entry.title: DLRMamba: Distilling Low-Rank Mamba for Edge Multispectral Fusion Object Detection

author.name: Qianqian Zhang, Leon Tabaro, Ahmed M. Abdelmoniem, Junshe An

entry.summary: Proposes Low-Rank SS2D for multispectral fusion object detection, reformulating Mamba state transitions via matrix factorization. Combined with distillation for edge deployment in maritime surveillance.

entry.title: TrajPred: Trajectory-Conditioned Joint Embedding Prediction for Surgical Instrument-Tissue Interaction Recognition in Vision-Language Models

author.name: Jiajun Cheng, Xiaofan Yu, Subarna, Sainan Liu, Shan Lin

entry.summary: TrajPred encodes instrument trajectories to incorporate temporal motion cues for surgical instrument-tissue interaction recognition in VLMs, addressing limitations in temporal information use and fine-grained action alignment.

entry.title: FabricGen: Microstructure-Aware Woven Fabric Generation

author.name: Yingjie Tang, Di Luo, Zixiong Wang, Xiaoli Ling, jian Yang, Beibei Wang

entry.summary: FabricGen generates woven fabric materials from text descriptions by decomposing macro-scale textures and micro-scale weaving patterns, fine-tuning diffusion models to respect weaving rules.

entry.title: SiamGM: Siamese Geometry-Aware and Motion-Guided Network for Real-Time Satellite Video Object Tracking

author.name: Zixiao Wen, Zhen Yang, Jiawei Li, Xiantai Xiang, Guangyao Zhou, Yuxin Hu, Yuhan Liu

entry.summary: SiamGM proposes a geometry-aware and motion-guided Siamese network for satellite video object tracking, addressing small target, blurred background, and aspect ratio challenges.

entry.title: Geometric Knowledge-Assisted Federated Dual Knowledge Distillation Approach Towards Remote Sensing Satellite Imagery

author.name: Luyao Zou, Fei Pan, Jueying Li, Yan Kyaw Tun, Apurba Adhikary, Zhu Han, Hayoung Oh

entry.summary: GK-FedDKD proposes geometric knowledge-guided federated dual knowledge distillation for remote sensing satellite imagery analysis. Addresses data heterogeneity across satellites through teacher-student distillation with geometric priors.

entry.title: A Multi-Layer Sim-to-Real Framework for Gaze-Driven Assistive Neck Exoskeletons

author.name: Colin Rubow, Eric Brewer, Ian Bales, Haohan Zhang, Daniel S. Brown

entry.summary: Develops a multi-layer sim-to-real framework for gaze-driven assistive neck exoskeletons, using VR to collect eye-head movement data to predict intended head movements from eye gaze alone. Proposes hierarchical controller selection from simulation through VR to real robot.

entry.title: Vision-Guided MPPI for Agile Drone Racing: Navigating Arbitrary Gate Poses via Neural Signed Distance Fields

author.name: Fangguo Zhao, Hanbing Zhang, Zhouheng Li, Xin Guan, Shuo Li

entry.summary: Proposes a vision-guided MPPI framework for autonomous drone racing using Gate-SDF, a neural signed distance field for implicit gate representation, enabling reference-free agile flight through arbitrarily placed gates.

entry.title: PanoDP: Learning Collision-Free Navigation with Panoramic Depth and Differentiable Physics

author.name: Hao Zhong, Pei Chi, Jiang Zhao, Shenghai Yuan, Xuyang Gao, Thien-Minh Nguyen, Lihua Xie

entry.summary: Presents PanoDP, a collision-free navigation framework combining panoramic depth perception with differentiable physics-based training. Uses dense differentiable collision terms rather than sparse terminal signals for policy optimization.

entry.title: AeroPlace-Flow: Language-Grounded Object Placement for Aerial Manipulators via Visual Foresight and Object Flow

author.name: Sarthak Mishra, Rishabh Dev Yadav, Naveen Nair, Wei Pan, Spandan Roy

entry.summary: Presents AeroPlace-Flow, a training-free framework for language-grounded aerial object placement using visual foresight (goal image synthesis) with 3D geometric reasoning and object flow for precise placement from language instructions.

entry.title: A Robust Antenna Provides Tactile Feedback in a Multi-legged Robot

author.name: Zhaochen J. Xu, Juntao He, Delfin Aydan, Malaika Taylor, Tianyu Wang, Jianfeng Lin, Wesley Dyer, Daniel I. Goldman

entry.summary: Develops tactile antennae for multi-legged robots with gradient compliance (stiff base, soft tip) inspired by centipede antennae, enabling real-time geometry sensing in confined spaces. From Daniel Goldman's lab at Georgia Tech.

entry.title: Reasoning Knowledge-Gap in Drone Planning via LLM-based Active Elicitation

author.name: Zeyu Fang, Beomyeol Yu, Cheng Liu, Zeyuan Yang, Rongqian Chen, Yuxin Lin, Mahdi Imani, Tian Lan

entry.summary: Proposes MINT (Minimal Information Neuro-Symbolic Tree) for drone planning that structures knowledge gaps into queryable format and uses LLMs to formulate optimal binary queries to resolve ambiguities with minimal human interaction.

entry.title: Contrastive-to-Self-Supervised: A Two-Stage Framework for Script Similarity Learning

author.name: Claire Roman, Philippe Meyer

entry.summary: Proposes a two-stage framework for learning script similarity: first training on labeled invented alphabets with contrastive loss, then extending to historical scripts via teacher-student distillation.

entry.title: OptiRoulette Optimizer: A New Stochastic Meta-Optimizer for up to 5.3x Faster Convergence

author.name: Stamatis Mastromichalakis

entry.summary: Presents OptiRoulette, a meta-optimizer that stochastically selects update rules during training from a pool of optimizers, with warmup locking and failure-aware replacement. Reports accuracy improvements on image classification benchmarks.

entry.title: Metalearning traffic assignment for network disruptions with graph convolutional neural networks

author.name: Serio Agriesti (Department of Technology, Management and Economics, Technical University of Denmark, Lyngby, Denmark), Guido Cantelmo (Department of Technology, Management and Economics, Technical University of Denmark, Lyngby, Denmark), Francisco Camara Pereira (Department of Technology, Management and Economics, Technical University of Denmark, Lyngby, Denmark)

entry.summary: Applies meta-learning with graph convolutional networks to traffic assignment problems under network disruptions, addressing the distribution shift when road network topology changes.

entry.title: Adaptive Double-Booking Strategy for Outpatient Scheduling Using Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Ninda Nurseha Amalina, Heungjo An

entry.summary: Proposes an adaptive outpatient double-booking framework combining individualized no-show prediction with multi-objective RL for clinic scheduling.

entry.title: Deterministic Fuzzy Triage for Legal Compliance Classification and Evidence Retrieval

author.name: Rian Atri

entry.summary: Studies deterministic dual encoders with fuzzy triage bands for legal compliance classification, emphasizing reproducibility and transparency for regulatory frameworks like HIPAA.

entry.title: Bayesian Transformer for Probabilistic Load Forecasting in Smart Grids

author.name: Sajib Debnath, Md. Uzzal Mia

entry.summary: Proposes a Bayesian Transformer for probabilistic load forecasting in smart grids, integrating Monte Carlo Dropout, variational layers, and stochastic attention with learnable Gaussian noise into a PatchTST backbone.

entry.title: Airborne Magnetic Anomaly Navigation with Neural-Network-Augmented Online Calibration

author.name: Antonia Hager, Sven Nebendahl, Alexej Klushyn, Jasper Krauser, Torleiv H. Bryne, Tor Arne Johansen

entry.summary: Presents a neural-network-augmented adaptive magnetic anomaly navigation system for aircraft with cold-start capability, combining extended Kalman filtering with physics-based magnetic interference compensation.

entry.title: Calibrated Credit Intelligence: Shift-Robust and Fair Risk Scoring with Bayesian Uncertainty and Gradient Boosting

author.name: Srikumar Nayak

entry.summary: Proposes Calibrated Credit Intelligence framework combining Bayesian neural scoring, fairness-constrained gradient boosting, and shift-aware recalibration for credit risk scoring under distribution shift.

entry.title: Fast and Flexible Audio Bandwidth Extension via Vocos

author.name: Yatharth Sharma

entry.summary: Proposes a Vocos-based audio bandwidth extension model that enhances audio from 8-48kHz with a single network supporting arbitrary upsampling ratios, achieving real-time factor of 0.0001 on A100 GPU.

entry.title: Learning embeddings of non-linear PDEs: the Burgers' equation

author.name: Pedro Taranc\'on-\'Alvarez, Leonid Sarieddine, Pavlos Protopapas, Raul Jimenez

entry.summary: Presents a method to construct solution embedding spaces for nonlinear PDEs (Burgers' equation) using multi-head PINNs and PCA, learning latent representations across initial conditions and viscosity values.

entry.title: Pareto-Optimal Anytime Algorithms via Bayesian Racing

author.name: Jonathan Wurth, Helena Stegherr, Neele Kemper, Michael Heider, J\"org H\"ahner

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for anytime algorithm comparison as Pareto optimization over time using rankings instead of raw objective values, addressing normalization and coherent aggregation challenges.

entry.title: Fine-Grained Table Retrieval Through the Lens of Complex Queries

author.name: Wojciech Kosiuk, Xingyu Ji, Yeounoh Chung, Fatma \"Ozcan, Madelon Hulsebos

entry.summary: Proposes DCTR, a fine-grained table retrieval mechanism using typed query decomposition and global connectivity-awareness for open-domain QA over relational databases. Evaluates along axes of query and data complexity.

entry.title: Sandpiper: Orchestrated AI-Annotation for Educational Discourse at Scale

author.name: Daryl Hedley, Doug Pietrzak, Jorge Dias, Ian Burden, Bakhtawar Ahtisham, Zhuqian Zhou, Kirk Vanacore, Josh Marland, Rachel Slama, Justin Reich, Kenneth Koedinger, Ren\'e Kizilcec

entry.summary: Presents Sandpiper, a mixed-initiative system coupling researcher dashboards with agentic LLM engines for scalable analysis of educational discourse data. Bridges high-volume conversational data with qualitative expertise.

entry.title: Does Semantic Noise Initialization Transfer from Images to Videos? A Paired Diagnostic Study

author.name: Yixiao Jing, Chaoyu Zhang, Zixuan Zhong, Peizhou Huang

entry.summary: Benchmarks semantic noise initialization for text-to-video diffusion against standard Gaussian noise. Finds no statistically significant improvement (p~0.17), with temporal coupling introducing instabilities not seen in image diffusion.

entry.title: Optimizing Multi-Modal Models for Image-Based Shape Retrieval: The Role of Pre-Alignment and Hard Contrastive Learning

author.name: Paul Julius K\"uhn, Cedric Spengler, Michael Weinmann, Arjan Kuijper, Saptarshi Neil Sinha

entry.summary: Addresses image-based 3D shape retrieval using large-scale multi-modal pretraining with pre-aligned image-point cloud encoders from ULIP/OpenShape, showing explicit view-based supervision is unnecessary for competitive IBSR performance.

entry.title: Virtual Try-On for Cultural Clothing: A Benchmarking Study

author.name: Muhammad Tausif Ul Islam, Shahir Awlad, Sameen Yeaser Adib, Md. Atiqur Rahman, Sabbir Ahmed, Md. Hasanul Kabir

entry.summary: BD-VITON introduces a virtual try-on dataset for Bangladeshi garments (saree, panjabi, salwar kameez), benchmarking existing models on culturally diverse clothing with complex draping and layering.

entry.title: Looking Into the Water by Unsupervised Learning of the Surface Shape

author.name: Ori Lifschitz, Tali Treibitz, Dan Rosenbaum

entry.summary: Uses dual neural-field networks to model water surface height and underlying image color, enabling unsupervised removal of refraction distortions from aerial water imagery. Leverages SIREN architectures for effective implicit representation.

entry.title: Enhancing Unregistered Hyperspectral Image Super-Resolution via Unmixing-based Abundance Fusion Learning

author.name: Yingkai Zhang, Tao Zhang, Jing Nie, Ying Fu

entry.summary: Proposes unmixing-based fusion framework for unregistered hyperspectral image super-resolution that decouples spatial-spectral information. Uses SVD for spectral unmixing with deformable aggregation for handling misalignment.

entry.title: OSCAR: Occupancy-based Shape Completion via Acoustic Neural Implicit Representations

author.name: Magdalena Wysocki, Kadir Burak Buldu, Miruna-Alexandra Gafencu, Mohammad Farid Azampour, Nassir Navab

entry.summary: OSCAR uses occupancy-based neural implicit representations for 3D vertebral anatomy reconstruction from ultrasound, enabling label-free shape completion during inference through a coupled latent space of image appearance and anatomical shape.

entry.title: Weakly Supervised Teacher-Student Framework with Progressive Pseudo-mask Refinement for Gland Segmentation

author.name: Hikmat Khan, Wei Chen, Muhammad Khalid Khan Niazi

entry.summary: Proposes a weakly supervised teacher-student framework for gland segmentation using sparse pathologist annotations and EMA-stabilized teacher networks for pseudo-mask refinement.

entry.title: ImprovedGS+: A High-Performance C++/CUDA Re-Implementation Strategy for 3D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Jordi Mu\~noz Vicente

entry.summary: ImprovedGS+ reimplements the ImprovedGS 3D Gaussian Splatting strategy in optimized C++/CUDA, achieving significant training speedups through kernel fusion and hardware-optimized implementations.

entry.title: Extend Your Horizon: A Device-Agnostic Surgical Tool Tracking Framework with Multi-View Optimization for Augmented Reality

author.name: Jiaming Zhang, Mingxu Liu, Hongchao Shu, Ruixing Liang, Yihao Liu, Ojas Taskar, Amir Kheradmand, Mehran Armand, Alejandro Martin-Gomez

entry.summary: Presents a device-agnostic framework for tracking surgical instruments under occlusion by fusing multiple view sources across head-mounted displays and optical tracking systems in augmented reality.

entry.title: A Primer on Evolutionary Frameworks for Near-Field Multi-Source Localization

author.name: Seyed Jalaleddin Mousavirad, Parisa Ramezani, Mattias O'Nils, Emil Bj\"ornson

entry.summary: Introduces evolutionary frameworks for near-field multi-source localization that operate on continuous signal models without requiring labeled data or discretized grids, supporting arbitrary array geometries.

entry.title: Gradient-based Nested Co-Design of Aerodynamic Shape and Control for Winged Robots

author.name: Daniele Affinita, Mingda Xu, Beno\^it Valentin Gherardi, Pascal Fua

entry.summary: Presents a gradient-based nested co-design framework that jointly optimizes aerodynamic shape and motion planning for winged robots. Uses a neural surrogate model for aerodynamic forces within a differentiable optimal control pipeline.

entry.title: Failure Mechanisms and Risk Estimation for Legged Robot Locomotion on Granular Slopes

author.name: Xingjue Liao, Feifei Qian

entry.summary: Systematically studies failure mechanisms of legged robots on granular slopes, measuring locomotion speed alongside slope-dependent granular resistive forces. Develops a robot-terrain interaction model predicting anchoring timing, step length, and speed as functions of terrain properties.

entry.title: LITHE: Bridging Best-Effort Python and Real-Time C++ for Hot-Swapping Robotic Control Laws on Commodity Linux

author.name: He Kai Lim, Tyler R. Clites

entry.summary: Presents LITHE, a lightweight software architecture that enables Python high-level control to hot-swap C++ real-time control laws on commodity hardware (Raspberry Pi), collapsing the robot control hierarchy onto a single board.

entry.title: GSAT: Geometric Traversability Estimation using Self-supervised Learning with Anomaly Detection for Diverse Terrains

author.name: Dongjin Cho, Miryeong Park, Juhui Lee, Geonmo Yang, Younggun Cho

entry.summary: Proposes GSAT, a self-supervised geometric traversability estimation method using anomaly detection to address the positive-only learning problem. Constructs positive hypersphere in learned feature space for identifying non-traversable terrain.

entry.title: Inverse Resistive Force Theory (I-RFT): Learning granular properties through robot-terrain physical interactions

author.name: Shipeng Liu, Feng Xue, Yifeng Zhang, Tarunika Ponnusamy, Feifei Qian

entry.summary: Introduces Inverse Resistive Force Theory (I-RFT), integrating granular resistive force theory with Gaussian Processes to infer terrain properties from arbitrary foot trajectories during natural locomotion.

entry.summary: Presents a communication-free multi-UAV coordination method for GNSS-denied forest environments using only onboard LiDAR for SLAM, obstacle detection, and robot detection. Includes perception-aware 3D navigation with limited sensor FOV.

entry.title: Might An LLM Be Conscious?

author.name: SE Gyges

entry.summary: Extensive philosophical exploration of whether LLMs could be conscious, covering definitions of consciousness, philosophical frameworks, and implications. Prompted by Anthropic employees' statements about potential model consciousness.

entry.title: Conversational Demand Response: Bidirectional Aggregator-Prosumer Coordination through Agentic AI

author.name: Reda El Makroum, Sebastian Zwickl-Bernhard, Lukas Kranzl, Hans Auer

entry.title: Exploring Human-in-the-Loop Themes in AI Application Development: An Empirical Thematic Analysis

entry.title: VDCook:DIY video data cook your MLLMs

author.name: Chengwei Wu
