entry.title: Evaluating Austrian A-Level German Essays with Large Language Models for Automated Essay Scoring

author.name: Jonas Kubesch, Lena Huber, Clemens Havas

entry.summary: Evaluates open-weight LLMs (DeepSeek-R1, Qwen3, Mixtral, Llama3.3) for automated essay scoring of Austrian A-level German texts, focusing on rubric-based evaluation.

entry.title: Ensemble Graph Neural Networks for Probabilistic Sea Surface Temperature Forecasting via Input Perturbations

author.name: Alejandro J. Gonz\'alez-Santana, Giovanny A. Cuervo-Londo\~no, Javier S\'anchez

entry.summary: Investigates ensemble GNN strategies for sea surface temperature forecasting, using input perturbation at inference time to generate diverse predictions without retraining.

entry.title: LiveSense: A Real-Time Wi-Fi Sensing Platform for Range-Doppler on COTS Laptop

author.name: Jessica Sanson, Rahul C. Shah, Maximilian Pinaroc, Cagri Tanriover, Valerio Frascolla

entry.title: Implementation of Quantum Implicit Neural Representation in Deterministic and Probabilistic Autoencoders for Image Reconstruction/Generation Tasks

author.name: Saadet M\"uzehher Eren

entry.summary: Proposes quantum implicit neural representation (QINR) based autoencoders and VAEs for image reconstruction/generation, demonstrating that QINR decoders can produce rich high-frequency features and are more stable than quantum GANs.

entry.title: xaitimesynth: A Python Package for Evaluating Attribution Methods for Time Series with Synthetic Ground Truth

author.name: Naqcho Ali Mehdi, Amir Ali

author.name: Zaid Abdullah, Merouane Debbah, Symeon Chatzinotas, Bjorn Ottersten

entry.title: EAGLE-Pangu: Accelerator-Safe Tree Speculative Decoding on Ascend NPUs

entry.title: Explainable Condition Monitoring via Probabilistic Anomaly Detection Applied to Helicopter Transmissions

author.name: Aurelio Raffa Ugolini, Jessica Leoni, Valentina Breschi, Damiano Paniccia, Francesco Aldo Tucci, Luigi Capone, Mara Tanelli

entry.title: Revisiting Gradient Staleness: Evaluating Distance Metrics for Asynchronous Federated Learning Aggregation

author.name: Patrick Wilhelm, Odej Kao

entry.title: TA-RNN-Medical-Hybrid: A Time-Aware and Interpretable Framework for Mortality Risk Prediction

author.name: Xiaoyi Wang, Long Feng, Zhaojun Wang

entry.title: Explainable and Hardware-Efficient Jamming Detection for 5G Networks Using the Convolutional Tsetlin Machine

It demonstrates how shared learning principles can explain many features of early language development.

author.name: Lizhi Ma, Yi-Xiang Hu, Yihui Ren, Feng Wu, Xiang-Yang Li

entry.summary: Presents an innovative 3D imaging approach for field evaluation of large aggregates using mobile device videos. Combines 3D reconstruction with segmentation for size and shape analysis of aggregate stockpiles.

entry.title: XMACNet: An Explainable Lightweight Attention based CNN with Multi Modal Fusion for Chili Disease Classification

author.name: Tapon Kumer Ray, Rajkumar Y, Shalini R, Srigayathri K, Jayashree S, Lokeswari P

entry.summary: Proposes XMACNet, a lightweight CNN using self-attention and multi-modal fusion of RGB images and vegetation indices (NDVI, NPCI, MCARI) for chili disease detection. Uses StyleGAN for data augmentation.

entry.title: Material Driven HRI Design: Aesthetics as Explainability

author.name: Natalie Friedman, Kevin Weatherwax, Chengchao Zhu

entry.summary: Argues that robot aesthetics should function as interaction signals rather than decoration, proposing that fashion-inspired material, color, and texture choices can communicate robot capabilities and set appropriate user expectations.

entry.title: Model-based thermal drift compensation for high-precision hexapod robot actuators

author.name: Cl\'ement Robert, Alain Vissiere, Olivier Company, Pierre Noire, Thierry Roux, S\'ebastien Krut

entry.summary: Proposes model-based thermal drift compensation for high-precision hexapod robot actuators by linking actuator expansion state to surface temperature measurements, enabling positioning error correction.

entry.title: Moloch v. Themis

author.name: Stephen Martin

entry.summary: Extends Scott Alexander's Moloch concept by proposing 'Themis' as an alternative coordination mechanism—a rational and fair system that enforces cooperation and is demonstrably better for all participants.

entry.title: Technical Report: Automated Optical Inspection of Surgical Instruments

author.name: Zunaira Shafqat, Atif Aftab Ahmed Jilani, Qurrat Ul Ain

entry.summary: Technical report on automated optical inspection of surgical instruments using AI to detect manufacturing defects like cracks, rust, and structural irregularities.

entry.title: One-Shot Badminton Shuttle Detection for Mobile Robots

author.name: Florentin Dipner, William Talbot, Turcan Tuna, Andrei Cramariuc, Marco Hutter

entry.summary: Presents a one-shot badminton shuttlecock detection framework with a dataset of 20,510 annotated frames. Proposes semi-automatic annotation pipeline and achieves F1 0.86 with fine-tuned YOLOv8.

entry.title: A Hybrid Machine Learning Model for Cerebral Palsy Detection

author.name: Karan Kumar Singh, Nikita Gajbhiye, Gouri Sankar Mishra

entry.summary: Presents a hybrid ML model for cerebral palsy detection from brain MRI images using preprocessing and classification techniques.

entry.title: Evolving Symbiosis, from Barricelli's Legacy to Collective Intelligence: a simulated and conceptual approach

author.name: James Ashford, Marko Cvjetko, Richard L\"offler, Berfin Sakallioglu, Alessandro Valerio, Marta Tataryn, Benedikt Hartl, L\'eo Pio-Lopez, Stefano Nichele

entry.summary: Documents work from the ALICE 2026 workshop replicating and extending Barricelli's 1953 symbiogenesis experiments with numerical organisms (1D cellular automata), extending to 2D and exploring DNA-norms. Discusses implications for artificial life, open-endedness, and collective intelligence.

entry.title: LLM Self-Expression Through Concept Albums, Part 2

author.name: Josh Snider

entry.summary: Creative experiment giving various LLMs (Claude Sonnet 4.6, Haiku 4.5, Gemini 3.1 Pro/Flash-Lite, GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark) freedom to design concept albums, then producing the music videos. Explores LLM creative expression.

entry.title: Distilling Replacing Guilt

author.name: Matthew Farrugia-Roberts

entry.summary: Summary and distillation of Nate Soares' 'Replacing Guilt' sequence, framing it as 'effective affectism'—careful analysis of emotions to determine which should be endorsed or dismissed for better motivation.

entry.summary: Announcement for UChicago XLab's summer AI safety research fellowship and replication fellowship programs.
